words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: The children noticed patterns in the tiles on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们注意到了地板瓷砖上的模式。
words.en: Designs or motifs that are repeated in a predictable sequence.

words.ex: I eat vegetables every day for health.
words.ex_cn: 为了健康，我每天都吃蔬菜。
words.en: Plants or parts of plants that are eaten as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.tr: v. 保持；保留；“keep”的现在分词； n. 一致；保管；
words.ex: She is keeping the room clean.
words.ex_cn: 她正在保持房间干净。
words.en: The act of holding onto something or maintaining it in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: Bread is a food made from flour, water, and usually yeast, mixed together and baked.

words.tr: n. 价值观；道德标准；价值；（数）值；“value”的复数； v. 重视；珍视；
words.ex: My family teaches me important values like honesty and kindness.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人教给我诚实和善良等重要的价值观。
words.en: The principles or standards of behavior; one's judgment of what is important in life.

words.tr: n. 冲浪运动； v. 冲浪；“surf”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves surfing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末冲浪。
words.en: Surfing is the sport of riding on the top of a wave while standing or lying on a special board.

words.ex: He gradually learned to ride a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渐渐学会了骑自行车。
words.en: If something changes or is done gradually, it changes or is done in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.ex: The manufacturers make cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这些制造商在这个工厂生产汽车。
words.en: Companies or individuals that produce goods in large quantities, typically using machinery.

words.ex: He has many followers on Instagram.
words.ex_cn: 他在Instagram上有许多粉丝。
words.en: People who support and admire a particular person or set of ideas.

words.ex: He is organising a party this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他正在这个周末组织一场派对。
words.en: To arrange or plan something such as an event or system.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.tr: n. 交会处；十字路口； v. 穿过；“cross”的现在分词；
words.ex: Be careful at the crossing near the school.
words.ex_cn: 在学校附近的交会处要小心。
words.en: A crossing is a place where something such as a road, river, or railway can be crossed safely.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；“habitat”的复数；
words.ex: Birds live in natural habitats like forests and wetlands.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类生活在森林和湿地等自然栖息地中。
words.en: The natural environment in which an animal or plant usually lives.

words.tr: v. 携带；“carry”的现在分词； adj. 运送的；运输的；
words.ex: He is carrying a bag to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正带着一个包去学校。
words.en: The act of holding or moving something from one place to another.

words.tr: n. 意思；意义； v. 表示…的意思；意思；“mean”的现在分词；
words.ex: What is the meaning of this word?
words.ex_cn: 这个词的意思是什么？
words.en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents.

words.tr: n. 录制的音像；记录；“recording”的复数；
words.ex: He listened to the recordings of his favorite songs.
words.ex_cn: 他听了他最爱歌曲的录音。
words.en: Recordings are sounds or images that have been stored on a tape, disc, or computer so that they can be heard or seen again.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.ex: He paid five euros for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五欧元买面包。
words.en: The currency unit used by the member countries of the European Union.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: The cats chased the mice in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 猫在厨房里追老鼠。
words.en: Mice are small rodents that are typically characterized by a pointed snout, small rounded ears, a body-length scaly tail, and a high breeding rate.

words.ex: I look at old photos to remember my childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 我看着老照片来回忆我的童年记忆。
words.en: Memories are things that you remember about the past.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.tr: adj.(游览等）有导游做向导的【动词guide的过去分词】
words.ex: He was guided by his teacher to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他被老师引导着解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you are guided by someone or something, you use them as your guide or follow their advice.

words.ex: The museum gets many visits every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆每个周末都迎来许多参观者。
words.en: If you visit someone, you go to see them and spend time with them. If you visit a place, you go there for a short time.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: Everybody likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: Every person; everyone.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.tr:
adj. 第十七的；
n. 第十七；
words.ex: This is the seventeenth chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 这是这本书的第十七章。
words.en: The seventeenth item in a series is the one that you count as number seventeen.

words.ex: The rivers flow into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入大海。
words.en: Rivers are large natural streams of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.tr: n. 姓名；名称；“name”的复数； v. 说出…的名字；
words.ex: He wrote down the names of all the students.
words.ex_cn: 他写下了所有学生的姓名。
words.en: A name is a word or set of words by which a person, animal, place, or thing is known, addressed, or referred to.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 总费用是50美元。
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.tr: v. 开展（活动）；发动；发射；发射( launch的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The school launched a clean-up campaign last week.
words.ex_cn: 学校上周开展了一次清洁活动。
words.en: To set or thrust (a self-propelled craft or projectile) in motion.

words.ex: He enjoys collecting stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢收集邮票。
words.en: The act of gathering items together, especially as a hobby or for study.

words.tr: v. 建议；推荐；“recommend”过去式和过去分词； adj. 被推荐的；
words.ex: The doctor recommended rest for two days.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议休息两天。
words.en: If something is recommended, it is suggested as being good or suitable for a particular purpose or job.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr: v. 表现；行动；“act”的现在分词； n. 演戏；演技；
words.ex: He is acting bravely in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中表现得很勇敢。
words.en: Acting is the activity or profession of performing in plays, films, or television productions.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.tr:
n. 水果；
v. 结果实；
words.ex: I like fruit.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果。
words.en: The edible part of a plant that develops from a flower, especially one that is sweet and contains seeds.

words.tr: adj. 丰饶的；富有的；富裕的；
words.ex: The land is rich in minerals.
words.ex_cn: 这片土地矿物丰富。
words.en: Having a great deal of money or assets; wealthy.

words.tr: adj. 有责任的；负责任的；
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

words.ex: His mistakes had serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 他的错误带来了严重的后果。
words.en: The results or effects of actions or conditions.

words.tr:
adv. 昨天；
n. 昨天；
words.ex: I saw her yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天见到她了。
words.en: The day before today.

words.tr: adj. 已退休的；已退职的； v. 退休；“retire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My retired grandfather walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我已退休的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Having left one's job and ceased to work.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.tr: adj. 受控制的； v. 控制；“control”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The experiment was conducted in a controlled environment.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是在受控制的环境中进行的。
words.en: If something is controlled, it is done or organized according to a particular method or system.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.ex: He learned new techniques to fix the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了新的技术来修理这台机器。
words.en: Techniques are methods or ways of doing something, especially those that require skill.

words.ex: The tips of the trees touched the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 树的末端触到了云朵。
words.en: Tips can refer to a small amount of money given to someone for performing a service, a piece of advice, or the pointed end of something. As a verb, it means to give a tip, to tilt, or to touch lightly.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.tr: v. 完成；“complete”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 完整的；已完成的；
words.ex: He completed his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: Having all necessary or normal parts, components, or steps; fully carried out or accomplished.

words.ex: You ought to finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你应当在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: You use 'ought' to indicate that it is morally right or advisable for someone to do something, or to indicate that it is probable that something is true or will happen.

words.ex: The prices of fruits went up last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周水果的价格上涨了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.tr: v. 抓住；赶上；“catch”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boy caught a fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在河里抓到了一条鱼。
words.en: Caught is the past tense and past participle of catch, which means to seize or capture something or someone.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.tr: v. 抓住；持有；举行；容纳；保存；“hold”的现在分词； n. 土地；
words.ex: He is holding the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他正紧紧地抓住绳子。
words.en: A holding is a piece of land that is owned by someone or the shares that someone owns in a company.

words.ex: He listens to music to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他听音乐来放松。
words.en: If you relax or if something relaxes you, you feel more calm and less worried or tense.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He has good habits every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有好习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.tr: n. 态度；姿势（复数形式）；
words.ex: His attitudes toward homework are very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, especially as shown by your behavior.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.ex: The woman is walking her dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个女人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A woman is an adult female human being.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.ex: We walk in the park on evenings.
words.ex_cn: 我们在夜晚去公园散步。
words.en: The period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.tr: v. 发展；发育；“develop”的现在分词； adj. 发展中的；
words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: A developing country or area of the world is poorer and has less advanced industries, especially in Africa, Latin America, or Asia.

words.ex: This is the greatest number of students in our class.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们班人数最多的时候。
words.en: The superlative form of great, used to describe something that is the largest in size, extent, or degree, or the most important or significant.

words.ex: The train stops at five stations.
words.ex_cn: 火车在五个车站停靠。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that passengers can get on or off, or goods can be loaded or unloaded. It can also refer to a building or buildings at such a place, or to a company that broadcasts radio or television programmes.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.ex: Many small businesses open near schools.
words.ex_cn: 许多小生意在学校附近开张。
words.en: Businesses are organizations that produce or sell goods or services in order to make a profit.

words.tr: adv. 部分地；在一定程度上；
words.ex: The cake is partly eaten.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕被部分吃掉了。
words.en: To some extent but not completely.

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.ex: The rain is affecting the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 雨正在影响野餐。
words.en: If something is affecting, it makes you feel strong emotions, especially sadness or pity.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.ex: The improvements in his English helped him pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他英语的改善帮助他通过了考试。
words.en: Improvements are changes that make something better or more satisfactory.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.tr: v. 建造；构造；“construct”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They constructed a new house last year.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年建造了一所新房子。
words.en: If you construct something, you build, make, or create it.

words.ex: He watched the game closely.
words.ex_cn: 他紧密地观看了比赛。
words.en: In a way that is very near in space or time; with little or no space or time in between.

words.tr: n. 空地；空间；空白；“space”的复数；
words.ex: The children play in the open spaces.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在空地上玩耍。
words.en: Spaces refer to the areas that are empty or available for use, or the distances between things.

words.ex: I receive a letter from my friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周都收到朋友的一封信。
words.en: To get or be given something; to welcome someone officially or socially.

words.ex: The child is quiet during nap time.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在午睡时很安静。
words.en: Making little or no noise; free from disturbance or tumult; tranquil; calm.

words.tr: v. （使）留痕迹；做标记；评分；“mark”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 明显的；显著的；有记号的；
words.ex: The storm marked the old tree with deep scratches.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在那棵老树上留下了深深的划痕。
words.en: A marked change or difference is very obvious and easily noticed.

words.ex: He plays soccer as his favorite sport.
words.ex_cn: 他把足球当作最喜欢的体育运动。
words.en: Sport is a physical activity that is governed by a set of rules or customs and often engaged in competitively.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.tr: v. 摧毁；破坏；“destroy”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The storm destroyed the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那所房子。
words.en: If something is destroyed, it is so badly damaged that it cannot be repaired or no longer exists.

words.tr: v. 分裂；分割；“divide”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 分裂的；分开的；
words.ex: The team was divided over the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队对这个新计划意见分裂。
words.en: If something is divided, it has been separated into parts or groups which are often in conflict with each other.

words.ex: He showed me his images from the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他旅行时拍的照片。
words.en: Pictures or photographs, especially those created electronically.

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.tr: n. 测试；“test”的复数； v. 考验；
words.ex: The students took math tests last week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们上周参加了数学测试。
words.en: A test is a series of questions, problems, or practical tasks to gauge someone's knowledge, experience, or ability.

words.tr: n. 英里（mile 的复数形式）
words.ex: He runs five miles every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑五英里。
words.en: A unit of linear measure equal to 5,280 feet or approximately 1.609 kilometers.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.tr: v. 管理；设法做到；完成（困难的事）；“manage”的现在分词； adj. 经营的；善经营的；
words.ex: He is managing a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他正在管理一家小商店。
words.en: Managing refers to the process of dealing with or controlling things or people. It can also mean to succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: He understands difficult situations easily.
words.ex_cn: 他很容易理解复杂的情况。
words.en: Situations refer to the set of circumstances in which one finds oneself; a state of affairs.

words.ex: Different cultures have different traditions.
words.ex_cn: 不同的文化有不同的传统。
words.en: The customs, arts, social institutions, and achievements of a particular nation, people, or other social group.

words.tr:
n. 营地；
v. 宿营；露营；
words.ex: The children set up a camp near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边搭了一个营地。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.tr: v. 测量；“measure”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 慎重的；谨慎小心的；
words.ex: He measured the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他测量了桌子的长度。
words.en: If you describe someone's way of speaking as measured, you mean that it is slow and deliberate, often because they are trying to hide their feelings.

words.ex: The boat floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水面上浮动。
words.en: To float means to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink, or to move slowly in the air or on water.

words.tr:
n. 上升；提高；
v. 上升；提高；
words.ex: There was a rise in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.tr:
v. 看待；有关；
n. 尊敬；致意；
words.ex: I regard him as a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他看作好朋友。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.tr: adj. 被损坏的； v. 损害；“damage”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The damaged car could not start.
words.ex_cn: 这辆受损的车无法启动。
words.en: If something is damaged, it is harmed or spoiled.

words.ex: Birds begin migration in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在秋天开始迁徙。
words.en: The movement of people, animals, or birds from one place to another, especially regularly according to the seasons.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: He majored in arts at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修人文学科。
words.en: The arts are activities such as music, painting, literature, film, and dance, which people can take part in for enjoyment, or to create works which express important meanings or ideas.

words.tr: v. 拥有；“own”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 自身拥有的；
words.ex: He owned a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年拥有一家小店。
words.en: Possessed or controlled by someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: Dolphins swim happily in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 海豚在海洋中快乐地游动。
words.en: Dolphins are a group of aquatic mammals related to whales and porpoises. They are found worldwide, mostly in the shallower seas of the continental shelves, and are carnivores, mostly eating fish and squid.

words.ex: She uses natural dyes to color her clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用天然染料给衣服上色。
words.en: A dye is a substance used to change the color of something, especially fabrics or hair.

words.ex: The children walk along different paths to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们走不同的路去上学。
words.en: Paths are routes or tracks between one place and another, often made by people walking.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.ex: He ran 100 meters in 9 seconds.
words.ex_cn: 他用9秒跑完了100米。
words.en: A second is one of the sixty parts that a minute is divided into. People often say 'a second' to mean a very short time.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr: v. 失去；输；“lose”的现在分词； n. 失败；损失；
words.ex: He is losing his keys again.
words.ex_cn: 他又在丢钥匙。
words.en: The act of failing to win or to keep something.

words.ex: Wildfires started at several hotspots in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 森林中的几个热点发生了野火。
words.en: Hotspots are places of significant activity or interest, especially those that are popular or problematic.

words.tr: v. 描述；“describe”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He described the cat as black and small.
words.ex_cn: 他描述这只猫是黑色且小巧的。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.tr: v. 供应（食物）；起作用；为……服务；对……有用；提供（产品或服务）；任职；
words.ex: The waiter served soup and bread.
words.ex_cn: 服务员上了汤和面包。
words.en: To serve means to perform duties or services for (a person, an organization, or a cause).

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.tr:
n. 种子；籽；
v. 播种；
words.ex: The farmer planted the seed in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把种子种在土里。
words.en: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

words.tr: n. 标签；“label”的复数； v. 贴标签；
words.ex: The bottles have clear labels.
words.ex_cn: 这些瓶子上有清晰的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, plastic, or other material which is attached to an object and gives information about it.

words.ex: The elephant walks slowly in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 大象在动物园里慢慢走。
words.en: An elephant is a very large animal with a long trunk, large ears, and two long curved tusks. Elephants are found in Africa and Asia.

words.ex: He makes beautiful origami with paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸折出漂亮的折纸。
words.en: Origami is the Japanese art of folding paper into decorative shapes and figures.

words.ex: I play soccer with my friends on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我在周末和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: The period from Friday evening to Sunday night, especially regarded as a time for leisure.

words.ex: The book costs ten pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书售价十英镑。
words.en: A unit of weight equal to 16 ounces (453.592 grams). Also, the basic monetary unit of the UK, equal to 100 pence.

words.ex: The outcome is depending on your effort.
words.ex_cn: 结果依赖于你的努力。
words.en: If you say that something depends or is depending on something else, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.tr: adj. 固定的；不能变的； v. 修理；固定；确定；“fix”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a fixed schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有一个固定的日程。
words.en: If something is fixed, it is attached or positioned so that it cannot move, or is arranged in a particular way and cannot be changed.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.tr: adj. 可选择的；非强制的；
words.ex: The field trip is optional.
words.ex_cn: 这次郊游是可选的。
words.en: If something is optional, you can choose whether or not you do it or have it.

words.tr:
adj. 第十八的；
n. 第十八；
words.ex: He was born on the eighteenth day of May.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于五月十八日。
words.en: The eighteenth item in a series is the one that you count as number eighteen.

words.ex: He has fifty dollars in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有五十美元。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and ten; ten more than forty; 50.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.tr: n. 介绍信；参考；引用；提及；“reference”的复数；
words.ex: He gave me three references for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提供了三封介绍信用于这份工作。
words.en: References are mentions of something or someone, or the act of looking at something for information.

words.ex: He read three articles about history.
words.ex_cn: 他读了三篇关于历史的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or journal. It can also refer to a particular item or object, especially one of a set, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸有十版。
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: The streets are busy with cars and people.
words.ex_cn: 街道上汽车和行人很多。
words.en: The streets refer to public roads in a city, town, or village, typically with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.ex: He runs faster than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟快。
words.en: Comparative of fast: moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.tr: adv. 极大地；值得注目地；
words.ex: The new policy significantly improved student performance.
words.ex_cn: 新政策极大地改善了学生的成绩。
words.en: In a way that is large or important enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.ex: He has three interviews this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周有三场面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study, or in order to find out their opinions or experiences.

words.tr: v. 出版；发布；“publish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 出版了的；发布了的；
words.ex: He published a book last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年出版了一本书。
words.en: To publish something means to make it available to the public, usually by printing it in a book, magazine, or newspaper, or by broadcasting it on the radio or television.

words.ex: The media reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 媒介迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.ex: He will possibly come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天可能会来。
words.en: You use possibly to indicate that something is true or might be true, but you are not certain.

words.tr: n. 模样；面貌；方面；朝向；“aspect”的复数；
words.ex: The aspects of the old house still look charming.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的外貌仍然很迷人。
words.en: a particular part or feature of something

words.ex: The book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section is a distinct part or subdivision of something, such as a document, a city, or an object.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.tr:
n. 修理；修补；
v. 修理；修补；
words.ex: The repair of the car took two days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的修理花了两天时间。
words.en: To repair something that is damaged or not working properly means to fix it.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.ex: The movements for clean water grew stronger last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年，清洁用水的活动变得更强烈了。
words.en: Movements refer to the act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place. It can also denote a group of people working together to advance their shared political, social, or artistic ideas.

words.tr: v. 成长；种植；养成；变得；“grow”的过去式；
words.ex: The tree grew tall near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在房子附近长高了。
words.en: Grew is the past tense of grow, which means to increase in size or amount, or to become something different.

words.ex: He uses simple strategies to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他使用简单的策略来解决数学问题。
words.en: A strategy is a plan or method chosen to bring about a desired future, such as achieving a goal or solving a problem.

words.tr: v. 改善；改进；“improve”的现在分词； n. 改善；改进；
words.ex: He is improving his English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在改善他的英语。
words.en: If something improves or if you improve it, it gets better.

words.tr: v. 提议；“propose”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被提议的；
words.ex: He proposed a new plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他提议了一个新的省钱计划。
words.en: If you propose something such as a plan or an idea, you suggest it for people to think about and decide upon.

words.tr: v. 抵达；抵港；抵港（arrive 的过去式）； adj. 已到达的；
words.ex: He arrived at the station at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他下午五点到达了车站。
words.en: If someone or something arrives at a place, they come to it from somewhere else.

words.tr: v. 邀请；“invite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He invited his friends to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他邀请了他的朋友来参加派对。
words.en: If you are invited to do something, you are formally asked or given permission to do it.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.tr: v. 供应；提供；报价；“offer”的现在分词； n. 出售物；作品；
words.ex: The store is offering fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天早上供应新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: An offering is something that is produced for other people to use, watch, or enjoy, or the act of producing it.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr: n. 桌子；台子；表格；“table”的复数；
words.ex: The children sat at the tables to eat lunch.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在桌子旁吃午餐。
words.en: A piece of furniture with a flat top and one or more legs, providing a level surface for eating, writing, or working.

words.tr: v. 挑选；采摘；“pick”的现在分词； n. 采摘；选择；
words.ex: He is picking apples from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从树上挑选苹果。
words.en: The act of selecting or choosing something, or the act of stealing from someone's pocket.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上游泳。
words.en: To swim means to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.ex: The software is doing meshing for the 3D model.
words.ex_cn: 该软件正在为三维模型建网。
words.en: The act of fitting together or interlocking, as the teeth of gears.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住球。
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.ex: The children built a castle in the sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙子里建了一座城堡。
words.en: Sand is a substance that consists of very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.

words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.ex: The positions of the trees are marked on the map.
words.ex_cn: 这些树的位置在地图上标了出来。
words.en: A position is a particular point or place in physical space, or a particular situation or status in a process or competition.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；“advantage”的复数； v. 有利于；
words.ex: The advantages of walking to school are clear.
words.ex_cn: 步行上学的优势很明显。
words.en: An advantage is a condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.ex: She has periods every month.
words.ex_cn: 她每个月都有经期。
words.en: A period is a length of time during which something happens or exists.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: They make important decisions every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天都在做重要的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about several possibilities.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.tr: v. 预订；预约；预订( book的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: I booked a hotel room for next week.
words.ex_cn: 我预订了下周的酒店房间。
words.en: If something is booked, it has been reserved or arranged in advance.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: He got the highest score in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在班上得了最高分。
words.en: Of the most elevated position or degree; utmost.

words.ex: The child has two strong legs.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子有两条强壮的腿。
words.en: Legs are the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.tr:
adj. 理想的；
n. 理想；典范；
words.ex: This is the ideal place to relax.
words.ex_cn: 这是放松的理想地方。
words.en: An ideal is a principle or value that one actively pursues as a goal, often in the context of ethics or morality.

words.tr: v. 接受；“accept”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 公认的；
words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: Generally agreed to be correct or satisfactory.

words.ex: His concerns about the exam made him nervous.
words.ex_cn: 他对考试的担心让他感到紧张。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you; something that concerns you is something that you think is important and that you are interested in.

words.ex: He loads the truck with boxes.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子装上卡车。
words.en: A large quantity or number.

words.ex: The job has strict requirements.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作有严格的要求。
words.en: A set of necessary conditions, qualifications, or specifications that must be met or fulfilled for a particular purpose, role, or process.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: He thinks it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you think that something is the case, you have the opinion that it is the case.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.tr: v. 定居；安顿；解决；“settle”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 定居的；稳定的；
words.ex: They settled in Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年在加拿大定居了。
words.en: If you feel settled, you have become used to your new home, job, or situation, and you feel comfortable and happy about it.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.tr: adj. 更便宜的；“cheap”的比较级；
words.ex: This shirt is cheaper than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更便宜。
words.en: Comparative form of cheap: costing less money than something else or than is usual.

words.ex: The buses arrive every ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车每十分钟到达一次。
words.en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another. Buses are usually public, meaning they are available for use by anyone who pays the fare.

words.ex: The children learned through visual aids like pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过图片等视觉辅助工具学习。
words.en: relating to seeing or to the eyes

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.ex: We discussed many topics in class today.
words.ex_cn: 今天我们课堂上讨论了很多话题。
words.en: Subjects or themes that are discussed, written about, or studied.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: The actors performed a funny play last night.
words.ex_cn: 男演员们昨晚表演了一出滑稽的戏剧。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.tr: v. 认为；把……看作；<古>与……有关，涉及（regard 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He is regarded as a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 人们认为他是一位好老师。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.tr: n. 饮食；吃； v. 吃；“eat”的现在分词；
words.ex: His eating habits are very healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他的饮食习惯非常健康。
words.en: Eating is the act of consuming food to provide nutritional support for the body.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.tr: n. 商店；“store”的复数； v. 贮藏；
words.ex: There are many stores on this street.
words.ex_cn: 这条街上有很多商店。
words.en: A place where merchandise is offered for sale; also, the act of keeping something for future use.

words.tr: v. 执行；表演；履行；执行( perform的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He performed the task quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速地执行了任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill something, such as a task or duty. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play or concert, to an audience.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.ex: She washed the pots after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后洗了罐子。
words.en: Containers made of various materials, typically round and deep, used for holding liquids or plants.

words.ex: I bought two new phones for my family.
words.ex_cn: 我为我的家人买了两部新电话。
words.en: A phone is a device that you use to talk to someone who is in another place, by dialling a number and speaking into it.

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: His claims about the product are not true.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个产品的主张是不真实的。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.tr: v. 交；递；（非正式）（使）轻松得到（hand 的过去式及过...；
words.ex: He handed the book to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把书交给了他的朋友。
words.en: Having a hand or hands. Used to describe someone's preference or ability in using a particular hand.

words.ex: The musicians played songs at the park.
words.ex_cn: 音乐家们在公园里演奏歌曲。
words.en: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument as their job or hobby.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.tr: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表；
words.ex: The school publishes a new timetable every term.
words.ex_cn: 学校每学期都会公布新的时间表。
words.en: A timetable is a detailed plan showing the times at which things are intended to happen, especially the times at which particular events or activities are planned to occur.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: Children need safe environments to grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要安全的环境来成长。
words.en: The conditions that you live or work in and the way that they influence how you feel or how effectively you can work.

words.ex: The satellites send pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 这些卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.tr: v. 吃；喂；“feed”的现在分词； n. 饲养；给食；
words.ex: The baby is feeding on milk.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在喝奶。
words.en: The act of giving food to a person or an animal.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr: n. 街区；积木；砖；块；大楼；大厦；障碍物；“block”的复数； v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: He lives in the next blocks near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园旁边的街区。
words.en: Blocks can refer to solid pieces of material with flat surfaces, or to the act of preventing something from happening or moving.

words.tr: v. 集中；聚焦；“focus”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 注意力集中的；聚焦的；
words.ex: He focused on his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you are focused on something, you are paying special attention to it because it is your main concern or interest.

words.ex: Many restaurants close early on Mondays.
words.ex_cn: 许多餐厅在周一早早关门。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: The characteristics of this animal include long legs and big ears.
words.ex_cn: 这种动物的特征包括长腿和大耳朵。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.tr: v. 构成；创立；使成形； adj. 成形的；制作（form 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The rocks formed the foundation of the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这些岩石构成了山的基础。
words.en: To form something means to make it into a particular shape or to create it.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.ex: There is a clear relation between exercise and health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间有明显的关联。
words.en: A relation between two things is a connection or link between them.

words.ex: The strandings of dolphins shocked the coastal community.
words.ex_cn: 海豚的搁浅让沿海社区感到震惊。
words.en: The act of causing a ship or marine animal to run aground or become stuck in shallow water.

words.ex: The ground is wet after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是湿的。
words.en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: He sings a happy song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上唱一首快乐的歌。
words.en: A song is a piece of music with words that is sung.

words.ex: He made many drawings of birds.
words.ex_cn: 他画了很多鸟的素描。
words.en: Drawings are pictures that are made with a pen, pencil, or crayon rather than paint, or the art of making such pictures.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.ex: The bears live in the forest near the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 熊住在山边的森林里。
words.en: A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws. In another sense, to bear means to carry, support, or endure something.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: The teacher showed us slides about the solar system.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们展示了关于太阳系的幻灯片。
words.en: Slides can refer to a series of images projected onto a screen or a surface, typically used in presentations, or to a smooth, inclined surface for children to play on by sliding down. As a verb, it means to move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it.

words.ex: The boy is playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: A boy is a male child or a young male person.

words.ex: Hi, how are you today?
words.ex_cn: 嗨，你今天怎么样？
words.en: used as a friendly greeting

words.ex: My grandfather tells stories every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父每天晚上都讲故事。
words.en: The father of one's father or mother.

words.ex: Handwashing is a simple prevention of disease.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防疾病的一种简单方法。
words.en: The act of stopping something from happening or arising.

words.ex: The fridges are full of food.
words.ex_cn: 冰箱里装满了食物。
words.en: Fridges are appliances or compartments which are artificially kept cool and used to store food and drink. Modern fridges generally make use of the cooling effect produced when a volatile liquid is forced to evaporate in a sealed system in which it can be condensed back to liquid outside the refrigerator.

words.ex: These organisms live in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这些生物生活在海洋中。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has the ability to act or function independently.

words.ex: Her husband cooks dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 她的丈夫每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: The boy picked up the objects on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩捡起了地上的物品。
words.en: Objects are physical things that you can see and touch. In grammar, an object is a noun, pronoun, or noun phrase that receives the action of a verb or is affected by it.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.ex: None of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 没有一个学生通过了考试。
words.en: not any; no amount or part of something

words.ex: The store sells all kinds of footwear.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种鞋类。
words.en: Footwear refers to garments worn on the feet, which typically serve the purpose of protection against adversities of the environment such as ground textures and temperature.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: There are numerous books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: If people or things are numerous, they exist or are present in large numbers.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车的人；自行车选手；“cyclist”的复数；
words.ex: The cyclists rode through the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车的人每天早上都穿过公园。
words.en: Cyclists are people who ride bicycles, especially those who do it regularly or as a sport.

words.ex: Bushfires burned many trees last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，丛林大火烧毁了许多树木。
words.en: A bushfire is an uncontrolled fire in the bush that is a serious threat to life, property, and the environment.

words.ex: The children got lost in the labyrinths of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在花园的迷宫中迷路了。
words.en: A labyrinth is a complicated irregular network of passages or paths in which it is difficult to find one's way; a maze.

words.tr: n. 梦想；美梦；梦想，美梦（dream 的复数形式）；
words.ex: He works hard to make his dreams come true.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的梦想。
words.en: Dreams are a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. They can also refer to cherished aspirations, ambitions, or ideals.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.tr: adj. 有……大小的；相比（size 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The box is sized to fit the toy inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小刚好能装下里面的玩具。
words.en: Having a specified size or dimension.

words.ex: He has forty books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有四十本书。
words.en: The number 40.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: The children walk to school from small villages.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从各个小村庄步行去上学。
words.en: Small communities in rural areas, typically smaller than a town.

words.tr: v. 安排；“arrange”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 安排的；
words.ex: They arranged a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们安排了明天的会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.tr: v. 缺少； n. 需求；欲望；必需品；需要的东西；缺乏( want的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He wants water after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完后缺少水。
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.tr: v. 花费；度过；“spend”的现在分词； n. 花费；开销；
words.ex: He is spending money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他正在花钱买书。
words.en: Spending refers to the act of using money to buy or pay for something.

words.ex: He is eighty years old.
words.ex_cn: 他八十岁了。
words.en: The number 80.

words.tr: adj. 失去的；失踪的； v. 错失；“miss”的现在分词；
words.ex: The missing book was found under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 那本丢失的书在床下找到了。
words.en: If someone or something is missing, they are not in their usual place, and you cannot find them.

words.tr: adj. 更接近的；更亲密的；“close”的比较级； adv. 更接近地；“close”的比较级；
words.ex: This chair is closer to the window.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子离窗户更近。
words.en: A closer is a person or thing that closes or finalizes something.

words.tr: n. 所有权人；主人；物主；
words.ex: The owner of the house sold it last week.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的主人上周把它卖了。
words.en: The owner of something is the person to whom it belongs.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.tr:
adj. 凉爽的；酷的；凉的；顶好的；
v. 变凉；
words.ex: The water is cool after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后水很凉爽。
words.en: If you say that a person or their behavior is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.tr: adv. 大幅度地；相当地；很大地；
words.ex: The price has increased considerably.
words.ex_cn: 价格大幅上涨了。
words.en: To a notably large or significant extent.

words.ex: He is a tall man.
words.ex_cn: 他是个高个子男人。
words.en: If something is tall, it is higher than usual or than other things of its type.

words.tr: n. 树枝；分支；分公司；分支；“branch”的复数；
words.ex: The wind blew down the branches of the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风把树的树枝吹落了。
words.en: The parts of a tree that grow out from the trunk and have leaves, flowers, or fruit on them.

words.ex: It rained all day, therefore the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use therefore to introduce a logical result or conclusion.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.tr: v. 忘记；遗忘；“forget”的过去式；
words.ex: I forgot my keys at home.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙忘在家里了。
words.en: If you forget something, you do not remember it.

words.tr: v. 遇见；见面；满足；“meet”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I met my friend at the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园里遇见了我的朋友。
words.en: Met is the past tense and past participle of meet. To meet someone means to come into their presence by chance or arrangement.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.tr: adj. 正确的；合适的；正当的；
words.ex: This is the proper way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决这个问题的正确方法。
words.en: If something is proper, it is suitable or correct for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.ex: He uses simple methods to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.tr: adj. 破损的；弄坏的； v. 打破；打断；“break”的过去分词；
words.ex: The broken cup lay on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 破了的杯子躺在地板上。
words.en: Damaged or shattered into pieces, typically as a result of force or impact.

words.ex: He is unable to swim.
words.ex_cn: 他不会游泳。
words.en: If you are unable to do something, you cannot do it, either because you do not have the necessary skill or knowledge, or because you do not have the opportunity to do it.

words.ex: He passed the exam with high marks.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.tr: v. 说话；讨论；说； n. 讲话，交谈 talk的过去式 v. 说话；说( talk的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: She talked to her friend yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天和朋友说话了。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; converse or communicate by spoken words.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；连接的； v. 连接；“connect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are connected.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是相关的。
words.en: If one thing is connected with another, there is a link or relationship between them.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.tr: n. 数量；数额；“amount”的复数； v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amounts of water in the two bottles are different.
words.ex_cn: 两个瓶子里的水量不同。
words.en: A quantity of something, especially the total of a thing or things in number, size, value, or extent.

words.ex: Importantly, he finished his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 重要的是，他按时完成了作业。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is important

words.tr: v. 放置；铺设；安排；“lay”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He laid the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: Laid is the past tense and past participle of lay. To lay something somewhere means to put it there carefully or neatly.

words.tr: v. 考虑；“consider”的现在分词； prep. 考虑到；就…而言；鉴于；
words.ex: I am considering going to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我正在考虑去公园。
words.en: Taking into account; in view of.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr:
adj. 第五的；
n. 五分之一；第五；
adv. 第五；
words.ex: He finished in fifth place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第五名。
words.en: The fifth item in a series is the one that you count as number five.

words.ex: He wears suits to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天上班都穿西装。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually including a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be acceptable or right for someone or something.

words.ex: He has fourteen apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有十四个苹果。
words.en: The number 14.

words.tr: v. 表示"展示; 展现; 出示"； vt. & vi. （动词present的过去式及过去分词形式）；
words.ex: He presented his project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的项目。
words.en: If you present someone with something such as a prize or document, or if you present it to them, you formally give it to them.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.ex: He is holding three cards in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着三张牌。
words.en: Cards are pieces of stiff paper or thin cardboard, often with a picture on one side, which are used for playing games or for sending messages.

words.tr: v. 代替；取代；“replace”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The old phone was replaced by a new one.
words.ex_cn: 旧手机被新手机代替了。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.tr:
n. 喜爱；赞同；
v. 赞成；偏爱；有利于；
words.ex: He has a favour for chocolate ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他特别喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favour, you like or support them.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: He showed excellence in math competitions.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中表现出色。
words.en: The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.

words.ex: The map shows the locations of all the restaurants.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了所有餐厅的位置。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.tr: v. 测量；“measure”的现在分词； adj. 测量用的； n. 测量；
words.ex: He is measuring the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他正在测量桌子的长度。
words.en: The act of determining the size, amount, or degree of something by using an instrument or device marked in standard units.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.ex: My mother teaches me math every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上教我数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.tr:
n. 记号；分数；痕迹；
v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；
words.ex: He put a mark on the map to show the place.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图上做了一个记号来表示那个地方。
words.en: A mark is a small area or spot on a surface which is different in colour or texture from the area around it. If you mark something, you make a mark on it in order to identify it or to give information about it.

words.ex: The skeleton of the dinosaur is displayed in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的骨架在博物馆里展出。
words.en: The internal structure that supports and gives shape to a person, animal, or plant, composed of bones and cartilage in vertebrates.

words.ex: The sun burned his skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒伤了他的皮肤。
words.en: Your skin is the natural outer covering of your body.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.tr: adj. 延长的；扩大范围的；延伸的；
words.ex: The meeting was extended by thirty minutes.
words.ex_cn: 会议被延长了三十分钟。
words.en: Made larger or longer than usual.

words.tr:
adv. 两者都不；
adj. 两者都不的；
conj. 也不；
pron. 两者都不；
words.ex: I don't like coffee, and neither do I like tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，也不喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a further negative statement after a negative one, or to indicate that a negative statement is also true of another person or thing

words.ex: The sun appears in the sky at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在黎明时出现。
words.en: If someone or something appears, they come into sight or become noticeable.

words.tr: v. 提供；报价；“offer”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He offered me a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我一杯茶。
words.en: If you offer something to someone, you ask them if they would like to have it or use it.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.tr: adj. 愿意的；乐意的； v. “will”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is willing to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are happy to do it if it is needed.

words.tr: adv. 令人惊讶地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: Surprisingly, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 令人惊讶的是，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: In a manner that causes surprise because it is unexpected or unusual.

words.ex: The car's speed rates are shown on the dashboard.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的速度速率显示在仪表盘上。
