words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr: v. 补救；纠正( repair的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He repaired the mistake by apologizing.
words.ex_cn: 他通过道歉来补救这个错误。
words.en: To fix something that is broken or damaged.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: Dogs breeds vary in size and color.
words.ex_cn: 狗的品种在大小和颜色上各不相同。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way. A breed of a pet animal or farm animal is a particular type of it.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.ex: The eastern city has many old temples.
words.ex_cn: 东部的城市有许多古老的寺庙。
words.en: Eastern means in or from the east part of an area.

words.tr: v. 参观；游览；访问；探望；访问( visit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: They visited the museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末参观了博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place for a short period of time, especially as a tourist or as part of an official duty.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了脚。
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.tr: n. 细胞；牢房；单元格；“cell”的复数；
words.ex: Plants are made of many cells.
words.ex_cn: 植物由许多细胞组成。
words.en: The basic structural and functional unit of all organisms; a device that delivers an electric current as the result of a chemical reaction; a small room in which a prisoner is locked up.

words.ex: He lost sight of the bird flying away.
words.ex_cn: 他看不见那只飞走的鸟了。
words.en: The ability to see; the act of seeing or the thing seen.

words.ex: The store sells seasonal fruits like strawberries in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在春天出售草莓等季节性水果。
words.en: Seasonal means relating to or happening during a particular season.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: He will consult a doctor for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他将咨询医生治疗他的头痛。
words.en: to seek information or advice from someone, especially someone who is an expert in a particular field

words.ex: The authors wrote a book about history.
words.ex_cn: 这些作者写了一本关于历史的书。
words.en: A person who writes books, articles, etc., especially as a job.

words.ex: Many diseases can be prevented with clean water.
words.ex_cn: 许多疾病可以通过干净的水来预防。
words.en: A disease is an illness which affects people, animals, or plants, for example one which is caused by bacteria or infection.

words.ex: Texas and California are two large states.
words.ex_cn: 德克萨斯州和加利福尼亚州是两个大的州。
words.en: The term 'states' refers to the political organization of a body of people under a single government, or the condition of a system or matter at a given time.

words.ex: The smell was unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这气味令人不快。
words.en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example, by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: His reaction was quick when the ball came at him.
words.ex_cn: 当球朝他飞来时，他的反应很快。
words.en: Your reaction to something that has happened or something that you have experienced is what you feel, say, or do because of it.

words.ex: The doctor gave me pills in the form of pellets.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了丸状的药片。
words.en: Small, rounded, compressed masses of a substance.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: The company is recruiting new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司正在招募新员工。
words.en: The process of finding and hiring new employees or members for an organization.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: He used the opener to open the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他用开瓶器打开了瓶子。
words.en: An opener is a device or tool used to open something, such as a bottle or can, or the first event in a series of events.

words.tr: v. 租用；出租；租借； n. 租用；租用 v. 租用( rent的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is renting a car for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为旅行租一辆车。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as a house, car, or piece of equipment, for a period of time.

words.tr: v. 装饰；装修；“decorate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She decorated the room with flowers.
words.ex_cn: 她用花装饰了房间。
words.en: If something is decorated, it has had decorations added to it to make it look more attractive.

words.ex: The committee gave the proposal several reviews.
words.ex_cn: 委员会对这个提案进行了多次复审。
words.en: A review is a report in which someone gives their opinion of something such as a new book or film. If you review a situation or system, you consider it carefully to see what is wrong with it or how it could be improved.

words.ex: He is physically tired after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后身体上很累。
words.en: In a way that relates to the body as opposed to the mind; in a way that relates to things that can be seen or touched.

words.ex: His explanation was understandable.
words.ex_cn: 他的解释是可以理解的。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour or feelings as understandable, you mean that they have reacted to a situation in a natural way or in the way you would expect.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.tr: n. 环境；装置；镶嵌( setting的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The settings of the forest made it perfect for camping.
words.ex_cn: 森林的环境非常适合露营。
words.en: The physical environment, context, or background in which something exists or takes place.

words.ex: The organisational structure is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 组织结构清晰而简单。
words.en: Relating to the way in which the different parts of something are arranged or organized.

words.ex: He shifts his job to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他把工作转换到一个新的城市。
words.en: Shifts refer to the periods of work that people are assigned to, especially in a job that operates 24 hours a day. It can also mean a change in position, direction, or tendency.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.ex: He lives in a residential area near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: Relating to or suitable for residence.

words.tr: v. 刷油漆；用颜料画；“paint”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 着了色的；油漆了的；
words.ex: He painted the wall blue yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天把墙刷成了蓝色。
words.en: Covered or decorated with paint.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.tr: n. 灯；“light”的复数； v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The lights in the room are bright.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的灯很亮。
words.en: Plural form of light, which refers to the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible.

words.ex: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or hobby.

words.ex: He is practically always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是上课迟到。
words.en: In a way that is almost true or almost the case; virtually.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.ex: I felt pity for the lonely child.
words.ex_cn: 我对那个孤独的孩子感到怜悯。
words.en: If you feel pity for someone, you feel very sorry for them.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.tr:
adj. 微型的；
n. 微型画；小型模型；
words.ex: He bought a miniature car for his collection.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的收藏买了一辆微型汽车。
words.en: A miniature is a very small detailed painting, often a portrait. It can also refer to a small-scale model or representation of something.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.ex: The painting gave me inspiration.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画给了我灵感。
words.en: Inspiration is a feeling of enthusiasm you get from someone or something, which gives you new and creative ideas.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.tr: n. 零售业； v. “retail”的现在分词；
words.ex: Retailing is a big part of the economy.
words.ex_cn: 零售业是经济的重要组成部分。
words.en: Retailing is the activity of selling goods to the public, usually in shops.

words.ex: He answered the question correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: In a manner that is accurate and free from errors.

words.ex: He felt satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到满意。
words.en: The feeling of pleasure that you have when you do or get something that you wanted or needed.

words.ex: He finishes his assignments every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上完成作业。
words.en: Tasks or pieces of work that are assigned to someone, especially as part of their studies or job.

words.ex: The sailors swam ashore after the boat sank.
words.ex_cn: 船沉没后，水手们游到了岸上。
words.en: If someone or something comes ashore, they come from the sea onto the shore.

words.ex: The old tree died last winter.
words.ex_cn: 那棵老树去年冬天死了。
words.en: To die means to stop living and become dead.

words.tr: adj. 搁浅的；处于困境的； v. 使搁浅；“strand”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boat was stranded on the sandbank.
words.ex_cn: 船搁浅在沙洲上。
words.en: Left in a difficult or helpless situation, especially without means of escape or assistance.

words.ex: I cannot swim.
words.ex_cn: 我不能游泳。
words.en: Cannot is the negative form of 'can'. It is used to say that someone is not able to do something or that something is not possible.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.ex: He uses social networks to stay in touch with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他使用社交网络与朋友保持联系。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or interconnect, or a group or system of interconnected people or things.

words.tr: n. 偏爱的事物；“preference”的复数；
words.ex: His preferences include coffee, books, and long walks.
words.ex_cn: 他的偏爱包括咖啡、书籍和长时间散步。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.ex: Children learn to socialise at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校学习进行社交活动。
words.en: To socialise means to participate or to cause someone to participate in social activities; to make someone behave in a way that is acceptable to their society.

words.tr: v. 注意；备注；“note”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 著名的；闻名的；显著的；
words.ex: He noted the time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他记下了会议的时间。
words.en: If someone or something is noted for a particular quality, they are well known for it.

words.ex: He learned a new technique to paint better.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一种新的绘画技术。
words.en: A technique is a particular method of doing an activity, usually a method that involves practical skills.

words.ex: I check my emails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上查看我的电子邮件。
words.en: Emails are messages distributed by electronic means from one computer user to one or more recipients via a network.

words.tr: v. 引入；介绍；“introduce”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is introducing a new math game to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向班级引入一个新的数学游戏。
words.en: To introduce means to present someone or something new to another person or group, to bring something into use or operation for the first time, or to present a new topic or idea.

words.ex: His beliefs guide his daily choices.
words.ex_cn: 他的信念指导他的日常选择。
words.en: Beliefs are things that someone accepts as true or real, especially a particular principle or a set of principles.

words.ex: They have conversations every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上都有对话。
words.en: Conversations are informal talks between two or more people in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: He specialises in repairing old clocks.
words.ex_cn: 他专用于修理老式钟表。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.ex: The teacher asked for simple descriptions of the animals.
words.ex_cn: 老师要求对这些动物做出简单的描述。
words.en: Descriptions are detailed accounts or explanations of something.

words.ex: The economies of many countries are growing slowly.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的经济增长缓慢。
words.en: Economies refer to the system by which a country's money, goods, and services are produced and used, or the careful management of resources to avoid waste.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.tr: adj. 以…为导向的； v. “orient”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The program is student-oriented.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是以学生为导向的。
words.en: If someone is oriented towards or oriented to a particular thing or person, they are mainly concerned with that thing or person.

words.tr: v. 分配；“allocate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher allocated books to each student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生分配了书籍。
words.en: If something is allocated to a particular person or for a particular purpose, it is given to that person or used for that purpose.

words.ex: The breaking of the ice caused a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 冰的破裂发出了一声巨响。
words.en: The act of breaking something; a pause or interruption in continuity.

words.ex: The house has a small terrace with chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带椅子的小平台。
words.en: A terrace is a flat area of stone or grass next to a building where people can sit.

words.tr: n. 滑雪（运动）； v. “ski”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves skiing in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山上滑雪。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving over snow on skis.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.tr: v. 取消； adj. 取消( cancel的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The flight was cancelled because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班被取消了。
words.en: To decide that something that was officially planned will not happen.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.ex: Steve Jobs is the founder of Apple.
words.ex_cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是苹果公司的创办者。
words.en: A founder is someone who establishes an organization, company, or institution. As a verb, it means to fail or collapse, especially in terms of a plan or a ship sinking.

words.tr: adv. 非常地；极多地；巨大地；
words.ex: The movie was hugely popular.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影非常受欢迎。
words.en: To an extremely great extent or degree; immensely.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.tr: v. 挖；“dig”的现在分词； n. 挖掘；
words.ex: He is digging a hole in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他正在花园里挖一个洞。
words.en: Digging refers to the act of breaking up, turning over, or removing earth, sand, etc., typically to find or extract something.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.ex: Professionals work hard to help people.
words.ex_cn: 专业人士努力工作来帮助他人。
words.en: People who are qualified in a particular profession or who are engaged in a specific activity as a paid job rather than as a hobby.

words.tr: adj. 有害的；造成破坏的； v. 损害；“damage”的现在分词；
words.ex: Smoking is damaging to your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的肺有害。
words.en: Causing or capable of causing damage; harmful.

words.tr: adj. 引起恐惧的；使惊恐的；骇人的； v. “frighten”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dark forest looked frightening at night.
words.ex_cn: 那个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来很吓人。
words.en: If you say that something is frightening, you mean that it makes you feel afraid or anxious.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.ex: This song reminds me of my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让我想起了我的童年。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.ex: He eats pasta for dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吃意大利面。
words.en: Pasta is a type of food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, and water that is formed into different shapes and then boiled.

words.tr: vt. 对…感到好奇（wonder的过去式与过去分词形式）
words.ex: He wondered why the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 他想知道天空为什么是蓝色的。
words.en: Past tense of 'wonder'; to have thought about something with curiosity or doubt.

words.ex: He wore jeans to the informal party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着牛仔裤去参加非正式的聚会。
words.en: If you describe something as informal, you mean that it is not done or said in a formal or official way.

words.tr: n. 池塘( pond的名词复数 )
words.ex: The ducks swim in the ponds.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A pond is a small area of still, fresh water. It is different from a river or a stream because it does not have moving water and it differs from a lake because it has a small area and is no more than around 1.8m deep.

words.ex: The clock strikes precisely at noon.
words.ex_cn: 钟恰好在正午敲响。
words.en: In a precise manner; exactly.

words.ex: The gardeners water the plants every morning.
words.ex_cn: 园丁们每天早上给植物浇水。
words.en: A gardener is a person who is employed to take care of the gardens of a large house or park.

words.ex: Birds begin nesting in spring.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在春天开始筑巢。
words.en: The process by which birds build or occupy nests.

words.tr: adj. 暖和的； n. 使热的人，温热装置 adj. 暖和的( warm的比较级 )；
words.ex: This jacket is warmer than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克比那件更暖和。
words.en: Something that is warmer has a higher temperature than something else, or than it had before.

words.ex: It is your duty to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成你的作业是你的职责。
words.en: A duty is a task or action that someone is required to perform.

words.ex: He has many family commitments on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末有很多家庭事务要处理。
words.en: A commitment is a promise or firm decision to do something, or the fact of promising to do something.

words.ex: The kitchen has a new washing appliance.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有一台新的洗衣机。
words.en: An appliance is a device or machine that is used to perform a particular task, especially in the home.

words.ex: He is protecting the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: Water causes erosion of the soil.
words.ex_cn: 水会导致土壤腐蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.ex: The dog buried the bones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗把骨头埋在了院子里。
words.en: The hard parts inside a human or animal that make up its skeleton.

words.ex: Bears go into hibernation in winter.
words.ex_cn: 熊在冬天冬眠。
words.en: Hibernation is a state of inactivity and metabolic depression in endotherms during winter.

words.ex: The government took new measures to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府采取了新措施来减少污染。
words.en: Measures are actions taken or plans made to achieve a particular purpose or to solve a problem. It can also refer to the size, length, or amount of something, determined by measuring.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.tr: v. 代表；体现；表现；表现( represent的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The flag represented the country's pride.
words.ex_cn: 这面旗帜代表了国家的自豪。
words.en: If someone represents you, they act on your behalf, for example by speaking for you in a court of law or in a parliament.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.tr: v. 位于；躺卧； n. 谎言；谎言( lie的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The village lies between two mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于两座山之间。
words.en: A lie is a statement that is not true, especially one that is deliberately made in order to deceive someone.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.tr: v. 强迫；促使；推动；“force”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 强迫的；不得已的；勉强的；
words.ex: They forced him to work late.
words.ex_cn: 他们强迫他加班。
words.en: If something is forced, it happens or is done because someone makes it happen, often without wanting to.

words.ex: Math and science are important disciplines in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学和科学是学校里重要的学科。
words.en: Disciplines refer to a branch of knowledge, typically one studied in higher education, or the practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behavior, using punishment to correct disobedience.

words.tr: v. 扩大；扩张；“expand”的现在分词； adj. 扩展的；扩充的；
words.ex: The company is expanding its business to new cities.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在将其业务扩大到新城市。
words.en: If something expands or is expanded, it becomes larger.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.ex: The two brothers have many conflicts.
words.ex_cn: 这两个兄弟有很多冲突。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.tr: v. 完成；结束；“finish”的现在分词； n. 结尾；结束；完成； adj. 最后的；完工的；
words.ex: He is finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在完成他的作业。
words.en: The act of completing something or the final touches added to something.

words.tr: v. 从事活动；“campaign”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is campaigning for cleaner parks.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为更干净的公园开展活动。
words.en: The act of campaigning involves activities aimed at influencing the decision making process within a specific group. In politics, it often refers to the organized effort to win an election.

words.ex: The listeners clapped after the song.
words.ex_cn: 听众在歌曲结束后鼓掌。
words.en: People who listen to something, especially to the radio or to someone speaking.

words.tr: v. 收养；采用；采纳；“adopt”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They adopted a little boy from the orphanage.
words.ex_cn: 他们从孤儿院收养了一个小男孩。
words.en: If you adopt a new method, idea, or attitude, you start to use it or accept it. If you adopt a child, you take it into your own family and make it legally your son or daughter.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: The past tense of wear, meaning to have clothing, jewelry, etc., on your body.

words.ex: The actors had a rehearsal before the play.
words.ex_cn: 演出前，演员们进行了一次排练。
words.en: A rehearsal of a play, dance, or piece of music is a practice of it in preparation for a performance.

words.tr: n. 标记；记号；“mark”的复数； v. 做标记；
words.ex: The teacher put marks on the paper to show correct answers.
words.ex_cn: 老师在纸上做了标记来表示正确答案。
words.en: Marks can refer to symbols or signs used to indicate something, grades or scores given to students' work, or physical traces left by something. As a verb, it means to make a mark on something, to grade or score something, or to pay attention to something.

words.ex: The teacher emphasise the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了作业的重要性。
words.en: To emphasise something means to indicate that it is particularly important or true, or to draw special attention to it.

words.ex: The company reported big gains this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年获得了丰厚的收益。
words.en: Gains refer to the profits or benefits obtained from something, especially in business or financial contexts.

words.ex: He is fixing his bicycle.
words.ex_cn: 他正在修理他的自行车。
words.en: The act of making something firm, stable, or stationary; the process of repairing or installing something.

words.ex: The lady is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 这位女士正在等公交车。
words.en: A lady is a woman who is polite, well-mannered, and refined.

words.ex: He drives a red van to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆红色的货车去上班。
words.en: A van is a road vehicle used for transporting goods or people, usually larger than a car but smaller than a truck.

words.ex: She turned on the cooker to boil water.
words.ex_cn: 她打开炉子烧水。
words.en: A cooker is a device or appliance used for cooking food.

words.ex: The restoration of the old house took two years.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子的修复花了两年时间。
words.en: The act of returning something to its original condition, or the state of being returned to its original condition.

words.ex: He wants to rid his house of clutter.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱家里的杂乱。
words.en: To rid someone or something of something unwanted or harmful means to remove it completely from them.

words.ex: The river deposited silt on the banks.
words.ex_cn: 河流在河岸上沉积了淤泥。
words.en: Silt is fine sand, soil, or mud which is carried along by a river and then left on the land.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.ex: He uses software to write his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他使用软件写作业。
words.en: Software refers to the programs and other operating information used by a computer.

words.ex: She organises meetings every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周一组织会议。
words.en: To organise means to arrange or plan something systematically.

words.ex: The reliability of this car is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的可靠性很高。
words.en: The quality of being trustworthy or consistent in performance.

words.ex: Atoms are the smallest parts of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: Atoms are the smallest units of matter that have the properties of an element. They consist of a nucleus surrounded by electrons.

words.ex: He faces his fears every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天直面自己的恐惧。
words.en: Fears are strong, often unpleasant emotions caused by the anticipation or awareness of danger.

words.tr:
v. 对待；治疗；招待；
adj. 已处理过的；
words.ex: He was treated kindly by his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被老师友好地对待。
words.en: If something is treated in a particular way, it is dealt with in that way. If someone is treated in a particular way, they are dealt with in that way, especially when it is bad or unfair.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The planes fly high above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在云层上方飞行。
words.en: Planes are vehicles designed for air travel that have wings and one or more engines. They are used for transporting passengers and goods across long distances. The term can also refer to a flat surface or a tool used for smoothing wood.

words.ex: The clock struck midnight.
words.ex_cn: 钟敲响了午夜。
words.en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

words.ex: The bands played at the music festival last night.
words.ex_cn: 这些乐队昨晚在音乐节上表演了。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for fastening or binding things together.

words.ex: The loud noise frightened the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something or someone frightens you, they cause you to suddenly feel afraid, anxious, or nervous.

words.ex: He fulfilled his promise to help me.
words.ex_cn: 他履行了帮助我的承诺。
words.en: To fulfil means to do something that is expected, hoped for, or promised, or to cause it to happen.

words.tr: n. 封条；“seal”的复数； v. 封入；
words.ex: The box has red seals on the lid.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的盖子上有红色封条。
words.en: Seals are large marine mammals that live in cold seas and have thick fur and layers of fat to keep them warm. They are known for their ability to swim gracefully and their playful nature.

words.tr: v. 威胁；“threaten”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone or something is threatened, they are in a situation where they may be harmed or damaged.

words.tr: n. 储备；保留；保护区；“reserve”的复数；
words.ex: The country keeps oil reserves for emergencies.
words.ex_cn: 该国为紧急情况保留石油储备。
words.en: Reserves refer to supplies of something that are kept for future use, or a group of people who are available to be called upon when needed.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.ex: Reading a book gives me relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 读书让我放松。
words.en: Relaxation is the state or process of becoming less tense, anxious, or stressed.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: He reads books as a hobby.
words.ex_cn: 他读书作为一种爱好。
words.en: A hobby is an activity that you enjoy doing in your spare time.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.ex: He is allergic to shellfish.
words.ex_cn: 他对贝类过敏。
words.en: Shellfish are sea creatures that live in shells and are eaten as food.

words.ex: He is concentrating on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在专心做作业。
words.en: Focusing all one's attention or mental effort on a particular object or activity.

words.tr: v. 提到；请教；提到( refer的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was referring to the blue book.
words.ex_cn: 他提到了那本蓝皮书。
words.en: to direct someone to a source for information; to mention or allude to

words.ex: The neighbouring town has a big market.
words.ex_cn: 邻近的城镇有一个大市场。
words.en: Neighbouring places are next to or near each other.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；“reflect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The lake reflected the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 湖面映出了山峦。
words.en: If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.ex: The boy picked up a piece of rubber from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块橡胶。
words.en: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of some tropical plants or artificially. It is used for making tires, boots, and many other products.

words.tr: adj. 带…色的；有色的； v. “color”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sky turned coloured with orange and pink at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出橙色和粉色。
words.en: Coloured is used to describe something that has color or is not black and white.

words.ex: The company sourced fresh materials from local farms.
words.ex_cn: 公司从本地农场获得了新鲜材料。
words.en: To obtain or procure from a particular source.

words.tr: n. 制陶艺术；制陶工艺；
words.ex: He learned ceramics from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里学习了制陶艺术。
words.en: The art of making objects by shaping pieces of clay and then baking them until they are hard.

words.ex: The buses take different routes to the school.
words.ex_cn: 公交车走不同的路线去学校。
words.en: A route is a way from one place to another. It can refer to a path, road, or way that is used to go from one place to another, or to the way that something such as a letter or a vehicle travels.

words.tr: v. 使变弱；使变为； n. 减轻体重法 v. 换算( reduce的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The medicine is reducing his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物正在减轻他的疼痛。
words.en: To make something smaller or less in amount, degree, or size.

words.ex: The tiger walks quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 老虎在森林里静静地行走。
words.en: A tiger is a large wild animal that has a yellow and black striped coat and is a member of the cat family.

words.ex: We went to the carnival last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了嘉年华。
words.en: A carnival is a public festival, typically one held annually in a particular place, involving processions, music, and dancing.

words.tr: n. 溜冰； v. “skate”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves skating on the frozen lake.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在结冰的湖面上溜冰。
words.en: Skating is the activity of moving on ice or a smooth surface using skates.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.tr: adj. 人种学的；人种志学的；
words.ex: The anthropologist wrote an ethnographic study of the tribe.
words.ex_cn: 这位人类学家写了一篇关于这个部落的人种学研究。
words.en: Relating to the scientific description of peoples and cultures with their customs, habits, and mutual differences.

words.tr: vt. 注视；注意；注视，注意（watch的过去式与过去分词形式）；
words.ex: He watched the bird fly away.
words.ex_cn: 他注视着鸟飞走。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.ex: The cooks prepare dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们每天晚上准备晚餐。
words.en: To prepare food by heating it, often by boiling, baking, or frying. Also refers to a person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；“entrepreneur”的复数；
words.ex: Entrepreneurs start new businesses to make money.
words.ex_cn: 企业家创办新企业来赚钱。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who sets up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.

words.ex: The administrators fixed the website error.
words.ex_cn: 管理员修复了网站的错误。
words.en: Administrators are people whose job is to manage and organize the affairs of a business or institution.

words.ex: The nurses help patients every day.
words.ex_cn: 护士们每天帮助病人。
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital. As a verb, to nurse means to care for someone who is ill or injured, or to treat something with care.

words.tr: n. 情绪；情感；情感：“emotion”的复数；
words.ex: Children often show their emotions by crying or laughing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们常常通过哭泣或大笑来表现他们的情绪。
words.en: Feelings such as happiness, sadness, anger, or love, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.tr: adj. 有意向的； v. “mind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is minded to go abroad next year.
words.ex_cn: 他有意明年出国。
words.en: Having a particular kind of mind or attitude.

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.ex: He put up posters on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他在墙上贴了海报。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: Many orchestras play classical music in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 许多管弦乐队在大城市演奏古典音乐。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Traditionally, orchestras include sections of string, woodwind, brass, and percussion instruments.

words.ex: He collects old coins and keeps them in collections.
words.ex_cn: 他收集旧硬币并把它们保存成收藏品。
words.en: A group of objects or works to be seen, studied, or kept together.

words.ex: He wears blue jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth.

words.ex: She wears long skirts in the summer.
words.ex_cn: 她夏天穿长裙子。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that fastens at the waist and hangs down around the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to go around the edge of something.

words.tr: v. 指出；表明；争论；争辩；
words.ex: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他指出这个计划太昂贵了。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.ex: Farmers care for the soils to grow healthy crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民照料土地以种植健康的庄稼。
words.en: Soil is the substance on the surface of the earth in which plants grow. It consists of rock and mineral particles mixed with decayed organic matter.

words.tr: adj. 肥沃的；有繁殖力的；多产的；富饶的；
words.ex: The fertile land grows many crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片肥沃的土地长满了各种作物。
words.en: Land or soil that is fertile is able to support the growth of a large number of strong healthy plants.

words.ex: Farmers protect the topsoil to grow healthy crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民保护表土以种植健康的作物。
words.en: Topsoil is the upper layer of soil, usually the top 2 inches (5.1 cm) to 8 inches (20 cm). It has the highest concentration of organic matter and microorganisms and is where most of the Earth's biological soil activity occurs.

words.ex: The warehouse is for storing goods.
words.ex_cn: 这个仓库用于保管货物。
words.en: The act of keeping something in a particular place until it is needed.

words.ex: We went on excursions to the mountains last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去山区郊游了。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one engaged in as a leisure activity.

words.ex: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 山景非常美丽。
words.en: The natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance, especially when picturesque.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: He owns the copyright to his novel.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有这部小说的版权。
words.en: The exclusive legal right, given to an originator or an assignee to print, publish, perform, film, or record literary, artistic, or musical material, and to authorize others to do the same.

words.ex: The politician gave a speech about education.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家就教育问题发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A politician is a person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a holder of or a candidate for an elected office.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.ex: The two companies worked together in collaboration.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司通过合作一起工作。
words.en: the act of working together with someone to produce or create something

words.ex: The movie shows a fantasy, not reality.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示的是幻想，而不是现实。
words.en: Reality is the state of things as they actually exist, rather than as they may appear or might be imagined.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: It is unnecessary to bring an umbrella today.
words.ex_cn: 今天带伞是不必要的。
words.en: If you describe something as unnecessary, you mean that it is not needed or does not have to be done, and often that it may be harmful or undesirable.

words.tr: v. 做广告；“advertise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The store advertised the sale on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在电视上做了广告宣传促销活动。
words.en: Promoted or made known to the public through advertisements.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.ex: He is a famous playwright who writes plays.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的剧作家，写剧本。
words.en: A playwright is a person who writes plays.

words.ex: He is attending a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要参加一个会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 群众或部队的集合；
words.ex: The hosting of thousands of soldiers surprised the town.
words.ex_cn: 数以千计士兵的集合让小镇感到惊讶。
words.en: The act of providing the necessary environment and services for a website or application to be accessible on the internet, or the act of being the host of an event.

words.ex: Many graduates find jobs soon after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 许多毕业生在毕业后很快找到了工作。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a course of study at a college, university, or school, and has received a degree or diploma.

words.ex: The translation of the book took two months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的翻译花了两个月。
words.en: The process of translating words or text from one language into another.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.ex: Children develop different abilities as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在成长过程中发展出不同的能力。
words.en: Abilities refer to the qualities or skills that someone has that make it possible for them to do something.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.tr: adj. 较合意的；更可取的；
words.ex: Tea is preferable to coffee in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上喝茶比喝咖啡更合意。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

words.tr: v. 面向；举向；（分娩时婴儿）露出；举向( present的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The classroom is presenting toward the north.
words.ex_cn: 这个教室面向北方。
words.en: The act of showing or offering something for others to see or consider.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.ex: The wardens walk around the prison every hour.
words.ex_cn: 狱警每小时在监狱里巡逻。
words.en: A warden is a person responsible for the supervision of a particular place or thing or for ensuring that regulations are obeyed, especially in a public institution or a national park.

words.tr: n. 元素；要素（尤指）风雨；“element”的复数；
words.ex: The elements battered the small cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风雨在暴风雨中猛烈袭击了小木屋。
words.en: The elements of something are the basic parts or aspects of it.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.tr:
v. 释放；
n. 释放；
words.ex: The factory releases smoke into the air.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向空气中释放烟雾。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or make it available, especially after it has been held or controlled. A release can also refer to the act of making something available or the state of being made available.

words.tr: v. <正>吃，吞下；<正>吃，吞下( ingest的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He ingested the medicine with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水吞下了药。
words.en: Taken into the body through the mouth and swallowed, especially referring to food, drink, or medicine.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.tr: adj. 蜿蜒的； v. “wind”的现在分词；
words.ex: The winding road goes through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条蜿蜒的道路穿过山脉。
words.en: A winding path, road, river, etc. repeatedly turns in different directions.

words.ex: My son loves watching cartoon animation.
words.ex_cn: 我儿子喜欢看卡通动画。
words.en: Animation is the process of making films in which drawings or puppets appear to move.

words.tr: adj. 讨厌的； v. “annoy”的现在分词；
words.ex: The loud noise is annoying.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音很讨厌。
words.en: Something that is annoying makes you feel fairly angry and impatient.

words.ex: The noise was 80 decibels.
words.ex_cn: 噪音是80分贝。
words.en: A decibel is a unit used to measure the intensity of a sound or the power level of an electrical signal by comparing it with a given level on a logarithmic scale.

words.ex: The city improved its drainage system after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，这座城市改进了它的排水系统。
words.en: Drainage is the system or process by which water or other liquids are drained from a place.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. “concern”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book is concerning climate change.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于气候变化的。
words.en: If something is concerning, it causes you to feel concerned about it.

words.ex: Traffic congestion caused delays on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 交通堵塞导致了高速公路的延误。
words.en: Congestion refers to the state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic or people, or the condition of being blocked or clogged.

words.tr:
conj. 也不；也没有；
adv. 也不；也没有；
words.ex: He doesn't like coffee, nor does she.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢咖啡，她也不喜欢。
words.en: used before the second or last of a set of negative possibilities, usually after 'neither'

words.ex: The table is two metres long.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子两米长。
words.en: A metre is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to 100 centimetres.

words.ex: The germination of the seed took five days.
words.ex_cn: 这颗种子的萌芽花了五天时间。
words.en: The process by which a seed begins to grow and develop into a new plant.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.ex: Children develop cognitive skills as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive means relating to the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.

words.ex: Blackbirds are singing in the trees.
words.ex_cn: 黑鸟在树上唱歌。
words.en: Blackbirds are a group of birds in the thrush family, Turdidae, which are primarily found in Europe, Asia, and North America. They are known for their melodious songs and are often found in gardens and woodlands.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 药片；平板电脑；石碑；
words.ex: He took two tablets for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了两片药来缓解头痛。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat piece of medicine that you swallow, or a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen.

words.tr: adv. 精神上；思想上；智力上；
words.ex: He is mentally strong despite his challenges.
words.ex_cn: 尽管面临挑战，他在精神上很坚强。
words.en: In a manner relating to the mind or mental processes.

words.tr: n. 编码；译码；编码，译码 v. （将文字材料）译成密码( encode的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The computer uses binary encoding to store data.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用二进制编码来存储数据。
words.en: The process of converting information or data into a particular form, especially for transmission, storage, or processing by computers.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.tr: n. 自闭症；孤独症；自我中心主义；
words.ex: He was diagnosed with autism at age three.
words.ex_cn: 他在三岁时被诊断出患有自闭症。
words.en: Autism is a developmental disorder characterized by difficulties with social interaction and communication, and by restricted and repetitive behavior.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.tr: v. 公认；意识到；认出；“recognise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is recognised as a great scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他被公认为一位伟大的科学家。
words.en: Generally accepted or acknowledged as being true or existing.

words.ex: She buys soft fabrics for her dresses.
words.ex_cn: 她为自己的连衣裙购买柔软的布料。
words.en: Fabrics are materials made by weaving or knitting fibers together, used for making clothes, curtains, etc., or the structure or foundation of something.

words.ex: He ate beetroot for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了甜菜根。
words.en: Beetroot is a deep red root vegetable that is eaten cooked or raw, often in salads.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.ex: He wears gloves to keep his hands warm.
words.ex_cn: 他戴手套来保暖双手。
words.en: Gloves are pieces of clothing which cover your hands and wrists and have individual sections for each finger. You wear gloves to keep your hands warm or dry or to protect them.

words.ex: The child looked sleepy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后看起来想睡觉。
words.en: If you are sleepy, you are tired and ready to go to sleep.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱买书。
words.en: To use money to pay for goods or services, or to use time or energy doing something.

words.ex: The trainee is learning how to use the machine.
words.ex_cn: 这位受训者正在学习如何使用这台机器。
words.en: A trainee is someone who is being taught how to do a particular job.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.tr: adj. 需氧的；好氧的；有氧的；
words.ex: Running is an aerobic exercise.
words.ex_cn: 跑步是有氧运动。
words.en: Aerobic exercise is physical exercise of relatively low intensity that depends primarily on the aerobic energy-generating process.

words.ex: The children rode a sled down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐着雪橇从积雪的山坡滑下。
words.en: A sled is a vehicle used for traveling over snow and ice, typically consisting of a light frame mounted on runners and often used for recreation or transporting goods.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.ex: The dark forest looks scary at night.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来吓人。
words.en: If something is scary, it causes fear or alarm.

words.ex: The rabbits hide behind the bushes.
words.ex_cn: 兔子藏在灌木后面。
words.en: A bush is a plant that grows to a medium height and has many branches.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.tr: v. 仍然是；保持；留下( remain的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He remained quiet during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间仍然是安静的。
words.en: If someone or something remains in a particular state or condition, they stay in that state or condition and do not change.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.ex: He has kind traits that make people like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有善良的特质，让人喜欢他。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.ex: My sibling plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的兄弟/姐妹每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A sibling is a brother or sister.

words.ex: He is a sociable man who likes to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢和朋友聊天的外向的人。
words.en: A sociable person is friendly and enjoys being with other people.

words.ex: The shy boy didn't speak in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩在课堂上没有说话。
words.en: If you are shy, you are nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

words.ex: Bats fly at night to find food.
words.ex_cn: 蝙蝠在晚上飞行觅食。
words.en: If someone is described as bats, it means they are crazy or eccentric.

words.ex: The plant grows quickly in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在阳光下生长得很快。
words.en: To increase in size or amount, or to become more advanced or developed.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.tr: int. 嗯(用于问题、建议之后)；嗯(表示没有听清楚)；
words.ex: You're going now? Huh?
words.ex_cn: 你现在就走？嗯？
words.en: Used to express confusion, surprise, or to ask for repetition.

words.ex: He is the organiser of the school fair.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校集市的组织者。
words.en: An organiser is someone who arranges an event or activity and makes the necessary preparations for it.

words.tr: v. 使处于某种状态；表达；放置；
words.ex: He puts the book on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在书架上。
words.en: To move something to a particular position or place; to cause someone or something to be in a particular state; to express something in words.

words.ex: He joined two associations last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年加入了两个协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.ex: He paints the fences every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都粉刷篱笆。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. To fence means to fight with swords, as a sport.

words.tr: v. 宠坏；搞糟；变质；“spoil”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被宠坏的；
words.ex: Her parents spoiled her with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母用太多玩具宠坏了她。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a child, as spoiled, you mean that they behave badly because they are given everything they want. Spoiled food or drink has decayed and is not fit to be eaten or drunk.

words.ex: He is analysing the data to find patterns.
words.ex_cn: 他正在分析数据以寻找模式。
words.en: If you analyse something, you consider it carefully or use statistical methods in order to fully understand it.

words.tr: n. 清洁；使清洁的人或物；清洁，使清洁的人或物 adj. 有去污作用的 v. 弄干净，清洗( cleanse的现在分词； v. 弄干净；清洗； adj. 有去污作用的；
words.ex: The cleansing of the river took many months.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的清洁花了好几个月。
words.en: The act of cleaning something, especially the skin.

words.tr: v. 煮沸；“boil”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 煮沸的；
words.ex: She boiled water for tea.
words.ex_cn: 她把水煮沸来泡茶。
words.en: Cooked in boiling water.

words.tr: adj. 不满意的；不高兴的； v. “dissatisfy”的过去式；
words.ex: He was dissatisfied with the service.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务不满意。
words.en: If you are dissatisfied with something, you are not contented or pleased with it.

words.ex: The dog dug deep pits in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗在院子里挖了深坑。
words.en: A large hole in the ground, especially one from which minerals are extracted.

words.ex: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.en: Milk is a white liquid produced by cows, goats, and some other animals, which people drink and use in cooking.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: Many people believe consumerism leads to waste.
words.ex_cn: 许多人认为消费主义会导致浪费。
words.en: Consumerism is the belief that it is good to buy and use a lot of goods and services, often associated with the idea that happiness can be achieved through consumption.

words.ex: She placed the cutlery neatly on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把餐具整齐地放在桌子上。
words.en: Cutlery refers to the tools used for eating or serving food, such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.tr: n. 色拉；凉拌生菜；“salad”的复数
words.ex: She eats salads every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她每天午餐都吃沙拉。
words.en: A mixture of raw vegetables, typically served as a dish, either alone or combined with other foods.

words.ex: The company uses social media channels to reach customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用社交媒体渠道来接触客户。
words.en: A channel is a band of radio waves used for broadcasting television or radio programmes, or a method or system for communication or distribution.

words.tr: adj. 可更新的；可再生的；
words.ex: Solar energy is a renewable resource.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能是一种可更新的资源。
words.en: A renewable resource is a natural resource which will replenish to replace the portion depleted by usage and consumption, either through natural reproduction or other recurring processes in a finite amount of time in a human time scale.

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.ex: The tides rise and fall twice a day.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每天涨落两次。
words.en: The regular rise and fall in the level of the sea, caused by the gravitational pull of the moon and sun.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
words.en: The knee is the joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans.

words.tr:
n. 猛玛（象）；庞然大物；
adj. 巨大的；庞大的；
words.ex: The mammoth lived in cold areas long ago.
words.ex_cn: 猛犸象很久以前生活在寒冷地区。
words.en: If you describe something as mammoth, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后刷了牙。
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.ex: The clouds are moving slowly across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵正在天空中缓慢移动。
words.en: A visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.tr: adj. 青少年的；十来岁的；
words.ex: Teenage boys often like playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 青少年男孩通常喜欢打篮球。
words.en: Teenage is used to describe someone who is between the ages of 13 and 19, or something that is related to or typical of this age group.

words.tr: adj. 鼓舞的；激励的； v. 鼓舞；激励；“inspire”的现在分词；
words.ex: Her speech was inspiring.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲是鼓舞人心的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as inspiring, you mean that they make you feel that you want to do something, especially something new or creative.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.ex: He is a composer who writes music for movies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位为电影作曲的作曲家。
words.en: A composer is a person who writes music, especially classical music.

words.tr: adj. 管弦乐的；管弦乐队的；
words.ex: The orchestra played an orchestral piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 乐团在音乐会上演奏了一首管弦乐作品。
words.en: Relating to or written for an orchestra.

words.tr: v. 安排（arrange 的 ing 形式）
words.ex: He is arranging books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把书摆放在架子上。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.ex: There are 637 girls in the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校里有637个女孩。
words.en: Female children or young women.

words.tr: v. 努力；奋斗；搏斗；搏斗( struggle的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He struggled to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成作业。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though other people or things may be making it difficult for you to succeed.

words.ex: The ships carry large cargoes across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这些船运送大量的货物穿越海洋。
words.en: Cargoes are goods carried by a large vehicle such as a ship or plane.

words.tr: v. 保存；保护；保持；“preserve”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 防腐的；
words.ex: The old photos were preserved in a box.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧照片被保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: Kept in its original state or in good condition, especially over a long period of time.

words.ex: He wore heavy boots to walk in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了厚重的靴子在雪地里走路。
words.en: Boots are a type of footwear that covers the foot and extends up the leg, sometimes to the knee or even the hip. They are typically made of leather or rubber and are worn for protection against cold, wet, or rugged terrain.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.ex: He throw the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To propel something through the air with a movement of the arm and hand.

words.ex: He puts the bottles in the bins.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子放进垃圾桶里。
words.en: A bin is a container that you put rubbish in.

words.ex: Exercise promotes good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼促进健康。
words.en: If someone promotes something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread.

words.ex: He hurt his finger while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在做饭时弄伤了手指。
words.en: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand, including your thumb.

words.ex: She baked a chocolate cake for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她为生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat in an oven. Cakes may be large and cut into slices or small and intended for one person only.

words.tr: v. 绑；系；拴；约束；与...成平局；“tie”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He tied his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系好了鞋带。
words.en: If something is tied, it is fastened or secured with a knot or similar method.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在秋季落下。
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.tr: v. 使装满；使充满；“fill”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He filled the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满了水。
words.en: Something that is filled has a lot of a particular substance or material inside it.

words.ex: The disappearance of the keys confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙的消失让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: The act of disappearing or the state of having disappeared.

words.ex: The redstarts sing loudly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 红尾鸲早上大声鸣叫。
words.en: Redstarts are small birds belonging to the genus Phoenicurus, known for their distinctive red tails.

words.ex: The stork flew over the house with a baby in its beak.
words.ex_cn: 鹳叼着婴儿飞过房子。
words.en: A stork is a large bird with long legs and a long beak, known for delivering babies in folklore.

words.ex: The warrior threw a spear at the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 战士向敌人投掷了一支矛。
words.en: A spear is a weapon consisting of a long pole with a sharp point at one end, used for thrusting or throwing.

words.ex: The specialists help patients with rare diseases.
words.ex_cn: 这些专家帮助患有罕见疾病的人。
words.en: A specialist is a person who concentrates primarily on a particular subject or activity; a person highly skilled in a specific and restricted field.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.ex: The company improved data retention after upgrading its system.
words.ex_cn: 公司在升级系统后提高了数据保留能力。
words.en: The action of retaining something; the continued possession, use, or control of something.

words.tr: adj. 有益的；值得的； v. “reward”的现在分词；
words.ex: Volunteering is a rewarding experience.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务是一种有益的经历。
words.en: Providing satisfaction or gratification; beneficial.

words.tr: adj. 压碎的；压扁的；压碎的，压扁的 v. 挤进( squash的过去式和过去分词 )； v. 将（某人[某物]）压扁；
words.ex: The tomatoes were squashed by the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 西红柿被重箱子压碎了。
words.en: To crush or squeeze something with force so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape.

words.ex: The school held a bake sale for fundraising.
words.ex_cn: 学校举办了一个烘焙义卖来筹款。
words.en: Fundraising is the activity of collecting money to support a charity or political campaign or organization.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.ex: Poachers kill elephants for their tusks.
words.ex_cn: 偷猎者为了象牙猎杀大象。
words.en: Poachers are people who illegally hunt or catch animals, especially on someone else's land.

words.ex: Vets take care of sick animals.
words.ex_cn: 兽医照顾生病的动物。
words.en: Vets are professionals who provide medical care to animals or individuals who have served in the military.

words.ex: The car drove slowly through the fog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓驶过浓雾。
words.en: Fog is a thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface which obscures or restricts visibility (to a greater extent than mist; strictly, reducing visibility to below 1 km).

words.ex: He ties his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系鞋带。
words.en: To fasten or secure with or as if with a cord, rope, or strap.

words.ex: A deer is walking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹿正在森林里走路。
words.en: A deer is a large wild animal that eats grass and leaves. The male has antlers that are shed and regrown each year.

words.ex: He faces many challenges every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天面临许多挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: He worked hard, and ultimately succeeded.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，最终成功了。
words.en: You use ultimately to indicate that something is the final result of a series of events or the most important part of a situation.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.ex: The mouse ran under the table.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠跑到了桌子下面。
words.en: A mouse is a small animal with a long tail, which is found in houses and fields and is often kept as a pet. In computing, a mouse is a small device that you move across a surface in order to move a cursor on your computer screen.

words.tr: v. 留心听；倾听( listen的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He listened carefully to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他认真地听老师讲课。
words.en: To listen is to give attention to sound or action.

words.ex: Her resilience helped her recover after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 她的复原力帮助她在事故后恢复。
words.en: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.

words.ex: The children found old toys in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阁楼上找到了旧玩具。
words.en: An attic is a space or room just below the roof of a building, often used for storage or as an extra room.

words.ex: Farmers grow corn as a crop.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植玉米作为农作物。
words.en: A crop is a plant such as wheat, potatoes, or cotton that is grown in large quantities by farmers.

words.ex: He eats nuts every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃坚果当早餐。
words.en: If you say that someone is nuts, you mean that they are crazy. Nuts are hard-shelled fruits of some trees.

words.ex: She has needles in her hand.
words.ex_cn: 她的手上有一根针。
words.en: Needles are thin, pointed metal pieces used in sewing or medical procedures, or anything resembling a needle in shape.

words.tr: v. 碰撞；打；击；“hit”的现在分词；
words.ex: The car was hitting a tree.
words.ex_cn: 汽车正在撞上一棵树。
words.en: The act of coming into contact with something quickly and forcefully.

words.ex: The fish survives in cold water.
words.ex_cn: 这种鱼在冷水里存活。
words.en: If a person or living thing survives in a dangerous situation such as an accident or an illness, they do not die.

words.tr: n. <英>饼干；<英>饼干( biscuit的名词复数 )；
words.ex: She ate a biscuit with tea in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她下午喝茶时吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A biscuit is a small, flat cake that is crisp and usually sweet.

words.ex: He eats sushi for lunch every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五吃寿司当午餐。
words.en: Sushi is a Japanese dish consisting of small balls or rolls of vinegar-flavored cold cooked rice served with a garnish of raw fish, vegetables, or egg.

words.tr: n. 柜台；计数器；反对；柜台( counter的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The customers waited at the counters to pay.
words.ex_cn: 顾客在柜台前排队付款。
words.en: Opposing arguments or points of view presented in a debate or discussion.

words.tr: adj. 遍地树木的；森林覆盖的；
words.ex: The forested hills looked green and peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 遍地树木的山丘看起来绿意盎然，宁静祥和。
words.en: Covered with forest.

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.ex: The cat likes to roam around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在花园里游荡。
words.en: To roam means to move about or travel without any definite purpose or destination.

words.tr: v. 流；流动；“flow”的现在分词；
words.ex: The river is flowing fast.
words.ex_cn: 河水正在快速流淌。
words.en: Moving smoothly and continuously in a current or stream.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.ex: There is an abundance of food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 聚会上食物非常丰富。
words.en: A very large quantity of something.

words.ex: The railways connect many cities in the country.
words.ex_cn: 铁路连接了这个国家的许多城市。
words.en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails.

words.tr: v. 指向；“point”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 尖的；
words.ex: He pointed to the map.
words.ex_cn: 他指向地图。
words.en: Something that is pointed has a sharp end or is very direct in what it says.

words.tr: v. 熔炼；提炼；熔炼，提炼（矿石）( smelt的过去式和过去分词 )；合演( costar的过去式和过去分；
words.ex: The iron was smelted in a hot furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁是在高温炉中熔炼的。
words.en: To extract (metal) from its ore by a process involving heating and melting.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.ex: He is a conner who tricks people with fake stories.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个用虚假故事骗人的骗子。
words.en: A person who deceives others for personal gain.

words.tr: n. 村舍；小屋；小别墅；“cottage”的复数；
words.ex: The tourists stayed in small cottages near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 游客们住在湖边的小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, especially in the country.

words.tr: n. 借用的言语（或思想等）； v. 借；借用；“borrow”的现在分词；
words.ex: His poem shows a lot of borrowing from old folk tales.
words.ex_cn: 他的诗大量借用民间故事的言语。
words.en: The act of taking and using something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.ex: The extensions of the building added more space.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的延伸部分增加了更多空间。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to enlarge or prolong it; a continuation.

words.tr: v. 检查；“check”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher checked the students' homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师检查了学生的作业。
words.en: Having a pattern of squares, typically of two colors; past tense and past participle of check, meaning to examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition.

words.ex: The tenants pay rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 这些房客每个月交房租。
words.en: Tenants are people who rent a place to live or work in.

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.ex: The shady spot under the tree is cool.
words.ex_cn: 树下的背阴处很凉爽。
words.en: If you describe a person or activity as shady, you mean that they seem dishonest or illegal.

words.tr: v. 调整；管制；“regulate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The government regulated the price of food.
words.ex_cn: 政府调整了食品的价格。
words.en: If an activity, process, or industry is regulated, it is controlled by rules or laws.

words.tr: v. 强迫；“force”的现在分词； n. 催熟；
words.ex: They were forcing him to work late.
words.ex_cn: 他们强迫他加班。
words.en: Forcing refers to the act of making someone do something against their will, often using threats or physical power.

words.tr: v. 加剧；增强；“intensify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The storm intensified after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后，风暴加剧了。
words.en: If you intensify something or if it intensifies, it becomes greater in strength, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He was knocking on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他正在敲门。
words.en: The sound of someone hitting something, such as a door or window, with their knuckles or a hard object.

words.tr: adj. 已冷的； v. “chill”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The chilled water tasted refreshing.
words.ex_cn: 冰凉的水喝起来很清爽。
words.en: If something is chilled, it has been made cold, often in order to make it more pleasant or refreshing.

words.ex: The store is temporarily closed.
words.ex_cn: 这家店暂时关闭了。
words.en: For a limited time; not permanently.

words.ex: The child is hungry and cries for food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子饿了，哭着要吃的。
words.en: Feeling or showing the need for food; having a strong desire or craving.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.ex: The swans are swimming in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 天鹅正在湖里游泳。
