words.en: Swans are large aquatic birds closely related to geese and ducks. They are known for their grace, both in water and in flight.

words.tr: v. 出现；呈现，出现，发生( arise的现在分词 )；
words.ex: Problems are arising from the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 新政策出现了问题。
words.en: Resulting or emerging from something.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.tr:
v. 触发；引起；发动；
n. 诱因；触发；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: A trigger is a device that activates a mechanism when it is pulled or pressed. It can also refer to something that causes a particular reaction or development.

words.tr:
adj. 中断的；
v. 打断；中断；
words.ex: The interrupted signal made the call drop.
words.ex_cn: 中断的信号导致通话断了。
words.en: If something is interrupted, it is stopped or paused, especially because of an unexpected event.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.tr: adj. 不快乐的；不高兴的；
words.ex: He looked unhappy after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后看起来不快乐。
words.en: If you are unhappy, you are sad and depressed.

words.ex: He finds peace through spiritual meditation.
words.ex_cn: 他通过精神上的冥想找到平静。
words.en: Relating to the human spirit or soul as opposed to material or physical things.

words.ex: Their friendship lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的友谊持续了二十年。
words.en: A friendship is a relationship between two or more friends.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.ex: He hurt his ear while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了耳朵。
words.en: The organ of hearing in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of this organ.

words.tr: v. 削减；切；（从某物上）切下；
words.ex: The company cuts costs to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司削减成本以节省资金。
words.en: Cuts can refer to the act of making an incision or reducing something in size, amount, or extent. It can also denote a wound or incision made by a sharp object.

words.tr: n. 上诉；恳求；“appeal”的复数； v. 有吸引力；
words.ex: He filed two appeals against the court's decision.
words.ex_cn: 他对法院的判决提起了两次上诉。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. An appeal is also a request for donations or support.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.ex: The police caught the men who committed crimes.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了那些犯下罪行的人。
words.en: Crimes are illegal actions or activities for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: The robbery happened at the bank yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天银行发生了抢劫。
words.en: The crime of stealing from someone or somewhere, especially using violence or threats.

words.tr: v. 排除，不包括在内；排除，不包括在内( exclude的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: Children under 12 are excluded from the game.
words.ex_cn: 12岁以下的儿童不被允许参加这个游戏。
words.en: If you exclude someone from a place or activity, you prevent them from entering it or taking part in it.

words.ex: The children drew circles on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在纸上画了圈。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the center of the area.

words.tr: adj. 没意识到的；不知道的；
words.ex: He was unaware of the rain until he got wet.
words.ex_cn: 他直到被淋湿了才意识到下雨了。
words.en: If you are unaware of something, you do not know about it.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.tr:
n. 橙子；橙色；
adj. 橙色的；
words.ex: I ate an orange for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃了一个橙子。
words.en: A round juicy citrus fruit with a tough bright reddish-yellow rind.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏足够教育的；贫穷的； v. 剥夺；使丧失；“deprive”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: Children from deprived areas often struggle to read and write.
words.ex_cn: 来自教育缺乏地区的儿童常常难以阅读和写作。
words.en: If you are deprived of something that you want or need, you do not have it.

words.ex: The poorer families need more help.
words.ex_cn: 更穷的家庭需要更多的帮助。
words.en: Comparative of poor; having less money or fewer possessions than someone else, or than you had before; of a lower quality or standard than someone or something else.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.tr:
n. 责任；责备；
v. 责怪；归咎于；
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.ex: The train arrives at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车在下午五点到达。
words.en: To reach a place, especially at the end of a journey.

words.ex: They live in a small flat near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Flats are apartments that are usually on one floor of a building. They can also refer to women's shoes with a very low heel or no heel.

words.ex: My pets are a cat and a dog.
words.ex_cn: 我的宠物是一只猫和一只狗。
words.en: Animals kept for companionship or pleasure.

words.ex: This book has three editions.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有三个版次。
words.en: An edition is a particular version of a book, magazine, or newspaper that is printed at one time.

words.tr: adj. 耸人听闻的；极好的；
words.ex: The newspaper published a sensational story about a ghost.
words.ex_cn: 这家报纸刊登了一篇关于幽灵的耸人听闻的消息。
words.en: A sensational event or situation is so remarkable that it causes great excitement and interest.

words.ex: The children are excited to see the circuses this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们很兴奋这个周末要看马戏团表演。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers, often including clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, that travels to different places to entertain people with their performances.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.tr: v. （按时间、顺序等）接着；跟随，接着；继承；
words.ex: Spring follows winter.
words.ex_cn: 春天接着冬天到来。
words.en: If you follow someone who is going somewhere, you move along behind them because you want to go to the same place.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.ex: He is a talented singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有才能的歌手。
words.en: Someone who is talented has a natural ability to do something well.

words.ex: I cherish every moment with my family.
words.ex_cn: 我珍惜与家人在一起的每一个瞬间。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.tr:
n. 展示优点的场合（或机会）；
v. 展示…的优点；
words.ex: The competition was a showcase for her talent.
words.ex_cn: 这次比赛是她展示才华的机会。
words.en: A showcase is a setting in which someone or something is displayed to its best advantage, or a glass case used for displaying articles in a shop or museum.

words.tr:
n. 魔术；魔法；
adj. 魔术（似）的；神奇的；
words.ex: He performed magic at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上表演了魔术。
words.en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

words.ex: The birds flew through the aerial sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在空中飞翔。
words.en: An aerial is a wire or rod that sends or receives radio or television signals. As an adjective, aerial describes things that are in the air or related to the air.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: The puppeteers moved the strings to make the dolls dance.
words.ex_cn: 木偶操纵者拉动绳子，让玩偶跳舞。
words.en: A puppeteer is a person who manipulates puppets in a performance.

words.ex: The concert was terrific!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something or someone as terrific, you are very pleased with them or very impressed by them.

words.tr: v. 参考；查阅；谈及；送交；推荐；“refer”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 援引的；
words.ex: He referred to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 他参考字典查找这个词的意思。
words.en: To direct someone to a source for information; to send or direct someone to a specialist or authority for decision, information, or treatment.

words.tr: v. 准备； adj. 准备的，预备的 v. 准备( prepare的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is preparing for his exam.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为考试做准备。
words.en: If you prepare something, you make it ready for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.ex: She answered the question confidently.
words.ex_cn: 她自信地回答了问题。
words.en: If you do something confidently, you do it in a way that shows you are sure of what you're doing or saying.

words.ex: His motivational speech made everyone feel hopeful.
words.ex_cn: 他激发性的演讲让每个人都感到充满希望。
words.en: Something that is motivational provides encouragement or incentive to do something.

words.ex: He is overcoming his fear of public speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他正在克服对公开演讲的恐惧。
words.en: To overcome means to successfully deal with or gain control of something difficult.

words.ex: His enrolment at the university starts next month.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的入学时间是下个月。
words.en: Enrolment refers to the process of signing up or registering for something, such as a school, course, or program.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.tr: v. 整理（文件或书等）；整理；校对( collate的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He collated the reports before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前整理了这些报告。
words.en: To collect, compare carefully in order to verify, and often to integrate or arrange in order.

words.tr: v. 画；提取；吸引；“draw”的过去式；
words.ex: He drew a cat on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一只猫。
words.en: Drew is the past tense of draw, which means to produce a picture or diagram by making lines and marks on paper or another surface.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.ex: The team reached a consensus on the project plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队就项目计划达成了共识。
words.en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: They signed an agreement to share the costs.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份分担费用的协议。
words.en: An agreement is a formal decision about future action which is made by two or more people, groups, or organizations.

words.ex: The unpopular teacher had few students in class.
words.ex_cn: 这位不受欢迎的老师班上学生很少。
words.en: If something or someone is unpopular, most people do not like them.

words.tr: adj. 最低限度的；极少的；最小的；
words.ex: He made minimal changes to the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对计划做了最低限度的修改。
words.en: Something that is minimal is very small in quantity, value, or degree.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: He is claiming that he saw a UFO.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己看到了UFO。
words.en: To state that something is true, often without providing evidence; to demand something as a right.

words.ex: It was unfortunate that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他没赶上公交车，真是不幸。
words.en: If you describe someone as unfortunate, you mean that something unpleasant or unlucky has happened to them. You can also describe the unpleasant things that happen to them as unfortunate.

words.ex: There were many incidents at the school last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月学校发生了许多事件。
words.en: An incident is an event, especially one that is unusual, important, or violent.

words.ex: He gave a fuller explanation than before.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了比之前更充分的解释。
words.en: More complete or containing more information.

words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: The children played on the deck of the ship.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在船的甲板上玩耍。
words.en: A deck is a floor-like surface on a ship, or a set of cards used in games. It can also mean to decorate or adorn something.

words.tr: v. 要价；指控；“charge”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 充了电的（带电的）；引起强烈感情的；
words.ex: The shop charged $50 for the shirt.
words.ex_cn: 这家店给这件衬衫要价50美元。
words.en: If a situation or atmosphere is charged, it is filled with emotion and therefore exciting or tense. If someone is charged with a crime, they are officially accused of it.

words.tr: n. 清单；“list”的复数； v. 列出；
words.ex: I made a list of groceries to buy.
words.ex_cn: 我列了一份购物清单。
words.en: A list is a set of items written or printed one after the other, often with numbers or bullet points in front of them. As a verb, to list means to make a list of items or to include something in a list.

words.tr:
n. 自豪；骄傲；
v. 对…感到自豪；
words.ex: He felt pride when his son graduated.
words.ex_cn: 当他儿子毕业时，他感到自豪。
words.en: A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired.

words.ex: He takes vitamin supplements every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上服用维生素补充剂。
words.en: Something that completes or enhances something else when added to it.

words.tr: n. 小测验；知识竞赛；“quiz”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher gave us five quizzes this week.
words.ex_cn: 老师这周给了我们五次小测验。
words.en: A quiz is a test, game, or competition in which someone answers questions.

words.ex: He made several requests for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了几次求助请求。
words.en: A request is the act of politely or formally asking for something.

words.tr: adj. 包容的；包含全部费用的；
words.ex: The school is inclusive and welcomes all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是包容的，欢迎所有学生。
words.en: Inclusive is used to describe something that is designed to include all types of people, things, or ideas, and to treat them all fairly and equally.

words.tr:
prep. 加；加上；
conj. 加；和；并且；
n. 优势；
words.ex: Five plus three is eight.
words.ex_cn: 五加三等于八。
words.en: Used to indicate addition, or a positive quality or factor.

words.tr:
v. 吹；打击；
n. 打击；
words.ex: The wind blows the leaves away.
words.ex_cn: 风吹走了树叶。
words.en: To move air or gas forcefully; to strike something with force.

words.ex: The upside of working late is more money.
words.ex_cn: 加班的好处是能赚更多钱。
words.en: The upside is the more positive aspect of a situation that is generally bad.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.ex: Each unit in the course lasts two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 课程中的每个单元持续两周。
words.en: Units refer to individual parts or elements that are part of a larger whole, often used in the context of measurement, education, or components of a system.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.ex: The sun shines on the crystals and makes them sparkle.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在晶体上，使它们闪闪发光。
words.en: Crystals are solid materials whose constituents (such as atoms, molecules, or ions) are arranged in a highly ordered microscopic structure, forming a crystal lattice that extends in all directions.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 天空的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.ex: The cake was divided into four segments.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕被分成了四部分。
words.en: A segment is one of several parts that together make up a whole thing, which could be a piece of fruit, a market, or a television program.

words.tr: n. 彩色；颜料；脸色；脸色（color 的复数）；
words.ex: The children love to paint with bright colors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢用鲜艳的彩色画画。
words.en: Colors are the different hues that can be seen in light and pigment, and are used to describe the appearance of objects.

words.tr: v. 纺（纱）；旋转；疾驰；“spin”的现在分词； n. 纺织；
words.ex: She is spinning wool into yarn.
words.ex_cn: 她正在把羊毛纺成纱线。
words.en: the process or activity of spinning fibers to produce yarn or thread.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: It's risky to walk alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 晚上独自走路是危险的。
words.en: If an activity or action is risky, it is dangerous or likely to fail.

words.tr: v. 推；逼迫；按；“push”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is pushing the cart down the street.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把购物车推下街道。
words.en: Pushing is used to describe someone who is determined to get what they want, often in a way that other people find annoying.

words.ex: The movie was tame and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影枯燥无味。
words.en: If you describe an animal as tame, you mean that it is not afraid of humans and is not dangerous. If you describe a person or their behavior as tame, you mean that they are not very exciting or interesting.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.ex: This is the longest river in the country.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个国家最长的河流。
words.en: Superlative form of long: having the greatest length.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.tr:
adj. 有利的；加权的
v. 使负担；装载过重；重累；视…为重要；“weight”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The survey results were weighted to reflect the population distribution.
words.ex_cn: 调查结果根据人口分布进行了加权。
words.en: If something is weighted, it has been given a value or importance that is greater than it would normally have.

words.ex: The plastic is pliable and easy to bend.
words.ex_cn: 这种塑料柔韧，容易弯曲。
words.en: A pliable object or material is easy to bend or shape without breaking.

words.ex: He has a big nose.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个大鼻子。
words.en: The part of the face or head that contains the nostrils and organs of smell and through which a person or animal breathes.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.ex: Let me help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 让我帮你做作业。
words.en: to allow something to happen or someone to do something by not doing anything to stop an action or by giving your permission

words.ex: There are thirteen apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十三个苹果。
words.en: The number 13, which is one more than twelve and one less than fourteen.

words.ex: A snake is a reptile.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种爬行动物。
words.en: A reptile is a cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia, including snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are characterized by their scaly skin and the fact that they lay eggs on land.

words.ex: The hotel confirmed all bookings for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 酒店确认了所有明天的预订。
words.en: Bookings refer to the act of reserving something, such as a hotel room, a flight, or a ticket for an event, in advance.

words.tr: v. 测试；试验；“test”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 经受过考验的；
words.ex: The teacher tested the students on math.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生进行了数学测试。
words.en: Having been subjected to tests or trials.

words.ex: The jury gave a guilty verdict.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团作出了有罪裁决。
words.en: A verdict is a decision made after a lot of consideration, especially one made by a jury in a court of law.

words.ex: It didn't matter what he said.
words.ex_cn: 他说什么并不重要。
words.en: If you say that something matters, you mean that it is important because it has an effect on a situation or person.

words.tr: n. 其他选项；工具条；补充报道
words.ex: The sidebar shows other options for editing the document.
words.ex_cn: 侧边栏显示了编辑文档的其他选项。
words.en: A sidebar is a short piece of text that provides additional information about a topic, often placed at the side of a page or screen.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.ex: He counted the coins with his fingers.
words.ex_cn: 他用手指数硬币。
words.en: Fingers are the long thin parts on the end of your hand that you use to hold things.

words.tr:
adj. 零下的；负的；
n. 缺点；
prep. 减去；
words.ex: The temperature is minus ten degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 气温是零下十摄氏度。
words.en: A minus is a mathematical symbol that represents subtraction or a negative quantity.

words.ex: The broken glass is a hazard.
words.ex_cn: 碎玻璃是危险。
words.en: A hazard is something which could be dangerous to you, your health or safety, or your plans or reputation.

words.tr: v. 降低；“lower”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He lowered the volume of the radio.
words.ex_cn: 他降低了收音机的音量。
words.en: To move something down to a less high position, or to reduce something in amount, degree, or quality.

words.tr: v. 承诺；有希望；“promise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: If you promise that you will do something, you say to someone that you will definitely do it.

words.ex: The edges of the paper are torn.
words.ex_cn: 纸的边缘撕破了。
words.en: The outer or furthest point of something.

words.ex: Toddlers love to play with colorful blocks.
words.ex_cn: 幼儿喜欢玩彩色积木。
words.en: Toddlers are young children who are just beginning to walk.

words.ex: He showed his qualifications for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了自己胜任这份工作的资格。
words.en: The skills, qualities, or experience that you need in order to do something.

words.tr:
n. 财政；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The government is managing its finances carefully.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在谨慎地管理其财政。
words.en: Finances refers to the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: The furniture is modular, so you can change its shape.
words.ex_cn: 这套家具是组合式的，你可以改变它的形状。
words.en: A modular system or method is one in which the parts can be separated and recombined easily, often used to describe furniture, software, or buildings that are made up of separate components.

words.tr: n. （按顺序的）数数；计数( count的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The child says counts slowly while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在玩耍时慢慢数数。
words.en: The third person singular present tense of the verb 'count'; also used as a noun meaning the act of counting or a total number obtained by counting.

words.tr: n. 研讨会；专题讨论；“seminar”的复数；
words.ex: Students attend seminars to discuss research topics.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加研讨会来讨论研究话题。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a particular subject or topic, often in an academic or professional setting.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.ex: He made clear statements about his plans.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的计划做了明确的陈述。
words.en: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

words.tr: n. 护理（工作）；护理行业； v. “nurse”的现在分词；
words.ex: She works in nursing at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她在当地医院从事护理工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of providing care for the sick and infirm.

words.tr: n. 倡议；新方案（initiative 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The government launched new initiatives to help small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府推出了新的倡议来帮助小企业。
words.en: An initiative is an important act or statement that is intended to solve a problem.

words.ex: The institutions help students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 这些机构帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.tr: v. 入学；招收( enrol的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is enrolling in university next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将入学大学。
words.en: To officially register or enter someone as a member of a group or a student at an institution.

words.ex: This small business is profitable.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业有利可图的。
words.en: If something is profitable, it makes a profit or is beneficial.

words.tr: v. 劝告； adj. 深思熟虑的 v. 劝告，提建议( advise的过去式和；
words.ex: He advised me to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他劝我多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you say that something is advised, you mean that it is the right or sensible thing to do, often because it has been thought about carefully.

words.tr: n. 储蓄金；存款；“saving”的复数；
words.ex: He used his savings to buy a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的储蓄买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Money that someone has saved, especially in a bank or official scheme.

words.tr: v. 影印；影印得好（或不好）（photocopy 的现在分词）；
words.ex: He is photocopying his notes before class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在课前影印他的笔记。
words.en: The process of making a photographic copy of printed or written material.

words.ex: He is graduating next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月毕业。
words.en: To complete a course of study at a school, college, or university, and receive a degree or diploma.

words.tr: n. 调查；勘测；“survey”的复数； v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did surveys about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: Surveys are a method of gathering information from a sample of people, traditionally with the intention of generalizing the results to a larger population.

words.ex: He walked to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天走路去学校。
words.en: To move at a regular pace by lifting and setting down each foot in turn, never having both feet off the ground at once.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: He pays his bills every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五支付账单。
words.en: A bill is a written statement of money that you owe for goods or services.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.tr: v. 赞助；“sponsor”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The company sponsored the local marathon.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司赞助了当地的马拉松比赛。
words.en: If an event or activity is sponsored by a person or organization, they pay for its costs or give it financial support.

words.ex: The forces of nature can be very powerful.
words.ex_cn: 自然的力量可能非常强大。
words.en: Forces refer to the capacity to do work or cause physical change; energy, strength, or active power.

words.tr: n. 享受；乐趣；乐事；享有；
words.ex: She finds enjoyment in reading books.
words.ex_cn: 她从读书中获得享受。
words.en: The pleasure that you get from something.

words.tr: int. 表示犹豫、思考或不确定的语气词；
words.ex: Erm, I'm not sure if I can come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 呃，我不确定我明天能不能来。
words.en: used to express hesitation or uncertainty

words.tr: n. 角；角度；角落；看问题的角度；“angle”的复数；
words.ex: The triangle has three angles.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三个角。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees. It can also refer to a particular way of approaching something or a point of view.

words.ex: He is inexperienced in managing teams.
words.ex_cn: 他在管理团队方面没有经验。
words.en: If you describe someone as inexperienced, you mean that they have little knowledge or experience of a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: The explorers traveled to unknown lands.
words.ex_cn: 这些探险家前往了未知的土地。
words.en: Explorers are people who travel to places about which very little is known, in order to discover what is there.

words.tr: n. 美；美的事物；美丽；美人；
words.ex: The beauty of the sunset amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 日落的美让所有人都惊叹。
words.en: Beauty is the quality of being pleasing, especially to look at, or someone or something that gives great pleasure, especially when you look at it.

words.ex: The facts show that he was not at the scene.
words.ex_cn: 事实表明他当时不在现场。
words.en: A fact is a piece of information that is known to be true.

words.ex: Winter is the coldest season.
words.ex_cn: 冬天是最冷的季节。
words.en: Superlative form of 'cold', meaning having the lowest temperature or being the least warm.

words.tr:
n. 帽子；
v. 覆盖…的顶部；
words.ex: He wore a blue cap to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶蓝色的帽子去公园。
words.en: A cap is a soft, flat hat with a peak at the front. Caps are usually worn by men and boys. A cap is also a protective lid or cover for a bottle, jar, or other container.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.tr: n. 平台；站台；月台；“platform”的复数；
words.ex: The company uses online platforms to sell products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用在线平台销售产品。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure or area, often used for public speaking, performances, or as a base for machinery or equipment.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.tr:
v. （使）结冰；（使）冻结；
n. 严寒期；冻结；
words.ex: The water will freeze in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 水在寒冷的天气里会结冰。
words.en: If a liquid or a substance containing a liquid freezes, or if something freezes it, it becomes solid because of low temperatures.

words.tr: v. 监控（无线电或电视传输信号）；监视；监控（无线电或电视传输信号）（monitor 的现在分词）；
words.ex: The team is monitoring radio signals for errors.
words.ex_cn: 团队正在监控无线电信号以查找错误。
words.en: The act of observing and checking the progress or quality of something over a period of time; keeping under systematic review.

words.ex: The unemployment rate is an economic indicator.
words.ex_cn: 失业率是一个经济指标。
words.en: An indicator is a measurement or value which gives you an idea of what something is like.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.ex: He drinks two litres of water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝两升水。
words.en: A litre is a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions; now equal to 1,000 cubic centimetres (or approximately 1.75 pints).

words.ex: His journeys across the mountains were long but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 他穿越群山的旅程漫长却美丽。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when involving a considerable distance; a trip.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: He checked his messages on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了手机上的信息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.ex: He asked two referees to write letters for his job application.
words.ex_cn: 他请了两位证明人为他的工作申请写推荐信。
words.en: Referees are officials who ensure that the rules of a game or sport are followed and who make decisions during the game.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.tr: v. 调整；使适合；使适应；
words.ex: He adjusted the chair to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了椅子以便坐得舒服。
words.en: To adjust something means to change it so that it is more effective or appropriate, or so that it fits better.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.ex: The officer gave a clear order to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军官向士兵下达了明确的命令。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, the police, or a government organization.

words.tr: adv. 急剧地；引人注目地；
words.ex: The temperature dropped dramatically overnight.
words.ex_cn: 夜间温度急剧下降。
words.en: In a way that is sudden, noticeable, or significant, often in a way that is intended to produce a strong effect.

words.ex: Eating less sugar reduces health risks.
words.ex_cn: 少吃糖可以减少健康风险。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.tr: n. 垃圾填埋（场）；垃圾堆填（区）；
words.ex: The city built a new landfill outside the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市在城外建了一个新的垃圾填埋场。
words.en: A landfill is a place where waste is buried under the ground.

words.tr: n. 分类； v. 分类；整理；“sort”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sorting of books by genre makes the library easier to use.
words.ex_cn: 按类型对书籍进行分类使图书馆更容易使用。
words.en: The act of separating things into different groups, types, or sizes.

words.ex: They carry umbrellas when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他们带雨伞。
words.en: A device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sometimes sun.

words.ex: He put the jam in jars.
words.ex_cn: 他把果酱装进了罐子里。
words.en: A jar is a wide-mouthed container, typically made of glass or pottery, used for storing food or other items. As a verb, to jar means to cause a sudden shock or jolt.

words.ex: He eats fibre to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃纤维来保持健康。
words.en: Fibre refers to a thread or filament from which a vegetable tissue, mineral substance, or textile is formed. It can also denote dietary material containing substances such as cellulose, lignin, and pectin, which are resistant to the action of digestive enzymes.

words.tr: n. 打印机；印刷厂；“printer”的复数；
words.ex: The office bought three new printers.
words.ex_cn: 办公室买了三台新打印机。
words.en: A printer is a machine that prints text or pictures onto paper, especially one linked to a computer.

words.ex: The children are holding their pencils.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们拿着他们的铅笔。
words.en: Pencils are instruments for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of graphite or a similar substance enclosed in a cylinder of wood or fixed in a metal or plastic case.

words.tr:
n. 金额；总数；
v. 概括；
words.ex: The sum of the bill is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 账单的金额是五十美元。
words.en: A sum is an amount of money, or the total amount of two or more amounts of money added together.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.ex: The matches start next week.
words.ex_cn: 比赛下周开始。
words.en: A match is a contest in which people or teams compete against each other in a sport or game. It can also refer to a short, thin piece of wood or cardboard used to light a fire.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.tr: n. 时事通讯；简报；“newsletter”的复数；
words.ex: I read the weekly newsletters from my favorite blog.
words.ex_cn: 我阅读我最喜欢博客的每周时事通讯。
words.en: A newsletter is a printed or electronic report containing news concerning the activities of a business or an organization that is sent to its members, customers, employees or other subscribers.

words.ex: The teacher supervises the students during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师在实验期间指导学生。
words.en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

words.ex: The city's expansion caused more traffic.
words.ex_cn: 城市的扩张导致了更多的交通拥堵。
words.en: Expansion refers to the process of becoming larger or more extensive.

words.tr: v. 联络（通过电话或信件）；与（某人）接触（或；联络（通过电话或信件）( contact的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: I contacted my teacher by email.
words.ex_cn: 我通过电子邮件联系了我的老师。
words.en: If you contact someone, you communicate with them, for example by telephone or letter.

words.tr: v. 拖拽；缓慢而费力地移动；
words.ex: He was dragging the box across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把箱子拖过地板。
words.en: To pull something or someone along with effort, often because they are heavy or because there is resistance.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.ex: He will inevitably fail if he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不学习，他不可避免地会失败。
words.en: If something will inevitably happen, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.ex: I disagree with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意你的观点。
words.en: If you disagree with someone or disagree with what they say, you do not accept that what they say is true or you do not accept that it is the correct thing to do.

words.ex: He kick the ball into the goal.
words.ex_cn: 他把球踢进了球门。
words.en: To strike or propel with the foot; a blow or thrust delivered by the foot.

words.ex: He is literate and can read simple books.
words.ex_cn: 他有读写能力，能读简单的书。
words.en: A literate person is able to read and write, and has a good education.

words.ex: This broken phone is useless.
words.ex_cn: 这部坏掉的手机毫无用处。
words.en: If something is useless, it is not able to do what it is supposed to do or is not effective.

words.ex: The village sits near a quiet lake.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄坐落于一个宁静的湖边。
words.en: To be in a position in which your bottom is resting on a chair, the ground, etc., with the upper part of your body upright, or to put someone in this position.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；
v. 分阶段进行；
words.ex: The project is in its final phase.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正处于最后阶段。
words.en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: Postgraduates are doing research in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 研究生正在实验室做研究。
words.en: Students who have completed a first degree and are studying or doing research at a more advanced level.

words.ex: They are writing dissertations for their PhD.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在为自己的博士学位写论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.ex: He practices judo every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习柔道。
words.en: A sport of unarmed combat derived from jujitsu and intended to train the body and mind. It involves using holds and leverage to unbalance the opponent.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: He does yoga every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做瑜伽。
words.en: Yoga is a Hindu spiritual and ascetic discipline, a part of which, including breath control, simple meditation, and the adoption of specific bodily postures, is widely practiced for health and relaxation.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.ex: He repainted the old house last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周重新粉刷了那栋老房子。
words.en: To paint something again, especially to give it a new appearance or to cover old paint.

words.ex: The shop will reopen next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店下周一重新开业。
words.en: To open again after being closed.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.ex: The dog learned through conditioning to sit when it hears a whistle.
words.ex_cn: 狗通过条件作用学会在听到口哨时坐下。
words.en: The process of training or accustoming a person or animal to behave in a certain way or to accept certain circumstances.

words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.tr: n. [建]升降机，电梯；[建]升降机，电梯（lift 的复数）； v. 举起；
words.ex: The lifts in this building are very fast.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里的电梯非常快。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. The noun lift can refer to the act of lifting or to a device that carries people or goods up and down in a building.

words.tr:
n. 后台；
adv. 在后台；
words.ex: The actors waited backstage before the show.
words.ex_cn: 演员们在演出前在后台等候。
words.en: Behind the scenes in a theater or relating to the private lives of people in the entertainment industry.

words.tr: v. 作巡回活动；“tour”的现在分词；
words.ex: The band is touring across Europe this summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队今年夏天正在欧洲巡回演出。
words.en: The act of traveling from place to place, especially for pleasure or to perform in a series of concerts, games, etc.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.ex: The students eat lunch in the refectory.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A refectory is a dining hall, especially in a monastery, college, or other institution.

words.tr: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意；
words.ex: The teacher warned the students not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要迟到。
words.en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

words.ex: He reads science journals every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都读科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a magazine, especially one that deals with a specialized subject, or a daily record of events or business.

words.ex: The audio signal was clear and loud.
words.ex_cn: 音频信号清晰响亮。
words.en: Audio refers to sound, especially when recorded, transmitted, or reproduced.

words.tr:
n. 收看（电视）；察看；观看；亲眼目睹的机会（尤指观看艺术作品）；
v. 考虑；估量；观察；查看；
words.ex: His daily viewing of news shows keeps him informed.
words.ex_cn: 他每天收看新闻节目以保持信息灵通。
words.en: The act of looking at or inspecting something; the act of watching television or a film.

words.tr: v. 征服；克服；攻克( conquer的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The army conquered the small kingdom last year.
words.ex_cn: 军队去年征服了那个小王国。
words.en: If you conquer something, you succeed in ending a problem or overcoming a difficulty.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.tr: n. 半挂车；（一侧与其他建筑相连的）半独立式的住宅
words.ex: The truck driver parked the semi near the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 卡车司机把半挂车停在了仓库附近。
words.en: A semi is a trailer that is attached to the back of a truck and is used for transporting goods.

words.tr: adj. 骇人的； v. “appall”的现在分词；
words.ex: The accident caused an appalling sight.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了一幅骇人的景象。
words.en: If you describe something as appalling, you are emphasizing that it is very bad or unpleasant, and that you find it extremely unacceptable.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.ex_cn: 火灾产生了浓烟。
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.ex: The balloon moved upwards slowly.
words.ex_cn: 气球慢慢地向上飘。
words.en: In a direction from lower to higher; towards a higher place or position.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.tr: adj. 光亮的；闪耀的；锃亮的；有光泽的；
words.ex: The shiny coin caught her eye.
words.ex_cn: 那枚光亮的硬币引起了她的注意。
words.en: Something that is shiny has a bright, smooth surface that reflects light.

words.ex: He said bye to his friends before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前向朋友们说了再见。
words.en: A farewell remark; used to express good wishes when parting or at the end of a conversation.

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.ex: This store sells the cheapest apples in town.
words.ex_cn: 这家店卖城里最便宜的苹果。
words.en: The least expensive option available.

words.ex: He made reservations for a table at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他为餐厅的桌子做了保留。
words.en: If you have reservations about something, you are not sure that it is entirely good or right.

words.ex: The horse walked quietly on its hooves.
words.ex_cn: 马用它的蹄子安静地走路。
words.en: The plural of hoof, the hard part of the foot of some animals, such as horses, cows, etc.

words.ex: The photographer took pictures of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这位摄影家拍了日落的照片。
words.en: A photographer is a person who takes photographs, especially as a job.

words.tr: n. 发明家；发明者；创造者；
words.ex: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.
words.ex_cn: 托马斯·爱迪生是一位著名的发明家。
words.en: An inventor is a person who has invented something, or whose job is to invent things.

words.ex: The company will employ five new workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将雇佣五名新员工。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.ex: The projection of the movie started at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 电影的放映晚上8点开始。
words.en: A projection is an estimate or forecast of a future situation or trend based on a study of present ones.

words.tr: v. 加衬里；排队；“line”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The jacket was lined with soft wool.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克内衬了柔软的羊毛。
words.en: Having a lining or linings; marked with lines.

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reels.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕到卷线筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. As a verb, to reel means to wind something on a reel or to stagger or sway as if about to fall.

words.ex: The rain lasted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整天。
words.en: To continue in time; go on.

words.tr: v. 点燃；开火；“fire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He fired the match to light the candle.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了火柴来点蜡烛。
words.en: If someone is fired from their job, they are told to leave because they have done something wrong or are not suitable. To fire a gun or a missile means to shoot it.

words.tr: n. 拼写；拼法； v. “spell”的现在分词；
words.ex: His spelling is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的拼写很差。
words.en: The forming of words from letters according to accepted usage; orthography.

words.ex: He is an engineer who builds bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名建造桥梁的工程师。
words.en: An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.tr: v. 注册；记录； n. 记录( register的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is registering for the course online.
words.ex_cn: 他正在网上注册这门课程。
words.en: To record or enroll officially in a list or directory.

words.tr: v. 毁灭；摧毁；“devastate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 非常伤心的；
words.ex: The earthquake devastated the small town.
words.ex_cn: 地震摧毁了这个小镇。
words.en: If you are devastated by something, you are very shocked and upset by it. If a place is devastated, it is severely damaged or destroyed.

words.tr: adj. 纯的；纯净的；纯粹的；
words.ex: She drank pure water from the spring.
words.ex_cn: 她喝了从泉水中取的纯净水。
words.en: Something that is pure is clean and does not contain any harmful substances.

words.ex: The old castle is built from red sandstone.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的城堡是用红色砂岩建造的。
words.en: Sandstone is a type of sedimentary rock composed mainly of sand-sized minerals or rock grains.

words.tr: adj. 烘烤的； v. 烘；烤；“bake”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The baked potatoes smell delicious.
words.ex_cn: 烤土豆闻起来很香。
words.en: Cooked by dry heat in an oven.

words.ex: The oak tree stands tall in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 栎树矗立在后院。
words.en: An oak is a large tree that is common in northern countries. Oaks have strong wood and are often used for making furniture.

words.ex: He walks in the orchard every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在果园里散步。
words.en: An orchard is an area of land where fruit trees are grown.

words.ex: He eats fruits every day for health.
words.ex_cn: 他为了健康每天吃水果。
words.en: The edible product of a plant or tree, consisting of the seed and its envelope, especially the latter when it is juicy or pulpy.

words.tr: v. 展开；伸开； n. 范围( spread的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He spreads the map on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图铺在桌子上。
words.en: To spread means to extend over a large or increasing area, or to distribute over a wide area or among many people.

words.ex: The footbridge connects the two sides of the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座人行桥连接了河的两岸。
words.en: A footbridge is a narrow bridge for pedestrians.

words.ex: The old mill stands by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊坐落在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour. It can also refer to a factory where certain materials are processed or manufactured.

words.tr:
n. 遗憾；
v. 懊悔；
words.ex: He felt a deep regret after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失去工作后感到深深的遗憾。
words.en: If you regret something that you have done, you wish that you had not done it.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.tr:
v. 滚动；
n. 滚动；卷形物；
words.ex: The ball roll down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 球从山上滚下来。
words.en: To move somewhere by turning over and over, or to make something move in this way.

words.ex: I download music from the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我从互联网下载音乐。
words.en: To download data means to transfer it to your computer or device from another computer or from the internet.

words.tr: n. 迪斯科舞会；迪斯科舞厅；
words.ex: We went to a disco last Saturday night.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六晚上去了迪斯科舞会。
words.en: A disco is a club or party where people dance to pop music.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.tr: adj. 欧洲大陆的；大陆的；
words.ex: He prefers continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢欧洲大陆式的早餐，有面包和咖啡。
words.en: Continental is used to describe something that relates to or is characteristic of a continent, especially the mainland of Europe as distinct from the British Isles.

words.ex: Please tell me beforehand if you can't come.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。
words.en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.ex: He was severely injured in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中严重受伤。
words.en: If something is done severely, it is done in a very great or intense degree.

words.ex: The movie left good impressions on the children.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影给孩子们留下了良好的印象。
words.en: An impression is an idea, feeling, or opinion that you get about someone or something, or an effect that someone or something has on you.

words.tr: n. 烧制；发射； v. 激励（fire的现在分词）；
words.ex: The pottery goes into the kiln for firing.
words.ex_cn: 陶器被放入窑中进行烧制。
words.en: The act of discharging a gun or other weapon, or the act of dismissing someone from a job.

words.ex: The farmer is ploughing the field in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 农民在早上耕作田地。
words.en: Ploughing is the process of turning over the earth with a plough, especially before seeds are planted.

words.ex: The excavation revealed ancient pottery.
words.ex_cn: 挖掘发现了古代陶器。
words.en: The process of digging up and removing earth, especially at an archaeological site.

words.ex: The farmer's cultivation of rice takes months.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植水稻需要几个月的时间。
words.en: The process of trying to acquire or develop a quality or skill.

words.ex: The old dwellings were small but cozy.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧住处虽然小，但很温馨。
words.en: Dwellings are houses or places where people live.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.tr: adv. 有系统地；有组织地；
words.ex: He systematically organized his books by subject.
words.ex_cn: 他有系统地按科目整理了他的书。
words.en: in a thorough, methodical, and organized manner

words.ex: The polishing of the silver made it shine brightly.
words.ex_cn: 对银器的擦亮使它闪闪发亮。
words.en: The act of making something smooth and shiny by rubbing it.

words.ex: The village is built on the mountainside.
words.ex_cn: 村庄建在山腰上。
words.en: The side or slope of a mountain.

words.tr:
adj. 未知的；不为人知的；
n. 未知的地方（或事物）；
words.ex: The unknown cause of the accident is being investigated.
words.ex_cn: 事故的未知原因正在调查中。
words.en: If something is unknown, it is not known or recognized by people.

words.tr: adj. 抛光的；磨光的；擦亮的； v. 擦亮；磨光；“polish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The polished table reflected the light.
words.ex_cn: 抛光的桌子反射着光线。
words.en: If something is polished, it has been made smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance.

words.ex: He received an invitation to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了参加派对的邀请。
words.en: An invitation is a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.

words.ex: The delegates vote on new rules.
words.ex_cn: 代表们对新规则进行投票。
words.en: A delegate is a person who is chosen or elected to vote or make decisions on behalf of a group of people, especially at a conference or a meeting.

words.tr: adj. 编码的； v. “code”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The coded message was hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个编码的信息很难理解。
words.en: If something is coded, it is written or arranged according to a code or set of rules, especially to hide its meaning.

words.tr: n. 操纵；处理； v. 处理；操纵；“handle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The handling of the machine requires training.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的操纵需要培训。
words.en: The act of managing or dealing with something.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.ex: The teacher is distributing the books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师正在把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute means to give out or deliver something to a number of people or places.

words.tr:
v. 指引；
n. 导演；
words.ex: He is directing the team to the right path.
words.ex_cn: 他正在指引团队走向正确的道路。
words.en: Directing involves guiding or managing the performance or operation of something, such as a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: The exits are near the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 出口在楼梯附近。
words.en: An exit is a way out of a place, especially a building or room. To exit means to go out of or leave a place.

words.ex: The cat is roaming around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 猫正在花园里四处游荡。
words.en: If you roam an area or roam around it, you wander or travel around it without having a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 追溯到；“date”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 过时的；陈旧的；
words.ex: This coin is dated to the year 1500.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币追溯到1500年。
words.en: Something that is dated is old-fashioned and no longer relevant or useful.

words.tr: v. 不见，消失；不复存在；不见，消失( disappear的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The bird disappeared behind the trees.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在树后消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go somewhere where they cannot be seen or found.

words.ex: The lion's mane is long and brown.
words.ex_cn: 狮子的鬃毛又长又棕。
words.en: The long hair growing from the neck of a horse, lion, or other animal; a person's long, thick hair.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他在举重时伤了脖子。
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.ex: The lion killed a deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在森林里杀死了一只鹿。
words.en: To kill someone or something means to cause their death.

words.ex: I bought a dozen eggs from the store.
words.ex_cn: 我从商店买了十二个鸡蛋。
words.en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

words.ex: The goats eat grass on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 山羊在山上吃草。
words.en: Goats are animals that are related to sheep. They are often kept for their milk, meat, or wool.

words.ex: He is the quickest runner in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上跑得最快的人。
words.en: Superlative form of quick: moving fast or doing something in a short time.

words.ex: I took a cab to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A cab is a taxi, a vehicle that carries passengers for a fare, usually calculated by a meter.

words.tr: adv. （用以询问大概的地方）在什么地方；
words.ex: I don't know his whereabouts.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他在什么地方。
words.en: The place where someone or something is.

words.tr: v. 拼写；“spell”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He spelt his name wrong on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他在表格上把他的名字拼错了。
words.en: Spelt is the past tense and past participle of spell, which means to write or name the letters that form a word in the correct order.

words.ex: We found three empty campsites near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边找到了三个空的露营地。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people can stay in tents, usually while they are on holiday.

words.ex: The mountainous region has many hiking trails.
words.ex_cn: 这个多山的地区有许多徒步小径。
words.en: A mountainous area has a lot of mountains.

words.ex: The food at this restaurant is superb.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅的食物极佳。
words.en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

words.tr: adj. 被保险的； v. 确保；“insure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The insured car was repaired after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这辆被保险的车在事故后得到了维修。
words.en: Covered by insurance; a person or entity whose life or property is covered by an insurance policy.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.tr: adj. 瓶装的； v. “bottle”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He drank bottled water during the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他在徒步时喝了瓶装水。
words.en: Adjective. Contained or stored in a bottle.

words.ex: The room has big mirrors on the walls.
words.ex_cn: 房间里墙上装着大镜子。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.ex: The ad campaign is targeting young adults.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告活动把年轻人作为目标。
words.en: To target means to direct something such as a product, advertisement, or missile at a particular person or group.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.ex: Each child shows their individuality in different ways.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都以不同的方式展现他们的个性。
words.en: The qualities that make someone or something different from others.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If something is required, it is necessary or it must be done.

words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.tr: adj. 评价过高的； v. “overrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: That movie is overrated; it's not that good.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影评价过高；其实没那么好。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is overrated, you mean that people have a higher opinion of them than they deserve.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.ex: He only read the partial report.
words.ex_cn: 他只读了部分报告。
words.en: If you describe something as partial, you mean that it is not complete or whole.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.ex: He is fortunate to have a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他很幸运拥有一份好工作。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is fortunate, you mean that they are lucky.

words.ex: This book belonged to my grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我祖父。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours. If you belong to a group or organization, you are a member of it.

words.tr: adj. 不切实际的；不实事求是的；
words.ex: It's unrealistic to expect to get rich quickly.
words.ex_cn: 指望快速致富是不切实际的。
words.en: If you say that someone is being unrealistic, you mean that they do not recognize the truth about a situation, especially about the difficulties involved in something they want to achieve.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.ex: The children did not know the dangers of fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们不知道火的危险。
words.en: Dangers refer to the possibility of suffering harm or injury.

words.tr: v. 面对； adj. v. 面对（face 的过去分词）；
words.ex: He faced his fears and spoke in public.
words.ex_cn: 他面对了自己的恐惧并在公众面前讲话。
words.en: Having a face of a specified kind or number; having a surface of a specified kind.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.tr:
adv. 全球性地；
adj. 全球性的；
words.ex: The news spread worldwide overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻一夜之间传遍全球。
words.en: Something that is worldwide exists or happens in all parts of the world.

words.tr: v. 逗留；（使）停止工作；停止( stop的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was stopping at the café for a coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他当时在咖啡馆逗留喝杯咖啡。
words.en: The act of stopping something or the state of being stopped.

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the head of state of that country.

words.tr: adj. 入侵的； v. 侵犯；侵略；“invade”的现在分词；
words.ex: The invading army took over the city.
words.ex_cn: 入侵的军队占领了这座城市。
words.en: If someone or something invades a place, they enter it in large numbers, often in a way that is unwelcome or causes damage.

words.tr: v. 越过； adj. 越过（cross 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He crossed the street quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速地越过了街道。
words.en: If you cross something, you go from one side of it to the other.

words.ex: The app has an interactive game for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有一个适合孩子的交互式游戏。
words.en: An interactive computer program or system is designed to involve the user in the exchange of information.

words.tr: n. 解说词；评论；实况报道；
words.ex: The commentator gave live commentary during the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 解说员在足球比赛期间进行了现场解说。
words.en: A commentary is a spoken or written description of an event or situation that is broadcast or published as it occurs.

words.ex: The frog hopped over the stone.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跃过了那块石头。
words.en: To move by jumping on one foot or to move quickly and lightly from one place to another.

words.ex: Children play different roles in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校的话剧中扮演不同的角色。
words.en: A role is a part that someone or something has in a particular situation, system, or process.

words.ex: The movie recreates the battle of Waterloo.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影再现了滑铁卢战役。
words.en: To recreate something means to make it exist or happen again, or to make a copy of something that existed in the past.

words.tr:
v. 嘲笑；嘲弄；
adj. 仿制的；
words.ex: They mock him for his accent.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他口音而嘲笑他。
words.en: To mock someone means to laugh at them, tease them, or make them look foolish, often by imitating their behavior or speech.

words.ex: Dinosaurs no longer exists.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙不再存在。
words.en: If something exists, it is present in the world as a real thing.

words.tr: adj. 棒极了；令人敬畏的；令人畏惧的；
words.ex: The concert was awesome!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会棒极了！
words.en: If you describe someone or something as awesome, you are emphasizing that you think that they are very impressive or extraordinary.

words.ex: The slopes of the hill are steep.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的斜坡很陡。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.ex: This is the driest season of the year.
words.ex_cn: 这是这一年最干燥的季节。
words.en: The superlative form of 'dry', meaning having the least moisture or liquid.

words.tr: v. 系上；附加；使相关；使依附；隶属于；“attach”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 附属的；附加的；依恋的；
words.ex: He attached the leash to the dog's collar.
words.ex_cn: 他把狗绳系在狗的项圈上。
words.en: If you say that one thing is attached to another, you mean that the two things are connected, either physically or because they are related in some way.

words.tr: v. 签名；“sign”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He signed the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在寄出信之前签了名。
words.en: Having a signature or signatures on it, typically to indicate approval, agreement, or authorization.

words.ex: His achievements in science won many awards.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学上的成就赢得了许多奖项。
words.en: Achievements are things that someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.tr: v. 是…的成员；应被放在；
words.ex: He belongs to a book club.
words.ex_cn: 他是读书俱乐部的成员。
words.en: Is the property or possession of someone or something.

words.ex: The relevance of this topic is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个主题的相关性是明显的。
words.en: The quality or state of being closely connected or appropriate.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr: v. 仔细检查；仔细检查( examine的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The doctor examined the wound carefully.
words.ex_cn: 医生仔细检查了伤口。
words.en: To inspect or scrutinize carefully; to test the knowledge or proficiency of someone by requiring them to answer questions or perform tasks.

words.tr: v. 从事；承担；“undertake”的过去分词；
words.ex: He undertook a new job last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月从事了一份新工作。
words.en: If you undertake a task or a responsibility, you start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.ex: The violinists played beautifully at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手们在音乐会上演奏得很优美。
words.en: A violinist is someone who plays the violin, especially someone who plays it well.

words.tr: v. 喜欢；“favour”的过去式； adj. 有特权的；
words.ex: She favoured tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: preferred or supported over others; given an advantage.

words.ex: The ants are carrying food to their nest.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁正在把食物搬回蚁巢。
words.en: Ants are small insects that live in large groups called colonies. They are known for their strong work ethic and ability to work together.

words.tr: adj. 不同的； v. 改变；变化；“vary”的现在分词；
words.ex: The weather shows varying conditions each day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都有不同的状况。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The child shows right laterality in writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在写字时表现出右利性。
words.en: Laterality refers to the preference or dominance of one side of the body over the other, especially in the context of brain function and the use of limbs.

words.ex: The army deployed troops near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军队在边境附近部署了部队。
words.en: To deploy means to move troops or equipment into a position where they are ready for military action, or to use something or someone, especially in an effective way.

words.ex: He is favouring his younger son.
words.ex_cn: 他偏爱他的小儿子。
words.en: To favour means to prefer or support someone or something over others, or to give an advantage to someone or something.

words.tr: n. 对应物；职务相当的人；“counterpart”的复数；
words.ex: The Chinese version has counterparts in the US.
words.ex_cn: 中文版本在美国有对应物。
words.en: A person or thing that corresponds to or has the same function as another person or thing in a different place or situation.

words.tr: n. 网球拍；喧闹；非法勾当；
words.ex: He bought a new racket for tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一副新的网球拍。
words.en: A racket is a piece of equipment used in sports such as tennis or badminton, consisting of a handle and a round or oval frame with a network of strings stretched across it. It can also refer to a loud, unpleasant noise or a dishonest or fraudulent scheme.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: He practices gymnastics every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习体操。
words.en: Gymnastics is a sport that involves exercises and movements that require physical strength, flexibility, balance, and control.

words.ex: The predominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的主导颜色是蓝色。
words.en: If something is predominant, it is more important, noticeable, or powerful than the other things in a situation.

words.tr: n. 清洁工人；清洁工具； adj. 更洁净的；更干净的；“clean”的比较级；
words.ex: The cleaner sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工人每天早上扫地。
words.en: A cleaner is a person whose job is to clean a place or a substance used for cleaning.

words.ex: He answered many enquiries about the course.
words.ex_cn: 他回答了关于这门课程的许多询问。
words.en: An enquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.tr:
adj. 第六的；六分之一的；
n. 第六；六分之一；
words.ex: He lives on the sixth floor.
words.ex_cn: 他住在第六层。
words.en: The sixth item in a series is the one that you count as number six.

words.tr: v. （尤指在山中）远足，徒步旅行，游山玩水；艰苦跋涉，徒步旅行( trek的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They went trekking in the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末去山里徒步旅行了。
words.en: Trekking is an activity that involves walking long distances, especially in the countryside or mountains.

words.ex: The company gave sponsorship to the local sports team.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司资助了当地的体育团队。
words.en: The support given by a sponsor; the act of sponsoring.

words.tr: adj. 有保证的； v. 保证；“guarantee”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The product comes with a guaranteed refund if you're not satisfied.
words.ex_cn: 如果您不满意，该产品保证退款。
words.en: Something that is guaranteed is certain to happen or to be true, or is certain to be of a particular quality.

words.ex: The walkers enjoy the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些散步的人每天早上都喜欢去公园。
words.en: Walkers are people who walk, especially for exercise or enjoyment.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.ex: The law sets limits on how much you can drive.
words.ex_cn: 法律对驾驶里程设定了限制。
words.en: Limits refer to the greatest or least amount, number, or level of something that is allowed or possible.

words.ex: He carries his books in a rucksack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在帆布背包里。
words.en: A rucksack is a bag with shoulder straps that allow it to be carried on someone's back, typically used by hikers or travelers.

words.ex: The living room has soft carpets.
words.ex_cn: 客厅里有柔软的地毯。
words.en: Carpets are thick woven materials for covering floors.

words.ex: The storm caused a disruption in the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴扰乱了火车服务。
words.en: Disruption is a situation in which something is prevented from continuing in its usual way because of problems or difficulties.

words.ex: The robotic arm helps doctors during surgery.
words.ex_cn: 机械臂帮助医生进行手术。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of robots or robotics.

words.tr: v. 发射；发起；掷；“launch”的现在分词； n. 发动；发射；启动；
words.ex: They are launching a rocket into space.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在将一枚火箭发射到太空中。
words.en: The act of starting something new or sending something into the air or space, especially a rocket, missile, or spacecraft.

words.ex: The operational system runs smoothly every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个运作系统每天运行顺畅。
words.en: If a system or service is operational, it is working or able to be used.

words.tr: v. 降低；减少；落下（ drop的过去式和过去分词 ）；
words.ex: The temperature dropped suddenly last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度突然降低了。
words.en: To fall or let something fall vertically.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: The wind turbines are located onshore to reduce costs.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机位于陆地上以降低成本。
words.en: Onshore refers to activities or operations that are carried out on land, especially in contrast to those conducted at sea or abroad. It can also pertain to wind farms or energy resources located on land.

words.ex: The meteorological report says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 气象报告说明天会下雨。
words.en: Relating to the branch of science concerned with the processes and phenomena of the atmosphere, especially as a means of forecasting the weather.

words.ex: He mapped the island with a pencil and paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔和纸绘制了这个岛的地图。
words.en: To represent an area or a route by making a map of it, or to represent something by creating a model or diagram of it.

words.tr: v. 完成；使完善( complete的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is completing his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他正在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish making or doing something.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；潜在的； v. “underlie”的现在分词；
words.ex: The underlying cause of the problem is poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的根本原因是贫困。
words.en: An underlying thing is the thing that is the most important or basic, although it is not easily noticed or stated directly.

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.tr: v. 劝告；建议；劝告，建议（advise 的现在分词）；
words.ex: He is advising his friend to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他正在劝告他的朋友存钱。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: The jet flew high above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 喷气式飞机在云层上方飞行。
words.en: A jet is an aircraft that is powered by jet engines, allowing it to fly at high speeds. It can also refer to a stream of liquid or gas forced out of a small opening, or to travel by jet aircraft.

words.ex: He has good relations with his coworkers.
words.ex_cn: 他和同事关系很好。
words.en: Relations refer to the way in which two or more people, groups, countries, etc., talk to, behave toward, and deal with each other.

words.ex: The dog is on a long chain.
words.ex_cn: 狗被一条长链拴着。
words.en: A chain consists of connected links, typically made of metal, used for fastening or securing something, or a series of connected things.

words.tr:
v. 位于；站立；忍受；
n. 立场；站立；摊位；站立；
words.ex: The castle stands on a hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡位于一座山上。
words.en: To be in an upright position on the feet; to be situated in a particular place; to tolerate or endure.

words.tr: adj. 已服务的；已维修的；
words.ex: The serviced apartment has clean towels and fresh sheets.
