words.ex_cn: 这间已服务的公寓有干净的毛巾和干净的床单。
words.en: Having been maintained or repaired; provided with necessary services.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.ex: He exploited the situation to get more money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用这个情况赚了更多钱。
words.en: To exploit someone or something means to use them in a way that benefits you, often unfairly or without considering their rights or feelings. It can also refer to the act of making full use of and deriving benefit from a resource.

words.ex: The kids were excited for the Halloween treats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们期待着万圣节的款待。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way. A treat is something special that you give someone or do for them, especially in order to show that you like them or want to thank them.

words.tr: abbr.abbr. economy 经济; economic 经济的; economics 经济学; eco
words.ex: The government wants to boost eco after the pandemic.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望在疫情后提振经济。
words.en: Short for 'ecological' or 'environmental,' relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on it.

words.ex: He enjoys playing football after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后喜欢踢足球。
words.en: To enjoy means to take pleasure or satisfaction in something.

words.tr: v. 登记；招收； adj. 入学登记了的；入学登记了的 v. [亦作enrol]( enroll的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He enrolled in the English course last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周登记了英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or sign up for a course, school, or program.

words.tr: n. 海产食物（如海鱼、贝类等）；
words.ex: We ate fresh seafood at the seaside restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的餐厅吃了新鲜的海产食物。
words.en: Seafood refers to fish and shellfish from the sea that are eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 摧毁；拆毁；拆除；大败；
words.ex: The demolition of the old building started last week.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧楼的拆除上周开始了。
words.en: The act of demolishing something, especially a building.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.tr: v. 包含；容纳；认为；保存；把握；拿；
words.ex: This box holds all my books.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子装着我的所有书。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; keep fast; grasp; to contain or be capable of containing.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.tr:
v. 提升；提高；改进；
n. 增加；改进；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better performance.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更好的性能。
words.en: To upgrade means to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or to raise it to a higher standard. It can also refer to the process of improving or raising something.

words.tr: adj. 遮蔽的；受庇护的；受保护的； v. 庇护；遮蔽；“shelter”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children played in a sheltered garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在一处遮蔽的花园里玩耍。
words.en: Protected from the harsh realities of life; not exposed to difficulties or unpleasantness.

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.ex: The teacher turned on the projector to show the video.
words.ex_cn: 老师打开投影仪来播放视频。
words.en: A projector is a machine that projects films or slides onto a screen or wall.

words.ex: She added kombu to the soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了昆布来提味。
words.en: Kombu is a type of edible kelp widely eaten in East Asia. It is most often used as an ingredient in Japanese cuisine, where it is used to make dashi, a soup stock.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.tr: n. 吨，公吨( tonne的名词复数 )
words.ex: The truck carries tonnes of sand.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车运载着数吨沙子。
words.en: A unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms.

words.ex: He adds sodium to his food for taste.
words.ex_cn: 他为了味道在食物里加钠。
words.en: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal. Sodium is an alkali metal, being in group 1 of the periodic table, because it has a single electron in its outer shell that it readily donates, creating a positively charged ion—the Na⁺ cation.

words.ex: Proteins are made of amino acids.
words.ex_cn: 蛋白质由氨基酸组成。
words.en: Relating to or containing an amino group, which is a functional group consisting of a nitrogen atom attached by single bonds to hydrogen atoms.

words.ex: He ate a potato for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一个土豆。
words.en: A potato is a round vegetable that grows underground and has white flesh with a brown, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: This restaurant serves fresh food.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供新鲜的食物。
words.en: To serve means to perform duties or services for another person or an organization, or to provide food and drink to customers in a restaurant or at a meal.

words.tr: n. 信号；“signal”的复数； v. 预示；
words.ex: The radio receives signals from satellites.
words.ex_cn: 收音机接收来自卫星的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.tr: n. 报警信号；警戒( alert的名词复数 )； v. 使（某人）保持警觉；
words.ex: The system sent alerts when the fire started.
words.ex_cn: 当火灾发生时，系统发送了报警信号。
words.en: Alerts refer to notifications or warnings about a particular situation requiring immediate attention or action.

words.tr:
n. 亮点；
v. 使突出；
words.ex: The highlights of the concert were the final songs.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的亮点是最后几首歌。
words.en: Highlights are the most interesting or memorable parts of something, such as an event or a period of time. It can also mean to emphasize or make something more noticeable.

words.ex: He plays the drums in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: Drums are musical instruments that you play by hitting them with sticks or your hands.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.tr: v. 屈服；顺从；顺从( submit的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He stopped resisting and was submitting to the authority.
words.ex_cn: 他停止抵抗，屈服于权威。
words.en: To present or propose something for consideration, judgment, or decision.

words.ex: He writes simple sentences every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写简单的句子。
words.en: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

words.ex: The soldier picked up a bullet from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 士兵从地上捡起一颗子弹。
words.en: A bullet is a small piece of metal with a pointed or rounded end, which is fired from a gun.

words.tr: adj. 更清楚的；更明显的；
words.ex: This picture is clearer than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这张图片比那张更清楚。
words.en: Comparative form of 'clear', meaning more easy to see, hear, or understand.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.ex: This pillow is softer than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头比另一个更软。
words.en: Comparative form of 'soft'; less hard or more gentle.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: The snowy mountains look beautiful in winter.
words.ex_cn: 多雪的山在冬天看起来很美。
words.en: Covered with snow; resembling snow in whiteness or texture.

words.ex: He informs me about the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 他通知我会议的时间。
words.en: To give someone facts or information; to tell someone about something.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: Geographers study maps and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 地理学家研究地图和河流。
words.en: A geographer is a scientist whose area of study is geography, the study of Earth's physical environment and human habitat.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: The government does a census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: A census is an official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.

words.ex: He bought three new pens for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了三支新笔。
words.en: A pen is an instrument for writing or drawing with ink, typically consisting of a metal nib or ball, or a nylon tip, fitted into a metal or plastic holder.

words.ex: He analyzes data every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天分析数据。
words.en: To examine something methodically and in detail, typically in order to explain and interpret it.

words.ex: He put the keys in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙放进了口袋里。
words.en: A pocket is a small bag sewn into or on clothing so that you can carry small objects such as money or keys in it.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.ex: The dimensions of the box are 10 cm by 5 cm by 3 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米乘3厘米。
words.en: Dimensions refer to the measurements of something, such as its length, width, and height, or the aspects and features of a situation or problem.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是粉红色的。
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.ex: He fixed the electrical wire with tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶带修好了电线。
words.en: Relating to electricity or things that use electricity.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: Goodness, I didn't expect to see you here!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我没料到会在这里见到你！
words.en: Goodness is the quality of being kind, helpful, and honest.

words.tr: n. 均匀厚度的片状硬物体；盘子；碟子；“plate”的复数；
words.ex: The metal plates are used to build the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 这些金属片用于建造桥梁。
words.en: Plates are flat, usually round dishes that are used to hold food. They can also refer to thin, flat pieces of metal or other material.

words.tr: v. 传播；扩散；展开；散布；“spread”的现在分词；
words.ex: The virus is spreading quickly in the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒正在这座城市迅速传播。
words.en: The act of extending over a larger or increasing area or scope; the diffusion or dissemination of something.

words.ex: The birds live in a quiet marsh.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在一片宁静的沼泽中。
words.en: A marsh is an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.ex: The bounds of the rectangle are 5 cm and 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的边长是5厘米和10厘米。
words.en: 1. Limits or borders. 2. To leap or spring.

words.ex: He takes the tram to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上乘电车上班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that is used for public transportation in cities and towns, running on tracks laid in the streets.

words.ex: The cows are eating grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛正在田野里吃草。
words.en: Cows are large female animals kept on farms for their milk or meat.

words.tr: v. 喂；吃；“feed”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She fed the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To provide food for someone or something, or to give someone or something the necessary materials or resources for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The four seasons are spring, summer, fall, and winter.
words.ex_cn: 四个季节是春天、夏天、秋天和冬天。
words.en: Seasons refer to the four periods of the year (spring, summer, autumn, and winter) into which the year can be divided based on the weather and the amount of daylight.

words.ex: The fisherman catches fish every morning.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫每天早上捕鱼。
words.en: A fisherman is a man who catches fish as a job or for sport.

words.ex: I like to browse the internet for fun.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢上网浏览消遣。
words.en: To look through or glance at reading matter casually or randomly.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那只昆虫飞过了草地。
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.tr: n. 害虫；有害的人或物( pest的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The farmers sprayed poison to kill pests.
words.ex_cn: 农民喷洒农药来杀死害虫。
words.en: Pests are insects or small animals which damage crops or food supplies.

words.ex: The bee is flying near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂正在花附近飞舞。
words.en: A bee is a flying insect known for its role in pollination and for producing honey and beeswax.

words.tr: v. 害虫、野兽大批出没于； adj. 为患的；大批滋生的（常与with搭配）；为患的，大批滋生的（常与with搭配） v. 害虫、野兽大批出没于( infest的过去式；
words.ex: The old house was infested with rats.
words.ex_cn: 那座老房子里有大量的老鼠出没。
words.en: Heavily populated or affected by pests or unwanted organisms.

words.ex: He wiped the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布擦了桌子。
words.en: To wipe something means to clean or dry it by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or your hand.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.tr: n. 基本原理；基础理论；
words.ex: The rationale for the new rule is to save time.
words.ex_cn: 这个新规则的基本原理是节省时间。
words.en: The fundamental reasons or logical basis for a course of action or belief.

words.ex: He continually checks his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地查看手机。
words.en: If something happens continually, it happens without stopping or happening repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: The government introduced reforms to improve education.
words.ex_cn: 政府推出了改革以改善教育。
words.en: Changes made in order to improve a system, organization, or law.

words.tr: v. 到达；延伸；伸出手臂；到达( reach的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is reaching the station just in time.
words.ex_cn: 他正到达车站，刚好来得及。
words.en: To extend out an arm in order to touch or grasp something; to arrive at a place, goal, or state.

words.tr: v. 预料；“anticipate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 预期的；
words.ex: He anticipated the rain and brought an umbrella.
words.ex_cn: 他预料到会下雨，所以带了伞。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.ex: I honestly don't know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我诚实地不知道答案。
words.en: In a way that is truthful and sincere; without deceit.

words.ex: Some substances are dangerous to touch.
words.ex_cn: 一些物质触摸起来很危险。
words.en: A substance is a particular type of solid, liquid, or gas that has consistent properties.

words.ex: Many families live in the suburbs to have more space.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在郊区以获得更多的空间。
words.en: The suburbs are the residential areas on the outskirts of a city or large town.

words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.ex: Many people go to cinemas on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 很多人在周末去电影院。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films.

words.tr:
n. 聚光灯；
v. 使公众注意；
words.ex: The spotlight shone on the singer during the concert.
words.ex_cn: 演唱会上，聚光灯照在歌手身上。
words.en: A spotlight is a powerful light, for example in a theatre, which can be directed so that it lights up a small area. If someone or something is in the spotlight, they are getting a lot of attention from the public and the media.

words.ex: The concerts will be held at different venues across the city.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会将在城市的不同场地举行。
words.en: A venue is the place where an event or meeting happens.

words.ex: The police set up barriers on the road.
words.ex_cn: 警察在道路上设置了路障。
words.en: A barrier is a problem, rule, or situation that prevents someone from doing something, or that makes it difficult for them to do it.

words.ex: The volcanoes erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: He gave a definite answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了肯定的答案。
words.en: If something is definite, it is firm and clear, and unlikely to be changed.

words.ex: He completed the task successfully.
words.ex_cn: 他成功地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that accomplishes a desired aim or result.

words.ex: My parent helps me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母帮我做作业。
words.en: A parent is a mother or father.

words.ex: He celebrates his successes every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都庆祝自己的成功。
words.en: the accomplishment of an aim or purpose

words.tr: v. 获得；取得；得到；“acquire”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 后天习得的；已获得的；
words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.ex: His ignorance of the rules caused the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的无知导致了这个错误。
words.en: Lack of knowledge or information.

words.tr: v. 忽视；“overlook”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher overlooked his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 老师忽视了他的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.tr: n. 修改；变更；改进；“modification”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher made some modifications to the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师对试卷做了一些修改。
words.en: Changes made to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He is duplicating the file to back it up.
words.ex_cn: 他正在复制文件以备份。
words.en: To duplicate something means to make an exact copy of it.

words.tr: n. 始终一贯；前后一致；
words.ex: His consistency in studying every day helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习的一贯坚持帮助他通过了考试。
words.en: Consistency is the quality or condition of being consistent, especially in achieving a level of performance or behavior that does not vary greatly in quality over time.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.ex: They will negotiate the price with the seller.
words.ex_cn: 他们会与卖家协商价格。
words.en: If people negotiate with each other or negotiate an agreement, they talk about a problem or a situation such as a business arrangement in order to solve the problem or complete the arrangement.

words.ex: He put on his jacket before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了夹克。
words.en: A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves.

words.tr: v. 进入；加入；“enter”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is entering the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他正悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To come or go into a place; to begin to be involved in an activity or a situation.

words.tr:
n. 信号；
v. 用信号通知；
words.ex: The traffic light is a signal to stop.
words.ex_cn: 交通灯是一个停止的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.ex: The firefighter is a hero for saving the child.
words.ex_cn: 消防员救了孩子，是个英雄。
words.en: A hero is a person who is admired for their courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.tr: adj. （非正式）组织好的；已备好的；
words.ex: His room is sorted and everything is in place.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很整齐，一切都井井有条。
words.en: Arranged systematically in groups; separated according to type, class, etc.

words.ex: My boss gives me work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的老板每天早上给我安排工作。
words.en: A boss is a person who is in charge of other people at work and tells them what to do.

words.tr: v. 排练；排演；排练，排演( rehearse的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The actors are rehearsing for the play.
words.ex_cn: 演员们正在为这场戏排练。
words.en: If you rehearse something, you practice it in order to be prepared for a performance or event.

words.ex: She sorted her priorities before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在开始项目之前整理了优先次序。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: He will tackle the problem tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会处理这个问题。
words.en: If you tackle a problem or task, you deal with it in a determined way. In sports such as football and rugby, a tackle is an act of trying to take the ball from a player on the other team.

words.ex: He wrote a short paragraph about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段关于他假期的短文。
words.en: A paragraph is a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph typically starts on a new line.

words.ex: The dove is a symbolic bird of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征性鸟类。
words.en: If you describe an event, action, or procedure as symbolic, you mean that it represents an important change, although it has little practical effect.

words.ex: He is an artistic boy who loves to draw.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢画画的艺术型男孩。
words.en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

words.tr: v. 描绘；描绘，描画( depict的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The painting depicted a quiet lake at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了日落时宁静的湖面。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.tr: n. 器官；机构( organ的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the human body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是人体中重要的器官。
words.en: Organs are parts of your body that have particular functions or jobs, such as the heart, lungs, or liver. They can also refer to organizations or parts of organizations that perform specific functions.

words.tr: adj. 感兴趣的；策划阴谋（intrigue 的过去式和过...； v. 引起……的兴趣；
words.ex: I was intrigued by the strange story.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个奇怪的故事感到感兴趣。
words.en: If you are intrigued by something, it interests you a lot because it seems strange or mysterious.

words.ex: The snake crawled slowly through the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蛇在草丛中缓慢地爬行。
words.en: A snake is a long, thin creature with no legs that slides along the ground.

words.ex: The painter draws a beautiful house.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家画了一座美丽的房子。
words.en: A painter is someone who paints pictures, or someone whose job is to paint surfaces such as walls and doors.

words.tr: v. 两件或更多的事情同时发生；想法、意见等相同；两件或更多的事情同时发生( coincide的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The meeting coincided with the rainstorm.
words.ex_cn: 会议与暴雨同时发生。
words.en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time. If ideas or opinions coincide, they are the same or very similar.

words.ex: The children played on the shores of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or wide river.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: I saw an advert on TV for new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 我在电视上看到一双新鞋的广告。
words.en: An advert is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.tr: v. 投入；献身；“devote”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 全心全意的；投入的；
words.ex: He devoted all his time to helping his students.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有时间都投入到了帮助学生上。
words.en: If you are devoted to something, you care about it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: He enjoys sporting events like football and basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢足球和篮球等体育赛事。
words.en: relating to or interested in sports; fair and generous in one's behavior or treatment of others, especially in a sports context

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.ex: He read the story aloud to his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他大声给小妹妹读这个故事。
words.en: If you say something aloud, you say it in a normal speaking voice, rather than whispering or thinking it.

words.tr: adj. 有压力的；紧张的； v. 强调；“stress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt stressed before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到有压力。
words.en: If you are stressed, you feel tense and anxious because of difficulties in your life.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.tr:
v. 跳；跳跃；
n. 跳；跳跃；
words.ex: The boy jump over the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 男孩跳过了水坑。
words.en: To push oneself off a surface and into the air by using the muscles in one's legs and feet; to move quickly and suddenly.

words.tr: adj. 失意的；挫败的； v. “frustrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt frustrated when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 当他考试不及格时，他感到失意。
words.en: If you are frustrated, you are upset or angry because you are unable to do anything about a situation.

words.tr: adj. 令人费解的；使人困惑的； v. 混淆；“confuse”的现在分词；
words.ex: The instructions are confusing.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明令人费解。
words.en: If something is confusing, it is difficult to understand because it is not clear or is complicated.

words.ex: The dog has parasites in its stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的胃里有寄生虫。
words.en: An organism that lives in or on another organism (its host) and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense.

words.ex: The baby covers his ears when the noise is loud.
words.ex_cn: 当噪音很大时，婴儿会捂住耳朵。
words.en: The organs of hearing and balance in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of these organs.

words.ex: The detective found poisons in the drink.
words.ex_cn: 侦探在饮料中发现了毒物。
words.en: Substances that cause death, injury, or harm to organisms, typically by chemical reaction or other activity on the molecular scale, when an organism absorbs a sufficient quantity.

words.ex: He helped indirectly by giving advice.
words.ex_cn: 他通过提供建议间接地帮忙了。
words.en: In a way that is not direct; not in a straight line or course.

words.ex: The poison in the snake is a natural toxin.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒液是一种天然毒素。
words.en: A toxin is a poisonous substance, especially one produced by bacteria, which causes disease.

words.tr: v. 毒害；下毒；“poison”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 中毒的；
words.ex: The water was poisoned by chemicals.
words.ex_cn: 水被化学物质毒害了。
words.en: If someone is poisoned, they have been given poison or exposed to something harmful that can cause illness or death.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.tr:
v. 使滞留；使搁浅；
n. 方面；
words.ex: The storm stranded the travelers on the island.
words.ex_cn: 风暴使旅行者滞留在岛上。
words.en: If someone is stranded, they are left in a place that is difficult for them to get away from. A strand of something such as hair, wire, or thread is a single thin piece of it.

words.tr: v. 监测；监控；“monitor”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher monitored the students during the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监测学生。
words.en: If you monitor something, you regularly check its development or progress, and sometimes comment on it.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.ex: He opted to stay home instead of going out.
words.ex_cn: 他选择待在家里而不是出去。
words.en: If you opt for something, or opt to do something, you choose it or decide to do it in preference to anything else.

words.ex: He lives in a bedsit near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他住在车站附近的一间单间公寓里。
words.en: A bedsit is a single room that serves as both bedroom and living room, often with basic cooking facilities.

words.tr: v. 知道；认识；“know”的现在分词； adj. 知情的；
words.ex: I know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我知道答案。
words.en: Having or showing knowledge or intelligence; perceptive.

words.ex: She put the apples in a basket.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个篮子里。
words.en: A basket is a container which is usually made of stiff fibers, such as rushes, straw, or thin strips of wood, and is used for carrying or storing things.

words.tr: v. 再引入，再提出；再引入，再提出( reintroduce的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The teacher reintroduced the old game to teach math.
words.ex_cn: 老师重新引入了这个游戏来教数学。
words.en: To introduce (a species, practice, or idea) again into a habitat or area where it once existed.

words.ex: The birds sing at daylight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日光下歌唱。
words.en: Daylight is the natural light that comes from the sun during the day.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；“illustrate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有插图的；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate means to make something clear or to explain it, often by using examples or pictures.

words.ex: The rangers patrol the forest to protect animals.
words.ex_cn: 护林员巡逻森林以保护动物。
words.en: Rangers are individuals or groups responsible for patrolling and protecting a particular area, such as a forest or park, or serving in a military capacity.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: The dog barks loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 狗在晚上大声吠叫。
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.tr: adj. 长满树木的；树木覆盖的；
words.ex: The wooded hillside is home to many birds.
words.ex_cn: 长满树木的山坡是许多鸟类的家园。
words.en: A wooded area is covered with trees.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.tr: n. （一）套；集；凝固( set的名词复数 )； v. 放；
words.ex: He bought a new set of tools for his workshop.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车间买了一套新工具。
words.en: Sets can refer to a collection of items or the act of placing or fixing something in a specific position or condition.

words.ex: The slower car reached the finish line last.
words.ex_cn: 那辆更慢的车最后到达了终点。
words.en: Moving or happening at a lower speed than something else.

words.ex: He quickly jot down the phone number.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙记下了电话号码。
words.en: To write or mark down quickly or briefly.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of land area used in the imperial and US customary systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 0.405 hectares.

words.ex: The two boys had a fight after school.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩放学后打了一架。
words.en: Fights refer to physical confrontations or battles between individuals or groups. It can also mean to struggle or contend against someone or something.

words.ex: He is coping with a lot of stress at work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在应付工作中的巨大压力。
words.en: Coping refers to the process of managing taxing circumstances, expending effort to solve personal and interpersonal problems, and seeking to master, minimize, reduce or tolerate stress or conflict.

words.ex: My classmates help me with homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的同学帮我做作业。
words.en: Your classmates are students who are in the same class as you at school or college.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.tr: adj. 以实验为基础的；实验性的；
words.ex: The scientist used an experimental method to test the theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用了一种以实验为基础的方法来检验这个理论。
words.en: Relating to or based on experiment.

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.tr: v. 商议；商量；请教；翻阅；商议，商量( consult的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He consulted his friend before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他在做决定前咨询了朋友。
words.en: If you consult someone or something, you ask them for information or advice.

words.tr: adj. 倾斜的；有坡度的； v. “slope”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sloping roof lets rainwater run off easily.
words.ex_cn: 倾斜的屋顶让雨水容易流走。
words.en: Something that is sloping has a surface or edge that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.ex: The rains caused floods in the village.
words.ex_cn: 雨水引发了村庄的洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide. Flooding may occur as an overflow of water from water bodies, such as a river or lake, in which the water overtops or breaks levees, resulting in some of that water escaping its usual boundaries, or it may occur due to an accumulation of rainwater on saturated ground in an areal flood.

words.tr: v. 最大化；使增加至最大限度；
words.ex: We want to maximise our profits this year.
words.ex_cn: 我们想在今年将利润最大化。
words.en: To maximise something means to make it as great in amount, size, or importance as possible.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: You can leave your bag wherever you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以把包放在任何你喜欢的地方。
words.en: in or to any place; in any case or situation

words.tr: v. 过滤；“filter”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The water was filtered before drinking.
words.ex_cn: 水在饮用前被过滤了。
words.en: Having been passed through a filter to remove impurities or unwanted material.

words.ex: The reed grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 芦苇长在河边。
words.en: A reed is a tall, thin plant that grows in water or marshy ground.

words.tr: n. 费用；控告；指控；负荷；装载；电荷；收费；掌管；“charge”的复数；
words.ex: The hotel charges are very high.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的费用很高。
words.en: If you charge someone an amount of money, you ask them to pay that amount for something that you have sold to them or done for them. Charges are formal accusations that someone has committed a crime.

words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运行顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you manage it and make it work. If a machine or system operates in a particular way, it works in that way. If a doctor operates on a patient, they perform a surgical operation on them.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.tr: n. 吸烟；抽烟； v. 冒烟；“smoke”的现在分词；
words.ex: Smoking is bad for your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对健康有害。
words.en: The act of inhaling and exhaling the smoke of tobacco or a drug.

words.tr: v. 转换；转变，改变( switch的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He switched the light on.
words.ex_cn: 他把灯打开了。
words.en: If you switch to something different, for example to a different system, task, or subject of conversation, you change to it from what you were doing or saying before.

words.ex: The radiators in the room keep it warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的暖气片在冬天让房间保持温暖。
words.en: Radiators are devices that send out heat, often used to warm rooms or to cool engines by dissipating heat.

words.ex: He turned off the taps before leaving the house.
words.ex_cn: 他离开房子前关掉了水龙头。
words.en: Taps is the sound or action of hitting something gently and quickly, or it can refer to a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container.

words.ex: The pipes leak water in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 地下室的管道在漏水。
words.en: Pipes are long, hollow objects through which liquids or gases can flow, or a device for smoking tobacco, consisting of a narrow tube made from wood, clay, etc. with a small bowl at one end.

words.ex: He reset the password to log in again.
words.ex_cn: 他重置了密码以便再次登录。
words.en: To set again or differently; to adjust or fix in a new or different way.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.tr: v. （使）参与；从事于；雇佣；“engage”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 忙着的；
words.ex: The teacher engaged the students in a group discussion.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们参与了一次小组讨论。
words.en: If you are engaged in an activity, you are doing it or involved in it. If you are engaged to someone, you have agreed to marry them.

words.tr: n. 观察；照准，观察，视线( sighting的名词复数 )；
words.ex: There were many sightings of dolphins near the coast.
words.ex_cn: 在海岸附近有许多海豚被观察到的记录。
words.en: Instances of seeing or observing something, especially something unusual or noteworthy.

words.ex: The story had a graphic description of the battle.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事对战斗的描述非常生动。
words.en: A graphic is a visual representation of data or information, such as a chart, diagram, or picture.

words.ex: The frogs jump near the pond.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙在池塘边跳跃。
words.en: Frogs are small, tailless amphibians with a short body, protruding eyes, and the ability to leap.

words.ex: Rabbits proliferate quickly in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在野外繁殖得很快。
words.en: If something proliferates, it increases in number or spreads quickly.

words.ex: The ship carries a provision of food for the journey.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船为旅程准备了食物供应。
words.en: A provision is a condition or requirement in a legal document. It can also refer to the act of supplying or providing something that is needed.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.tr: n. 举起；上升；吊起； v. 举起；抬起；提起；“lift”的现在分词；
words.ex: The lifting of the box made his back hurt.
words.ex_cn: 举起这个箱子使他的背部很疼。
words.en: The act of raising something to a higher position or level.

words.tr: v. 概述；画[标]出…的轮廓( outline的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is outlining the main points of the report.
words.ex_cn: 他正在概述报告的主要内容。
words.en: If you outline an idea or a plan, you explain it in a general way.

words.ex: They use hair-dryers to dry their hair after washing.
words.ex_cn: 他们洗完头发后用吹风机吹干。
words.en: A hair-dryer is an electrical device that you use to dry your hair by blowing hot air over it.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.ex: The children are playing in the pools.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在泳池里玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that has formed naturally. It can also refer to a swimming pool. As a verb, to pool means to combine resources or efforts for a common purpose.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.tr: n. 房间；室；腔；大会议室；
words.ex: He sat in the chamber and waited quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在房间里安静地等待。
words.en: A chamber is a large room, especially one that is used for formal or public events.

words.ex: He cleaned the room thoroughly.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底地打扫了房间。
words.en: In a thorough manner; completely and carefully.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.ex: He talks to strangers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和陌生人说话。
words.en: People whom one does not know or with whom one is not familiar.

words.tr:
n. 教养；养育；培育；
v. 培养；
words.ex: Her parents gave her good nurture.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母给了她良好的教养。
words.en: To nurture someone or something is to care for and encourage their growth or development.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: v. 剥去；strip“”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He stripped the old paint from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧漆剥掉了。
words.en: If something is stripped, it has been removed or taken away, often leaving the underlying layer or structure exposed.

words.tr: n. 影响；势力；影响( influence的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The weather influences what we wear.
words.ex_cn: 天气影响我们的穿着。
words.en: The capacity or power of persons or things to be a compelling force on or produce effects on the actions, behavior, opinions, etc., of others.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.ex: The hairdresser cut my hair nicely.
words.ex_cn: 理发师给我剪了一头漂亮的头发。
words.en: A hairdresser is a person who cuts, colours, and arranges people's hair, especially women's, as their job.

words.ex: The teacher conducted a science experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师实施了一次科学实验。
words.en: To have carried out a particular activity or process, especially in a systematic way.

words.tr: v. 评价；判断；裁决（judge 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The teacher judged his answer as correct.
words.ex_cn: 老师评价他的答案是正确的。
words.en: To form an opinion or conclusion about something or someone based on evidence or reasoning.

words.ex: He is a renowned scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有名的科学家。
words.en: Known or talked about by many people; famous.

words.ex: The car fits fuel i perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车完美地适配了燃料 i。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object. If you are fitted for a piece of clothing, you try it on so that the person who is making it can see where it needs to be altered.

words.ex: The new tool enables students to learn faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使学生能够学得更快。
words.en: To enable means to make it possible for someone to do something or for something to happen.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.tr: v. 选择；做出抉择（opt 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He opted to stay home instead of going out.
words.ex_cn: 他选择待在家里而不是出去。
words.en: If you opt for something, or opt to do something, you choose it or decide to do it in preference to anything else.

words.ex: Glaciers are melting because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 冰川因全球变暖而融化。
words.en: A glacier is a large, slow-moving mass of ice, formed from compacted layers of snow, that slowly deforms and flows in response to gravity.

words.tr: v. 复制；复制( replicate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The bacteria are replicating quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这些细菌正在快速复制。
words.en: To replicate something means to make an exact copy of it or to do something again in the same way as before.

words.tr: n. 矿井；矿；矿( mine的名词复数 ) v. 在…中开采，开采( mine的第三；
words.ex: The workers went down into the mines to dig coal.
words.ex_cn: 工人们进入矿井挖煤。
words.en: Mines can refer to excavations in the earth for extracting coal, minerals, or precious stones, or to explosive devices placed in the ground or water to destroy enemy personnel or vehicles.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The children visited old castles in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们参观了乡村里的古老城堡。
words.en: A castle is a large building with thick, high walls. Castles were built by important people, such as kings, in former times, especially for protection during wars.

words.ex: The church floor has beautiful mosaics made of colored stones.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的地板上有用彩色石头制成的美丽马赛克。
words.en: Mosaics are pictures or decorations made from small pieces of colored stone, glass, or ceramic.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: My dad cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我爸爸每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A father; a male parent.

words.tr: n. 居住者；居民；“inhabitant”的复数；
words.ex: The inhabitants of the village are friendly.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的居住者很友好。
words.en: The inhabitants of a place are the people who live there.

words.tr: v. 仔细检查；审查；仔细检查( examine的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The doctor is examining the patient's arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生正在仔细检查病人的手臂。
words.en: To inspect or scrutinize carefully.

words.tr: n. 学者；[复数]（院校的）学术活动；学者( academic的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The academics published a new research paper.
words.ex_cn: 这些学者发表了一篇新的研究论文。
words.en: Academics refers to the scholarly activities of a school or educational institution, especially the pursuit of research, education, and scholarship.

words.tr: v. 居住于；栖息；“inhabit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The island is inhabited by a small community.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛屿上住着一个小社区。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: They crossed the river on a wooden raft.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘着木筏渡过了河。
words.en: A raft is a flat structure made of pieces of wood tied together, which is used as a boat or floating platform.

words.ex: I am somewhat tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 下班后我有点累。
words.en: You use somewhat to indicate that something is the case to a limited extent or degree.

words.tr: v. 修正；“revise”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 经过修订（或校正）的；
words.ex: He revised his essay before submitting it.
words.ex_cn: 他在提交作文之前进行了修改。
words.en: If you revise something, you alter it in order to make it better or more accurate.

words.ex: The class analyzed statistical data from the survey.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级分析了调查的统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the use of statistics or statistical methods.

words.tr: v. 制造；“manufacture”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The toys were manufactured in China.
words.ex_cn: 这些玩具是在中国制造的。
words.en: Manufactured refers to something that has been made or produced, especially on a large scale using machinery.

words.ex: Many corporations hire new employees every year.
words.ex_cn: 许多公司每年都会招聘新员工。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.tr: v. 咨询；“consult”的现在分词； adj. 作顾问的；咨询的；
words.ex: He consults his doctor for advice.
words.ex_cn: 他向医生咨询建议。
words.en: Consulting is the business of giving expert advice to other professionals, especially in business.

words.tr: v. 加强，巩固( strengthen的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: He strengthened his muscles by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重增强了肌肉。
words.en: If something strengthens a person or group or if they strengthen their position, they become more powerful and more secure, or more likely to succeed.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.tr: n. 六十年代；六十多岁；
words.ex: He was born in the sixties.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于六十年代。
words.en: The decade from 1960 to 1969, or the age between 60 and 69.

words.ex: The sums on the bill were too high.
words.ex_cn: 账单上的金额太高了。
words.en: The total amount resulting from the addition of two or more numbers, amounts, or items.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a small dose of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一小剂量的药。
words.en: A dose of a medicine or a drug is the amount of it that you take at one time, or the amount that is recommended for you to take.

words.tr: n. 眼镜；玻璃杯；“glass”的复数；
words.ex: He wears glasses to see the board clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴眼镜以便清楚地看到黑板。
words.en: Glasses are objects worn in front of the eyes to help people see better. They consist of a pair of lenses set in a frame that rests on the nose and ears.

words.ex: She donates money to charities every month.
words.ex_cn: 她每个月都向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: Organizations that help people in need, especially by providing money, food, or other forms of assistance.

words.ex: The school organized clean-up campaigns every month.
words.ex_cn: 学校每个月都组织清洁活动。
words.en: Organized series of activities or operations designed to achieve a particular goal, often in marketing or politics.

words.tr: v. 宣传；推广；宣传，推广（publicise 的过去式和过去分词，同 publicize）；
words.ex: The movie was publicised on TV and social media.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影在电视和社交媒体上进行了宣传。
words.en: To make something widely known or to promote something publicly.

words.ex: The fish live in these clean waters.
words.ex_cn: 这些鱼生活在这片清澈的水域中。
words.en: 1. The waters of a particular area are the sea, rivers, or lakes that are part of it. 2. If you water plants, you pour water on them to help them grow.

words.ex: He campaigned for clean water in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他为家乡的清洁用水发起了运动。
words.en: If someone campaigns for something, they carry out a planned set of activities over a period of time in order to achieve their aim.

words.ex: The software sends updates every week.
words.ex_cn: 软件每周发送更新材料。
words.en: The latest information or news about something, or the process of making something more modern or suitable for use now by adding new information or changing its design.

words.ex: The observers watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 观察者们安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: People who watch and pay attention to something, especially in order to learn or understand it.

words.tr: n. 曲线；“curve”的复数； v. 沿曲线运动；
words.ex: The artist drew smooth curves on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家在纸上画了光滑的曲线。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, continuously bending line, for example, the line that represents the edge of a circle.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.tr: v. 坐；“sit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He sat on the chair quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地坐在椅子上。
words.en: To be in a position in which your bottom is resting on a chair, the ground, etc., with the top part of your body upright.

words.tr: vi. 有或起作用（function的过去式与过去分词形式）
words.ex: The machine functioned well yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天运行良好。
words.en: To function means to work or operate in a particular way, or to serve a particular purpose.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.ex: She is the coordinator of the school event.
words.ex_cn: 她是学校活动的协调者。
words.en: A coordinator is someone whose job is to organize the various parts of an activity or the people involved in it so that it works efficiently.

words.ex: The regulatory agency checks food safety.
words.ex_cn: 监管机构检查食品安全。
words.en: Relating to the regulation of something, especially by the government.

words.ex: He showed avoidance of difficult math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他回避困难的数学问题。
words.en: The act of keeping away from or preventing something from happening.

words.ex: The boy got punishment for breaking the window.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为打碎了窗户而受到了处罚。
words.en: Punishment is the act of punishing someone or the state of being punished.

words.ex: The teacher is transformational in how she teaches math.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师在教数学的方式上具有变革性。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by transformation; causing a marked change in someone or something.

words.ex: The company uses a transactional model for customer payments.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用交易型模式处理客户付款。
words.en: Relating to or involving transactions, especially of a business or commercial nature.

words.tr: v. 交流；相互作用；相互影响；相互作用[影响]，互相配合( interact的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The children are interacting with each other.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在互相交流。
words.en: To interact means to communicate or work together with someone or something.

words.ex: The waiter writes down the orders.
words.ex_cn: 服务员写下订单。
words.en: Orders can refer to instructions given by someone in authority, the sequence in which things are arranged, or requests made to purchase goods or services.

words.tr: n. 追随者；拥护者；信徒；
words.ex: He is a loyal follower of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 他是这位艺术家的忠实追随者。
words.en: A follower is a person who supports and admires a particular person or set of ideas.

words.ex: He called urgently for help.
words.ex_cn: 他紧急地呼救。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with immediately.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.tr:
n. 负荷；载重；
v. 载入；
words.ex: The bridge can't hold such a heavy load.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥承受不了这么重的负荷。
words.en: A load is a large quantity of something that is carried by a vehicle, person, or animal, or the amount of work that a person or machine has to do.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.ex: The can is made of tin.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是锡做的。
words.en: Tin is a soft, silvery-white metal that is often used to coat other metals to prevent them from rusting. It is also used in the production of tin cans and other containers.

words.ex: Iron and copper are common metals.
words.ex_cn: 铁和铜是常见的金属。
words.en: Metals are chemical elements that are typically hard, shiny, malleable, fusible, and ductile, with good electrical and thermal conductivity.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.ex: He got high scores in the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: The number of points, goals, runs, etc., achieved in a game or by a team or an individual.

words.ex: The deer walked through the thick undergrowth.
words.ex_cn: 鹿穿过了茂密的矮树丛。
words.en: Undergrowth refers to the dense growth of shrubs and other plants beneath the trees in a forest.

words.tr: n. 安装；装置；就职；军事设施；装置( installation的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The installations of the new pipes took two days.
words.ex_cn: 新管道的安装花了两天时间。
words.en: the act of installing something; something that is installed, especially a piece of equipment or a work of art

words.tr: n. 采矿；采矿业； v. “mine”的现在分词；
words.ex: Mining is an important industry in this region.
words.ex_cn: 采矿是这个地区的重要产业。
words.en: Mining is the process of extracting minerals and other materials from the earth.

words.ex: This book is ours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我们的人或物。
words.en: You use ours to refer to something that belongs or relates both to yourself and to one or more other people.

words.ex: The family stayed in wooden cabins near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这家人住在湖边的小木屋里。
words.en: Small, simple houses or rooms, especially those made of wood and located in a rural or wild area.

words.tr: adj. 值得纪念的；难忘的；
words.ex: That vacation was a memorable trip.
words.ex_cn: 那次旅行是一次值得纪念的旅程。
words.en: Something that is memorable is worth remembering or likely to be remembered, because it is special or very enjoyable.

words.ex: The museum displayed many beautiful artworks.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了许多精美的艺术品。
words.en: Artwork refers to the pieces of art that are produced by artists, including paintings, sculptures, and other forms of visual art.

words.ex: He is proactive in solving problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决问题时很积极主动。
words.en: If you are proactive, you take action to make things happen rather than waiting for them to happen to you.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt was one of the earliest civilisations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: Civilisation refers to an advanced state of human society, in which a high level of culture, science, industry, and government has been reached.

words.tr: n. 可能；能力( capability的名词复数 )；[复数]潜在能力；
words.ex: The new phone has great capabilities for taking photos.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机拍照的功能很强。
words.en: The abilities or qualities that someone or something has that can be used to achieve something.

words.tr: v. 嵌入；插入；插入( insert的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is inserting a coin into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把硬币嵌入机器中。
words.en: The act of putting something into a place or position, especially into a larger container or system.

words.ex: He was realising his mistake too late.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到自己的错误时已经太晚了。
words.en: to become aware of or understand something; to achieve something you wanted

words.ex: The fence safeguards the garden from animals.
words.ex_cn: 围栏保护花园免受动物侵扰。
words.en: A safeguard is a measure taken to protect someone or something from potential harm or danger.

words.ex: The students work in laboratories to test science experiments.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室里做科学实验。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific experiments, research, or teaching, or for the manufacture of drugs or chemicals.

words.ex: Scientists made new discoveries about the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们对海洋有了新的发现。
words.en: Discoveries are things that are found or learned about for the first time.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.ex: The village suffered from famine last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个村庄遭受了饥荒。
words.en: A famine is a serious shortage of food in a country, which may cause many people to get sick or die.

words.ex: He enquired about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了火车时刻表。
words.en: If you enquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.ex: The caretaker cleans the building every day.
words.ex_cn: 看管人每天打扫这座大楼。
words.en: A caretaker is a person whose job is to look after a large building such as a school or a block of flats or apartments, and deal with small repairs to it.

words.tr: v. 扫荡；打扫；掠过；“sweep”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The army swept the village to find hidden enemies.
words.ex_cn: 军队扫荡了村庄，寻找隐藏的敌人。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.ex: He injured his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: To injure someone means to cause them physical harm, for example in an accident or an attack.

words.tr: adj. 不平坦的；不均匀的；
words.ex: The road is uneven and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路不平坦，很难开车。
words.en: Something that is uneven is not regular, consistent, or equal.

words.ex: He wears sandals in summer.
words.ex_cn: 他夏天穿凉鞋。
words.en: Sandals are light shoes that you wear in warm weather, which have straps instead of a solid part over the top of your foot.

words.ex: The scarecrow stands in the field to keep birds away.
words.ex_cn: 稻草人站在田里赶走鸟儿。
words.en: A scarecrow is an object in the shape of a person, which is put in a field where crops are growing in order to frighten birds away.

words.ex: He spends weekends doing woodwork in his garage.
words.ex_cn: 他周末在车库里做木工活。
words.en: The activity or skill of making things from wood.

words.tr: v.major（以…为专业）的现在分词形式
words.ex: He is majoring in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他主修计算机科学。
words.en: The act of studying a particular subject as the main part of your course at a university or college.

words.tr: adv. 糟糕地；拙劣地；不足；
words.ex: He performed poorly in the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中表现得很糟糕。
words.en: In a manner that is not good or satisfactory.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.ex: Biologists study animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 生物学家研究动物和植物。
words.en: Biologists are scientists who study living organisms and their relationship to their environment.

words.tr: adj. 剩余的；剩下的； v. 依然不变；留下；“remain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The remaining cookies were shared among the children.
words.ex_cn: 剩下的饼干被孩子们分了。
words.en: The part that is still left after other parts have been used, taken away, or destroyed.

words.ex: The temperatures are very high in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气温很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: The fence shows the boundaries of the yard.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆显示了院子的边界。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The warmth of the sun made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的温暖让她露出了微笑。
words.en: The quality, state, or sensation of being warm; moderate and comfortable heat.

words.ex: He calculates the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速计算出总成本。
words.en: To determine by mathematical methods; compute.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上读书。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.ex: The exterior of the house is painted white.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观是白色的。
words.en: The outer surface or structure of something.

words.tr: v. 安装；安装( install的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is installing a new light in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他正在厨房安装一盏新灯。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: The functions of the brain are still being studied by scientists.
words.ex_cn: 大脑的功能正在被科学家们研究。
words.en: The purpose that something is designed to have or the role that someone or something has in a situation, system, or organization.

words.ex: The school uses computerised tests for math.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用计算机化的数学测试。
words.en: Made to operate by or through the use of computers; automated.

words.ex: The ruler made laws for his people.
words.ex_cn: 这位统治者为他的人民制定法律。
words.en: A ruler is a person who governs or commands. It can also refer to a straight strip or cylinder of plastic, wood, metal, or other rigid material, typically marked at regular intervals and used to draw straight lines or measure distances.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: The company uses new tech to improve its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用新技术来改进其产品。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.ex: The city is divided into different zones for shopping and living.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市被划分为不同的购物和居住地带。
words.en: An area or stretch of land having a particular characteristic, purpose, or use, or subject to particular restrictions.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.tr: adj. 近的；近似；近的( near的比较级 )；
words.ex: The park is nearer than the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园比学校更近。
words.en: At a shorter distance in space or time; closer.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.tr: v. 设计；“design”的现在分词； adj. 蓄意的；
words.ex: He is designing a new house.
words.ex_cn: 他正在设计一座新房子。
words.en: The process of planning or creating something, such as a building, a machine, or a piece of software, in a way that is both functional and aesthetically pleasing.

words.ex: Calling time a thief is a metaphor.
words.ex_cn: 把时间称为小偷是一种隐喻。
words.en: A metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.

words.tr: v. 接近；靠近；“approach”的现在分词； adj. 接近的；临近的；
words.ex: The train is approaching the station.
words.ex_cn: 火车正在接近车站。
words.en: Coming closer in distance or time.

words.ex: She buys pads for her period every month.
words.ex_cn: 她每个月都买卫生巾。
words.en: Pads are pieces of soft material used to protect something or make something more comfortable. As a verb, to pad something means to fill or cover it with soft material to protect it or make it more comfortable.

words.ex: He sold his properties to buy a new house.
words.ex_cn: 他卖掉了自己的财产来买一栋新房子。
words.en: Properties are qualities or features that belong naturally to something; they can also refer to buildings or land owned by someone.

words.ex: She pulled the curtains to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上窗帘以挡住阳光。
words.en: Curtains are pieces of material that hang from the top of a window and can be drawn across it to cover it.

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.ex: The spotting of the signal was very accurate.
words.ex_cn: 信号的测定点位非常准确。
words.en: The act of noticing or identifying something, often something that is not easy to see or that is hidden.

words.ex: The passenger got off the bus at the next stop.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅客在下一站下了车。
words.en: A passenger is a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not the driver or one of the people who works on it.

words.ex: His incomes are from his job and rent.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入来自他的工作和租金。
words.en: Money received, especially on a regular basis, for work or through investments.

words.ex: The shoppers bought apples and bread at the market.
words.ex_cn: 顾客们在市场买了苹果和面包。
words.en: People who are shopping or intending to shop.

words.ex: The multi-colored flowers brightened the garden.
words.ex_cn: 五颜六色的花让花园变得明亮。
words.en: A prefix meaning 'many' or 'multiple', used in the formation of compound words to indicate the involvement of more than one of the specified element.

words.ex: The house has three storeys.
words.ex_cn: 这栋房子有三层。
words.en: A storey is a level of a building; a floor.

words.tr: adj. 贴邻的；毗连的； v. “adjoin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The two houses are adjoining.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子是贴邻的。
words.en: Adjoining is used to describe something that is next to or joined with something else.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.ex: The machine stops when the power is off.
words.ex_cn: 当电源关闭时，机器停止工作。
words.en: Stops: (verb) Ceases movement or activity.

words.ex: She sees a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 她看见树上有一只鸟。
words.en: To perceive with the eyes; to understand or realize something.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: He wrote a book about ethnography of the tribe.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于这个部落的人种学的书。
words.en: Ethnography is the systematic study of people and cultures. It is designed to explore cultural phenomena where the researcher observes society from the point of view of the subject of the study.

words.ex: The seller gave me a receipt.
words.ex_cn: 卖方给了我一张收据。
words.en: A seller is a person or organization that sells something.

words.ex: The children are eager to open their presents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们渴望打开他们的礼物。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.ex: The airline lost my luggage.
words.ex_cn: 这家航空公司弄丢了我的行李。
words.en: An airline is a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr:
v. 选择；挑选；
adj. 精心挑选的；
words.ex: He will select the best candidate for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他将选择最适合这份工作的人。
words.en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.ex: Each participant must sign the form.
words.ex_cn: 每个参与者都必须签署表格。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in an activity or event.

words.tr:
int. 再见；
n. 说再见；
words.ex: She said goodbye and left the room.
words.ex_cn: 她说再见后离开了房间。
words.en: Goodbye is a conventional expression used at parting.

words.tr: v. （通过努力等）赢得；（在…中）获胜，赢，战胜（对手）；
words.ex: He wins the race with hard training.
words.ex_cn: 他通过刻苦训练赢得了比赛。
words.en: To achieve victory in a contest, conflict, game, or bet; to gain something desired or beneficial through effort or good fortune.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: She hires a babysitter to look after her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她请了一个保姆来照看她的宝宝。
words.en: A babysitter is someone who looks after children while their parents are out.

words.tr: n. 警示； v. 警告；“warn”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign gave a warning about the slippery road.
words.ex_cn: 标志提醒了道路湿滑的警示。
words.en: A warning is something which is said or written to tell people of a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant thing that might happen.

words.tr: v. 捐赠； adj. v. 捐赠（donate 的过去分词形式）；
words.ex: She donated her old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 她把旧书捐给了图书馆。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization in order to help them.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: They are sitting on the sofas and watching TV.
words.ex_cn: 他们正坐在沙发上看电视。
words.en: A sofa is a long, comfortable seat with a back and usually with arms, which two or three people can sit on.

words.ex: The job is repetitive and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作重复且无聊。
words.en: Something that is repetitive involves doing the same thing over and over again.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.ex: Microbes live in the soil and help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 微生物生活在土壤中，帮助植物生长。
words.en: Microbes are very small living things, especially ones that cause disease, which can only be seen with a microscope.

words.ex: The doctor checked her fertility to help her get pregnant.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了她的生育力，以帮助她怀孕。
words.en: Fertility refers to the ability to produce offspring or to the quality of being fertile, especially in terms of soil or land.

words.ex: The farmers work on their lands every day.
words.ex_cn: 农民们每天在他们的土地上劳作。
words.en: Lands refer to the solid surface of the earth that is not covered by water. It can also mean to come down through the air and rest on the ground or another surface.

words.tr: n. 试验；检测；考试；测验； v. 试验；测试；“test”的现在分词；
words.ex: The testing of the new car took three months.
words.ex_cn: 新车的试验花了三个月。
words.en: The process of subjecting something to a test to determine its qualities or performance.

words.tr: n. 生态学家；生态学者；
words.ex: The ecologist studied birds in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生态学家研究了森林里的鸟类。
words.en: An ecologist is a scientist who studies the relationships between living things and their environment.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.ex: The cows eat grasses in the field.
words.ex_cn: 牛在田野里吃草。
words.en: Plants with narrow leaves growing from the base, covering the ground in many areas.

words.ex: The farmers work on farms every day.
words.ex_cn: 农民每天在农场工作。
words.en: A farm is an area of land, or sometimes a building, where crops are grown or animals are kept.

words.tr: adv. 准确地；精确地；正确地；
words.ex: He measured the length accurately.
words.ex_cn: 他准确地测量了长度。
