words.tr: v. 做梦；梦想；“dream”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I dreamed of flying last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚梦见自己在飞翔。
words.en: A misspelling of 'dreamed,' meaning experienced a dream during sleep or imagined something.

words.ex: Follow the guidelines to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 遵循指南以通过考试。
words.en: Guidelines are general rules, principles, or pieces of advice that help you to do something or to decide what to do in a particular situation.

words.tr: adj. 放松的；不拘束的； v. 放宽；“relax”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He sat in the chair with a relaxed smile.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上，面带放松的微笑。
words.en: If you are relaxed, you are calm and not worried or tense.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.ex: He does workouts every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼。
words.en: Physical exercises that you do to keep fit or to prepare for a sporting event.

words.ex: He does a daily workout at the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在健身房健身。
words.en: A session of vigorous physical exercise or training.

words.tr: v. 减少；降低；跌落；削弱；
words.ex: He lowers the volume when the baby sleeps.
words.ex_cn: 当宝宝睡觉时，他把音量调低。
words.en: Makes something less in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: The supervisors check the workers every day.
words.ex_cn: 主管们每天检查工人们。
words.en: Supervisors are people who are in charge of a group of workers or a particular operation and who make sure that everything is done correctly.

words.ex: The government supports different sectors like education and health.
words.ex_cn: 政府支持教育和医疗等不同领域。
words.en: A sector is a part of an area of activity, especially of a country's economy, or a part of a particular industry.

words.ex: The paced rhythm helped runners stay in sync.
words.ex_cn: 有节奏的步调帮助跑者保持同步。
words.en: Moving or progressing at a specified speed or in a specified manner.

words.ex: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
words.ex_cn: 他爬梯子去修屋顶。
words.en: A ladder is a piece of equipment consisting of a series of steps or rungs fixed between two upright lengths of wood, metal, or rope, used for climbing up or down something.

words.tr: v. 保持；保养；保持( maintain的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He maintained his health by exercising every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天锻炼来保持健康。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.ex: He adds sweeteners to his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他往茶里加甜味剂。
words.en: Sweeteners are substances used to impart a sweet taste to foods or in the preparation of foods, typically as a substitute for sugar.

words.ex: She knit a warm scarf for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的弟弟织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

words.tr: n. 山药; 甘薯; 薯蓣( yam的名词复数 ); 白薯
words.ex: He eats yams for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃山药。
words.en: Starchy root vegetable with sweet, orange flesh, commonly boiled or roasted; similar to a sweet potato.

words.tr: vt. & vi. 把…编入预算；& vi. 把…编入预算（budget的过去式与过去分词形式）；
words.ex: The school budgeted $5,000 for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校把5000美元编入了新书的预算。
words.en: If something is budgeted, it is included in a budget or planned according to a budget.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.ex: He uses an app to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个应用程序来学习英语。
words.en: An app is a computer program that is designed for a specific purpose, especially one that can be downloaded onto a mobile device.

words.ex: She adds spices to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她给汤里加香料。
words.en: Spices are substances obtained from plants, which are used to flavor food or drink.

words.ex: The skull protects the brain.
words.ex_cn: 颅骨保护大脑。
words.en: The bony framework of the head that encloses the brain and supports the structures of the face.

words.ex: The apple is ripe and ready to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果熟了，可以吃了。
words.en: When fruit or crops are ripe, they are ready to be eaten or harvested because they have developed to the right stage.

words.ex: The monkeys are climbing the trees.
words.ex_cn: 猴子们正在爬树。
words.en: Monkeys are mammals of the order Primates, which includes lemurs, lorises, tarsiers, and apes, including humans. They are known for their intelligence and social behavior.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: The children played on the gravel path.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在砾石小路上玩耍。
words.en: Gravel consists of very small stones. It is often used to make paths and roads.

words.tr: n. 鹰嘴豆( chickpea的名词复数 )
words.ex: She eats chickpeas for lunch every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天午餐都吃鹰嘴豆。
words.en: Chickpeas are a type of legume that is high in protein and fiber, commonly used in various cuisines around the world.

words.ex: She rolled out the paste for the pie crust.
words.ex_cn: 她把面团擀平做派皮。
words.en: Paste is a soft, wet, sticky mixture of a powder and a liquid, which can be spread easily. It is also used to refer to the action of sticking something onto a surface using a sticky substance.

words.ex: The smell of the soup was appetising.
words.ex_cn: 这汤的香味很开胃。
words.en: If you describe food as appetising, you mean that it looks or smells good and makes you want to eat it.

words.ex: She added cinnamon spice to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她往蛋糕里加了肉桂香料。
words.en: Spice refers to a substance used to flavor food, which is usually made from parts of plants, especially their seeds, fruits, or roots. It can also mean something that adds interest or excitement.

words.tr: adj. 讳莫如深的；守口如瓶的；谨慎小心的；狡猾的
words.ex: He was cagey when asked about his plans.
words.ex_cn: 当被问到他的计划时，他很谨慎。
words.en: If you describe someone as cagey, you mean that they are careful not to give too much information or to show their feelings.

words.ex: The forest showed quick regrowth after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 火灾后，森林迅速再生长。
words.en: The process of growing again or the new growth that results from this process.

words.tr: n. （音乐）和弦；（数学）弦( chord的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The guitarist played three simple chords.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了三个简单的和弦。
words.en: In music, a chord is any harmonic set of pitches consisting of multiple notes (also called "pitches") that are heard as if sounding simultaneously.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.tr:
n. 曲调；调子；
v. 调整；调音；
words.ex: He hummed a happy tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着一首欢快的曲调。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. It can also refer to adjusting something so that it works or looks better.

words.ex: The guitarist played a C major chord.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了一个C大和弦。
words.en: A chord is a group of three or more musical notes played together.

words.tr: v. 激励；激发；“motivate”的现在分词；
words.ex: Her teacher gave her a prize, which was motivating.
words.ex_cn: 她的老师给了她一个奖品，这激励了她。
words.en: If something is motivating, it makes you feel enthusiastic and eager to achieve something.

words.ex: He plans to resell the shoes for more money.
words.ex_cn: 他计划把这些鞋子转卖以赚更多钱。
words.en: To sell something that you have bought, especially in order to make a profit.

words.tr: v. 拒绝；驳回；“reject”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He rejected the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.tr: n. 马拉松赛跑；耐力赛；
words.ex: He ran a marathon last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他上个星期日跑了一场马拉松赛跑。
words.en: A marathon is a long-distance running event with an official distance of 42.195 kilometers (26 miles 385 yards), usually run as a road race. The event was instituted in commemoration of the fabled run of the Greek soldier Pheidippides, a messenger from the Battle of Marathon to Athens.

words.ex: The runner won the race quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位跑步者很快赢得了比赛。
words.en: A runner is a person who runs, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.tr: n. 爪子；爪子（claw 的复数）；
words.ex: The cat stretched out its claws.
words.ex_cn: 猫伸出了它的爪子。
words.en: The sharp, curved nails on the feet of some animals, used for catching prey, climbing, or fighting.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刷牙。
words.en: The hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: The water freezes at zero centigrade.
words.ex_cn: 水在零摄氏度时结冰。
words.en: Centigrade is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.tr: n. 隐生现象；潜生现象；
words.ex: Some tardigrades enter cryptobiosis when the environment dries up.
words.ex_cn: 当环境变干时，某些缓步动物会进入隐生现象。
words.en: A state of suspended animation in organisms, allowing survival in extreme conditions by drastically reducing metabolic activity.

words.tr: v. 使再生效；恢复； adj. 恢复( revive的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The old law was revived last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这项旧法律又被重新生效了。
words.en: If something is revived, it becomes active, popular, or successful again after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是真实的。
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统分解食物。
words.en: Relating to the process of digesting food.

words.ex: The birds ate the worms in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在花园里吃了蠕虫。
words.en: Worms are small, long, thin creatures that have no bones and live in soil.

words.ex: The farmer planted ryegrass to feed his cows.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植黑麦草来喂养他的奶牛。
words.en: A type of grass with fine leaves, commonly used for lawns, pastures, and erosion control.

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.ex: The boy hurt his spine when he fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他从树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。
words.en: The spine is the row of bones down the center of your back that supports your body and protects your spinal cord.

words.tr: n. 平装本，平装书( paperback的名词复数 )
words.ex: He buys paperbacks at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买平装书。
words.en: Paperbacks are books that have a flexible paper binding and are less expensive than hardcover books.

words.tr: v. 降级；“degrade”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was degraded for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规定而被降级。
words.en: If something is degraded, it has become worse in quality or condition.

words.ex: He ate a fresh fig for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个新鲜的无花果。
words.en: A fig is a soft sweet fruit that grows in hot countries. It is full of tiny seeds and often eaten dried.

words.tr: v. 组织；安排；使有条理
words.ex: She organizes her books by color.
words.ex_cn: 她按颜色整理她的书。
words.en: To organize means to arrange or plan something systematically.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.ex: We bought apples, bananas, oranges, etcetera.
words.ex_cn: 我们买了苹果、香蕉、橙子等等。
words.en: used at the end of a list to indicate that further, similar items are included

words.ex: He finished in the thirteenth position.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第十三名。
words.en: The ordinal number corresponding to the cardinal number thirteen.

words.tr: n. 有…座位的汽车（或飞机等）
words.ex: This car has five seater seats.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有五个座位。
words.en: A seater is a vehicle or aircraft that has a specified number of seats.

words.ex: My parents are letting me go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我父母允许我去公园。
words.en: the act of renting out property or accommodation

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.tr: n. 工匠；手艺人；手艺人（craftsman 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The craftsmen made beautiful wooden chairs by hand.
words.ex_cn: 工匠们手工制作了漂亮的木椅。
words.en: A craftsman is a person who is skilled at making things by hand.

words.tr:
n. 锻造车间；
v. 建立（联系等）；
words.ex: The blacksmith works in the forge every morning.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠每天早上都在锻造车间工作。
words.en: To forge something means to create it, especially by using considerable effort or skill. It can also mean to make or produce something, especially with some difficulty or effort. Additionally, it refers to the act of making a copy or imitation of something with the intent to deceive.

words.tr: n. 磨坊；磨粉机；磨坊( mill的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The old mills stand by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊伫立在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour, or a factory where a particular substance is produced.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.ex: The knife was sharpened after cutting the wood.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀在砍完木头后被磨利了。
words.en: Made or become sharp or sharper.

words.tr:
adj. 古老的；
n. 古董；
words.ex: He bought an antique chair from the old market.
words.ex_cn: 他从旧市场买了一把古老的椅子。
words.en: Something that is antique is old and often valuable because it is rare or well made.

words.ex: She bought fresh teas from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场上买了新鲜的茶叶。
words.en: plural of tea; a drink made by infusing leaves of the tea plant in boiling water.

words.tr: adj. 有同情心的；表示怜悯的；
words.ex: She is a compassionate teacher who helps struggling students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位有同情心的老师，帮助学习困难的学生。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as compassionate, you mean that they feel or show pity, sympathy, and understanding for people who are suffering.

words.ex: The class discusses math problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级每天讨论数学问题。
words.en: to talk about something with somebody, especially in order to decide something

words.ex: I need a photocopy of my passport.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一份护照的影印本。
words.en: A photocopy is a copy of a document made by a photocopier.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；街道；附近地区；
words.ex: I walk my dog in the neighborhood every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上在街坊遛狗。
words.en: A neighborhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.tr: adj. 阳光灿烂的；晴朗的；
words.ex: It is a sunny day today.
words.ex_cn: 今天是阳光灿烂的一天。
words.en: When it is sunny, the sun is shining brightly.

words.ex: He sweats heavily after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后大量出汗。
words.en: Sweat is the salty liquid that comes out through the skin when you are hot, ill, or afraid.

words.ex: The humidifier helps to humidify the dry air.
words.ex_cn: 加湿器有助于使干燥的空气变得湿润。
words.en: To humidify means to add moisture or water vapor to the air or to a gas, making it more humid.

words.tr: adj. 多风的；风大的；“windy”的比较级；
words.ex: The coast is windier than the inland area.
words.ex_cn: 海岸比内陆多风。
words.en: adj. (of weather) marked by strong winds or more wind than usual

words.ex: The song became a big hit after it appeared on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在登上电视后成了引人注意的东西。
words.en: If you hit someone or something, you deliberately touch them with a lot of force, with your hand or an object held in your hand.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.ex: Strong gusts blew the leaves across the yard.
words.ex_cn: 一阵阵强风把树叶吹得满院子都是。
words.en: A gust is a sudden, strong rush of wind.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.tr: v. 阻塞；阻碍；“block”的现在分词；
words.ex: The fallen tree is blocking the road.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树堵住了道路。
words.en: The act of obstructing or impeding the progress or movement of something or someone.

words.ex: The river flows through a deep canyon.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经一个深峡谷。
words.en: A canyon is a large valley with very steep sides and usually a river flowing along the bottom.

words.tr: v. 围起；“enclose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They enclosed the garden with a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用篱笆把花园围了起来。
words.en: If something is enclosed, it is placed inside an envelope, package, or container, often for the purpose of sending it to someone.

words.ex: Plants grow better with sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光下生长得更好。
words.en: Sunlight is the light that comes from the sun.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.ex: Travelers carry maps to find their way.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者带着地图找路。
words.en: People who are traveling, especially those who are on a journey.

words.ex: He writes cheques to pay for groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他用支票支付食品杂货费用。
words.en: A cheque is a printed form on which you write an amount of money and who it is to be paid to. Your bank then pays the money to that person from your account.

words.tr: n. 讲述者；（银行）出纳员；
words.ex: The old man is the teller of fairy tales.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是童话故事的讲述者。
words.en: A teller is a person who works in a bank and whose job includes receiving and paying out money.

words.ex: The bank recorded all transactions yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 银行昨天记录了所有交易。
words.en: Transactions are the actions or processes of buying, selling, or exchanging goods, services, or money.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.tr: adj. 上升的；增长的； n. 底托；登上；乘骑； v. “mount”的现在分词；
words.ex: The mounting pressure made him nervous.
words.ex_cn: 上升的压力让他感到紧张。
words.en: The act of fixing or attaching something in position.

words.tr: n. 毛骨悚然的感觉；爬行动物
words.ex: A cold creep ran down her spine when she saw the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到那个影子时，一股毛骨悚然的感觉从脊背窜下。
words.en: A feeling of fear or unease; also refers to small, crawling creatures.

words.ex: The unfinished homework lay on the desk.
words.ex_cn: 未完成的作业放在书桌上。
words.en: Not finished or concluded; incomplete.

words.ex: He felt unmotivated to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得缺乏动力去完成作业。
words.en: If you are unmotivated, you lack enthusiasm and are not willing to work hard or do something.

words.ex: He stopped bothering his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他停止打扰他的妹妹了。
words.en: bothering: causing annoyance, worry, or trouble to someone.

words.tr: n. （学校、医院、军队、监狱中的）牧师；
words.ex: The chaplain prayed with the soldiers before the mission.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在任务前为士兵们祈祷。
words.en: A chaplain is a member of the clergy attached to a private chapel, institution, ship, regiment, etc.

words.ex: He will resit the math exam next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将重考数学考试。
words.en: If someone resits an examination, they take it again, usually because they failed it the first time.

words.ex: She was sympathetic to his problems.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的问题很同情。
words.en: If you are sympathetic to someone who is in a bad situation, you are kind to them and show that you understand their feelings.

words.ex: He follows a dietary plan to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循一种饮食计划来保持健康。
words.en: Relating to the diet or the kinds of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats.

words.tr: n. 嗜好；爱好； v. “like”的现在分词；
words.ex: His liking for chocolate is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 他对巧克力的嗜好非常强烈。
words.en: If you have a liking for something, you enjoy it or approve of it.

words.ex: Loud noises upsets her.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的声音让她感到苦恼。
words.en: Causes emotional distress or disturbance.

words.tr: n. 饮食学家；营养学家；
words.ex: The dietician helped me plan healthy meals.
words.ex_cn: 饮食学家帮我规划了健康的饮食。
words.en: A dietician is a professional who is qualified to give advice about diet and nutrition.

words.ex: He was counselled by his teacher to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 他被老师劝告要更加努力学习。
words.en: If you counsel someone to take a course of action, or if you counsel a course of action, you advise that course of action.

words.ex: The hospital is understaffed and needs more nurses.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院人手不足，需要更多的护士。
words.en: If an organization is understaffed, it does not have enough employees to function properly.

words.tr: n. 措辞；用词； v. “word”的现在分词；
words.ex: The wording of the notice was clear.
words.ex_cn: 通知的措辞很清晰。
words.en: The way in which words are used to express something, especially in a document or speech.

words.tr: adj. 更快的；更迅速的；“quick”的比较级；
words.ex: This car is quicker than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车比旧车更快。
words.en: More rapid in movement or action than someone or something else.

words.ex: The drawbacks of this phone are high price and short battery.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是价格高和电池续航短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature that makes something less effective than it could be.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.ex: The departmental meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 部门会议早上九点开始。
words.en: Relating to a department or departments within an organization.

words.ex: The murder happened last night in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这起谋杀发生在昨晚的公园里。
words.en: Murder is the unlawful premeditated killing of one human being by another.

words.ex: His preoccupation with video games made him ignore his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的全神贯注让他忽略了作业。
words.en: If you have a preoccupation with something or someone, you think or worry about them very often and they are the main focus of your attention.

words.tr: n. 目无法纪; 不服从法律; 不受法律制约; 未实施法律
words.ex: The town suffered from lawlessness after the police left.
words.ex_cn: 警察离开后，这个城镇陷入了无法无天的状态。
words.en: The state of being without law or control; the absence of laws or the disregard for laws.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: The decision was made in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定是按照规则做出的。
words.en: Agreement or harmony; conformity.

words.tr: v. 下定义；“define”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 明确的；
words.ex: The teacher defined the word clearly.
words.ex_cn: 老师清楚地给这个词下了定义。
words.en: If something is defined, it is explained or described in a clear and precise way.

words.tr: v. 犯罪；做错事；“commit”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 忠诚的；
words.ex: He was committed for stealing a car.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷车而被定罪。
words.en: If you are committed to something, you are willing to give your time and energy to it because you believe in it.

words.ex: He was jailed for embezzlement from his company.
words.ex_cn: 他因盗用公司公款而入狱。
words.en: Embezzlement is the act of dishonestly taking or using money that belongs to someone else, especially when it is in your care or belongs to the organization you work for.

words.ex: The man was punished for fraud.
words.ex_cn: 这个人因欺骗而受到惩罚。
words.en: Fraud is the crime of gaining money or financial benefits by a trick or by lying.

words.tr: v. 把；保证（做某事、遵守协议或遵从安排等）( commit的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is committing his thoughts to paper.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把他的想法写在纸上。
words.en: Committing: (verb) Performing an action, often illegal or immoral.

words.tr: adj. 可原谅的；情有可原的；
words.ex: His excuse was excusable because he was sick.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口是可以原谅的，因为他生病了。
words.en: If something is excusable, it can be forgiven or understood because there is a good reason for it.

words.ex: I listen to morning broadcasts on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我听早上的广播节目。
words.en: To transmit (a program or some information) by radio or television.

words.tr: n. 电视连续剧；连载小说，电视连续剧( serial的名词复数 )；
words.ex: I watch serials every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚饭后看电视连续剧。
words.en: Stories published in installments over time.

words.ex: He lost his job, which was a great misfortune.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，这是一场巨大的不幸。
words.en: An unfortunate condition or event.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.ex: She dilutes the juice with water.
words.ex_cn: 她用水稀释果汁。
words.en: To make a liquid weaker by adding water or another solvent to it.

words.ex: He put the milk in a carton.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶倒进了硬纸盒里。
words.en: A carton is a box or container usually made of cardboard or plastic, used for holding goods.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不重要的；
words.ex: The mistake was insignificant and didn't affect the result.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误无关紧要，没有影响结果。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as insignificant, you mean that they are small or unimportant, and therefore not worth considering seriously.

words.ex: His deception fooled everyone at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他的欺骗骗过了派对上的所有人。
words.en: Deception is the act of deceiving someone or the state of being deceived.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.ex: He has faith in his ability to win.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛有信心。
words.en: Strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

words.ex: He is richer than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他哥哥更富有。
words.en: Having more wealth or resources than someone or something else; more abundant or plentiful.

words.tr: v. 抢劫；掠夺；抢夺； n. 抢夺( rob的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was caught robbing a convenience store.
words.ex_cn: 他被抓住正在抢劫便利店。
words.en: To take property unlawfully from (a person or place) by force or threat of force.

words.ex: The police opened an inquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: The chart illustrates how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这个图表阐明了植物是如何生长的。
words.en: If you say that something illustrates a situation that you are drawing attention to, you mean that it shows that the situation exists.

words.ex: He gave an intentional wrong answer to confuse the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他故意答错答案来迷惑老师。
words.en: Something that is intentional is done on purpose, not by chance.

words.ex: The bomb will explode at noon.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹将在中午爆炸。
words.en: If an object explodes, it bursts loudly and with great force, often causing damage or injury.

words.ex: He showed indifference to his friend's problems.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的问题表现出冷淡。
words.en: Indifference is the state of being indifferent, especially in the sense of not caring or being uninterested.

words.tr: adj. 悲剧的；悲惨的；不幸的；
words.ex: The accident was a tragic event.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故是一场悲剧。
words.en: A tragic event or situation is extremely sad, usually because it involves death or suffering.

words.tr: adj. 天真无邪的；无辜的；
words.ex: The innocent child smiled at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 那个天真无邪的孩子对陌生人笑了。
words.en: If someone is innocent, they did not commit a crime which they have been accused of.

words.ex: The law has a loophole that lets companies avoid taxes.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律有一个漏洞，让公司可以避税。
words.en: A loophole is a small mistake in a law or set of rules which allows people to do something that would otherwise be illegal or not allowed.

words.ex: Can you give me the particulars of the accident?
words.ex_cn: 你能告诉我事故的细节吗？
words.en: The details or pieces of information about something or someone.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；尊敬；
v. 尊敬；给予荣誉；履行；
words.ex: He received an honor for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honor is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. A person who has honor is someone who is admired and respected because of his or her integrity and ethical behavior.

words.ex: The town had celebrations for the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇为节日举行了庆祝活动。
words.en: Celebrations refer to special social events, ceremonies, or parties that are organized in order to celebrate something.

words.ex: The wedding party was held under a large marquee in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼派对在花园里的大帐篷下举行。
words.en: A marquee is a large tent used for social or commercial events, or the canopy over the entrance to a theater or cinema.

words.ex: He paints on a canvas with oil colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用油画颜料在帆布上作画。
words.en: A strong, coarse unbleached cloth made from hemp, flax, cotton, or a similar yarn, used to make items such as sails and tents and as a surface for oil painting.

words.tr: v. 扮小丑（clown的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is clowning around to make the children laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他正在逗孩子们笑，装傻扮丑。
words.en: Clowning is the act of performing as a clown, often involving slapstick comedy and physical humour.

words.ex: The children performed an acrobatic routine on the stage.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在舞台上表演了一个杂技节目。
words.en: Acrobatic refers to the performance of extraordinary feats of balance, agility, and motor coordination, often in a performance context.

words.ex: The purists prefer the original version.
words.ex_cn: 纯粹主义者更喜欢原版。
words.en: Purists are people who insist on following traditional rules or styles, especially in language, art, or music, and who oppose any form of change or innovation.

words.ex: The magician showed some magic tricks.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师表演了一些魔术把戏。
words.en: A trick is a clever or skillful action that someone does in order to entertain or deceive people.

words.ex: He loves watching puppetry at the children's theater.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在儿童剧院观看木偶戏。
words.en: The art or practice of making and manipulating puppets, especially in performances.

words.ex: The troupe performed a dance show in the town square.
words.ex_cn: 这个表演团在广场上演了一出舞蹈表演。
words.en: A troupe is a group of actors, singers, or dancers who work together.

words.ex: The lifeless fish floated on the water.
words.ex_cn: 那条死鱼漂在水面上。
words.en: If something is lifeless, it is either not alive or it appears to be not alive.

words.tr: v. 询问；“enquire”的现在分词； adj. 爱探索的；
words.ex: He was enquiring about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他正在询问火车时刻表。
words.en: Seeking or showing an interest in learning about something; inquiring.

words.tr: n. 恢复精神的人或物；
words.ex: A short nap is a good refresher after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后小睡一会儿是恢复精神的好方法。
words.en: A refresher is a course that helps people to learn or remember something that they have already been taught, or something that makes you feel more energetic or less tired.

words.ex: He is uncertain about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个答案不确定。
words.en: If you are uncertain about something, you do not know what is true, what is going to happen, or what you should do.

words.tr: v. 分析；<美>分析( analyze的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is analyzing the data for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为他的项目分析数据。
words.en: To examine something methodically and in detail, typically in order to explain and interpret it.

words.ex: He kept putting off his homework because of procrastination.
words.ex_cn: 他因为拖延一直推迟做作业。
words.en: Procrastination is the action of delaying or postponing something.

words.tr: adj. 技艺高超的；完成的；熟练的； v. 完成；实现；“accomplish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an accomplished pianist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位技艺高超的钢琴家。
words.en: If someone is accomplished at something, they are very skilled at it.

words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.tr: v. 提升；使（机器、计算机系统等）升级；提高（设施； n. 浓缩 v. 提升( upgrade的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They are upgrading their old computers.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在提升他们的旧电脑。
words.en: The act of improving or enhancing something to a higher standard or level.

words.ex: The leavers planted trees before they left school.
words.ex_cn: 毕业生们离校前种了树。
words.en: Leavers are people who are leaving a place, especially students who are leaving a school or college at the end of their studies.

words.tr: n. 受益人(beneficiary的复数形式)
words.ex: The beneficiaries received money from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 受益人从慈善机构收到了钱。
words.en: A beneficiary is someone who receives money or other benefits as a result of something, especially a will or an insurance policy.

words.ex: He cited a book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中引用了一本书。
words.en: To cite something means to quote it or mention it as evidence or proof of what you are saying.

words.tr: n. 支持者；拥护者；“supporter”的复数；
words.ex: The supporters cheered loudly for their team.
words.ex_cn: 支持者们为他们的球队大声欢呼。
words.en: People who support a particular person, group, or idea.

words.ex: The soldiers were given quarters near the base.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们被安排在基地附近的住处。
words.en: Quarters can refer to one of four equal parts into which something is divided, a period of three months, a period of 15 minutes, or a place where someone lives or stays.

words.ex: There was a disagreement about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 关于这个计划，他们产生了分歧。
words.en: A disagreement is a situation in which people have different opinions about something and often argue.

words.ex: He bought a largish house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近买了一所相当大的房子。
words.en: Somewhat large in size.

words.tr:
n. 精英主义者；
adj. 精英主义的；
words.ex: He is an elitist who believes only the smartest should lead.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精英主义者，认为只有最聪明的人才应该领导。
words.en: An elitist is someone who believes that a society or system should be led by an elite.

words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: He repeatedly asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他再三地请求帮助。
words.en: If something is done repeatedly, it is done again and again.

words.ex: The police used surveillance to watch the building.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用监视来观察那栋大楼。
words.en: The careful watching of a person or place, especially by the police or army, because of a crime that has happened or is expected.

words.ex: He said farewell to his friends before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前向朋友们道别。
words.en: Farewell is an expression of good wishes at parting, often used to say goodbye.

words.ex: He put the letter in an envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把信装进了一个信封。
words.en: An envelope is a flat, usually rectangular or square, paper container for a letter, which you seal before you send it by post.

words.tr: adj. 不公正的；不公平的；
words.ex: The teacher gave an unfair test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个不公正的考试。
words.en: If you describe a situation or action as unfair, you mean that it is not right or reasonable, especially because it does not treat people equally.

words.ex: I use dictionaries to learn new words.
words.ex_cn: 我用字典学习新单词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book or electronic resource that lists the words of a language (typically in alphabetical order) and gives their meaning, or gives the equivalent words in a different language, often also providing information about pronunciation, origin, and usage.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.tr: adj. 惊吓的；受惊的；害怕的； v. “frighten”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was frightened by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 孩子被巨大的噪音吓到了。
words.en: If you are frightened, you are anxious or afraid, often because of something that has just happened or that you think may happen.

words.ex: He is a maker of wooden chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他是木椅的制造者。
words.en: A maker is a person or company that makes or produces something.

words.tr: n. 磁带；录音带；胶带；带子；
words.ex: He recorded the song on a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首歌录在磁带上。
words.en: A tape is a narrow strip of plastic or other material that is used for recording sound or pictures, or for sticking things together.

words.tr:
n. 刻度盘；
v. 拨；
words.ex: He looked at the clock's dial to check the time.
words.ex_cn: 他看着钟的刻度盘来查看时间。
words.en: A dial is the face of a clock or watch, or a similar control on a piece of equipment, which shows you the time or other information. As a verb, to dial means to call a telephone number by pressing the buttons on a telephone.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.ex: He won many awards for his science projects.
words.ex_cn: 他因科学项目赢得了许多奖项。
words.en: Prizes or other forms of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.tr: adj. 有辨别力的；能洞悉的；眼光敏锐的； v. “discern”的现在分词；
words.ex: She is a discerning shopper who always finds the best quality.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有辨别力的购物者，总是能找到最好的质量。
words.en: If you describe someone as discerning, you mean that they are able to judge which things of a particular kind are good and which are bad.

words.ex: The traveller visited five countries last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者去年夏天访问了五个国家。
words.en: A traveller is a person who is travelling or who often travels.

words.tr: adj. 群体的；社区的；公有的；
words.ex: They share a communal kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们共用一个群体厨房。
words.en: Communal means relating to or shared by all the members of a community.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.ex: The hovercraft moves quickly over water.
words.ex_cn: 气垫船在水面上快速移动。
words.en: A hovercraft is a vehicle that travels quickly over land or water by floating on a cushion of air that it creates.

words.ex: The hovercrafts move fast over water.
words.ex_cn: 气垫船在水面上快速移动。
words.en: A hovercraft is a vehicle that can travel over land and water. It floats above the surface it is traveling over on a cushion of air.

words.ex: The bird hovers above the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在花上空盘旋。
words.en: To remain in one place in the air, or to stay close to someone or something.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: The water contains sulphate from the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 水中含有来自岩石的硫酸盐。
words.en: A sulphate is a salt or ester of sulphuric acid, containing the anion SO₄²⁻ or the divalent group —OSO₂O—.

words.tr:
adj. 半开的；微启的
adv. 微开地；半开地
words.ex: The door was ajar so I pushed it open.
words.ex_cn: 门半开着，所以我推开了它。
words.en: If a door is ajar, it is slightly open.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.ex: She picked up a thread from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她从布料上捡起一根线。
words.en: A thread is a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving. It can also refer to a theme or idea that connects parts of a story or discussion.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: The two companies will merge next year.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司明年将合并。
words.en: To combine or unite to form a single entity.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.tr:
n. 大头针；
v. 固定；
words.ex: She stuck a pin on the map.
words.ex_cn: 她在地图上别了一枚大头针。
words.en: A pin is a small piece of metal with a sharp point at one end and a round head at the other, used especially for fastening pieces of cloth together.

words.ex: She picked up a needle to sew the button.
words.ex_cn: 她拿起一根针来缝纽扣。
words.en: A needle is a thin, pointed piece of metal that is used in sewing. It has a hole at one end for thread to pass through.

words.ex: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
words.en: A bolt is a type of fastener consisting of a threaded pin or rod with a head at one end, designed to be inserted through holes in assembled parts and tightened by a nut from the other end. It can also refer to a sudden dash or run, or to eat food quickly and without chewing.

words.ex: The guitar amplifier makes the sound louder.
words.ex_cn: 吉他放大器让声音变大。
words.en: An amplifier is an electronic device that increases the strength of electrical signals, especially sound signals.

words.ex: He wore a decent shirt to the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件像样的衬衫去面试。
words.en: Decent is used to describe something which is considered to be of an acceptable standard or quality.

words.ex: His babyish laugh made everyone smile.
words.ex_cn: 他稚气的笑声让每个人都笑了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as babyish, you mean that it is silly or childish.

words.tr:
n. 颜料；染料；色素；（显示健康好坏的）脸色
v. 着色；“color”的现在分词
words.ex: The coloring for the painting came from natural plants.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜料来自天然植物。
words.en: The act or process of applying color.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.ex: The fall was injuring his leg.
words.ex_cn: 这次跌倒正在伤害他的腿。
words.en: To injure someone means to cause them physical harm, for example, in an accident or attack.

words.tr: v. 杀死；“kill”的现在分词； n. 杀人； adj. 致命的；
words.ex: The lion was killing a deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只狮子正在杀死一只鹿。
words.en: The act of causing death, especially deliberately; or something that causes death or is very difficult to endure.

words.ex: This box is the heaviest of all.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子是所有箱子里最重的。
words.en: Superlative form of heavy; having the most weight.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.ex: The cartilage in his knee hurts when he runs.
words.ex_cn: 他的膝盖软骨在跑步时会疼。
words.en: Cartilage is a strong, flexible connective tissue found in various parts of the body, including the joints, the rib cage, the ear, the nose, the bronchial tubes, and the intervertebral discs. It is not as hard and rigid as bone, but it is stiffer and less flexible than muscle.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上游泳。
words.en: To move through water by moving the body or parts of the body.

words.ex: The doctor checked his skins for rashes.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的皮肤是否有皮疹。
words.en: The natural outer layer of a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: He said it with a smile, but his words had barbs.
words.ex_cn: 他说这话时带着微笑，但话语中带有讽刺。
words.en: Sharp projections or points, especially those on a fishhook or arrow, designed to prevent easy removal; also refers to a pointed, often hurtful remark.

words.ex: He used sandpaper to smooth the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用砂纸打磨木头。
words.en: Sandpaper is strong paper that has a layer of sand glued to it, used for rubbing surfaces in order to make them smoother.

words.ex: The shark uses its fins to swim quickly.
words.ex_cn: 鲨鱼用它的鳍快速游泳。
words.en: Plural form of fin, which refers to a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balance.

words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

words.ex: He spends his days scavenging for cans to sell.
words.ex_cn: 他整天捡瓶子卖钱。
words.en: The act of searching for and collecting discarded items or food.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.tr: v. 举起，抬起( lift的过去式和过去分词 )；提高；解除（封锁、包围等）；
words.ex: He lifted the box easily.
words.ex_cn: 他轻松地举起了箱子。
words.en: To move something or someone upwards or to a higher position.

words.tr: adj. 大都市的；大城市的；
words.ex: He lives in a metropolitan city like New York.
words.ex_cn: 他住在纽约这样的大都市。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a metropolis or large city, especially as the main city of a country or region.

words.tr: adj. 网状的； n. “mesh”的过去式；
words.ex: The meshed wire fence keeps animals out.
words.ex_cn: 网状的铁丝网把动物挡在外面。
words.en: 1. (of a material or fabric) resembling a net in appearance or construction. 2. (of two or more things) fitting together or interlocking well.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.ex: Driving alone is uneconomical because of high fuel costs.
words.ex_cn: 独自开车因为燃油费用高而不经济。
words.en: If you say that something is uneconomical, you mean that it does not make a profit or that it is not efficient in its use of resources.

words.ex: This is the warmest coat I have ever worn.
words.ex_cn: 这是我穿过的最暖和的外套。
words.en: superlative form of warm: having the highest temperature or being the most affectionate or friendly

words.ex: The fisherman showed his catches from the morning trip.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫展示了他早晨捕获的渔获物。
words.en: To catch means to capture or seize something after a chase or search.

words.ex: The cat sleeps on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发上睡觉。
words.en: A cat is a small furry animal with a tail, whiskers, and sharp claws. Cats are often kept as pets.

words.tr: v. 滚动；“roll”的现在分词； n. 横摇； adj. 起伏的；转动的；摇摆的；
words.ex: The ball is rolling down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 球正在滚下山坡。
words.en: Moving by turning over and over on an axis.

words.tr: n. 长途汽车的全体乘客
words.ex: A coachload of students went to the museum.
words.ex_cn: 一整车学生去了博物馆。
words.en: A coachload refers to the number of passengers that a coach (a large vehicle designed to carry passengers) can carry.

words.tr: n. 看见； v. “sight”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sighting of a rare bird excited the birdwatchers.
words.ex_cn: 看到一只稀有鸟类让观鸟者兴奋不已。
words.en: The act of seeing or noticing someone or something, especially something unusual or unexpected.

words.ex: There were many cancellations of flights yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天有很多航班被取消。
words.en: The act of deciding that something that was officially planned will not happen.

words.ex: He took a provisional job until he found a better one.
words.ex_cn: 他在找到更好的工作之前做了一份临时工作。
words.en: Something that is provisional is temporary and likely to be changed or replaced in the future.

words.ex: He writes with a black pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支黑色钢笔写字。
words.en: A pen is a tool used for writing or drawing with ink.

words.ex: They danced the tango at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他们在聚会上跳了探戈舞。
words.en: A ballroom dance of Latin American origin in 2/4 or 4/4 time with a basic pattern of step-step-step-step-close and characterized by long pauses and stylized body positions.

words.ex: He wisely saved money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他明智地为将来存钱。
words.en: In a way that shows good judgment or the benefit of experience.

words.ex: He has a slight cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有点轻微的感冒。
words.en: A slight change, difference, or action is not very great or important.

words.ex: The car stopped quickly when he pressed the brakes.
words.ex_cn: 当他踩下刹车时，车很快就停了。
words.en: Brakes are devices in a vehicle that make it go slower or stop.

words.ex: The teacher gave a satisfactory grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个令人满意的分数。
words.en: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough or acceptable.

words.ex: The newborn baby slept quietly in its mother's arms.
words.ex_cn: 新生的婴儿安静地躺在母亲的怀里。
words.en: A newborn baby or animal has recently been born.

words.tr: v. 用标签标明；“label”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The box is labeled 'Fragile'.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子上贴着‘易碎’的标签。
words.en: Marked or tagged with a label.

words.ex: Click the dropdown to choose your favorite color.
words.ex_cn: 点击下拉菜单选择你最喜欢的颜色。
words.en: A dropdown is a list of options that appears below a button or other control when it is clicked or hovered over.

words.tr: n. 否定的观点；底片；“negative”的复数；
words.ex: He only sees the negatives in every situation.
words.ex_cn: 他总是看到每件事的负面观点。
words.en: Negatives refer to statements or situations that express denial, disagreement, or refusal, or to the opposite of something considered positive.

words.ex: He made a niggle about the coffee being too hot.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨咖啡太烫了。
words.en: To niggle means to worry about or pay too much attention to small or unimportant details, or to cause someone to do this.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.ex: The company will discontinue the old model.
words.ex_cn: 公司将会停止生产这款旧型号。
words.en: If you discontinue something that you have been doing regularly, you stop doing it.

words.ex: The soft chair gives me comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把软椅子给我带来舒服。
words.en: If you comfort someone, you make them feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them.

words.ex: The store is open 24 hours for your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 商店24小时营业，以方便您。
words.en: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.

words.tr: v. 生锈；“rust”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The old bike rusted in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那辆旧自行车在雨中生锈了。
words.en: Covered with rust; corroded.

words.tr: adj. 弯曲的； v. 弯曲；使弯曲；“bend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bent pipe leaked water.
words.ex_cn: 弯曲的管道漏水了。
words.en: Bent is used to describe something that is not straight but has a curve or angle in it. It can also refer to someone's natural talent or inclination towards a particular activity or subject.

words.ex: He is edging the garden with stones.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用石头给花园加边。
words.en: A border or edge, especially one that is decorative or serves to protect or define.

words.ex: The university sent me the prospectus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 大学给我寄了这门课程的简章。
words.en: A prospectus is a formal document that describes a new project, business, or product, especially one that is offered for sale or investment.

words.ex: He decided to quit smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年决定戒烟。
words.en: If you quit, or quit something, you stop doing it or leave it.

words.ex: He finished his coursework last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了他的课程作业。
words.en: Coursework refers to the work that students do during a course of study, which is often assessed as part of their final grade.

words.tr: adj. 引起疲劳的；累人的； v. “tire”的现在分词；
words.ex: The long walk was tiring.
words.ex_cn: 这次长时间的散步让人感到疲惫。
words.en: If you describe something as tiring, you mean that it makes you tired so that you want to rest or sleep.

words.ex: He made pretensions that he was too busy to help.
words.ex_cn: 他借口太忙了，无法帮忙。
words.en: If you say that someone has pretensions, you mean that they claim or pretend to have a particular quality, status, or ability, often without justification.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.ex: He bought a gift for his spouse.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的配偶买了一份礼物。
words.en: A spouse is a person's partner in marriage.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.tr: adj. 离婚的； v. “divorce”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a divorced father with two children.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有兩個孩子的離婚父親。
words.en: If someone is divorced, they are no longer married because their marriage has been legally ended.

words.ex: He studied hard, thus he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。
words.en: You use thus to show that what you are about to mention is the result or consequence of something else that you have just mentioned.

words.tr: n. 二十几岁；一生中20至29岁的十年；
words.ex: He traveled across Europe in his twenties.
words.ex_cn: 他在二十几岁时游历了欧洲。
words.en: The period of life between 20 and 29 years of age; the years from 1920 to 1929.

words.ex: Many old people rely on their pensions to live.
words.ex_cn: 许多老人依靠他们的退休金生活。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money paid regularly by the government or a private company to a person who does not work any more because they are old or have become ill.

words.ex: He made many investments in stocks.
words.ex_cn: 他做了很多股票投资。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest, or the thing that you invest it in.

words.ex: The students asked their advisors for help with their projects.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向他们的顾问寻求项目帮助。
words.en: Advisors are people who give advice, especially someone whose job is to give advice on a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 文件；公文；文献；“document”的复数；
words.ex: He filed all the documents in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有文件都放在抽屉里了。
words.en: Documents are written, drawn, or printed materials that provide information or evidence.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.tr: v. 借；借来；“borrow”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He borrowed a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 他从图书馆借了一本书。
words.en: Something that is borrowed is taken or received from someone else with the intention of returning it or its equivalent.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: He is telephoning his mother now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在给妈妈打电话。
words.en: The act of making a telephone call.

words.ex: He accepted a nominal fee for the service.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项服务收取了微不足道的费用。
words.en: If you say that something is nominal, you mean that it is very small in comparison to the real value or importance of something.

words.ex: He graduated in 2020, and thereafter he moved to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他2020年毕业，之后搬到了纽约。
words.en: After a particular event or time.

words.ex: It is advisable to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是明智的。
words.en: If something is advisable, it will avoid problems if you do it.

words.ex: The nationals living abroad sent money to their families back home.
words.ex_cn: 生活在国外的侨民给家里的亲人寄钱。
words.en: Nationals refers to the citizens of a particular country or the competitors in a national championship.

words.ex: He is emailing his teacher about the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在给老师发邮件询问作业。
words.en: The act of sending messages or documents electronically via the internet.

words.tr: v. 出口；出口，输出( export的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They are exporting rice to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在向其他国家出口大米。
words.en: The act of sending goods or services to another country for sale.

words.ex: The carpenters built a wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 木匠们做了一张木桌。
words.en: A carpenter is a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The poorest children need more help with food and school.
words.ex_cn: 最贫困的孩子需要更多的食物和教育帮助。
words.en: The superlative form of 'poor', meaning having the least amount of money or resources among a group, or being of the lowest quality.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；“operate”的现在分词； adj. 运行的；
words.ex: The machine is operating smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转得很顺畅。
words.en: Operating refers to the action of functioning or working, especially in a business or medical context.

words.tr: v. 使能够，提供做…的权利[措施]；使可； adj. 激活的 v. 使能够，提供做…的权利[措施]( enable的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The new app enabled her to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 这个新应用程序使她能够在家工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.ex: The shop sold the clothes on consignment.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店以委托方式销售这些衣服。
words.en: A consignment is a quantity of goods that are sent somewhere, especially in order to be sold.

words.tr: v. 拍摄（电影）；“film”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They filmed the movie in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他们在纽约拍摄了这部电影。
words.en: To record something on film or video.

words.ex: He edits the school newspaper every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周编辑校报。
words.en: To prepare written material for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying it.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.tr: v. 合作；协作；“cooperate”的现在分词；
words.ex: They are cooperating to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在合作完成这个项目。
words.en: To work or act together toward a common end or purpose.

words.ex: He is compromising his values for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他为了这份工作而妥协自己的原则。
words.en: If you describe information or a situation as compromising, you mean that it reveals an embarrassing or guilty secret about someone.

words.ex: The editing of the book took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的编辑花了三个月。
words.en: The process of revising and preparing a written, recorded, or filmed material for publication or presentation.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.ex: The island is uninhabited.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛没有人居住。
words.en: If a place is uninhabited, no people live there.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.ex: The hikers got lost in the wilderness.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者在荒野中迷路了。
words.en: A wilderness is a wild and uncultivated region, as of forest or desert, uninhabited or inhabited only by wild animals.

words.ex: The weather in that region goes from extremes of heat to extremes of cold.
words.ex_cn: 那个地区的天气从酷热到严寒，变化极端。
words.en: Extremes are the furthest or highest degree of something, often used to describe situations or conditions that are at the very limit of what is possible or acceptable.

words.ex: The windiest day of the year was last Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 一年中最刮风的一天是上周二。
words.en: Having the most wind; most exposed to strong winds.

words.ex: The snowfall last night was heavy.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚的降雪量很大。
words.en: Snowfall is the amount of snow that falls in a particular place during a particular period.

words.ex: Technically, the phone works, but it's slow.
words.ex_cn: 技术上讲，这部手机能用，但很慢。
words.en: In a way that relates to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry.

words.ex: He ran unbelievably fast in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中跑得不可思议地快。
words.en: In a manner that is hard to believe; extremely.

words.ex: Icebergs float in the cold ocean.
words.ex_cn: 冰山漂浮在寒冷的海洋中。
words.en: Large floating masses of ice detached from a glacier or ice sheet and carried out to sea.

words.ex: The lake freezes in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天湖面会结冰。
words.en: If a liquid or a substance containing a liquid freezes, or if something freezes it, it becomes solid because of low temperatures.

words.tr: v. 使加倍；折叠； n. 双打；复制品（double 的复数）；
words.ex: The company doubles its profits every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年使利润翻倍。
words.en: Doubles refers to a game or match in which two players compete against two others, especially in tennis, badminton, or table tennis. It can also refer to a dance performed by two people together.

words.tr: adj. 综合的；整合的；融合的； v. 整合；结合；“integrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school offers an integrated science course.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校提供一门综合科学课程。
words.en: An integrated system or approach combines different groups or ideas in a way that works well.

words.tr: v. 生成；（通过物理或化学过程）发生；
words.ex: The machine generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器发电。
words.en: Creates or produces something, especially as a result of a process or action.

words.ex: He communicates with his friends every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都和朋友交流。
words.en: To share or exchange information, news, or ideas with someone.

words.ex: The children pull sledges down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们拉着雪橇从积雪的山坡上滑下。
words.en: A sledge is a vehicle on runners for conveying loads or passengers over snow or ice, either pushed or pulled, or drawn by horses, dogs, or a motor vehicle.

words.tr: abbr. 不间断电源（Uninterrupted Power Supply）；
words.ex: The computer stayed on during the power outage thanks to the ups.
words.ex_cn: 由于不间断电源，电脑在停电时仍然正常运行。
words.en: An upward movement or increase.

words.tr: adj. 可展开的；可延伸的；可延展的；
words.ex: This table is extendable, so it can fit more people.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是可展开的，因此可以容纳更多人。
words.en: Capable of being extended or stretched out.

words.ex: This apple has 95 kilocalories.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果有95千卡。
words.en: A kilocalorie is a unit of energy of 1,000 calories, especially as a measure of the energy value of foods.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The book has a compact design.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的设计很紧凑。
words.en: A compact object or substance is small and dense, with all its parts closely packed together.

words.ex: The park preserves wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护野生动物。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state, or to prepare food for long-term storage by canning, drying, or other methods.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He wears ultra sunglasses to protect his eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他戴超深色太阳镜来保护眼睛。
words.en: An ultra is someone who has extreme political or religious views, or who takes an extreme position on a particular issue.

words.ex: She picked a violet from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵紫罗兰。
words.en: A violet is a small plant that has purple or white flowers in the spring.

words.ex: The children laugh as they see bubbles in the water.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到水里的泡泡时笑了。
words.en: A bubble is a thin ball of liquid enclosing air or another gas.

words.ex: The planet has thick atmospheres that trap heat.
words.ex_cn: 这颗行星有浓厚的大气层，能锁住热量。
words.en: The layers of gases surrounding a planet or the mood or feeling of a particular place.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.tr: v. 驱使；驾驶；“drive”的过去分词； adj. 发愤图强的；
words.ex: Fear of failure drove him to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 对失败的恐惧驱使他更加努力工作。
words.en: If you describe someone as driven, you mean they are very strongly motivated to achieve something or to do something.

words.ex: The bike gears help you ride faster on hills.
words.ex_cn: 自行车的传动装置帮助你在上坡时骑得更快。
words.en: Gears are wheels with teeth around the edge that mesh together to transmit power in machinery.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.tr: n. 布鲁斯音乐；蓝色；“blue”的复数；
words.ex: He plays the blues on his guitar every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用吉他演奏布鲁斯音乐。
words.en: A type of slow, sad music, originally from the southern US, in which the singer typically sings about their difficult life or bad luck in love.

words.ex: The bank did a valuation of the house.
words.ex_cn: 银行对这所房子进行了评估。
words.en: The process of estimating or determining the value of something, often used in finance and real estate to assess the worth of assets, companies, or properties.

words.ex: The metallic spoon felt cold in her hand.
words.ex_cn: 金属勺子在她手中感觉很冷。
words.en: Metallic means relating to or resembling metal or metals.

words.ex: He showed great capability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题上展现了很强的能力。
words.en: The ability or qualities necessary to do something.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: He likes sciences like biology and chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物和化学等科学。
words.en: The systematic study of the structure and behavior of the physical and natural world through observation and experiment.

words.tr:
n. 一小口；
v. 呷；啜；小口喝；
words.ex: He took a sip of water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一小口水。
words.en: To drink something slowly by taking small amounts into your mouth.

words.ex: He received a confirmation email for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了航班的确认邮件。
words.en: Confirmation is the act of confirming something or making it more definite.

words.ex: He sent the letter by postal service.
words.ex_cn: 他通过邮政服务寄了这封信。
words.en: Relating to the system for sending letters and parcels from one place to another.

words.ex: Mom reassured me that everything would be fine.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈让我安心，一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you reassure someone, you comfort them and stop them from worrying.

words.tr: v. 设计；发明；想出；想出( devise的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He devised a simple plan to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一个简单的计划来解决问题。
words.en: If you devise a plan, system, or machine, you have the idea for it and design it.

words.tr: v. 保持联络；做联系人；
words.ex: The manager liaises with the suppliers every week.
words.ex_cn: 经理每周与供应商保持联络。
words.en: To liaise means to act as a link to assist communication and cooperation between people or groups, especially in a professional context.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.tr: v. 表达；表示；“express”的的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He expressed his feelings clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地表达了感受。
words.en: If you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you show what you think or feel.

words.tr: v. 触摸；接触；触动；“touch”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He touched the warm cup with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手摸了摸温热的杯子。
words.en: If you are touched by something, it affects you emotionally, often making you feel grateful or sympathetic.

words.ex: The allocation of funds is decided by the committee.
words.ex_cn: 资金的分配由委员会决定。
words.en: An allocation is an amount of something, especially money, that is given to a particular person or used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: His score exceeds the passing limit.
words.ex_cn: 他的分数超过了及格线。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.tr: v. 伴随；陪伴；陪同；“accompany”的现在分词； adj. 伴随的；陪伴的；附随的；
words.ex: The music was accompanying her dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随着她的舞蹈。
words.en: If something is accompanying another thing, it is present or occurs with it.

words.tr: v. 猛地咬住；猛地咬住（ snap的过去式和过去分词 ）；
words.ex: The dog snapped at the mailman's leg.
words.ex_cn: 狗猛地咬住了邮递员的腿。
words.en: Broke suddenly and completely, often with a sharp sound; lost control of one's temper or emotions suddenly and violently.

words.ex: My parents give me a weekly allowance.
words.ex_cn: 我父母每周给我零用钱。
words.en: An allowance is money that is given regularly, usually to a child, by their parents, or by the government to someone who is unemployed or ill.

words.tr: adj. 震惊的；震撼的； v. “shock”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was shocked when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他感到震惊。
words.en: If you are shocked by something, you feel very surprised and upset because of it.

words.ex: The forest is a virgin land, untouched by humans.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是未开发的土地，从未被人类触及过。
words.en: A virgin is someone who has never had sexual intercourse. It can also describe something that is in its original pure or natural condition and has not been touched or changed by people.

words.ex: The city uses incineration to dispose of waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市使用焚烧来处理垃圾。
words.en: The act of burning something completely; reducing it to ashes.

words.ex: The survey asked householder about their energy use.
words.ex_cn: 这项调查询问了户主他们的能源使用情况。
words.en: A householder is a person who owns or rents a house; the head of a household.

words.ex: He is baling hay in the field.
words.ex_cn: 他正在田里打包干草。
words.en: The process of making large bundles or packages of materials, especially agricultural products like hay or cotton, for storage or transport.

words.tr: v. （使某物[人]）坚韧；（使某物[人]）坚韧，坚强，强硬( toughen的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The glass was toughened to resist breaking.
words.ex_cn: 这种玻璃经过强化以防止破碎。
words.en: Made or become stronger or more resilient.

words.tr: v. 再用；重新使用； n. 再生的 v. 再用，重新使用( reuse的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The bottles were reused to save money.
words.ex_cn: 这些瓶子被再利用以节省金钱。
words.en: To use something again after it has been used before.

words.ex: The water goes through filtration to remove dirt.
words.ex_cn: 水经过过滤以去除杂质。
words.en: The process of passing a liquid through a filter to remove solid particles or other impurities.

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.ex: The air conditioner keeps the room cool.
words.ex_cn: 空调使房间保持凉爽。
words.en: A conditioner is a substance that you put on your hair after you have washed it to make it softer.

words.ex: He recycles plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: The car's bumpers were damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的保险杠在事故中损坏了。
words.en: Bumpers are bars at the front and back of a vehicle that reduce damage if the vehicle hits something.

words.ex: He bought a soda from the vending machine.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动售货机买了一瓶苏打水。
words.en: The act of selling goods, especially through a vending machine.

words.tr: n. 整形外科；外科修补术；“plastic”的复数；
words.ex: He went to the hospital for plastics after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他去医院做了整形外科手术。
words.en: Plastics are materials which are produced from oil by a chemical process and which are used to make many objects. They are light in weight and do not break easily.

words.ex: The cup is made of polystyrene.
words.ex_cn: 这个杯子是用聚苯乙烯制成的。
words.en: Polystyrene is a synthetic aromatic hydrocarbon polymer made from the monomer styrene. Polystyrene can be solid or foamed. General-purpose polystyrene is clear, hard, and brittle. It is a very inexpensive resin per unit weight.

words.ex: He bought a poly of apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一堆苹果。
words.en: A prefix meaning many or much, used in the formation of compound words.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.ex: The juniors played basketball after school.
words.ex_cn: 年少者们放学后打篮球。
words.en: Juniors refers to individuals who are younger or of a lower rank or position, often used in educational contexts to denote students in their third year of study or in workplaces to refer to employees with less experience or lower status.

words.ex: The seniors gave us advice about how to succeed in school.
words.ex_cn: 前辈们给了我们关于如何在学校取得成功的建议。
words.en: Seniors are people who are older or of a higher rank than others in a particular group or organization.

words.ex: The treasurer keeps the club's money safe.
words.ex_cn: 司库保管俱乐部的钱。
words.en: A treasurer is an official who is responsible for the money and accounts of an organization.

words.ex: He tightened his grips on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住了把手。
words.en: The act of holding something tightly or the ability to understand something.

words.tr: v. 停顿；“stall”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The car stalled at the traffic light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红绿灯处停顿了。
words.en: If a process or system stalls, or if someone or something stalls it, it stops making progress.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.ex: The statue was colossal, taller than the building.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像巨大，比大楼还高。
words.en: If you describe something as colossal, you are emphasizing that it is very large.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.tr:
v. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；抨击；达到；
n. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；(演出等)成功；
words.ex: He hit the ball with a bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒打了球。
words.en: If you hit someone or something, you deliberately touch them with a lot of force, with your hand or an object held in your hand.

words.ex: He is accepting of different opinions.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意接受不同的意见。
words.en: Willing to accept or tolerate something, especially something that is not ideal.

words.ex: The weather is favourable for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐有利。
words.en: If your opinion or your reaction is favourable to something, you agree with it and approve of it.

words.tr: adj. 勇敢的； n. 明显的( bold的比较级 )；
words.ex: He made a bolder decision to speak up.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了更勇敢的决定，勇敢地说出了自己的想法。
words.en: Comparative form of 'bold', meaning more willing to take risks or more confident in facing challenges.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.ex: Please shut the door.
words.ex_cn: 请关上门。
words.en: To shut something means to move it so that it fills an opening or to move it so that it is no longer open.

words.ex: Telecommunications connect people across the world.
words.ex_cn: 电信连接了全世界的人们。
words.en: Telecommunications is the technology of sending signals and messages over long distances using electronic means, such as radio, telephone, television, and the internet.

words.tr: adj. 固有的；内在的；本身的；
words.ex: Honesty is an intrinsic part of her character.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是她性格中固有的部分。
words.en: belonging to a thing by its very nature

words.tr: adj. 预先决定的； v. “forego”的过去分词；
words.ex: The outcome was foregone, as the winner was chosen before the contest.
words.ex_cn: 结果是预先决定的，因为获胜者在比赛前就已经选好了。
words.en: If you say that something is foregone, you mean that it is obvious that it will happen or be true.

words.tr: adv. 就本人而言；亲自地；
words.ex: Personally, I like tea more than coffee.
words.ex_cn: 就本人而言，我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do something personally, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it. You can also use personally to show that you are talking about your own opinion or experience.

words.ex: The loud noise muddles my thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让我的思绪混乱。
words.en: To confuse or mix up, especially by making something unclear or disordered.

words.ex: He permanently moved to Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年永久搬到了加拿大。
words.en: In a way that continues or lasts forever without changing.

words.ex: It is debatable whether he is the best player.
words.ex_cn: 他是不是最好的球员是有争议的。
words.en: If you say that something is debatable, you mean that it is not certain whether it is true or right.

words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来省钱。
words.en: To save means to keep something, especially money or time, for use in the future, or to prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.

words.tr: v. 更新；“update”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 最新的；更新的；
words.ex: He updated his phone software yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天更新了手机软件。
words.en: Made more modern or up to date.

words.ex: The manager oversees the team's daily work.
words.ex_cn: 经理监督团队的日常工作。
words.en: To oversee means to watch and direct a piece of work, the people doing it, or the way it is done in order to ensure that it is done correctly.

words.ex: The induction of the new mayor will be held next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新市长的就职典礼将在下周一举行。
words.en: Induction is the process or action of inducting someone to a position or organization, or the process of reasoning from specific cases to general rules.

words.ex: Undergraduates are learning basic math this semester.
words.ex_cn: 本科生这学期正在学习基础数学。
words.en: Undergraduates are students at a university or college who are studying for their first degree.

words.ex: He organized all his files on the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他把电脑上的所有文件都整理好了。
words.en: n. A file is a box or a folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. v. If you file a document, you put it in the correct file. If you file a formal or legal accusation, complaint, or request, you make it officially.

words.ex: At the outset, he was unsure about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 在开始时，他对这个计划并不确定。
words.en: The outset of something is the beginning of it.

words.ex: He read the first three chapters of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的前三章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.
