words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr: n. 代理；副职；恶习；缺点；
words.ex: He acted as vice for the manager during her absence.
words.ex_cn: 在经理缺席期间，他担任代理。
words.en: A vice is a moral fault or weakness in someone's character.

words.ex: It's the other way versa.
words.ex_cn: 这是相反的。
words.en: The opposite side or counterpart of something.

words.ex: He loves boxing and trains every day.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢拳击运动，每天训练。
words.en: Boxing is a sport in which two people fight each other using their fists, usually while wearing padded gloves.

words.tr: adj. 被许可的； v. “license”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a licensed doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有执照的医生。
words.en: Officially permitted or authorized to do something.

words.ex: He pays a monthly subscription for the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付杂志的订阅费。
words.en: A subscription is an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a service or magazine, or to belong to or support an organization.

words.tr: v. 再开；重新开始( reopen的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The park is reopening next week.
words.ex_cn: 公园下周重新开放。
words.en: The act of opening something again, especially after it has been closed for a period of time.

words.ex: He reoriented his career toward teaching.
words.ex_cn: 他将职业方向重新确定为教学。
words.en: To change the focus or direction of something.

words.ex: The room was stuffy and hard to breathe in.
words.ex_cn: 房间闷热得让人难以呼吸。
words.en: If you describe a place as stuffy, you mean that it is unpleasantly warm and has no fresh air.

words.tr: n. 用户，使用者；用户，使用者( user的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The app has many active users.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有许多活跃用户。
words.en: A user is a person or thing that uses something such as a service, machine, or product.

words.ex: The room is airy with windows on all sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间四面都有窗户，通风很好。
words.en: If a place or room is airy, it has a lot of fresh air because it is large or has a lot of windows.

words.ex: The park reopens next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 公园下周一重新开放。
words.en: If a place or business reopens or is reopened, it becomes open to the public again after being closed for a period of time.

words.tr: vi. 做实验，进行试验（experiment的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is experimenting with new recipes.
words.ex_cn: 他正在尝试新的食谱。
words.en: The act of conducting experiments or trials, especially in order to discover something unknown or to test a hypothesis.

words.ex: He sent the document by fax.
words.ex_cn: 他通过传真发送了文件。
words.en: A fax is a machine that sends and receives documents electronically along a telephone line, or a document that is sent or received using such a machine.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: He still listens to old cassettes.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然听旧磁带。
words.en: A cassette is a small flat case containing a very long strip of magnetic material that is used to record sound or pictures. Cassettes are played on a cassette player or recorder.

words.ex: He forgot his password and could not log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码，无法登录。
words.en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place or to use a computer system.

words.ex: The teacher gave each student a manual for the science lab.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每位学生发了一本科学实验室的手册。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.tr: n. 笔记本电脑；“laptop”的复数；
words.ex: Students use laptops to take notes in class.
words.ex_cn: 学生用笔记本电脑在课堂上做笔记。
words.en: A laptop is a small, portable computer that you can use on your lap.

words.ex: The team consisted of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: To be composed or made up of something.

words.ex: The history book describes ancient invasions by nomadic tribes.
words.ex_cn: 这本历史书描述了古代游牧民族的入侵。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.ex: The tribes live in the forest far from cities.
words.ex_cn: 这些部落生活在远离城市的森林里。
words.en: A tribe is a social group consisting of people of the same race or nationality who share the same customs, traditions, and language.

words.ex: He loves eating foreign food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么外国食物。
words.en: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own

words.tr:
n. 第十一；
adj. 十一分之一的；
words.ex: He finished in the eleventh place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第十一名。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number 11 in a series.

words.ex: The city became prosperous after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市变得繁荣了。
words.en: A prosperous person, place, or economy is rich and successful.

words.ex: The newcomers are learning the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 新来的人正在学习学校的规则。
words.en: Newcomers are people who have recently arrived in a place or started an activity.

words.ex: The merchants sell fruit at the market.
words.ex_cn: 商人们在市场卖水果。
words.en: Merchants are people who buy and sell goods, especially in large amounts.

words.ex: The lenders gave money to the small business.
words.ex_cn: 出借人把钱借给了这家小企业。
words.en: Lenders are individuals or institutions that provide funds to borrowers with the expectation that the funds will be repaid, often with interest.

words.tr: adv. 跟经济有关地；经济地；
words.ex: The country is developing economically.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在经济上发展。
words.en: In a way that relates to economics or finance; in a way that uses no more of something than is necessary.

words.ex: There is a shortage of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的清洁用水不足。
words.en: A shortage is a situation in which there is not enough of something that is needed.

words.ex: The birds live in the marshland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟住在河边的沼泽地里。
words.en: Marshland refers to an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.tr: v. 排水；“drain”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boys drained the water from the pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把池子里的水排干了。
words.en: If someone is drained, they are extremely tired and have no energy left.

words.ex: The kitchen must be sanitary to prevent illness.
words.ex_cn: 厨房必须保持清洁以防止疾病。
words.en: relating to the conditions that affect hygiene and health, especially the supply of sewage facilities and clean drinking water

words.ex: The needy family received food from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫穷的家庭从慈善机构收到了食物。
words.en: Needy people do not have enough food, medicine, or clothing, or adequate houses.

words.ex: The housed chip works better in dusty environments.
words.ex_cn: 这个封装的芯片在多尘的环境中表现更好。
words.en: If someone is housed, they are provided with a place to live.

words.ex: The landlords raised the rent last month.
words.ex_cn: 房东上个月提高了租金。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns and rents land such as a house, apartment, or condo.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.ex: My aunts visited me last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的阿姨们上周末来看我了。
words.en: The sister of one's father or mother; the wife of one's uncle.

words.ex: My uncles come to visit every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔叔们每个星期天都来拜访。
words.en: The brother of one's father or mother or the husband of one's aunt.

words.tr: v. 陪伴；伴随；伴奏（accompany 的过去分词）； adj. 伴随的；相伴的；
words.ex: He was accompanied by his friend to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他由朋友陪伴去公园。
words.en: If you accompany someone, you go somewhere with them.

words.ex: The apple costs fifty pence.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果售价五十便士。
words.en: A small British coin and monetary unit worth one hundredth of a pound.

words.tr: v. 给…贴标签；“label”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有标签的；
words.ex: The teacher labelled the boxes with students' names.
words.ex_cn: 老师给箱子贴上了学生的名字。
words.en: Having a label or labels attached; marked with a label.

words.ex: The phone rung three times before she answered.
words.ex_cn: 电话响了三声，她才接起来。
words.en: A rung is one of the horizontal supports on a ladder for a person's foot.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: The children came home with mucky hands.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们回家时手脏兮兮的。
words.en: If something is mucky, it is dirty and messy.

words.ex: The pond has many fishes.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里有很多鱼。
words.en: Fishes are aquatic vertebrates that are typically cold-blooded, covered with scales, and equipped with two sets of paired fins and several unpaired fins.

words.ex: The explorers walked through dark caverns.
words.ex_cn: 探险者们走进了黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: Large caves or a series of connected chambers in a cave.

words.ex: The dog splashes water while drinking.
words.ex_cn: 狗喝水时溅起水花。
words.en: If a liquid splashes or if you splash a liquid, it falls on or hits something or someone in a series of small drops.

words.tr: n. 通勤者；经常往返者；
words.ex: He is a commuter who takes the train to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每天乘火车上班的通勤者。
words.en: A commuter is someone who travels a long distance to work every day.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.ex: The ships are waiting at the docks.
words.ex_cn: 船只正在码头等待。
words.en: Docks are areas of water in a port where ships are loaded, unloaded, or repaired.

words.ex: The trees surround the house.
words.ex_cn: 树木环绕着房子。
words.en: If something or someone is surrounded by something, that thing is situated all around them.

words.tr: adj. 受欢呼的；受赞誉的； v. “acclaim”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The acclaimed actor received a standing ovation.
words.ex_cn: 这位受欢呼的演员赢得了起立鼓掌。
words.en: Publicly praised; celebrated.

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.tr: v. 提出理由证明；坚决主张；争吵；争吵，辩论( argue的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is arguing that exercise improves mental health.
words.ex_cn: 他提出理由证明锻炼能改善心理健康。
words.en: Arguing: (verb) Having a heated verbal disagreement.

words.tr: v. （使马）飞奔，奔驰；（使马）飞奔，奔驰( gallop的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The boy galloped his horse across the field.
words.ex_cn: 男孩骑着马在田野上飞奔。
words.en: Moved at a fast, bounding pace, as a horse might.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.tr: v. （使马）飞奔； adj. 急性的；飞驰的，急性的 v. （使马）飞奔，奔驰( gallop的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The boy was galloping his horse across the field.
words.ex_cn: 男孩正骑着马在田野上飞奔。
words.en: Galloping is used to describe something that is moving or developing very quickly.

words.ex: The succession of rain made the ground wet.
words.ex_cn: 连续的雨水使地面变湿了。
words.en: A succession of things of the same kind is a number of them that exist or happen one after the other.

words.tr:
n. 同事；（组织的）会员；家伙；同胞；
adj. 同类的；同事的；
words.ex: He works as a fellow with Dr. Smith in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里与史密斯博士一起工作，是他的同事。
words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.ex: The old cinematograph showed black-and-white films in the town hall.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧电影放映机在市政厅播放黑白电影。
words.en: A cinematograph is an early motion picture device, used both for filming and projecting movies.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: The inventors created a new machine.
words.ex_cn: 这些发明家创造了一台新机器。
words.en: People who invent new things or processes.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reel.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕在卷筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. It can also refer to a lively Scottish or Irish dance, or to the act of staggering or lurching violently.

words.tr: v. 拍照；（使某物）发出； adv. 猛地咬住( snap的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was snapping pictures of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他正在拍日落的照片。
words.en: The act of breaking or dividing something suddenly, often with a sharp sound.

words.ex: He gave an absolute yes to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议给出了完全肯定的回答。
words.en: Absolute means complete and total, or not limited in any way.

words.ex: The cold water gave her a sudden sensation.
words.ex_cn: 冷水给了她一种突然的感觉。
words.en: A sensation is a physical feeling or a reaction of interest or excitement that something causes in a person or in a group of people.

words.ex: He had a fainting after standing too long.
words.ex_cn: 他站得太久后昏倒了。
words.en: Fainting is a temporary loss of consciousness due to a sudden drop in blood flow to the brain. It's also known as syncope.

words.ex: The policeman held a gun.
words.ex_cn: 警察拿着一把枪。
words.en: A gun is a weapon designed to discharge projectiles, often metal bullets, by the force of an explosive such as gunpowder.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.ex: The new dance became a craze among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这种新舞蹈在青少年中成为了一种狂热。
words.en: A craze is an activity, object, or idea that is extremely popular, usually for a short time.

words.ex: He likes old talkies from the 1920s.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢20世纪20年代的老有声电影。
words.en: A film with recorded dialogue and sound, as opposed to a silent film.

words.tr: n. 副标题；字幕；“subtitle”的复数；
words.ex: The movie has English subtitles.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有英文字幕。
words.en: Subtitles are words shown at the bottom of a film or television screen that translate or transcribe the dialogue or narrative.

words.ex: The dialogue in the movie was very funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影中的对白非常幽默。
words.en: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people in a book, play, or film.

words.ex: The company will compensate you for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 公司会因延误而补偿你。
words.en: If you compensate for a lack of something or for something you have done wrong, you do something to show that you are sorry or that you are trying to make things better.

words.tr: n. 背板(notum的复数); 背板（昆虫的背片）( notum的名词复数 )
words.ex: The insect's nota support its wings.
words.ex_cn: 昆虫的背板支撑着它的翅膀。
words.en: Spanish for 'note' or 'bill'; in English, used in phrases like 'nota bene' meaning 'note well'.

words.ex: He took out two loans to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他贷了两笔款来买一辆车。
words.en: Loans are sums of money that are borrowed, often from a bank, and are expected to be paid back with interest.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: He spoke without hesitation.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不犹豫地说了。
words.en: Hesitation is the act of pausing before doing something, especially because you are nervous or not certain about it.

words.tr:
adj. 年长的；
n. 长者；
words.ex: My elder brother works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我年长的哥哥是一名老师。
words.en: An elder is a person who is older than you, especially one who is respected for their wisdom and experience.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: The window has mullioned glass.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户有格子状的玻璃。
words.en: Having mullions; divided by vertical bars, as a window.

words.ex: The roofs of the houses are covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 房子的屋顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The outer covering of a building or vehicle that protects it from the weather.

words.ex: He built a wall with red bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: Bricks are rectangular blocks of baked clay used for building walls and houses.

words.ex: The smoke came out of the chimney.
words.ex_cn: 烟从烟囱里冒出来。
words.en: A chimney is a pipe through which smoke goes up into the air, usually through the roof of a building.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.ex: She ate a ripe pear for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个熟透的梨当零食。
words.en: A pear is a sweet, juicy fruit that is narrow at the top and wider at the bottom. It has a thin green or brown skin, and white flesh.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.tr: v. 徘徊；漫游；“wander”的现在分词；
words.ex: He was wandering in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you describe a person or their thoughts as wandering, you mean that the person is not concentrating on anything in particular and their thoughts are not clear.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.ex: The road is signposted with arrows.
words.ex_cn: 这条路用箭头做了指引。
words.en: Marked with signposts to guide or direct someone.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；
v. 邮寄；
words.ex: I checked my mail this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上查了邮件。
words.en: Mail refers to letters, packages, etc., that are sent or delivered by post.

words.tr:
v. 给…打钩；发出滴嗒声；
n. 钩号；
words.ex: Please tick the box if you agree.
words.ex_cn: 如果你同意，请在方框里打钩。
words.en: The word 'tick' can refer to the sound a clock makes, a very short period of time, a mark used to indicate something, or a type of small insect. As a verb, it can mean to make a ticking sound or to mark something with a tick.

words.ex: He likes to drink beer in local pubs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在当地的酒馆喝啤酒。
words.en: Pubs are places where alcoholic drinks are served and people gather to drink and socialize.

words.ex: He went to the pub after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后去了酒吧。
words.en: A pub is a building where people can have drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, and talk to their friends. Many pubs also serve food.

words.ex: We sang songs using karaoke at the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们在聚会上用卡拉OK录音唱歌。
words.en: A form of entertainment in which people sing popular songs without the original vocals, typically following the lyrics on a video screen.

words.ex: Scientists test many hypotheses to find the truth.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们测试许多假说以寻找真相。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea or explanation for something that is based on known facts but has not yet been proved.

words.ex: This plan is viable and can be done with little money.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且用很少的钱就能完成。
words.en: If something is viable, it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

words.ex: The gatherer collected wild berries from the forest.
words.ex_cn: 采集者从森林里采摘野莓。
words.en: A gatherer is someone who collects things, especially plants or food, from the wild.

words.tr: adj. 分散的；散落的； v. 散布；分散；“scatter”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The books were scattered on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 书散落在地板上。
words.en: If something is scattered, it is spread out or distributed over a wide area in an irregular way.

words.ex: The pigs are eating in the mud.
words.ex_cn: 猪正在泥里吃东西。
words.en: Pigs are domesticated mammals, known for their stout bodies, short legs, and snouts used for digging. They are raised for their meat, called pork.

words.ex: Females are more likely to study biology than physics.
words.ex_cn: 女性更有可能学习生物而不是物理。
words.en: Females are individuals of the sex that can bear offspring or produce eggs, distinguished biologically by the production of gametes (ova) that can be fertilized by male gametes.

words.ex: The beginnings of the project were very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的起点非常简单。
words.en: The early stages or initial parts of something.

words.tr: v. 超过； adj. 超过( exceed的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 他超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in number or size than something else.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.tr: v. 殖民化；开拓殖民地
words.ex: They are colonising a new island.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在殖民一个新岛屿。
words.en: To colonise means to send people to live in and govern another country or region, often establishing control over it.

words.ex: The company has many fleets of delivery trucks.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有许多车队的送货卡车。
words.en: A fleet is a group of ships, or all of the ships in a country's navy, or a group of vehicles or aircraft under the control of one company or organization.

words.ex: Farmers grow wheat in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植小麦。
words.en: Wheat is a cereal plant that is grown in temperate countries and is the most important kind grown for food.

words.ex: Farmers grow barley for animal feed.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植大麦作为动物饲料。
words.en: Barley is a cereal grain that is used as food and also in making beer and whiskey.

words.tr: adj. 植入的；嵌入的； v. 使插入；使嵌入；“embed”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The chip is embedded in the phone.
words.ex_cn: 芯片被植入手机中。
words.en: If an object is embedded in a substance or mass, it is fixed firmly and deeply in it.

words.ex: Botanists study plants in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 植物学家在森林里研究植物。
words.en: A botanist is a scientist who studies plants, including their physiology, structure, genetics, ecology, distribution, classification, and economic importance.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.ex: He learned husbandry from his father on the farm.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里学会了畜牧业。
words.en: Husbandry is the careful management of resources, especially in agriculture or farming, to ensure their efficient use and conservation.

words.ex: The town built shelters for people during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 镇上为人们在风暴期间建造了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: The workers load stone from the quarries.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从采石场装载石头。
words.en: A quarry is a place, typically a large, deep pit, from which stone or other materials are or have been extracted. It can also refer to an animal or person that is being hunted or chased.

words.tr: v. 削成碎片；“chip”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The dog chipped the ice with its teeth.
words.ex_cn: 狗用牙齿把冰削成了碎片。
words.en: Having a small piece broken off from the edge or surface.

words.tr: v. 磨碎；碾碎；“grind”的现在分词； adj. 磨的；
words.ex: He is grinding coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把咖啡豆磨成粉。
words.en: The process of wearing something down by friction or the act of crushing something into small particles.

words.ex: There is ample food for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有足够的食物。
words.en: If there is an ample amount of something, there is enough of it and usually some extra.

words.ex: The colonisers came to the land long ago.
words.ex_cn: 殖民者很久以前来到了这片土地。
words.en: Colonisers are people who establish colonies in a new country or area.

words.tr: v. 塑造；定形；使成形；“shape”的现在分词；
words.ex: Parents are shaping their children's values.
words.ex_cn: 父母正在塑造孩子的价值观。
words.en: The act of giving a particular form or shape to something.

words.ex: The workers are hollowing out the tree trunk.
words.ex_cn: 工人们正在挖空树干。
words.en: The act of making something hollow by removing its inner part.

words.ex: The thickness of the ice is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 冰的厚度很危险。
words.en: The quality or state of being thick, especially the distance between opposite surfaces of an object.

words.tr: adj. 上釉的； v. “glaze”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The glazed tile sparkled in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 上釉的瓷砖在阳光下闪闪发光。
words.en: Having a shiny or glassy surface; often used to describe eyes that appear lifeless or unfocused.

words.ex: The glass broke into fragments on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃摔在地上成了碎片。
words.en: Pieces of something that has been broken or separated from a whole.

words.ex: The doctor put in ten stitches to close the wound.
words.ex_cn: 医生缝了十针来缝合伤口。
words.en: Stitches are the pieces of thread that have been used to sew the edges of a wound together.

words.ex: The necklace is an imitation made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链是用塑料做的仿制品。
words.en: An imitation of something is a copy of it.

words.ex: The vessels sailed across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些船航行在海上。
words.en: A vessel is a ship or large boat, or a container for holding liquids, or a tube that carries blood through the body.

words.tr: n. 计算机操作；计算； v. “compute”的现在分词；
words.ex: Computing helps us solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机操作帮助我们快速解决数学问题。
words.en: Computing is the activity of using computers and writing programs for them.

words.ex: The company recruited five new employees last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月招募了五名新员工。
words.en: If you recruit people for an organization, you select them and persuade them to join it or work for it.

words.ex: The clerk is stamping the passport.
words.ex_cn: 职员正在给护照盖章。
words.en: The act of bringing down the foot forcibly and noisily on the ground or an object; also, the act of impressing a mark or design on a surface with a stamp.

words.tr: v. 为…配备职员；“staff”的现在分词；
words.ex: The hospital is staffing the new ward with experienced nurses.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院正在为新病房配备有经验的护士。
words.en: The process of providing workers for an organization or for a particular job or task.

words.tr: n. 电话亭；摊位；“booth”的复数；
words.ex: He called his friend from a phone booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个电话亭给朋友打了电话。
words.en: A booth is a small enclosed area where goods are sold or services are provided at a fair or market.

words.ex: The host showed great hospitality to the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主人对客人表现出极大的款待。
words.en: Hospitality is friendly and generous behaviour towards guests, especially by giving them food, drink, or a place to stay.

words.ex: The attendants clapped when the speaker finished.
words.ex_cn: 出席者们在演讲者结束时鼓掌。
words.en: People who are present at an event, meeting, or function, or who accompany and assist someone.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.ex: His handing of the problem was very calm.
words.ex_cn: 他处理这个问题的方法非常冷静。
words.en: The act of giving something to someone, or the way in which something is given.

words.ex: He used the sun to orient himself.
words.ex_cn: 他用太阳来确定方向。
words.en: To orient means to align or position something in relation to the points of a compass or other specified positions, or to familiarize someone with a new situation or environment.

words.ex: He was forgiven for lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因为撒谎而被原谅了。
words.en: If you forgive someone who has done something wrong, you stop being angry with them and stop blaming them.

words.ex: The Earth is a globe.
words.ex_cn: 地球是一个球体。
words.en: The globe is the world; especially used to refer to the Earth as a planet.

words.tr: adv. 明显地；引人注目地；
words.ex: He is noticeably taller than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他哥哥明显高得多。
words.en: In a way that is easily seen or noticed; clearly.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.ex: The undersides of the leaves are green.
words.ex_cn: 叶子的下侧是绿色的。
words.en: The lower or hidden surfaces of an object.

words.ex: The child was fearful of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: If you are fearful of something, you are afraid of it.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.ex: The child shows great vitality while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时充满活力。
words.en: Vitality refers to the state of being strong and active; energy.

words.ex: The children saw wild beasts in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在动物园里看到了野兽。
words.en: A beast is a large and dangerous animal, or a cruel and brutal person.

words.ex: The system has a vulnerability that hackers can exploit.
words.ex_cn: 这个系统有一个黑客可以利用的脆弱性。
words.en: The state of being exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally.

words.ex: The chickens are eating corn in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 鸡们在院子里吃玉米。
words.en: Chickens are birds which are kept on a farm for their eggs and for their meat.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自西南方向。
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.ex: The driver stopped the car at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 司机在红灯处停了车。
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle.

words.ex: This brand has an exclusive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个品牌拥有独有的设计。
words.en: Something that is exclusive is available only to particular people, and not to everyone.

words.ex: The movie got a high rating from viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影获得了观众的高评分。
words.en: A rating is a classification or ranking of someone or something based on a comparative assessment of their quality, standard, or performance.

words.tr: v. 踢； n. 极度兴奋；（毒品或酒精的）效力( kick的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He kicks the ball hard.
words.ex_cn: 他用力踢球。
words.en: To strike out with the foot or feet; to make a sudden forceful thrust with the foot.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打排球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.ex: He performed a mime on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上表演了哑剧。
words.en: A mime is a form of performance art where the performer uses gestures and movements without speech to convey a story or emotion. As a verb, to mime means to imitate or mimic actions or expressions without using words.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.ex: I am recommending this book to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我正在向我的朋友推荐这本书。
words.en: To recommend means to suggest that someone or something would be good or suitable for a particular purpose or job.

words.ex: The car is fuelled by electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以电力作为燃料。
words.en: To supply with fuel; to stimulate or increase the intensity of.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: He bought a new mop to clean the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一把新拖把来拖地。
words.en: A mop is a tool for cleaning floors, consisting of a bundle of thick strings or a sponge attached to a long handle. As a verb, to mop means to clean or soak up liquid from a surface by wiping.

words.ex: He carries water in buckets.
words.ex_cn: 他用桶提水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other materials.

words.ex: They dine at 7 every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上七点进餐。
words.en: To dine means to eat dinner.

words.ex: He values individualism in his work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中重视个人主义。
words.en: Individualism is the belief that the rights and freedom of the individual are the most important rights in a society.

words.ex: The multinational company has offices in five countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家跨国公司在五个国家设有办事处。
words.en: A multinational company or business operates in several different countries.

words.ex: He fundamentally disagrees with the policy.
words.ex_cn: 他根本上不同意这项政策。
words.en: In a basic and important way; essentially.

words.ex: He finally realize his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: If you realize that something is true, you become aware of that fact or understand it.

words.ex: We can utilize solar energy to power the house.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以利用太阳能来为房子供电。
words.en: To utilize something means to use it in a practical or effective way.

words.tr: adj. 被忽略的；被忽视的；未被重视的； v. 疏忽；忽视；不予重视；“neglect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The neglected garden was full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 被忽略的花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: If you neglect someone or something, you fail to give them the amount of attention that they need or deserve.

words.ex: He showed conformity with the group's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了小组的规定。
words.en: Conformity is the act of matching attitudes, beliefs, and behaviors to group norms or standards.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.ex: He is a solver of hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位解决难题的人。
words.en: A solver is a person or thing that solves a problem or puzzle.

words.ex: He expects his team to win.
words.ex_cn: 他期望他的团队获胜。
words.en: If you expect something, you believe that it is going to happen or you think that it should happen.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.ex: The movie was fantastically funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极其搞笑。
words.en: In a manner that is extraordinarily good or attractive; in a way that is difficult to believe.

words.ex: The child left footprints in the wet sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在湿沙地上留下了脚印。
words.en: The marks left by a person's or animal's foot on a surface.

words.ex: The scholars received money to help with their studies.
words.ex_cn: 这些奖学金获得者获得了资金以帮助他们的学习。
words.en: Scholars are people who study a subject in great detail, especially at a university or college.

words.ex: The giraffe eats leaves from tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 长颈鹿吃高树上的叶子。
words.en: A giraffe is a large African animal with a very long neck and legs and pale brown fur with dark spots. Giraffes are the tallest living land animals.

words.tr: n. 难以理解的事；古代的秘密宗教仪式（mystery 的复数）；
words.ex: The mysteries of the deep ocean still confuse scientists.
words.ex_cn: 深海的难以理解的事仍然让科学家困惑。
words.en: Mysteries are things that are not understood or known about, often because they are difficult to understand or explain.

words.tr: n. 版画； v. 在（硬物）上雕刻；“engrave”的现在分词；
words.ex: He bought an old engraving at the art market.
words.ex_cn: 他在艺术市场买了一幅古老的版画。
words.en: An engraving is a picture or design that has been cut into a surface.

words.ex: The story includes an illustration of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事包含了一个善良的例证。
words.en: An illustration is a picture or diagram that helps make something clear or attractive.

words.tr: adj. 可识别的；可辨认的；
words.ex: The stolen bike is identifiable by its red handlebar.
words.ex_cn: 这辆被盗的自行车可以通过它的红色车把识别出来。
words.en: If something or someone is identifiable, they are able to be recognized.

words.tr: v. 雕刻；“engrave”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The name was engraved on the stone.
words.ex_cn: 名字被刻在石头上。
words.en: If something is engraved, it has been cut or carved into a surface, or if an image or memory is engraved in your mind, it is firmly fixed there.

words.tr: v. 想象；假想；“imagine”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He imagined a world without war.
words.ex_cn: 他想象了一个没有战争的世界。
words.en: To form a mental image of something; to think of something as possible or likely.

words.ex: I guessed the answer was 5.
words.ex_cn: 我猜答案是5。
words.en: To form an opinion or estimate about something without sufficient evidence or knowledge.

words.tr: adj. 无意的；非故意的；无意识的；
words.ex: He made an unintentional mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他犯了一个无意的错误。
words.en: If something is unintentional, it is done without being planned or intended.

words.ex: He gave a disrespectful answer to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师说了不尊重的话。
words.en: If you are disrespectful, you show no respect in the way that you speak or behave toward someone.

words.ex: He gave her a romantic gift on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节送了她一份浪漫的礼物。
words.en: If you describe something as romantic, you mean that it is connected with love or with a feeling of excitement and mystery associated with love.

words.ex: The wood burns slowly in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 木头在火中缓慢燃烧。
words.en: If there is a fire or a flame somewhere, you say that there is a burn there. When you burn something, you destroy or damage it with fire or heat.

words.ex: The painting is priceless.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是无价的。
words.en: If you say that something is priceless, you are emphasizing that it is worth a very large amount of money, or that it is very important to you and you could not replace it.

words.ex: The explorer found an undiscovered island.
words.ex_cn: 探险家发现了一个未被发现的岛屿。
words.en: If something is undiscovered, it has not been discovered or found out.

words.ex: He enjoys photographing birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在公园里拍照鸟。
words.en: The act of taking photographs.

words.ex: He is tracing the origin of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他正在追溯问题的根源。
words.en: The act of following or marking the course or position of something, especially with one's finger, a pen, or a cursor.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.ex: His heroics saved the lives of five people.
words.ex_cn: 他勇敢果断的行为救了五个人的生命。
words.en: Actions or behavior that is bold and dramatic, often in a way that is intended to impress others.

words.ex: The factory uses ccs to reduce its carbon emissions.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用碳捕获与封存来减少碳排放。
words.en: Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) is a technology used to capture carbon dioxide emissions from sources like power plants and store it underground to prevent it from entering the atmosphere.

words.ex: The insurer paid for the car repair.
words.ex_cn: 保险公司支付了汽车修理费用。
words.en: An insurer is a company or person that provides insurance, which is a financial arrangement that provides compensation for loss, damage, illness, or death in return for payment of a specified premium.

words.tr:
v. 引用；
n. 报价；
words.ex: He quotes his favorite poet in every speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在每次演讲中都引用他最喜欢的诗人。
words.en: Quotes refer to words or phrases taken from a text or speech, or the act of repeating someone else's words. It can also mean to give someone an estimated price for a service or product.

words.tr: n. 银行业；银行业务； v. “bank”的现在分词；
words.ex: He works in banking in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事银行业。
words.en: Banking refers to the business activity of accepting and safeguarding money owned by other individuals and entities, and then lending out this money in order to earn a profit.

words.ex: The soldiers marched in a line.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们列队行进。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.tr: adj. 浅的；浅的( shallow的比较级 )；
words.ex: The water in the pond is shallower than last year.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘的水比去年浅了。
words.en: Comparative form of shallow; less deep.

words.tr: adv. 最远地；最大限度地；
words.ex: He ran the furthest of all the students.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比所有学生都远。
words.en: Furthest means at the greatest distance from a particular point or place.

words.tr: n. 保龄球； v. “bowl”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves playing bowling on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末打保龄球。
words.en: Bowling is a game in which you roll a heavy ball down a long, narrow track towards a group of wooden objects called pins, trying to knock down as many of them as possible.

words.ex: The cat ran down the alley.
words.ex_cn: 猫跑进了小巷。
words.en: An alley is a narrow passage between buildings or other structures.

words.tr: n. 拱廊；有拱廊的街道；游乐中心
words.ex: The old arcade has stone pillars and a tiled roof.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的拱廊有石柱和瓦片屋顶。
words.en: A covered passage with arches along one or both sides.

words.ex: The departures board shows the flight times.
words.ex_cn: 起飞显示屏显示航班时间。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.ex: He will depart tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他明天早上离开。
words.en: If you depart from a place, you leave it and start a journey to another place.

words.ex: This store is the closest to my house.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店离我家最近。
words.en: Superlative of 'close': nearest in space, time, or relationship.

words.ex: The two pipes are coupled together.
words.ex_cn: 这两根管道是连接在一起的。
words.en: Joined or linked together; combined.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.ex: The team created a mapping of the forest area.
words.ex_cn: 团队制作了该森林区域的制图。
words.en: The process of making a map or the representation of the structure of something.

words.ex: He joined the airforce after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了空军。
words.en: The military aviation branch of a country's armed forces.

words.tr: n. 时刻；机会( occasion的名词复数 )；
words.ex: We meet on special occasions.
words.ex_cn: 我们在特殊时刻见面。
words.en: Specific times or events suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.tr: n. 快速；速度( speed的名词复数 )； v. 急行；加速；
words.ex: The speeds of the cars on the highway are very high.
words.ex_cn: 高速公路上汽车的速度非常快。
words.en: Speeds refers to the rate at which someone or something moves or operates, or to move quickly.

words.tr: 名词短语，表示距离为50公里
words.ex: The town is 50 km from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇离城市50公里。
words.en: Fifty kilometers, a unit of distance equal to approximately 31 miles.

words.ex: Scientists found fossils in the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在岩石中发现了化石。
words.en: Fossils are the remains or impressions of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.tr: n. 国家（nation 的复数）; n. （Nations）人名；（英）内申斯
words.ex: The nations signed a peace agreement.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家签署了一项和平协议。
words.en: Sovereign states or large communities of people with a common identity and government.

words.tr: adj. 保留的； v. 保留；“reserve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The seats are reserved for students.
words.ex_cn: 这些座位是为学生保留的。
words.en: If something is reserved, it is kept specially for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: The law prohibits smoking in public places.
words.ex_cn: 法律禁止在公共场所吸烟。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.ex: This plant produces electricity using nuclear power.
words.ex_cn: 这座电厂使用核能发电。
words.en: relating to the nucleus of an atom, or to the energy produced when the nucleus of an atom is split or joined with another nucleus

words.ex: The fireworks caused loud explosions in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在夜空中引发了巨大的爆炸。
words.en: An explosion is a sudden, violent burst of energy, for example one caused by a bomb.

words.ex: The box has four sided faces.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有四个侧面。
words.en: Having sides or a specified number or type of sides.

words.tr: adj. 平衡的； v. （使）平衡；“balance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She eats a balanced diet to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 她吃均衡的饮食以保持健康。
words.en: If something is balanced, it has equal proportions or is arranged in a way that is not too much in one direction or another.

words.tr: n. 心理学家；心理学研究者；
words.ex: The psychologist helped the child feel less afraid.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家帮助孩子感觉不那么害怕。
words.en: A psychologist is a person who studies the human mind and human emotions and behaviour, and who uses this knowledge to help people with mental health problems.

words.tr: v. 说服；劝服；“persuade”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He persuaded her to go with him.
words.ex_cn: 他说服了她和他一起去。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.tr: n. 爱好运动的人；运动员；
words.ex: Sportspeople often wake up early to train.
words.ex_cn: 爱好运动的人经常早起训练。
words.en: Sportspeople are individuals who participate in sports, either professionally or as amateurs.

words.ex: The company values flexibility in work hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视工作时间的灵活性。
words.en: Flexibility refers to the quality of bending easily without breaking, or the ability to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances or conditions.

words.ex: The regularity of his daily routine helps him stay focused.
words.ex_cn: 他日常作息的规律性帮助他保持专注。
words.en: The quality or state of being regular; the condition of being governed by or according to rules, principles, or established customs.

words.ex: The cellists played softly in the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 大提琴手们在管弦乐队中轻柔地演奏。
words.en: A cellist is someone who plays the cello.

words.ex: An ant is carrying a leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚂蚁正在搬一片叶子。
words.en: A small insect, often with a sting, that lives in a complex social colony with one or more breeding queens. It is wingless except for fertile adults, which form large mating swarms, and is proverbial for its industriousness.

words.ex: He consistently arrives at school on time.
words.ex_cn: 他一贯准时到校。
words.en: In a way that does not vary; in the same way over time.

words.tr: v. 掏出；捕鱼( fish的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He fished a key out of his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出一把钥匙。
words.en: To fish means to try to catch fish, either for food or as a form of recreation.

words.ex: The car made a lateral move to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车横向移动以避开狗。
words.en: Relating to the side or sides; situated at or extending to the side.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: The teacher gave me the corrections for my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我作文的修改意见。
words.en: Changes that are made to something in order to correct or improve it.

words.tr: abbr. 艾滋病；获得性免疫缺乏综合症；“Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome”的缩写；
words.ex: He got tested for aids last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周做了艾滋病检测。
words.en: AIDS is a disease caused by a virus that weakens a person's immune system, making them vulnerable to other infections and diseases.

words.tr: abbr. 印度联合新闻社；“United News of India”的缩写；
words.ex: The uni reported the election results quickly.
words.ex_cn: 印度联合新闻社迅速报道了选举结果。
words.en: A university is an institution of higher education and research which awards academic degrees in various subjects.

words.ex: The job entails working long hours.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作牵涉到长时间工作。
words.en: If one thing entails another, it involves it or causes it.

words.tr: v. 使（某人）气馁；威吓；使（某人）气馁，威吓( daunt的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The big exam daunted her.
words.ex_cn: 这场大考让她感到气馁。
words.en: If something daunts you, it makes you feel slightly afraid or worried about dealing with it.

words.tr: n. 床上用品；寝具； v. “bed”的现在分词；
words.ex: She bought new bedding for her bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 她为卧室买了新的床上用品。
words.en: Bedding refers to the materials that are used on a bed for sleeping on, such as sheets and blankets.

words.ex: The sights from the mountain top were amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山顶看到的视野令人惊叹。
words.en: The things that you can see in a particular place, especially interesting or beautiful things.

words.ex: The mountains have high peaks.
words.ex_cn: 这些山有很高的山峰。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: The children played in the valleys between the hills.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在山之间的山谷里玩耍。
words.en: A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.tr: v. 编织；编制；“weave”的现在分词；
words.ex: She is weaving a blanket with colorful threads.
words.ex_cn: 她正在用彩色线编织一条毯子。
words.en: The act or process of forming something by combining various elements in a complex or intricate way, especially the process of making fabric by interlacing threads on a loom.

words.tr: n. 雕刻品；雕刻图案； v. 雕刻；“carve”的现在分词；
words.ex: The museum displayed a beautiful wooden carving.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展示了一件精美的木雕品。
words.en: A carving is an object or design that has been cut out of a material such as wood or stone.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimize waste in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少厨房里的浪费。
words.en: To minimize something means to reduce it to the smallest possible amount or degree.

words.ex: We planned our itinerary before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅行前规划了路线。
words.en: An itinerary is a plan of a journey, including the route and the places that you will visit.

words.tr: v. 使适应（新气候或环境）
words.ex: He needs to acclimatize to the hot weather.
words.ex_cn: 他需要适应炎热的天气。
words.en: To acclimatize means to adjust to a new climate, environment, or situation.

words.ex: This math problem is the hardest I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题是我见过的最难的。
words.en: superlative of hard: most difficult; most solid

words.tr: adj. 到绝顶的；终极的；最后的；
words.ex: The culminating moment of the concert was the final song.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的到绝顶的时刻是最后一首歌。
words.en: to reach the highest point or the final stage of something

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: She wore a gorgeous dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件华丽的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you say that something is gorgeous, you mean that it gives you a lot of pleasure or is very attractive.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.tr: v. 使激活； adj. 活性化的；有生气（activate 的过去分词）；
words.ex: The button activated the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮激活了警报。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working.

words.ex: He collects stamps from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的邮票。
words.en: If you collect things, you gather them together over a period of time, usually because you are interested in them.

words.ex: The weather shows many variations in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气有很多变化。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, form, or condition of something.

words.ex: The salinity of the sea water is too high for most fish.
words.ex_cn: 海水的盐分对大多数鱼来说太高了。
words.en: The concentration of salt in a solution, especially in water.

words.ex: The lighthouse beamed light across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔向大海发射出光线。
words.en: adj. Fitted with beams; v. Emit (light, radio waves, etc.)

words.tr: v. 转移；调动；“transfer”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He transferred his money to a new bank.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱转到了一家新银行。
words.en: To move someone or something from one place, vehicle, person, or group to another.

words.tr: n. 运作方式；力学；“mechanic”的复数；
words.ex: The mechanics of this machine are simple to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运作方式很简单易懂。
words.en: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on bodies and with motion, comprised of kinetics, statics, and kinematics.

words.ex: The depletion of natural resources is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的损耗是一个严重的问题。
words.en: The act of reducing something by a large amount so that there is not enough left.

words.ex: The project is ongoing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: An ongoing situation has been happening for quite a long time and seems likely to continue for some time in the future.

words.ex: The variability of weather makes it hard to plan outdoor events.
words.ex_cn: 天气的可变性使得计划户外活动很困难。
words.en: The quality or state of being subject to change or variation.

words.tr: adj. 盛行的；有优势的；普遍的； v. “prevail”的现在分词；
words.ex: The prevailing weather today is sunny.
words.ex_cn: 今天盛行的天气是晴天。
words.en: The prevailing thing in a particular place or at a particular time is the one that is most common or strongest at that place or time.

words.ex: He joined the navy after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了海军。
words.en: The navy is the part of a country's armed forces that is trained to operate at sea.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: The astronauts completed their missions on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员完成了他们在月球上的任务。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.ex: The yachtsmen sailed smoothly across the bay.
words.ex_cn: 游艇驾驶员们平稳地驶过海湾。
words.en: A yachtsman is a man who sails or owns a yacht, especially one who participates in yacht racing.

words.ex: This is a biological experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个生物学实验。
words.en: Relating to biology or living organisms.

words.tr: v. 保护；保存；保持；“preserve”的现在分词；
words.ex: We are preserving the old forest from being cut down.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在保护这片老森林不被砍伐。
words.en: To keep something in its original state or in good condition, especially over a long period of time.

words.tr: n. 渔业；渔场( fishery的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The government supports local fisheries to protect marine life.
words.ex_cn: 政府支持当地渔业以保护海洋生物。
words.en: Fisheries are areas of the sea where fish are caught in large quantities for commercial purposes.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

words.tr: n. 可能发生的情况；设想；
words.ex: It's a possible scenario that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天会下雨是一个可能发生的情况。
words.en: A scenario is a description of a possible course of action or events.

words.tr: adj. 迷失方向的； v. “disorient”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt disoriented after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后他感到迷失方向。
words.en: If you are disoriented, you have lost your sense of direction, or you feel confused and not sure where you are or what you should do.

words.tr:
n. 滞后；延迟；
v. 落后；缓慢移动；
words.ex: There is a lag between the signal and the response.
words.ex_cn: 信号和响应之间有滞后。
words.en: If one thing or person lags behind another thing or person, their progress is slower than that of the other.

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人气馁的；
words.ex: The rainy weather was dispiriting.
words.ex_cn: 阴雨天气令人沮丧。
words.en: Making someone lose their enthusiasm or hope; discouraging.

words.ex: The palace had opulent carpets and golden chandeliers.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿里有华丽的地毯和金色的吊灯。
words.en: Having or displaying great wealth or richness.

words.tr: v. 低估；对…估计不足；“underestimate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被低估了的；
words.ex: They underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他们低估了考试的难度。
words.en: To underestimate someone or something means to fail to understand how strong, skillful, intelligent, or important they really are.

words.ex: She wore a chic dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条别致的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as chic, you mean that they are stylish and fashionable.

words.ex: She bought a dress from a small boutique downtown.
words.ex_cn: 她在市中心的一家小型时装精品屋买了一条裙子。
words.en: A boutique is a small shop that sells stylish clothes, shoes, or jewelry.

words.ex: The city has many districts.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有许多地区。
words.en: A district is a part of a country, city, or town that is recognized as a separate unit because of a particular characteristic.

words.tr: adj. 庄重的；庄严的；堂皇的；
words.ex: The stately mansion stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 那座庄重的豪宅矗立在山上。
words.en: Something that is stately is impressive because of its size, beauty, or grandeur.

words.ex: The rich people live in big mansions.
words.ex_cn: 富人住在大的大厦里。
words.en: A mansion is a very large, impressive house, especially one that is the home of a wealthy or important person.

words.ex: The hotel has a plush lobby with velvet chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有一个豪华的大堂，配有丝绒椅子。
words.en: Plush refers to something that is luxurious and expensive, or a type of fabric that is very soft and thick.

words.ex: The small village is idyllic with green fields and quiet streams.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄有着绿色的田野和宁静的溪流，十分宁静美好。
words.en: An idyllic place or experience is extremely pleasant, beautiful, and peaceful, often in a way that seems too good to be true.

words.tr: n. 揭露；被揭示的真相；
words.ex: The letter was a revelation about his secret life.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他隐秘的生活。
words.en: A revelation is a surprising and previously unknown fact that has been disclosed to others.

words.ex: His opinion is subjective and not based on facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点是主观的，不是基于事实的。
words.en: Based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions.

words.ex: The company used a short slogan to attract customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司用了一个简短的口号来吸引顾客。
words.en: A short and striking or memorable phrase used in advertising or politics.

words.ex: The nurse will dispense medicine to the patients.
words.ex_cn: 护士将分发药品给病人。
words.en: To dispense means to distribute or provide something, especially in a systematic way, or to prepare and give out medicine.

words.ex: Travellers carry maps to find their way.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者带着地图找路。
words.en: People who are travelling or who often travel.

words.tr: v. 使最大化；充分利用；
words.ex: He is maximising his profits by selling more products.
words.ex_cn: 他通过销售更多产品来使利润最大化。
words.en: To make as large or great as possible; to use to the greatest advantage.

words.ex: The car has a sleek design.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有着流畅的外形。
words.en: Sleek describes something that is smooth, glossy, and streamlined, often implying a sense of elegance and efficiency.

words.ex: He manages to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他设法在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: to be in charge of a business, team, or organization; to succeed in doing something, especially something difficult

words.tr: n. 基础；支撑； v. “underpin”的现在分词；
words.ex: Education is the underpinning of a strong society.
words.ex_cn: 教育是强大社会的基础。
words.en: Underpinning refers to a solid foundation laid below ground level to support or strengthen a structure. It can also mean a set of ideas, motives, or devices that justify or form the basis for something.

words.tr: n. 旅馆经理；旅馆老板；
words.ex: The hotelier welcomed guests with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 旅馆经理微笑着欢迎客人。
words.en: A person who owns or manages a hotel.

words.ex: She entrusted her keys to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙托付给了朋友。
words.en: If you entrust something important to someone or entrust them with it, you give them the responsibility of looking after it or dealing with it.

words.ex: The predictability of the weather helps farmers plan their work.
words.ex_cn: 天气的可预测性帮助农民规划他们的工作。
words.en: The ability to be predicted; the quality of being predictable.

words.ex: He pretends to sleep when his mom asks him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈让他打扫房间时，他假装睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.ex: Parents shouldn't indulge their children's bad habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母不应该放任孩子的坏习惯。
words.en: To indulge means to allow yourself or someone else to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you.

words.tr: adj. 饮食奢侈的；纵容（pamper 的过去分词形式）；
words.ex: The pampered dog eats gourmet food every day.
words.ex_cn: 这只被宠坏的狗每天吃精致的食物。
words.en: If you pamper someone, you treat them very kindly, sometimes too kindly, and look after them very well.

words.tr: adj. 宠坏的； v. 宠坏；毁坏；“spoil”的过去式及过去分词；
words.ex: The child is spoilt because his parents give him everything he wants.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子被宠坏了，因为父母给他想要的一切。
words.en: If someone is spoilt, they are given everything they want or are allowed to do whatever they want, often with the result that they behave badly.

words.ex: The minuscule dot was hard to see with the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 那个极小的点用肉眼很难看到。
words.en: If you describe something as minuscule, you mean that it is very small.

words.tr: n. 洗发水；洗发精；洗发香波；
words.ex: She bought a new shampoo at the store.
words.ex_cn: 她在商店买了一瓶新的洗发水。
words.en: Shampoo is a liquid soap that is used for washing your hair, or the act of washing your hair with this liquid.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: His nationality is Canadian.
words.ex_cn: 他的国籍是加拿大人。
words.en: Nationality is the legal relationship between an individual and a state, often used to refer to the country to which a person belongs.

words.ex: The veterinarian helps sick animals.
words.ex_cn: 兽医帮助生病的动物。
words.en: A veterinarian is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals.

words.ex: He plays handball after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后打手球。
words.en: Handball is a team sport in which two teams of seven players each pass a ball using their hands with the aim of throwing it into the goal of the other team.

words.ex: He is a guider for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 他是新员工的指导者。
words.en: A person who leads or directs others, especially in a specific activity or tour.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: The old factory is now a derelict building.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧工厂现在是一座破败的建筑。
words.en: If a building or a piece of land is derelict, it is not cared for and is in bad condition. A derelict person or thing is one that has been abandoned or neglected.

words.ex: The trucks deliver goods to the warehouses at night.
words.ex_cn: 卡车在夜间将货物运送到仓库。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: The farmers use storehouses to keep their grain.
words.ex_cn: 农民们使用仓库来存放他们的谷物。
words.en: A storehouse is a building where things are stored.

words.ex: The developer built a new apartment complex.
words.ex_cn: 这家开发商建造了一座新的公寓楼。
words.en: A developer is a person or a company that develops software, websites, or applications, or that builds houses or other structures on land.

words.tr: adj. 同步的；v. 使同时（synchronise 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The lights are synchronised with the music.
words.ex_cn: 灯光与音乐同步。
words.en: Caused to occur or operate at the same time or rate.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.ex: The garden has ornamental flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园里有装饰性的花卉。
words.en: Something that is ornamental is intended to be attractive and is not necessary or useful.

words.ex: He sat on the bench in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在公园的长凳上。
words.en: A bench is a long seat for several people, typically made of wood or metal.

words.tr: n. 玫瑰； v. 上升；提高；“rise”的过去式；
words.ex: She picked a red rose from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵红玫瑰。
words.en: A rose is a flower, often with a pleasant smell, which grows on a bush with thorns on the stems.

words.tr: n. 赛艇运动；划（船）； v. “row”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves rowing as a weekend sport.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把赛艇运动作为周末的运动。
words.en: The activity or sport of propelling a boat by means of oars.

words.tr: n. 海滨的木板人行道
words.ex: We walked on the boardwalk by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的木板路上散步。
words.en: A boardwalk is a path made of wooden boards, especially one built along a beach or waterfront for walking.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.tr: n. 港湾；河口湾；河口；入海口；
words.ex: The river flows into the estuary before reaching the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流在入海前流入港湾。
words.en: An estuary is the wide part of a river where it nears the sea; fresh and salt water mix.

words.ex: The watchers waited quietly outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 观察者们安静地等在房子外面。
words.en: Watchers are people who watch something, especially in order to make sure that nothing bad happens or to notice any changes.

words.ex: The soldier was spying on the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 这名士兵在夜间秘密侦察敌军营地。
words.en: A spy is a person who secretly collects and reports information about the activities, movements, and plans of an enemy or competitor.

words.ex: The movie has amazing visuals.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有令人惊叹的视觉效果。
words.en: Visuals refer to the elements of a presentation or display that appeal to the sight, such as pictures, diagrams, or videos, used to make information more accessible or appealing.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopaedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找了这个词。
words.en: A book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.ex: This chemical is an enhancer for plant growth.
words.ex_cn: 这种化学物质是植物生长的增强剂。
words.en: An enhancer is something that improves the quality, value, or extent of something else.

words.ex: She likes to try different cuisines when she travels.
words.ex_cn: 她旅行时喜欢尝试不同的菜系。
words.en: A cuisine is a style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.tr: v. 包含； adj. 股份有限的；组成公司的；组成公司( incorporate的过去式和过；
words.ex: The recipe incorporated fresh herbs for better flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱包含了新鲜香草以提升风味。
words.en: If something is incorporated into a larger group, system, or area, it becomes part of it.

words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.tr: adj. 有苦味的；激烈而不快的；痛苦的；刺痛的；
words.ex: The medicine tastes bitter.
words.ex_cn: 这种药尝起来很苦。
words.en: Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet. Feeling or showing anger, hurt, or resentment because of bad experiences or a sense of unjust treatment.

words.ex: The heat intensifies during the day.
words.ex_cn: 白天热量增强。
words.en: To intensify means to increase in degree or strength, or to make something do so.

words.ex: The occurring was sudden and surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个事件发生得很突然，让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: To happen or take place; to be found or exist in a particular place or situation.

words.ex: The sweetness of the honey made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜的甜蜜让她露出了微笑。
words.en: The quality of being sweet.

words.ex: He eats bread and rice for carbohydrates.
words.ex_cn: 他吃面包和米饭来获取碳水化合物。
words.en: Carbohydrates are substances, found in certain kinds of food, that provide your body with heat and energy and are made up of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The sourness of the lemon made her face twist.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬的酸味让她皱起了脸。
words.en: The quality or state of being sour; acidity or bitterness in taste or character.

words.ex: The teacher warns students not to cheat.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要作弊。
words.en: To warn someone means to tell them about a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant thing that might happen, so that they can avoid it.

words.ex: The spoilage of milk happens when it is left out too long.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶放太久就会腐败。
words.en: The process of becoming spoiled, especially the decay or decomposition of food.

words.ex: The saltiness of the soup made it taste too strong.
words.ex_cn: 汤的咸味让它味道太重了。
words.en: The quality or state of being salty.

words.tr: vt.& vi. 打电话给某人（phone的过去式与过去分词形式）
words.ex: He phoned his mother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天给妈妈打了电话。
words.en: To make a telephone call to someone.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.ex: The band plays beautiful music with flutes.
words.ex_cn: 乐队用长笛演奏美妙的音乐。
words.en: A flute is a musical instrument of the woodwind family. You play it by blowing over a hole at one end while holding it sideways. Flutes are also the long, thin, parallel grooves cut into the surface of a column or other architectural feature.

words.ex: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A singer is a person who sings, especially as a profession.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.ex: The birds flew high in the heavens.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中高飞。
words.en: The heavens are often referred to as the sky, especially when regarded as a place where the sun, moon, stars, and planets are situated, or more generally as the apparent vault of the sky.

words.tr: n. 简介；情况介绍会； v. “brief”的现在分词；
words.ex: The manager gave a briefing before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议前，经理做了一个简介。
words.en: A briefing is a meeting in which people are given information or instructions.

words.ex: My parents are allowing me to stay out late.
words.ex_cn: 我父母允许我晚点回家。
words.en: To permit someone to do something or to let something happen.

words.tr: n. （指登山者、步行者使用或背小孩时使用的）背包；（有轻金属框的）箱形背包；
words.ex: The children wear backpacks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天背着背包去上学。
words.en: A backpack is a bag that you carry on your back, made of cloth with straps that go over your shoulders.

words.tr: v. 把…撞击成（某种状态）；敲，击，打( knock的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The storm knocked the door open.
words.ex_cn: 风暴把门撞开了。
words.en: Knocked: (verb) Struck or hit something, often with a sound.

words.ex: The school has a small theatrette for student plays.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个用于学生戏剧表演的小剧院。
words.en: A small theater or cinema, often used for private screenings or small-scale performances.

words.ex: The cinema has daily screenings of new movies.
words.ex_cn: 电影院每天都有新电影的放映。
words.en: Screenings refer to the process of showing films or videos, or the act of examining or testing people or things to discover if there is a particular disease or problem.

words.ex: He watches documentaries about animals on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他看电视上关于动物的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives detailed information about a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: The typographer corrected the typos before printing.
words.ex_cn: 排字工在印刷前纠正了这些错误。
words.en: Typos are mistakes made when typing something, especially mistakes that result in words being spelled incorrectly.

words.tr: vt. 使按顺序排列，安排顺序；使按顺序排列，安排顺序（sequence的过去式与过去分词形式）；
words.ex: The teacher sequenced the tasks from easy to hard.
words.ex_cn: 老师把任务按从易到难的顺序安排。
words.en: Arranged in a sequence; following in order.

words.tr: adj. 有注释的；有注解的
words.ex: The teacher gave an annotated map to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们一张标注过的地图。
words.en: Provided with explanatory notes or comments.

words.ex: He did it for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 他为了她的缘故做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result. You can also say that you do it for something's sake.

words.ex: He is good at paragraphing his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长清晰地分段表达他的想法。
words.en: The act of dividing written text into paragraphs for clarity and structure.

words.ex: The inclusion of all students is important.
words.ex_cn: 包含所有学生是很重要的。
words.en: The act of including or the state of being included.

words.ex: The article has clear subheadings to help readers find information.
words.ex_cn: 这篇文章有清晰的小标题，帮助读者找到信息。
words.en: Subheadings are headings given to subsections within a larger piece of writing. They help to organize the text and make it easier for the reader to follow.

words.tr: n. 格式化； v. “format”的现在分词；
words.ex: The computer fixed the formatting of the document.
words.ex_cn: 计算机修复了文档的格式化。
words.en: The act of arranging data in a preset or specified manner, especially in computing and publishing.

words.tr: n. 编号； v. 数数；“number”的现在分词；
words.ex: The numbering on the pages is wrong.
words.ex_cn: 页面的编号错了。
words.en: The process of assigning numbers to items in a series or list.

words.ex: The player scored with a powerful headers.
words.ex_cn: 这名球员用一个有力的头球得分。
words.en: Information placed at the top of a document, page, or email, such as titles, logos, or navigation links.

words.ex: The footers walked slowly along the river path.
words.ex_cn: 步行的人沿着河边的小路慢慢走着。
words.en: Information placed at the bottom of a document, page, or email, such as page numbers or contact details.

words.tr: n. 清单；名单；上市； v. 列出；“list”的现在分词；
words.ex: He checked the listing before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前检查了清单。
words.en: A listing is a list or a catalog of items, especially one that is published or made available in a particular form.

words.ex: He is a big fan of soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他是足球的忠实粉丝。
words.en: A fan is a device that creates a current of air by the movement of its blades. It is also used to refer to a person who has a strong interest in and admiration for a particular person or thing.

words.ex: The cowboy rode his horse across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 牛仔骑着马穿过沙漠。
words.en: A cowboy is a man who herds cattle, traditionally in the western United States, and is often depicted as wearing a wide-brimmed hat and boots.

words.tr: v. 使经受；使遭受；提交( subject的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He was subjected to cold weather during the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他在徒步旅行中经受了寒冷的天气。
words.en: If someone is subjected to something, they are made to experience it, often something unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 史诗；史诗般的作品；“epic”的复数；
words.ex: The ancient Greeks told epics about heroes and gods.
words.ex_cn: 古希腊人讲述关于英雄和神祇的史诗。
words.en: Epics are long poems, typically derived from ancient oral tradition, narrating the deeds and adventures of heroic or legendary figures or the history of a nation.

words.ex: The cities are geographically far apart.
words.ex_cn: 这些城市在地理上相距很远。
words.en: In terms of geography or physical location.

words.tr: n. 更热心的人；更渴望的人；
words.ex: He is a keener of sports than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他弟弟更热爱运动。
words.en: Someone who is very eager or enthusiastic about something.

words.tr: v. 列出；“list”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 列出的；上市的；
words.ex: The teacher listed the homework on the board.
words.ex_cn: 老师把作业写在了黑板上。
words.en: Included in a list, especially of companies whose shares are traded on a stock exchange.

words.ex: Some countries have flat plateaux where people grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 一些国家有平坦的高原，人们在上面种植作物。
words.en: A plateau is a large flat area of land that is higher than the land around it, or a period during which there are no large changes.

words.ex: The river eroded the bank over time.
words.ex_cn: 河水随着时间侵蚀了河岸。
words.en: To be gradually worn away or destroyed by natural forces, such as wind, water, or acid.

words.ex: The mineral outcrops appear on the hillside.
words.ex_cn: 矿脉在山坡上露出。
words.en: An outcrop is a visible exposure of bedrock or ancient superficial deposits on the surface of the Earth.

words.tr:
n. （鸟或羊）群；（人）群；
v. 聚集；群集；
words.ex: A flock of birds flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过田野。
words.en: A flock is a group of birds, sheep, or goats, or a large group of people. It can also refer to a soft material for stuffing cushions, quilts, etc., made from wool or cotton. As a verb, it means to gather or move in a flock.

words.ex: He overcame many hardships during his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他在童年时克服了许多艰难。
words.en: Hardships refer to severe suffering or privation, often as a result of difficult conditions or situations.

words.tr: v. 忍受；忍耐；容忍；持； adj. 吃苦耐劳的 v. （长时间地）忍受，忍耐，容忍( endure的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He endured the pain without crying.
words.ex_cn: 他忍受着疼痛没有哭。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.ex: The invasion of privacy is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 侵犯隐私是一个严重的问题。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.tr: adj. 根深蒂固的；生根的； v. 生根；“root”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His beliefs are rooted in tradition.
words.ex_cn: 他的信念根深蒂固于传统。
words.en: If something is rooted in a particular emotion, belief, or idea, it is strongly influenced by it or developed from it.

words.ex: He collects rainwater in a barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他用桶收集雨水。
