words.ex: The bank sent letters to the debtors.
words.ex_cn: 银行给债务人寄了信。
words.en: Debtors are individuals or entities that owe money to another party.

words.tr: v. 继承；经遗传获得（品质、身体特征等）；
words.ex: He inherits his father's house.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了他父亲的房子。
words.en: To receive money, property, or a title from someone who has died, or to have qualities or physical features that are similar to those of your parents or ancestors.

words.tr: v. 假装；（尤指儿童）（在游戏中）装扮；假装( pretend的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is pretending to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他假装在睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.ex: The weather is unpredictable today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气不可预测。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as unpredictable, you mean that you cannot tell what they are going to do or how they are going to behave.

words.ex: He drew a picture with charcoal.
words.ex_cn: 他用木炭画了一幅画。
words.en: Charcoal is a black substance made by burning wood slowly in an oven with little air, used for drawing or as a fuel.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.ex: He is a dependable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是提供帮助。
words.en: Someone or something that is dependable can be relied on to do what you need or expect.

words.tr: v. 执行；贯彻；实现( implement的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The team is implementing the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队正在执行新计划。
words.en: To implement something means to put a decision, plan, or system into effect.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；著名的；
words.ex: This is a notable achievement.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个值得注意的成就。
words.en: Worthy of attention or notice; remarkable.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.ex: He eats cereals for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷物当早餐。
words.en: Cereals are plants such as wheat, corn, or rice that produce grain. The grain from these plants is used for food.

words.tr: n. 打气筒；泵( pump的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He used the pumps to fill the bicycle tires.
words.ex_cn: 他用打气筒给自行车轮胎打气。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action, typically converted from electrical energy into hydraulic energy. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.tr: n. [劳经]岗位；[测]标杆；邮件（post 的复数）；
words.ex: The company has many open posts for new workers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有许多新的岗位空缺。
words.en: 1. A post is a long, sturdy piece of timber or metal set upright in the ground and used as a support or marker. 2. To post means to display a notice in a public place or to send a letter or package through the postal system.

words.tr: n. 倡议；主动权；自发性；措施；
words.ex: The school launched an initiative to reduce plastic use.
words.ex_cn: 学校发起了一项减少塑料使用的倡议。
words.en: An initiative is an important act or statement that is intended to solve a problem.

words.ex: He dig a hole in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里挖了一个洞。
words.en: To dig means to break up, turn over, or remove earth, sand, etc., using a tool, a machine, or your hands. It can also mean to search for something by moving or looking through something, or to like or enjoy something very much.

words.ex: He stored water in large tanks.
words.ex_cn: 他把水储存在大箱子里。
words.en: A tank is a large, heavily armored fighting vehicle with tracks and a large gun that moves on wheels inside the tank. Also, a tank can be a large container for storing liquid or gas.

words.tr: adj. 有（法律）责任的；有…倾向的；
words.ex: He is liable for the damage caused by his car.
words.ex_cn: 他对他的车造成的损害负有责任。
words.en: If you are liable for something such as a debt or a duty, you are legally responsible for it. If something is liable to happen, it is very likely to happen.

words.tr: n. 时间轴；时间表；时间轴，时间表( timeline的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The teacher drew timelines to show the history of ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了时间轴来展示古罗马的历史。
words.en: A timeline is a graphical representation of a chronological sequence of events, or a schedule of activities.

words.ex: The boss appointed Tom as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 老板任命汤姆为新经理。
words.en: If you appoint someone to a job or official position, you formally choose them for it.

words.ex: He filled out the sheets with his name and address.
words.ex_cn: 他在这几张表格上填上了自己的姓名和地址。
words.en: Sheets refer to large pieces of thin material used especially on beds or as a covering for something.

words.tr: adj. 人与人之间的；人际关系的；
words.ex: Good interpersonal skills help people work together.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际交往能力有助于人们合作。
words.en: relating to relationships or communication between people

words.tr: n. 电话会议；视频会议；
words.ex: We use teleconferencing to talk with our team in another city.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用电话会议与另一个城市的团队交谈。
words.en: Teleconferencing is the use of telecommunication technology to conduct meetings between participants who are in different locations.

words.ex: He answered the questions orally.
words.ex_cn: 他口头回答了问题。
words.en: In a spoken rather than written form; by means of speech.

words.tr: n. 炉，火炉( stove的名词复数 )
words.ex: The family cooks food on stoves.
words.ex_cn: 这家人用炉子做饭。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.tr: v. 关闭；使接近；“close”的现在分词； n. 关闭；倒闭；
words.ex: He is closing the door slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在慢慢关上门。
words.en: The act of shutting or finishing something.

words.ex: The toddler is walking slowly by the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这个幼儿正慢慢地在沙发旁走路。
words.en: A toddler is a young child who has just learned to walk or who is learning to walk.

words.ex: Motorists must stop at red lights.
words.ex_cn: 司机必须在红灯前停车。
words.en: A motorist is someone who drives a car.

words.tr: adj. 富有的( wealthy的比较级 )
words.ex: He is wealthier than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他兄弟更富有。
words.en: Having more wealth or resources than someone or something else.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.ex: The editor corrected the grammar in the article.
words.ex_cn: 编辑纠正了这篇文章的语法。
words.en: An editor is a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in it.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.ex: The baby is 20 inches long.
words.ex_cn: 这个婴儿有20英寸长。
words.en: An inch is a unit of length in the British imperial and United States customary systems of measurement. It is also used to describe a very small amount or degree of something.

words.ex: The newspaper's headline said 'City Wins Championship'.
words.ex_cn: 报纸的大字标题写着‘城市赢得冠军’。
words.en: A headline is the title of a newspaper story, printed in large letters at the top of the story, especially on the front page.

words.ex: He designs graphics for video games.
words.ex_cn: 他为电子游戏设计绘图。
words.en: Graphics are visual images or designs on some surface, such as a wall, canvas, screen, paper, or stone, to inform, illustrate, or entertain.

words.tr: adj. 误导的； v. “mislead”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ad is misleading because it shows fake results.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告是误导的，因为它展示了虚假的结果。
words.en: If you describe something as misleading, you mean that it gives you a wrong idea or impression.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.tr: v. 屈尊俯就地对待；赞助（patronise 的过去式及过去分词，patronise 等...；
words.ex: He patronised her by speaking slowly, as if she were a child.
words.ex_cn: 他以慢吞吞的语调和她说话，仿佛她是个孩子，表现出屈尊俯就的态度。
words.en: If someone patronises you, they speak or behave towards you in a way which seems friendly, but which shows that they think they are superior to you in some way.

words.ex: He explicitly said no to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他明确地拒绝了这个提议。
words.en: In a clear and detailed manner, leaving no room for confusion or doubt.

words.tr: n. 社论（editorial 的复数形式）
words.ex: The newspaper publishes editorials every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸每周日发表社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or owner on a topic or item of news.

words.tr: adj. 更宽广的；更广博的；更广泛的；“broad”的比较级；
words.ex: This book gives a broader view of history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书提供了更宽广的历史视角。
words.en: Comparative form of 'broad', meaning more extensive in scope or range.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.tr: n. 洗碗；v. 洗碗（dishwash 的现在分词）；
words.ex: He hates dishwashing after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌饭后洗碗。
words.en: The act of washing dishes, typically after a meal.

words.ex: The pipes are made of metal cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 这些管道由金属圆柱体制成。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.ex: The ancient stones had inscriptions from Roman times.
words.ex_cn: 这些古老的石头上有罗马时代的铭文。
words.en: Words or letters that have been written or carved into something, especially as a historical record or as a form of decoration.

words.tr: v. 用水清洗（尤指身体部位）；给…洗澡，游泳( bathe的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He bathed his hands in warm water.
words.ex_cn: 他用温水清洗了双手。
words.en: To wash oneself or someone else in a bath or shower.

words.ex: He used pumice to smooth his rough skin.
words.ex_cn: 他用轻石来磨平粗糙的皮肤。
words.en: Pumice is a type of volcanic rock that is very light and full of holes, formed when lava cools quickly. It is often used for cleaning or smoothing surfaces.

words.ex: The priest anointed the child with oil.
words.ex_cn: 牧师为孩子涂了油。
words.en: To anoint means to smear or rub with oil, typically as part of a religious ceremony, or to choose someone for a particular job or position, especially a religious or political one.

words.ex: He scraped the ice off the window.
words.ex_cn: 他把窗户上的冰刮掉了。
words.en: To remove something from a surface by moving a sharp or hard object across it, or to rub against a surface so that slight damage or an unpleasant noise is produced.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.tr: n. （古希腊或古罗马人用的）刮身板
words.ex: The ancient Roman used a strigil to clean his skin.
words.ex_cn: 古罗马人用刮身板清洁皮肤。
words.en: A strigil is a tool used in ancient Greece and Rome to scrape dirt and oil from the skin after bathing or exercise.

words.ex: He is discovering a new planet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在发现一颗新行星。
words.en: To find something or someone unexpectedly or in the course of a search.

words.ex: She tinted the glass blue.
words.ex_cn: 她把玻璃染成了蓝色。
words.en: A tint is a small amount of a particular color, especially when it is used to make the main color lighter or darker.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.tr: v. 牺牲，献出； adj. [医]被处死的 v. 牺牲，献出( sacrifice的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.ex: The ancient Romans built aqueducts to bring water to cities.
words.ex_cn: 古罗马人建造了水渠来为城市供水。
words.en: A structure for conveying water, typically in the form of a bridge across a valley or other gap.

words.ex: This plant has medicinal properties.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物具有药用价值。
words.en: Having healing properties; used in the treatment of disease.

words.ex: The street was full of filth after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，街道上满是污秽。
words.en: Filth is a noun that refers to disgusting dirt or refuse, or obscene and offensive language or printed material.

words.ex: The kitchen was unsanitary and dirty.
words.ex_cn: 厨房不卫生且脏乱。
words.en: If you describe a place as unsanitary, you mean that it is dirty, and likely to cause disease.

words.ex: There were outbreaks of flu in the school last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天学校爆发了流感。
words.en: An outbreak is a sudden occurrence of something unwelcome, such as war or disease.

words.tr: v. 守卫；“guard”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 谨慎的；有保留的；警戒着的；
words.ex: The soldiers guarded the gate all night.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们整晚守卫着大门。
words.en: If you are guarded, you are careful not to show your feelings or give away information.

words.ex: They shared secrets under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他们在树下分享秘密。
words.en: Information that is not known or seen by others.

words.ex: The artist mixed oils to create vibrant colors.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家混合油画颜料来创造鲜艳的色彩。
words.en: Oils are substances that are not soluble in water and are used in cooking, as fuels, or for lubrication.

words.tr: n. 刮胡须； v. “shave”的现在分词；
words.ex: He does his shaving every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刮胡须。
words.en: The act of removing hair from the face or body using a razor.

words.ex: Shampooing his hair every day makes it dry.
words.ex_cn: 每天洗发会让他的头发变干。
words.en: The act of washing the hair with shampoo.

words.ex: The laundry machine does the laundering every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 洗衣机每个星期天负责洗涤。
words.en: Laundering refers to the process of making illegally-gained proceeds appear legal, typically involving complex sequences of banking transfers or commercial transactions.

words.ex: He walked toward the door.
words.ex_cn: 他朝门走去。
words.en: In the direction of; in relation to; near to; for the purpose of.

words.tr: v. 给予专利权；“patent”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The company patented the new device last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年获得了该新设备的专利权。
words.en: Protected by a patent; made or manufactured under the terms of a patent.

words.ex: Limestone contains calcium carbonate.
words.ex_cn: 石灰石含有碳酸钙。
words.en: A carbonate is a salt of carbonic acid, containing the anion CO₃²⁻, or the compound CO₂ combined with a metal.

words.ex: Lye is a strong alkali used in cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种用于清洁的强碱。
words.en: An alkali is a chemical compound that neutralizes acids to form salts and turns red litmus paper blue.

words.tr: v. 获得；获得( obtain的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He obtained a scholarship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项奖学金。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.tr: v. （使）联合；兼有；使融合（或并存）；
words.ex: The recipe combines flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱将面粉和水混合在一起。
words.en: To combine things means to mix them together in order to make something new or to achieve a particular result.

words.tr: vt. 屈服；投降；屈服，投降（yield的过去式与过去分词形式）；
words.ex: The soldier yielded to the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向敌人屈服了。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If something yields, it produces something as a result of a process or an action.

words.ex: Glycerine is used in many skin creams.
words.ex_cn: 甘油被用于许多护肤霜中。
words.en: Glycerine is a thick, sweet, colorless liquid that is used in making medicines, explosives, and antifreeze, and in food and skin care products.

words.ex: The fatty meat made him feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 这块脂肪太多的肉让他感到恶心。
words.en: containing a lot of fat; oily or greasy

words.ex: The lab has strong acids.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有强酸。
words.en: Substances that have a pH of less than 7, can turn blue litmus paper red, and can react with bases and some metals to form salts.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢化学，因为它很有趣。
words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.tr: vt. 使负重担（tax的过去式与过去分词形式）
words.ex: The hard work taxed him greatly.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作让他感到压力巨大。
words.en: Subject to or burdened with a tax or charge; overworked or weary.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.tr: adj. 加强的； v. 增强；“reinforce”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The concrete wall is reinforced with steel bars.
words.ex_cn: 这堵混凝土墙用钢筋加固了。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more able to withstand pressure, especially by adding extra material or support.

words.tr: adj. 温暖的；（味道） 不浓的；温柔的( mild的比较级 )；
words.ex: The weather in spring is milder than in winter.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气比冬天更温暖。
words.en: comparative form of mild; less severe or harsh

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人泄气的；让人懊恼的； v. “frustrate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The slow internet is frustrating.
words.ex_cn: 网速慢让人沮丧。
words.en: If something is frustrating, it annoys you or makes you angry because you cannot do anything about the problems it causes.

words.ex: The subcommittee met to discuss the budget.
words.ex_cn: 小组委员会开会讨论预算。
words.en: A subcommittee is a smaller committee formed from a main committee to concentrate on a specific task or area.

words.ex: The store offers an assortment of snacks.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供各种各样的零食。
words.en: An assortment is a group of similar things that are of different types or sizes.

words.ex: The trees were replanted after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，这些树被重新栽种了。
words.en: To plant again or in a new place.

words.ex: He went for a walk irrespective of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨去散步了。
words.en: If something is done or happens irrespective of particular factors, it is not influenced or affected by them.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.ex: The fishermen use icehouses to store fish in winter.
words.ex_cn: 渔民在冬天用冰屋储存鱼。
words.en: A building where ice is stored, especially one that was used in the past to store ice collected in winter for use in summer.

words.ex: The fish was stored in an icehouse.
words.ex_cn: 鱼被存放在冰库里。
words.en: A building or facility used for storing ice, often historically for preservation.

words.tr: v. 使隔热；“insulate”的现在分词； adj. 绝缘的；
words.ex: The walls are insulating the house from cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁使房子隔绝了寒冷天气。
words.en: Preventing the passage of heat, electricity, or sound; isolating from others.

words.ex: The cow eats straw from the barn.
words.ex_cn: 牛吃谷仓里的稻草。
words.en: A straw is a thin tube of paper or plastic that you use to suck a drink into your mouth.

words.ex: The floor was covered with sawdust after the carpenter worked.
words.ex_cn: 木匠工作后，地板上铺满了锯屑。
words.en: Sawdust consists of tiny particles of wood that are produced when you saw wood.

words.ex: The kitchen has new appliances.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有新的电器。
words.en: Appliances are devices or machines, usually electrical, that are used in the home, for example for cooking, cleaning, or entertainment.

words.ex: The doctor gave me some medicines for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了些治感冒的药。
words.en: Medicines are substances that are used to treat or prevent diseases and illnesses.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.ex: The producers make movies for the public.
words.ex_cn: 制片人制作电影给公众看。
words.en: Producers are individuals or companies that create goods or provide services, especially in the fields of agriculture, manufacturing, or entertainment.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.ex: The goat eats grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 山羊在田野里吃草。
words.en: A goat is a farm animal or a wild animal that is about the size of a sheep. Goats have horns, and some have long hair.

words.ex: The train runs on the railroad.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁路上行驶。
words.en: A railroad is a permanent road having a line of rails fixed to ties and laid on a roadbed and providing a track for cars or equipment drawn by locomotives or propelled by self-contained motors.

words.tr: v. 分开；分裂；“split”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tree is splitting in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: Splitting refers to the act of dividing or separating something into parts, often with force or intensity.

words.ex: The quantity of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: A quantity is an amount that you can measure or count.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.tr: v. 触发；引发；“trigger”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: Caused to function or activate; set off.

words.ex: Old villages used watermills to grind grain.
words.ex_cn: 旧村庄用水车磨谷物。
words.en: A watermill is a mill that uses moving water as its power source; it is a structure that uses a water wheel or water turbine to drive a mechanical process such as milling (grinding), rolling, or hammering.

words.ex: The windmills turn slowly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 风车在田野里缓缓转动。
words.en: Windmills are structures that convert the energy of wind into rotational energy by means of vanes called sails or blades.

words.tr: v. 统治；支配；“dominate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The king dominated the land for fifty years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家五十年。
words.en: To have control over a place or a person, or to be the most important person or thing in a situation.

words.ex: The dress has a beautiful lace at the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子的底部有漂亮的花边。
words.en: Lace is a very delicate cloth which is made with a lot of holes in it. It is made by twisting together very fine threads of cotton to form patterns.

words.ex: She tied ribbons on the gift.
words.ex_cn: 她把丝带系在礼物上。
words.en: Ribbons are long, narrow strips of fabric, used especially for tying something or for decoration.

words.ex: Stagecoaches carried people across the wild west.
words.ex_cn: 马车在西部荒野运送乘客。
words.en: Stagecoaches were large carriages pulled by horses that were used to carry passengers and mail in the past.

words.ex: The truth finally surfaced after the investigation.
words.ex_cn: 经过调查，真相终于显露了。
words.en: To come to the surface of the water; to appear or become known after being hidden or not seen.

words.ex: He is knowledgeable about history and science.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史和科学都很博学。
words.en: Someone who is knowledgeable has or shows a clear understanding of many different facts about the world or about a particular subject.

words.tr: v. 群集，成群结队而行；群集，成群结队而行( flock的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: Birds flocked to the lake at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日出时成群飞向湖边。
words.en: gathered or moved together in large numbers, often quickly

words.ex: He is informing his friends about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他正在通知他的朋友们关于这次会议。
words.en: If you inform someone about something, you tell them about it.

words.ex: They bought luxuries like silk clothes and gold watches.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了丝绸衣服和金表这样的奢侈品。
words.en: Luxuries are things that are not necessary but which give you pleasure or make your life more comfortable.

words.ex: The house has modern conveniences like hot water and electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有热水和电力等现代便利设施。
words.en: Facilities or services that make life easier or more comfortable.

words.ex: He bought food and water, the basic necessities.
words.ex_cn: 他买了食物和水，这些基本必需品。
words.en: Necessities are things that you must have in order to live properly or do something.

words.tr: adj. 难以置信的；不可想象的；
words.ex: The damage from the storm was unimaginable.
words.ex_cn: 风暴造成的破坏难以置信。
words.en: If you describe something as unimaginable, you are emphasizing that it is difficult to imagine or understand because it is not part of people's normal experience.

words.tr: n. 古董；古玩，古董，古物( antique的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He collects antiques from the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 他收藏19世纪的古董。
words.en: Antiques are old objects such as furniture, jewelry, or works of art that are collected and considered valuable because of their beauty, rarity, or historical significance.

words.ex: Fortunately, the bus came just in time.
words.ex_cn: 幸运的是，公交车正好准时到了。
words.en: Used to say that something good has happened, especially when it could have been bad.

words.ex: The train has a sleeping compartment for passengers.
words.ex_cn: 火车上有一个供乘客休息的隔间。
words.en: A compartment is a separate section or part of something, especially a space in a vehicle that is separated from other spaces.

words.tr: n. 英国货币；英镑；标准纯银；银制品；
words.ex: He paid for the book with sterling.
words.ex_cn: 他用英镑支付了这本书的费用。
words.en: Sterling is used to describe something of very high quality or value. It can also refer to British money or a standard of purity for silver.

words.tr: v. 提取（存款）；“withdraw”的过去式；
words.ex: He withdrew $200 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了200美元。
words.en: To remove or take away (something) from a particular place or position; to discontinue or stop participating in an activity or membership.

words.ex: He was robbed of his wallet on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上被抢走了钱包。
words.en: To take property unlawfully from (a person or place) by force or threat of force.

words.ex: He lost his keys and can't get into the house.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了钥匙，进不了家门。
words.en: Keys are small pieces of shaped metal which you insert into a lock and turn in order to lock or unlock something such as a door or a drawer. They can also refer to the buttons on a computer keyboard or the answers to a test or puzzle.

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.ex: The crowding on the bus made it hard to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 公交车上的拥挤让人难以呼吸。
words.en: The presence of a large number of people or things in a space that is too small to accommodate them comfortably.

words.ex: There was a sudden noise in the night.
words.ex_cn: 夜里突然传来一阵响声。
words.en: If something is sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: The blond man smiled at the children.
words.ex_cn: 那个白肤金发的男子对孩子们微笑了。
words.en: If someone has blond hair, it is pale yellow in color.

words.ex: The hairy bear has thick haired skin.
words.ex_cn: 这只毛茸茸的熊有厚厚的有毛发的皮肤。
words.en: Having hair of a specified kind.

words.tr: n. 数字；数字( digit的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He wrote his phone number with digits.
words.ex_cn: 他用数字写下了他的电话号码。
words.en: Digits are the numbers from 0 to 9, or the fingers or toes on a person's hand or foot.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.ex: The teacher is very approachable and always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师非常和蔼可亲，总是面带微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as approachable, you think that they are friendly and easy to talk to.

words.tr: v. 分配；指派；“assign”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 指定的；
words.ex: The teacher assigned homework to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们布置了作业。
words.en: Given a specific task, role, or responsibility.

words.ex: He is on probationary status at his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他在新工作中处于试用期。
words.en: Relating to a period of testing or trial, especially for a new employee or a criminal on parole.

words.tr: adj. 法定的；依照法规的；
words.ex: The statutory minimum wage is $10 per hour.
words.ex_cn: 法定最低工资是每小时10美元。
words.en: Statutory means relating to rules or laws which have been formally written down.

words.ex: He feels unwell after eating too much ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多冰淇淋后感觉不舒服。
words.en: If you are unwell, you are ill.

words.tr: adj. 难以获得的；不能利用的；没空的；
words.ex: The book is unavailable in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆里难以获得。
words.en: If someone or something is unavailable, they are not able to be used or contacted, often because they are busy, not present, or not working.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.tr: v. 补贴；给……发津贴，补贴（subsidise 的过去式及过去分词，subsidise 等于 s...；
words.ex: The government subsidised the farmers to help them buy seeds.
words.ex_cn: 政府补贴农民，帮助他们购买种子。
words.en: If a government or other authority subsidizes something, they pay part of the cost of it.

words.ex: He bought the shirt cheaply at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上便宜地买到了这件衬衫。
words.en: If something is done cheaply, it is done at a low cost.

words.ex: He sits at his workstation every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上坐在他的工作站前。
words.en: A workstation is a high-performance computer system that is designed for a single user and has more power than a personal computer. It is typically used for professional applications such as graphic design, engineering, and scientific research.

words.tr: adj. 不卫生的，不干净的；
words.ex: The kitchen was unhygienic and full of dirt.
words.ex_cn: 厨房很不卫生，到处都是脏东西。
words.en: If you describe something as unhygienic, you mean that it is dirty and likely to cause illness or disease.

words.ex: The company expands its business to new cities.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将其业务扩大到新城市。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something do this.

words.ex: Factories release pollutants into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河流排放污染物。
words.en: Pollutants are substances that make land, water, air, etc., dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.tr: v. 卸船； adj. 放电的，泻出的 v. 下（客）( discharge的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The workers discharged the cargo from the ship.
words.ex_cn: 工人们把货物从船上卸下来。
words.en: Allowed to leave a hospital or medical facility after treatment.

words.tr:
adv. 朝下游方向；
adj. 下游的；
words.ex: The boat moved downstream with the current.
words.ex_cn: 船顺流而下。
words.en: In the direction in which a stream or river flows; situated or moving in the direction of the flow of a stream or river.

words.ex: The rainwater drains into the street.
words.ex_cn: 雨水排入街道。
words.en: If you drain something, you remove the liquid from it, usually by pouring it away or by allowing it to flow away. If something drains, the liquid flows away from it.

words.tr: v. 处理；处理（dispose 的现在分词）；
words.ex: He is disposing of the old trash.
words.ex_cn: 他正在处理旧垃圾。
words.en: To get rid of something that you no longer want or need.

words.ex: Environmentalists plant trees to protect the planet.
words.ex_cn: 环保主义者植树以保护地球。
words.en: Environmentalists are people who are concerned about protecting the environment.

words.ex: You must abide by the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: If you can't abide someone or something, you dislike them very much.

words.ex: Fish live in estuaries where rivers meet the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在河流汇入大海的河口。
words.en: An estuary is the wide part of a river where it nears the sea; fresh and salt water mix.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.tr: v. 损伤；毁坏； n. “damage”的复数；
words.ex: The storm damages the roof.
words.ex_cn: 风暴损坏了屋顶。
words.en: Money that a court orders you to pay to someone because you have harmed them or their property.

words.ex: We derive the answer from the formula.
words.ex_cn: 我们从公式中得到答案。
words.en: If you derive something such as pleasure or benefit from a person or from something, you get it from them.

words.ex: The school bought new devices for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们购买了新的设备。
words.en: A device is an object that has been invented for a particular purpose, for example for recording or measuring something.

words.tr:
n. 收获；收成；
v. 收获；收割；
words.ex: The farmers celebrated the harvest in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在秋天庆祝收获。
words.en: The harvest is the process of gathering mature crops from the fields. It is a crucial activity in agriculture that marks the end of the growing season.

words.ex: The traffic came to a standstill during the rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰期交通陷入了停滞。
words.en: A situation in which all activity or movement has stopped.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.ex: The company has an offshore office in Ireland.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在爱尔兰有一个离岸办公室。
words.en: Located or based in a foreign country, especially to take advantage of lower costs or less stringent regulations.

words.tr: adj. 不稳定的；飘忽不定的；
words.ex: The weather has been erratic this month.
words.ex_cn: 这个月的天气一直不稳定。
words.en: Something that is erratic does not follow a regular pattern, but happens at unexpected times or moves in unexpected directions.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.tr: v. 构造； n. v. 构造（construct 的现在分词）；
words.ex: He is constructing a model house with blocks.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用积木搭建一个模型房子。
words.en: The act of building or creating something, especially a large structure or system.

words.ex: The dam holds back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 水坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.ex: The city improved its hydro system to prevent floods.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改进了其水利系统以防止洪水。
words.en: A hydro is a place where people go to receive treatments involving water, such as baths or massages, especially for health reasons.

words.tr: v. 使活动；起动；触发； adj. 活动的，活性的 v. 使活动，起动，触发( activate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The button is activating the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮正在使警报启动。
words.en: To make something start working or make someone start doing something.

words.ex: The generator provides electricity during the power outage.
words.ex_cn: 发电机在停电时提供电力。
words.en: A generator is a machine which produces electricity or another form of energy.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.tr: v. 倾泻；涌出；倾；倒；涌流；
words.ex: He pours water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进杯子里。
words.en: To pour means to cause a liquid or other substance to flow from a container in a continuous stream, especially by holding the container at an angle.

words.ex: She spoke powerfully about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 她强烈地谈论了气候变化。
words.en: In a manner that is powerful; with great strength or intensity.

words.ex: The generating of electricity requires wind or water.
words.ex_cn: 电力的生成需要风或水。
words.en: To generate means to cause something to exist or occur.

words.tr: n. 兆瓦，百万瓦特（电能计量单位）( megawatt的名词复数 )
words.ex: The wind farm produces 50 megawatts of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个风力发电场产生50兆瓦的电力。
words.en: A unit of power equal to one million watts, used especially in measuring the output of power stations.

words.tr: n. 潟湖；污水池( lagoon的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The fish swim in the quiet lagoons.
words.ex_cn: 鱼儿在宁静的潟湖中游动。
words.en: A lagoon is a shallow body of water separated from a larger body of water by barrier islands or reefs.

words.tr:
adj. 水下的；淹没的；
v. 浸没；
words.ex: The submerged car was hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 那辆水下的汽车很难看到。
words.en: If something is submerged, it is under the surface of a liquid, especially water.

words.tr:
n. 管子；管道；烟斗；
v. 吹笛；以管输送；
words.ex: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了坏掉的管子。
words.en: A pipe is a long, round, hollow object, usually made of metal or plastic, through which a liquid or gas can flow.

words.tr: v. 得到；获得；使；收到；变得；“get”的过去分词；
words.ex: I have gotten a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我从图书馆得到了一本新书。
words.en: Gotten is the past participle of get. It is used in the perfect tenses to indicate that something has been obtained or achieved.

words.tr: n. 重击；重创；痛击； v. “pound”的现在分词；
words.ex: The pounding of the drums scared the children.
words.ex_cn: 鼓声的重击吓到了孩子们。
words.en: The act of hitting something repeatedly with great force.

words.tr: v. 滑；滑脱；下降； adj. 打滑，打滑的 v. 滑( slip的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He slipped on the wet floor.
words.ex_cn: 他在湿的地板上滑倒了。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance. Slip can also mean to move smoothly and quietly, or to pass into a particular state or condition.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: She eats fruits to get vitamins.
words.ex_cn: 她吃水果来获取维生素。
words.en: Vitamins are substances that are found in foods and are necessary for normal growth and health.

words.ex: The soldiers defended the fort during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在战斗中保卫了堡垒。
words.en: A fort is a strong building or a place with a wall or fence around it where soldiers can stay and be safe from the enemy.

words.ex: The invaders came from the north.
words.ex_cn: 入侵者来自北方。
words.en: Invaders are people or groups that enter a place by force in order to conquer or take control of it.

words.ex: He wrote his notes on ruled paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在有平行线条的纸上记了笔记。
words.en: To have control and authority over a country, area, or group of people.

words.ex: The nobleman lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位贵族住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A nobleman is a man who belongs to the noble class in a society, especially in the past.

words.tr: v. 宣布；宣告；通知；声称；宣称；播音；广播；
words.ex: The teacher announced the exam date.
words.ex_cn: 老师宣布了考试日期。
words.en: If you announce something, you tell people about it publicly or officially.

words.ex: Children find amusement in playing games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩游戏时感到快乐。
words.en: Amusement is the feeling that you have when you think that something is funny or entertaining.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.ex: The school gave out booklets about healthy eating.
words.ex_cn: 学校分发了关于健康饮食的小册子。
words.en: A booklet is a small, thin book that has a paper cover and that gives you information about something.

words.ex: He sadly said goodbye to his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他伤心地跟他的狗说了再见。
words.en: In a manner that expresses sorrow or unhappiness.

words.tr: v. 吹；“blow”的过去分词； adj. 胀起的；
words.ex: The wind blew the leaves away.
words.ex_cn: 风吹走了树叶。
words.en: Blown refers to something that has been shaped by blowing, especially glass, or to the state of being swollen or out of breath.

words.ex: He redesigned the website last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周重新设计了这个网站。
words.en: To design again or differently, typically in a way that improves the previous design.

words.ex: The archers shot arrows at the target.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手们向靶子射箭。
words.en: Individuals who use bows and arrows, especially in historical or sporting contexts.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.ex: Falcons fly high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 猎鹰在天空中高飞。
words.en: A falcon is a bird of prey that is known for its speed and ability to dive at high speeds to catch its prey.

words.ex: I watched a clip of the movie on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我在YouTube上看了这部电影的一个片段。
words.en: A clip is a small device, usually made of metal or plastic, that is specially shaped for holding things together. As a verb, to clip means to cut something, especially to make it shorter or neater.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.ex: His childish laugh made everyone smile.
words.ex_cn: 他孩子气的笑声让每个人都笑了。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially an adult, as childish, you disapprove of them because they behave in an immature way.

words.ex: The dog bit hard and broke the jawbone.
words.ex_cn: 狗咬得很用力，把颚骨咬断了。
words.en: The jawbone is the bone that forms the lower jaw in humans and other vertebrates. As a verb, to jawbone means to use one's influence or authority to persuade or pressure someone to do something.

words.ex: The children love watching animated movies.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢看动画电影。
words.en: Animated means full of life or excitement, or made to appear to move as if by magic or technology.

words.ex: The warmed blanket felt cozy on the cold night.
words.ex_cn: 温暖的毯子在寒冷的夜晚感觉很舒适。
words.en: Made or become warm or warmer.

words.tr: adj. 糊涂的；混乱的； v. “muddle”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He gave a muddled answer to the simple question.
words.ex_cn: 他对简单的问题给出了一个糊涂的回答。
words.en: If you describe something as muddled, you mean that it is confused or disorganized.

words.ex: The project cost overrun the budget.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的成本超过了预算。
words.en: If an army or a group of people overruns a place, they take control of it by force. If something such as a place or a piece of land is overrun by things or people, it is filled with them and they spread everywhere.

words.ex: The storm caused many catastrophes.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了许多灾难。
words.en: A catastrophe is an extremely bad event that causes great suffering or destruction.

words.ex: He told me some myths about the moon.
words.ex_cn: 他给我讲了一些关于月亮的神话。
words.en: Myths are traditional stories, especially concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.ex: He bought the toy on a whim.
words.ex_cn: 他一时兴起买了这个玩具。
words.en: A whim is a sudden desire or change of mind, especially one that is unusual or unexplained.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.ex: Ancient civilisations built great temples.
words.ex_cn: 古代文明建造了伟大的神庙。
words.en: Complex societies with developed social, cultural, and political systems, often marked by advancements in arts and sciences.

words.ex: She kindly helped me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 她亲切地帮我做作业。
words.en: If someone is kindly, they are friendly and behave in a gentle and caring way.

words.ex: He depended on his parents for money.
words.ex_cn: 他依赖父母给钱。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply.

words.ex: The weather forecasts predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: A forecast is a statement of what is expected to happen in the future, especially in relation to a particular event or situation.

words.ex: Astronomers watch stars at night.
words.ex_cn: 天文学家在晚上观察星星。
words.en: Astronomers are scientists who study celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；
words.ex: This result is noteworthy because it changes our understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个结果值得注意，因为它改变了我们的理解。
words.en: If you describe something as noteworthy, you mean that it is interesting, significant, or important enough to deserve attention or to be noticed.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动；
n. 影响；支配；
words.ex: The tree branches sway in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树的枝条在风中摇摆。
words.en: To sway means to move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side. It can also mean to influence someone or something.

words.tr: v. 企图；试图；“attempt”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He attempted to steal the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他企图偷那辆自行车。
words.en: An attempted action is one that someone has tried to do but has not succeeded in doing.

words.tr: adj. 天空的；天体的；天国的；
words.ex: The celestial lights shone brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中的光芒在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Relating to the sky or the heavens; belonging or relating to heaven as the abode of the gods.

words.tr: n. （图画中圣人头上的）光环，灵光( halo的名词复数 )
words.ex: The painting shows saints with golden haloes above their heads.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了圣人头上有着金色的光环。
words.en: A circle of light shown around or above the head of a saint or holy person to represent their holiness.

words.ex: The stars shine brightly at night.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜晚明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Stars are celestial bodies that appear as points of light in the night sky. They are massive, luminous spheres of plasma held together by gravity.

words.ex: Comets fly through space and have long tails.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在太空中飞行，有长长的尾巴。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.tr: v. 快速移动；（因吃惊、害怕或激动而）猛地一动；跳( jump的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The cat jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫快速移动跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To push yourself off the ground and into the air using your legs and feet.

words.tr: v. 呼吸； adj. 无声的，有气的 v. 呼吸( breathe的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He breathed deeply after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完后深呼吸了一下。
words.en: Having or showing life; alive.

words.tr: v. 改正； adj. 改正，矫正( rectify的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He rectified the mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了作业中的错误。
words.en: If someone rectifies something that is wrong, they change it so that it becomes correct or satisfactory.

words.ex: My grandmother often tells proverbs to teach me life lessons.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶经常用谚语来教我人生道理。
words.en: A proverb is a short, commonly known saying that expresses a truth based on common sense or experience.

words.ex: The children felt delight when they saw the toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到玩具时感到高兴。
words.en: Delight is a feeling of very great pleasure.

words.ex: Meteorologists predict the weather every day.
words.ex_cn: 气象学家每天预测天气。
words.en: A meteorologist is a scientist who studies the atmosphere and its phenomena, especially in relation to weather and weather forecasting.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: The vanes on the roof show the wind direction.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶上的风向标显示风向。
words.en: A vane is a flat or curved surface that is designed to catch the wind and turn or to guide the flow of air or water.

words.ex: He uses gauges to check the pressure in the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他用仪表来检查机器中的压力。
words.en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the measurement. It can also refer to a standard measure or scale of measurement. As a verb, to gauge means to measure or estimate the amount, level, or size of something.

words.ex: The hygrometer shows the humidity in the room.
words.ex_cn: 湿度计显示房间里的湿度。
words.en: A hygrometer is an instrument used for measuring the moisture content in the atmosphere.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: Some inventions help people every day.
words.ex_cn: 一些发明每天都在帮助人们。
words.en: Inventions are new devices, methods, or processes that have been developed as a result of study and experimentation.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.ex: The temperature decreases at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度降低。
words.en: If something decreases or if you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.tr: v. 证实；“verify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The scientist verified the results with a second test.
words.ex_cn: 科学家用第二次实验证实了结果。
words.en: Confirmed as true or accurate by evidence or testimony.

words.ex: The astronomer looks at stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 这位天文学家通过望远镜观察星星。
words.en: An astronomer is a scientist who studies celestial bodies such as planets, stars, and galaxies.

words.ex: He sent a telegraph to his family.
words.ex_cn: 他给家人发了一封电报。
words.en: A system for transmitting messages from a distance along a wire, especially one creating signals by making and breaking an electrical connection.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.ex: He works in meteorology and predicts the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他从事气象学工作，预测天气。
words.en: Meteorology is the scientific study of the atmosphere and of atmospheric conditions, especially as they relate to weather and weather forecasting.

words.ex: He spoke into the microphone to be heard clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他对着麦克风说话，以便被清楚地听到。
words.en: A microphone is a device that is used to make sounds louder or to record them.

words.ex: The hotel has a large atrium with plants and sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有一个带植物和阳光的宽敞中庭。
words.en: An atrium is a part of the heart that receives blood from the veins, or a large open space within a building, often with a glass roof.

words.tr: n. 矿泉疗养地；矿泉城；水疗中心；
words.ex: They went to the spa to relax and drink mineral water.
words.ex_cn: 他们去矿泉疗养地放松并饮用矿泉水。
words.en: A spa is a place where people go to improve their health and relax by having treatments such as massages and facials, and by exercising and swimming.

words.ex: He gets massages every week to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都做按摩来放松。
words.en: Massages refer to the action of rubbing and kneading of the body with the hands, especially to relieve tension or pain.

words.tr: n. 面部按摩；美容，面部按摩( facial的名词复数 )；
words.ex: She loves to get facials every week.
words.ex_cn: 她每周都喜欢做面部按摩。
words.en: Facials refer to a beauty treatment for the face, typically including cleansing, exfoliation, extraction, creams, lotions, facial masks, peels, and massage.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.ex: He devotes his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他投入时间帮助孩子们。
words.en: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it.

words.ex: His behavioural changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to or involving behaviour.

words.ex: She sensibly saved money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 她明智地为将来存钱。
words.en: In a way that shows good judgment; reasonably.

words.ex: He is wallpapering his bedroom with blue flowers.
words.ex_cn: 他正在给卧室贴蓝色花朵的壁纸。
words.en: The act of covering the walls of a room with wallpaper.

words.tr: v.替人临时照看小孩【动名词】
words.ex: She is babysitting her neighbor's child after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后在帮邻居照看孩子。
words.en: The activity of taking care of someone's child or children while the parents are away, usually for a short period of time.

words.ex: The judge judged the case favourably.
words.ex_cn: 法官赞同地裁决了此案。
words.en: In a way that expresses approval or preference; advantageously.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with dementia last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有痴呆。
words.en: Dementia is a condition characterized by progressive or persistent loss of intellectual functioning, especially memory impairment, often associated with aging.

words.ex: The dressmaker made a new dress for the girl.
words.ex_cn: 女裁缝为这个女孩做了一条新裙子。
words.en: A dressmaker is a person who makes women's clothes, especially as their job.

words.ex: He spoke calmly even when he was angry.
words.ex_cn: 即使他很生气，他还是平静地说话。
words.en: In a calm manner; without agitation or strong emotion.

words.ex: The child felt helpless when he lost his mother.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子失去妈妈时，他感到无助。
words.en: Unable to defend oneself or to act without help.

words.ex: She waited patiently for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 她耐心地等公交车。
words.en: In a patient manner; with patience.

words.tr: v. 表达 (express的现在分词)；表达( express的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is expressing his feelings with simple words.
words.ex_cn: 他正用简单的词语表达自己的感受。
words.en: To convey or communicate (a thought, feeling, or idea) in words or by gestures and conduct.

words.ex: He is a drummer in a rock band.
words.ex_cn: 他是摇滚乐队的一名鼓手。
words.en: A drummer is a person who plays a drum or drums.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.tr: n. 长笛手；横笛吹奏者；
words.ex: The flautist played a soft melody at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 长笛手在音乐会上演奏了一段柔和的旋律。
words.en: A flautist is someone who plays the flute.

words.ex: The actors rehearse their lines every evening.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天晚上排练他们的台词。
words.en: To rehearse means to practice a play, piece of music, or other work for later public performance.

words.tr: adj. 似乎合理的；看似真实的；似乎可信的；看似真实的；
words.ex: His excuse sounded plausible.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口听起来似乎合理。
words.en: An explanation or statement that is plausible seems likely to be true or valid.

words.ex: The trumpeter played a loud song at the parade.
words.ex_cn: 小号手在游行中吹奏了一首响亮的曲子。
words.en: A trumpeter is a musician who plays the trumpet.

words.ex: The trombonists played loudly in the parade.
words.ex_cn: 长号手们在游行中大声演奏。
words.en: A trombonist is a musician who plays the trombone.

words.ex: He took a deep breath before jumping.
words.ex_cn: 他跳之前深吸了一口气。
words.en: The air taken into or expelled from the lungs.

words.ex: He plays the trombone in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹长号。
words.en: A trombone is a large brass musical instrument that you play by blowing into it and sliding a U-shaped tube in and out to change the length of the tube and produce different notes.

words.ex: He refuses to eat broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

words.ex: I admire my teacher for her patience.
words.ex_cn: 我钦佩我的老师有耐心。
words.en: If you admire someone or something, you like and respect them very much.

words.ex: The percussionists played drums and cymbals at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 敲击乐手在音乐会上演奏了鼓和钹。
words.en: A percussionist is a musician who plays percussion instruments, such as drums, cymbals, and xylophones, in an orchestra or band.

words.tr: v. 终结（finalise 的过去分词）
words.ex: The plan was finalised yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划昨天确定了。
words.en: To finalise something means to complete all the arrangements for it, especially by discussing or agreeing on the final details.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.tr: v. 作曲；撰写；“compose”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is composing a song for his daughter.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为女儿作一首歌。
words.en: The act of creating or putting together something, especially a piece of music or writing.

words.ex: He earns commissions from selling cars.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖车赚取佣金。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something. It can also refer to a payment to someone who sells goods which is directly related to the amount sold, or to the act of formally asking someone to do a special piece of work.

words.ex: The students wrote short compositions in class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在课堂上写了短篇作文。
words.en: Compositions refer to the works created by someone, especially in music, literature, or art. It can also mean the way in which a whole or mixture is made up.

words.tr: v. 探索；探究；探测；勘探；
words.ex: He explores the forest to find hidden paths.
words.ex_cn: 他探索森林以寻找隐藏的小路。
words.en: If you explore a place, you travel around it to find out what it is like. If you explore an idea or suggestion, you think about it or comment on it in detail, in order to assess it carefully.

words.tr: n. 迪吉里杜管（澳洲土著人的乐器）
words.ex: He plays the didgeridoo at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐节上演奏迪吉里杜管。
words.en: A wind instrument developed by Indigenous Australians of northern Australia, traditionally made from a hollowed-out tree trunk and producing a deep, resonant sound.

words.ex: Her expressive eyes showed all her feelings.
words.ex_cn: 她富有表情的眼睛展现了她所有的感情。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as expressive, you mean that their behaviour clearly indicates their feelings or intentions.

words.ex: The wire is connecting the two devices.
words.ex_cn: 这条电线正在连接两个设备。
words.en: To join or link together; to associate or consider as related.

words.ex: The staged play attracted a large audience.
words.ex_cn: 上演的戏剧吸引了大量观众。
words.en: Arranged or planned to happen in a particular way or at a particular time, especially for effect.

words.ex: He watched the Harry Potter trilogy last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他上周末看了《哈利·波特》三部曲。
words.en: A trilogy is a series of three books, plays, or films that have the same subject or the same characters.

words.ex: He plays a stringed instrument like a violin.
words.ex_cn: 他演奏一种弦乐器，比如小提琴。
words.en: Having strings or equipped with strings, especially referring to musical instruments.

words.tr: v. 哭泣；啜泣； adj. <主方>湿透的 v. 哭泣，啜泣( sob的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The child was sobbing after losing her toy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在丢了玩具后哭了起来。
words.en: Sobbing is the act of crying noisily, taking sudden, sharp breaths.

words.tr: n. 口哨声； v. “whistle”的现在分词；
words.ex: I heard the whistling of the wind through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 我听到了风穿过树木的口哨声。
words.en: The act of producing a tune or sound by forcing breath through a small hole between one's lips or teeth, or a device that makes a high sound by air or steam being forced through it.

words.tr: adj. 有帮助的；乐器的；仪器的；
words.ex: Her advice was instrumental in helping me pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对帮助我通过考试很有帮助。
words.en: If someone or something is instrumental in a process, plan, or system, they are one of the most important influences in causing it to happen.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.ex: The children played near the creek after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在小河旁玩耍。
words.en: A creek is a small, narrow stream or river.

words.tr: v. 使（某物）被遮暗；使（某物）被遮暗( overshadow的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The big storm overshadowed the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这场大风暴使日落黯然失色。
words.en: If an unpleasant event or feeling overshadows something, it makes it less happy or enjoyable.

words.tr: adj. 得分；得分，进球（score的过去式）；
words.ex: He scored 20 points in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中得了20分。
words.en: To score means to gain points, goals, or runs in a game or contest, or to make a cut or notch in something.

words.ex: He plays the clarinet in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹单簧管。
words.en: A clarinet is a musical instrument of the woodwind family in the shape of a pipe. You play the clarinet by blowing into it and covering and uncovering the holes with your fingers.

words.ex: He subconsciously picked up his pencil when he thought.
words.ex_cn: 当他思考时，他下意识地拿起了铅笔。
words.en: If you do something subconsciously, you do it without realizing that you are doing it.

words.ex: He learned a new phrase in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一个新的西班牙语短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.ex: He loves to listen to symphonies on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周日早上听交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is written for an orchestra to play.

words.ex: He plays concertos with the orchestra every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和管弦乐队演奏协奏曲。
words.en: A concerto is a musical composition usually composed in three parts or movements, in which one solo instrument is accompanied by an orchestra.

words.tr: adv. 深深地；深刻地；非常；
words.ex: She was deeply moved by the story.
words.ex_cn: 她被这个故事深深打动了。
words.en: To a great depth; profoundly.

words.ex: The party was a celebration of her graduation.
words.ex_cn: 这个派对是她毕业的庆祝。
words.en: A celebration is a special enjoyable event that people organize because something pleasant has happened or because it is someone's birthday or anniversary.

words.ex: The comet shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.ex: He is switching from tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从喝茶转换到喝咖啡。
words.en: The act of changing or exchanging something, especially in a system or process.

words.ex: He is a freelance graphic designer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名自由职业的平面设计师。
words.en: A freelance person is someone who does particular pieces of work for different organizations, rather than working all the time for a single organization.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.ex: This is his fiftieth birthday.
words.ex_cn: 这是他的五十岁生日。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number fifty in a series.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.tr: v. 俯瞰；忽视；“overlook”的现在分词；
words.ex: The hotel room is overlooking the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这间酒店房间俯瞰着大海。
words.en: If a building, window, or place overlooks something, it has a view of it, usually from above.

words.ex: She picked red roses for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲摘了红玫瑰。
words.en: Roses are a type of flower known for their beauty and fragrance, often used in gardens and as gifts.

words.ex: The birds made a soft chatter in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨鸟儿发出轻柔的啁啾声。
words.en: If you chatter, you talk quickly and continuously, usually about things which are not important.

words.tr: n. 代表；推销员；销售代表；发言人；
words.ex: He is the rep for our team.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们团队的代表。
words.en: A rep is a person who acts on behalf of a group or organization, especially in selling products or services.

words.ex: The rains came early this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年雨水来得早。
words.en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

words.ex: Scientists work at the observatory to study stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在天文台工作以研究恒星。
words.en: A building or place equipped for observation of natural phenomena (as in astronomy); also : an institution whose primary purpose is making such observations.

words.ex: Scientists use telescopes to see stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家用望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an instrument shaped like a tube with lenses inside it, used for making distant objects look larger and nearer.

words.ex: There was a dip in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额有所下降。
words.en: To dip something means to put it into a liquid and then take it out again.

words.ex: The rider rode his horse quickly across the field.
words.ex_cn: 骑手快速骑马穿过田野。
words.en: A rider is someone who rides a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle, or a clause added to a document that provides additional information or conditions.

words.ex: The horse canter around the field.
words.ex_cn: 马在田野里慢跑。
words.en: If a horse canters, it moves at a speed that is slower than a gallop but faster than a trot.

words.ex: They love watching musicals on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢在周末看音乐剧。
words.en: A musical is a play or film in which part of the story is sung to music.

words.ex: The students are wearing gowns for the graduation ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿着长袍参加毕业典礼。
words.en: A gown is a formal dress, typically worn on special occasions. It can also refer to a loose outer garment worn for sleeping or by judges, academics, etc.

words.ex: The riders are riding their bikes on the road.
words.ex_cn: 骑手们正在路上骑自行车。
words.en: Riders are people who ride horses, bicycles, motorcycles, etc., or additional clauses in a document.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他敲了敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.ex: The dancers practiced every day.
words.ex_cn: 这些舞者每天练习。
words.en: People who dance, especially as a profession or in a performance.

words.ex: He is conveying a message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向朋友传达一条信息。
words.en: To convey means to communicate or make known; to transport or carry from one place to another; to transfer or deliver (something, such as property) to another especially by a sealed writing.

words.tr: vt. 暗示；暗指；意味着（imply 的现在分词）；
words.ex: His silence was implying he disagreed.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他不同意。
words.en: If you imply that something is the case, you say something which indicates that it is the case in an indirect way.

words.ex: My sister's daughter is my niece.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹的女儿是我的侄女。
words.en: Someone's niece is the daughter of their sister or brother.

words.ex: He vividly described the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他鲜明地描述了日落。
words.en: In a way that produces powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: The children are playing with dolls.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩娃娃。
words.en: A doll is a child's toy that looks like a small person or baby.

words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If something reflects an attitude or situation, it shows that the attitude or situation exists or it shows what it is like.

words.tr:
n. 仙子；小精灵；
adj. 幻想中的；
words.ex: The little girl saw a fairy in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在花园里看到了一位仙子。
words.en: A fairy is a mythical being of folklore and romance usually having magic powers and dwelling on earth in close relationship with humans.

words.ex: He told tales about dragons and pirates.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了关于龙和海盗的故事。
words.en: A tale is a story, especially one that involves imaginary or exaggerated events.

words.tr: v. 遭遇海难； adj. 遭遇海难的；v. 遭遇海难，船只失事（shipwreck 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The sailors were shipwrecked on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 水手们遭遇海难，被困在一个小岛上。
words.en: If someone is shipwrecked, their ship has been destroyed in an accident at sea and they have managed to reach land.

words.ex: He gave a witty answer to the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师的问题给出了机智的回答。
words.en: Someone or something that is witty is amusing in a clever way.

words.ex: There are many wells in the village to get water.
words.ex_cn: 村子里有许多水井用来取水。
words.en: A well is a deep hole or shaft dug into the ground to obtain water, oil, gas, or brine.

words.ex: The child drew a semicircle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在纸上画了一个半圆。
words.en: A semicircle is half of a circle, or something that has the shape of half a circle.

words.ex: He wore a ceremonial robe for the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他为婚礼穿了一件仪式性的长袍。
words.en: relating to or used in a ceremony; formal

words.ex: The tsunami destroyed the village near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 海啸摧毁了海边的村庄。
words.en: A tsunami is a very large ocean wave caused by an underwater earthquake or volcanic eruption.

words.ex: He found a trove of old coins in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 他在阁楼上发现了一堆古钱币珍藏。
words.en: A trove is a valuable collection of objects.

words.tr: adj. 熙熙攘攘的； v. “bustle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The market is bustling with people.
words.ex_cn: 市场里人来人往，熙熙攘攘。
words.en: If a place is bustling, it is full of busy activity.

words.ex: The sunken ship lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 沉没的船位于海底。
words.en: Having descended below the surface; submerged or depressed.

words.ex: The divers explored the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员们探索了珊瑚礁。
words.en: Various; several; of different kinds.

words.ex: The museum displays ancient artefacts from Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了来自埃及的古代人工制品。
words.en: An artefact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.tr: adj. 自治的；有自治权的；自主的；
words.ex: The region has autonomous control over its education system.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区对其教育系统拥有自治权。
words.en: An autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself.

words.ex: The oil rigs work far out at sea.
words.ex_cn: 石油钻井平台在遥远的海面上工作。
words.en: Framework or equipment used for support, especially in sailing, climbing, or oil drilling.

words.ex: The company built new pipelines to carry oil.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司建造了新的管道来输送石油。
words.en: Pipelines are long pipes, typically underground, for conveying oil, gas, etc., over long distances.

words.ex: He used compasses to find north in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针在森林里找北方。
words.en: Compasses are instruments used for drawing circles or arcs or for measuring distances on maps. They consist of two legs connected at one end by a pivot.

words.ex: The submarine uses sonar to find objects underwater.
words.ex_cn: 潜艇使用声呐来发现水下的物体。
words.en: Sonar is a system for detecting objects under water by emitting sound pulses and detecting or measuring their return after being reflected.

words.ex: The truck used a winch to pull the car out of the mud.
words.ex_cn: 卡车用绞车把车从泥里拉出来。
words.en: A winch is a mechanical device that is used to pull in (wind up) or let out (wind out) or otherwise adjust the tension of a rope or wire rope. In its simplest form, it consists of a spool and attached hand crank.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.ex: The sea washed up old ship wrecks on the shore.
words.ex_cn: 海浪把旧船的残骸冲上了岸边。
words.en: The remains of something that has been badly damaged or destroyed, especially a ship or vehicle.

words.tr: adj. 静止的；不动的；休眠的；
words.ex: The resting lake reflected the sky.
words.ex_cn: 静止的湖面倒映着天空。
words.en: In a state of rest; not active or engaged in activity.

words.tr: v. 运送；运送( ferry的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They are ferrying supplies to the island.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在运送物资到岛上。
words.en: The act of transporting people or goods, especially across a body of water, using a boat or other vessel.

words.tr: adj. 预制的； v. “prefabricate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house was built with prefabricated parts.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是由预制构件建造的。
words.en: Prefabricated buildings or objects are built from parts that have been made in a factory and can be put together quickly.

words.ex: The statue is made of white marble.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由白色大理石制成。
words.en: Marble is a type of very hard rock which is used for making statues and for building. It is usually white with dark lines in it.

words.ex: The electromagnetic wave travels through space.
words.ex_cn: 电磁波在太空中传播。
words.en: Relating to the interrelation of electric currents or fields and magnetic fields.

words.ex: The company offloads old data to save space.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去掉旧数据以节省空间。
words.en: To offload means to remove goods from a vehicle or ship, or to transfer responsibility or work to someone else.

words.tr: n. 梁；桁；“beam”的复数； v. 发射电波；“beam”的复数；
words.ex: The bridge is supported by strong steel beams.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥由坚固的钢梁支撑。
words.en: 1. A beam is a line of light that shines from a bright object. 2. A beam is a long thick bar of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof or floor of a building. 3. If you beam, you smile broadly.

words.tr: n. 审视；（雷达）（屏面上的）光点；浏览( scan的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The teacher gave the tests a quick scan.
words.ex_cn: 老师快速审视了一下试卷。
words.en: To look at something carefully in order to detect some feature.

words.tr: adj. 引起兴趣的；引人入胜的； v. “intrigue”的现在分词；
words.ex: The mystery story was intriguing.
words.ex_cn: 这个侦探故事很引人入胜。
words.en: If you describe something as intriguing, you mean that it is interesting or strange.

words.ex: The map shows the coordinates of the treasure.
words.ex_cn: 地图显示了宝藏的坐标。
words.en: Coordinates refer to a set of numbers that determine the position of a point, line, or shape in space. As a verb, it means to bring different elements into a relationship that will ensure efficiency or harmony.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: If a person or a vehicle carries something, they take it from one place to another.

words.tr: n. 检查；视察；查看；审视；
words.ex: The teacher did an inspection of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师对教室进行了检查。
words.en: An inspection is an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed.

words.ex: The kitchen has many receptacles for trash.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有很多垃圾容器。
words.en: A receptacle is a container that is used to hold or store things. In electrical terms, it refers to a device into which an electric plug can be inserted to provide power to an appliance.

words.ex: The sugar dissolved in the water.
words.ex_cn: 糖溶解在水里。
words.en: Having been broken down or dispersed in a liquid; having been officially ended or dismissed.

words.ex: The ancient statue was made of terracotta.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代雕像由赤陶制成。
words.en: Terracotta is a type of fired clay, typically of a brownish-red color and unglazed, used as an ornamental building material and in modeling.

words.ex: She eats olive every day with bread.
words.ex_cn: 她每天和面包一起吃橄榄。
words.en: An olive is a small oval fruit with a hard stone and bitter flesh, green when unripe and bluish black when ripe, used as food and as a source of oil.

words.ex: He drinks wine with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃饭时喝葡萄酒。
words.en: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice.

words.tr: v. 计算；清点；“count”的现在分词； n. 计算；
words.ex: He is counting the apples in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 他正在计算篮子里的苹果数量。
words.en: The action of finding the number of elements of a finite set of objects.

words.ex: Moths fly around the lamp at night.
words.ex_cn: 飞蛾晚上在灯周围飞。
words.en: A moth is an insect similar to a butterfly that usually flies at night. Moths are attracted to light and are often considered pests because they can damage clothes and other materials.

words.ex: He stored firewood in the woodshed.
words.ex_cn: 他把柴火存放在柴棚里。
words.en: A woodshed is a small building where wood for fuel is stored.

words.ex: The camels walk across the sands slowly.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼缓慢地走过沙漠。
words.en: Sands refer to the tiny, loose grains of worn or disintegrated rock, found on beaches, deserts, etc.

words.ex: He put three spoons of sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他在茶里放了三勺糖。
words.en: A spoon is an implement consisting of a small, shallow oval or round bowl on a long handle, used for eating, stirring, and serving food.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了火腿。
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.ex: She added a tomato to her salad.
words.ex_cn: 她往沙拉里加了一个西红柿。
words.en: A tomato is a soft, red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable.

words.ex: He eats cheddar on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上吃切达奶酪。
words.en: A type of hard, pale yellow to orange cheese originally made in the English village of Cheddar.

words.ex: The children carry their lunchboxes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天带着午餐盒去学校。
words.en: A lunchbox is a small container that you carry your lunch in, to school or work.

words.tr:
n. 袋子；
v. 劫掠；
words.ex: He carried the apples in a burlap sack.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果装在一个麻布袋里。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material, used for storing or carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment or the act of looting a place.

words.ex: He bought a brass lamp at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个黄铜制品台灯。
words.en: Brass is a yellow-coloured metal made from copper and zinc. It is used especially for making ornaments and musical instruments.

words.ex: The keepers feed the animals every morning.
words.ex_cn: 饲养员每天早上喂动物。
words.en: A keeper is someone who is responsible for looking after something, especially something valuable or important.

words.ex: The convicts work in the garden every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些囚犯每天早上在花园里工作。
