words.ex: The sponge is absorbing water.
words.ex_cn: 海绵正在吸收水。
words.en: If something is absorbing, it is very interesting and holds your attention completely.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.ex: The cookie is crumbly and tastes sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这块饼干易碎，味道很甜。
words.en: Something that is crumbly breaks easily into small pieces.

words.ex: The vase retains its color even after years.
words.ex_cn: 这个花瓶即使过了多年仍保持它的颜色。
words.en: Keeps or continues to have or possess something.

words.ex: The food supply was inadequate for the number of people.
words.ex_cn: 食物供应对人数来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

words.ex: The hikers struggled across the rough terrain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿越了崎岖的地形。
words.en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

words.ex: The room was devoid of any furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间里全无家具。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is devoid of a quality or thing, you are emphasizing that they have none of it.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: Children like eating sugars in candies.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在糖果里吃糖。
words.en: Sugars are sweet-tasting, soluble carbohydrates, many of which are used in food.

words.tr: n. 霉菌；菌类；真菌；“fungus”的复数；
words.ex: The bread has fungi growing on it.
words.ex_cn: 面包上长了霉菌。
words.en: Fungi are a group of living organisms which are classified in their own kingdom. This means they are not animals, plants, or bacteria. Fungi include mushrooms, molds, and yeasts.

words.tr: v. 使混乱，扰乱；使混乱，扰乱( disrupt的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The storm disrupted the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴扰乱了火车时刻表。
words.en: If someone or something disrupts an event, system, or process, they cause difficulties that prevent it from continuing or operating in a normal way.

words.tr: v. （使）流干；（使）逐渐流走；喝光；喝干； n. 排水，泄水，排泄 v. （使）流干， （使）逐渐流走( drain的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The sun was draining the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 太阳正在使水坑干涸。
words.en: If you say that something is draining, you mean that it makes you feel very tired and exhausted.

words.tr: v. 驯养；使爱家；适应家庭生活；“domesticate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 喜欢家庭生活的；被驯养了的；
words.ex: Humans domesticated dogs thousands of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 人类在几千年前驯养了狗。
words.en: Domesticated animals or plants are those that have been tamed or cultivated by humans for companionship, food, or other uses, often altering their natural behaviors or characteristics to suit human needs.

words.tr: v. 放开；发布；释放( release的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was releasing the rope slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在慢慢放开绳子。
words.en: The act of making something available or setting free.

words.tr: v. 抽；喷涌出；“pump”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The pump pumped water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 水泵从井里抽水。
words.en: If someone is pumped, they are very excited or enthusiastic about something.

words.tr: adj. 不多的；适度的；谦虚的；
words.ex: He made a modest profit last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年的利润不多。
words.en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

words.ex: The growers harvest tomatoes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些种植者每天早上收获番茄。
words.en: Growers are people or companies that grow crops or plants, especially for sale.

words.ex: This plant has regenerative powers.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物具有再生能力。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by regeneration; able to regrow or be renewed.

words.ex: The soil is moist after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后土壤是潮湿的。
words.en: Slightly wet; damp or humid.

words.tr: v. 与……作斗争；防止，减轻（combat 的现在分词）；
words.ex: They are combating pollution by recycling more.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过更多回收利用来与污染作斗争。
words.en: To take action to reduce or prevent something bad or undesirable.

words.ex: He is conducting the students in a science project.
words.ex_cn: 他正在指导学生进行一个科学项目。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: He uses compost to make his garden soil richer.
words.ex_cn: 他用堆肥来使花园的土壤更肥沃。
words.en: Compost is a mixture of decaying organic matter, such as leaves and food scraps, used to improve soil structure and provide nutrients for plants.

words.ex: Farmers spread manure on the fields to help crops grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民把肥料撒在田里以帮助庄稼生长。
words.en: Manure is organic matter used as fertilizer in agriculture.

words.ex: The wind blew through the cornstalks in the field.
words.ex_cn: 风从田里的玉米秆中吹过。
words.en: The main stem of a corn plant, typically left in the ground after the ears of corn have been harvested.

words.ex: The children play on the lawn after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草坪上玩耍。
words.en: A lawn is an area of grass that is kept cut short and is usually part of someone's garden or yard, or part of a park.

words.ex: She added colorful trimmings to the dress.
words.ex_cn: 她在裙子上加了彩色的装饰。
words.en: The trimmings are the extra parts that are used to decorate or complete something, especially food.

words.tr: adj. 有希望的；有前途的； v. 承诺；答应；“promise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The young boy is a promising student.
words.ex_cn: 这个小男孩是个有希望的学生。
words.en: Showing signs of future success or achievement.

words.tr: n. 丰富；充实；浓缩；富集
words.ex: The school offers enrichment activities for gifted students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为天才学生提供拓展活动。
words.en: The act of improving or enhancing the quality or value of something.

words.tr: v. 耕作；培养；“cultivate”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farmers are cultivating rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民正在田里耕作水稻。
words.en: Developing or improving something, especially a skill, quality, or relationship, through careful effort and attention.

words.tr: n. 堆制肥料； v. “compost”的现在分词；
words.ex: He practices composting with kitchen waste.
words.ex_cn: 他用厨余垃圾进行堆肥。
words.en: Composting is the process of converting organic materials into a nutrient-rich soil amendment through natural decomposition.

words.ex: The scientist tested the theory experimentally.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家通过实验检验了这一理论。
words.en: In a way that relates to or is based on experiments.

words.ex: The computer performs basic operations quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机快速执行基本操作。
words.en: Operations refers to the organized activities or actions that are carried out to achieve a particular goal, especially in business or military contexts. It can also refer to the process of performing a surgical procedure.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.tr: v. 坚决主张；提出理由证明；争吵，辩论；
words.ex: He argues that everyone should have free education.
words.ex_cn: 他坚决主张每个人都应享有免费教育。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: The steamship crossed the ocean in five days.
words.ex_cn: 这艘轮船在五天内横渡了海洋。
words.en: A steamship is a ship that is powered by steam engines, especially one that carries passengers and cargo across the sea.

words.ex: The farmer grows wheat on his land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农场主在他的土地上种植小麦。
words.en: A farmer is a person who owns or manages a farm.

words.ex: The two groups munite to fight for justice.
words.ex_cn: 这两个团体联合起来为正义而斗争。
words.en: To unite or bring together, especially in a common cause or effort.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.tr: v. 喊；呼，喊，叫( shout的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He shouted for help when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时大喊求助。
words.en: Past simple and past participle of shout; to speak loudly and forcefully.

words.tr: adj. 不适宜的；不合适的；
words.ex: This shirt is unsuitable for the cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫不适合寒冷的天气。
words.en: If someone or something is unsuitable for a particular purpose or situation, they are not appropriate for it.

words.ex: She wears colorful bracelets on her wrist.
words.ex_cn: 她手腕上戴着彩色的手链。
words.en: Bracelets are decorative bands or chains worn around the wrist or arm. They can be made from various materials, including metal, leather, cloth, plastic, or other materials, and sometimes contain jewels, rocks, wood, and/or shells.

words.ex: She used a mixer to make the cake batter.
words.ex_cn: 她用搅拌器来做蛋糕面糊。
words.en: A mixer is a machine or device used for mixing things together, especially in cooking or in music production.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.ex: He smashed the glass with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把玻璃打碎了。
words.en: To break something into pieces violently and noisily, or to cause something to do this by dropping, throwing, or hitting it.

words.ex: She bought fresh perishables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了新鲜的易腐食品。
words.en: Perishables are goods, especially foodstuffs, that are liable to decay or spoil.

words.ex: We will brainstorm ideas for the project tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将为这个项目集思广益。
words.en: To brainstorm is to try to solve a problem or come up with new ideas by having a group of people discuss it and all suggest ideas.

words.tr: adj. 过时的；废弃的；淘汰的；
words.ex: This phone is obsolete because it doesn't work with new apps.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机已经过时了，因为它不能使用新应用。
words.en: Something that is obsolete is no longer needed because something better has been invented.

words.tr: v. 演变；进化；“evolve”的现在分词；
words.ex: The language is evolving slowly.
words.ex_cn: 这种语言正在缓慢地演变。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: The cat disappeared behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫从房子后面消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go away or are taken away so that you cannot see them any more.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: He follows the laws of his country.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守自己国家的法律。
words.en: Laws are the system of rules that a particular country or community recognizes as regulating the actions of its members and may enforce by the imposition of penalties.

words.tr: v. 联系起来；讲述；叙述；（把…）联系起来( relate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He relates the story to his own life.
words.ex_cn: 他将这个故事与自己的生活联系起来。
words.en: to tell or describe a series of events, or to show or establish a connection between two or more things

words.ex: The library keeps old newspapers in an archive.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧报纸保存在档案馆里。
words.en: A collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: The old gun backfires when he pulls the trigger.
words.ex_cn: 当他扣动扳机时，这把老枪向后爆发。
words.en: If a plan or project backfires, it has the opposite result to the one that was intended.

words.ex: They collaborate to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作完成这个项目。
words.en: to work jointly with others or together especially in an intellectual endeavor

words.ex: She played the piano brilliantly.
words.ex_cn: 她出色地弹奏了钢琴。
words.en: In a way that is very impressive or excellent.

words.ex: The rope is 150 centimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子长150厘米。
words.en: A unit of length in the metric system equal to one hundredth of a meter.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish or command.

words.ex: He has a natural aptitude for math.
words.ex_cn: 他天生有数学天赋。
words.en: An aptitude is a natural ability to do something.

words.ex: He solves math puzzles every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解数学谜题。
words.en: A puzzle is a game, toy, or problem designed to test ingenuity or knowledge. As a verb, it means to cause someone to feel confused because they cannot understand or make sense of something.

words.ex: There is an inconsistency between his words and actions.
words.ex_cn: 他的言行不一致。
words.en: The quality or state of being inconsistent; lack of consistency.

words.ex: He uses a smartphone to call his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他用智能手机给朋友打电话。
words.en: A smartphone is a mobile phone that can perform many of the functions of a computer, typically having a touchscreen interface, internet access, and an operating system capable of running downloaded applications.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: His industriousness helps him finish work early.
words.ex_cn: 他的勤奋让他能早早完成工作。
words.en: The quality of being hard-working and diligent.

words.ex: The hamster runs on its wheel at night.
words.ex_cn: 仓鼠晚上在轮子上跑步。
words.en: A hamster is a small furry animal with large cheeks for carrying food, which is often kept as a pet.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.ex: He was grapping the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧地抓住了绳子。
words.en: To seize or hold firmly.

words.ex: Children see many adverts on TV.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在电视上看到很多广告。
words.en: Adverts are notices or announcements in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event.

words.ex: He is the creator of that popular game.
words.ex_cn: 他是那个流行游戏的创作者。
words.en: A creator is someone who brings something into existence, especially someone who invents or designs something new.

words.tr: v. 源于；（从…中）得到获得；
words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源于拉丁语。
words.en: If you derive something such as pleasure or benefit from a person or from something, you get it from them.

words.ex: He wrongly answered the question.
words.ex_cn: 他错误地回答了这个问题。
words.en: Incorrectly or unjustly.

words.ex: He assumes it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you imagine that it is true, sometimes wrongly.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.tr: v. 指挥；控制；命令；掌握；指挥，控制，命令( command的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The general commanded the soldiers to march forward.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥士兵向前行进。
words.en: To give an authoritative order; to be in charge or control of a group of people.

words.tr: n. 收集；采集；聚会；聚集； v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的现在分词；
words.ex: The gathering of old books took him years.
words.ex_cn: 收集旧书花了他多年时间。
words.en: A gathering is a group of people meeting together for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He was officially appointed as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 他被正式任命为新经理。
words.en: In a formal or authoritative manner; according to the rules or laws.

words.ex: The councillors voted to fix the road.
words.ex_cn: 这些议员投票决定修路。
words.en: Councillors are members of a council, especially a local government council.

words.ex: The choir sings every Sunday in church.
words.ex_cn: 唱诗班每周日在教堂唱歌。
words.en: A choir is a group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school.

words.ex: The cadets march every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些学员每天早上列队行进。
words.en: A cadet is a young person who is being trained in the armed forces or the police.

words.tr: v. 庆祝；庆贺； vt. 庆祝（现在进行时 ing形式） v. 庆祝，庆贺( celebrate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They are celebrating his birthday with a cake.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在用蛋糕庆祝他的生日。
words.en: Marking a special occasion with enjoyment and festivities.

words.tr: n. 一百周年纪念；一百年；
words.ex: The town held a party for the centenary of its founding.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇为建镇一百周年纪念举行了派对。
words.en: A centenary is the one hundredth anniversary of a significant event.

words.ex: Children laughed as the firework lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看着焰火点亮夜空，哈哈大笑。
words.en: A firework is a small device that is lit to produce a display of light, noise, and smoke, often used in celebrations.

words.ex: The company has a simple logo on its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的产品上有一个简单的标志。
words.en: A logo is a design or symbol used by a company to identify its products, services, or itself.

words.ex: He is finalising the report before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他正在完成报告，以便在会议前提交。
words.en: To finalise something means to complete all the details of it, especially in order to agree on or arrange something.

words.ex: The operator answered the phone quickly.
words.ex_cn: 接线员迅速接听了电话。
words.en: An operator is a person who operates equipment or a machine, or a person who is in charge of a telephone switchboard.

words.tr: v. （与某人）联络；做联络人，联络( liaise的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The manager liaised with the team to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 经理与团队联络以解决问题。
words.en: To liaise means to act as a link to assist communication or cooperation between people or groups.

words.ex: He confesses that he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you confess to doing something, you admit that you did it.

words.ex: The movie's premiere was held last night.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的首映昨晚举行。
words.en: The first public performance of a play, film, or other form of entertainment.

words.ex: She wore a dressy dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件考究的连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's clothes as dressy, you mean that they are smart or formal.

words.ex: She wore a dress for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为了这个特殊场合穿了一条裙子。
words.en: An occasion is a particular time when something happens, or a special event.

words.tr:
adj. 多媒体的；
n. 多媒体；
words.ex: The school uses multimedia tools to teach students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用多媒体工具来教学。
words.en: Multimedia is the use of computers to present text, graphics, video, animation, and sound in an integrated way.

words.ex: The movie's soundtrack played softly during the ending scene.
words.ex_cn: 电影的配乐在结尾场景中轻轻播放。
words.en: The soundtrack is the music that has been specially written for a film.

words.tr: v. 引起；引起( arouse的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The movie aroused his curiosity.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影引起了他的好奇心。
words.en: Aroused interest or excitement; stimulated sexually or emotionally.

words.ex: The president welcomed the dignitaries at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 总统在仪式上欢迎了各位政要。
words.en: Dignitaries are people who are considered to be important because they have a high rank in government or in a church.

words.ex: The connections between the wires are loose.
words.ex_cn: 这些电线之间的连接松了。
words.en: Connections refer to the relationships or links between people, things, or ideas. It can also mean the act of connecting or the state of being connected.

words.ex: He is translating a book from Chinese to English.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把一本中文书翻译成英文。
words.en: The act or process of changing something, such as words or text, from one language into another.

words.ex: He loves reading old sagas about heroes.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读关于英雄的古老传说。
words.en: A long, detailed story of heroic or legendary events.

words.ex: The playwrights wrote a new play last year.
words.ex_cn: 剧作家们去年写了一部新剧。
words.en: A playwright is a person who writes plays.

words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.tr: n. 神话；神话学；神话集；
words.ex: He loves reading Greek mythology.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读希腊神话。
words.en: Mythology is a collection of myths, especially one belonging to a particular religious or cultural tradition.

words.ex: The child loves to play with fantasy stories about dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢玩关于龙的幻想故事。
words.en: A fantasy is a pleasant situation or event that you imagine, which is unlikely to happen.

words.ex: His provocative words made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他挑衅的话让所有人都生气了。
words.en: If you describe something as provocative, you mean that it is intended to make people react angrily or argue against it.

words.ex: He learns new phrases every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习新的短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.ex: Everyone has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有自由发言的权利。
words.en: Rights are legal, social, or ethical principles of freedom or entitlement; that is, rights are the fundamental normative rules about what is allowed of people or owed to people, according to some legal system, social convention, or ethical theory.

words.ex: He gave a laboured smile, tired from the long day.
words.ex_cn: 他露出一个吃力的微笑，因为漫长的一天而疲惫。
words.en: If something is laboured, it is done with a lot of effort, often in a way that is not natural or relaxed.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.ex: His behavior is unacceptable.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为是不可接受的。
words.en: If you describe something as unacceptable, you strongly disapprove of it or object to it and feel that it should not be allowed to continue.

words.ex: The small spider is harmless.
words.ex_cn: 这只小蜘蛛是无害的。
words.en: If someone or something is harmless, they are not dangerous and do not cause any harm.

words.ex: He is bullying his little brother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在欺负他的弟弟。
words.en: The use of strength or influence to harm or intimidate those who are weaker.

words.ex: The child is behaving well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上行为良好。
words.en: to act or conduct oneself in a specified way, especially towards others.

words.ex: He spoke abusively to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他暴虐地对孩子们说话。
words.en: In a manner that involves the improper use or treatment of something, or that involves insulting or offensive language.

words.ex: He shouted aggressively at the other driver.
words.ex_cn: 他挑衅地对另一名司机大喊。
words.en: If you do something aggressively, you do it in a forceful and determined way.

words.ex: His superiority in math helped him win the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的优越让他赢得了比赛。
words.en: If one side in a war or conflict has superiority, it has an advantage over its enemy, for example because it has more soldiers or better equipment.

words.ex: The lowest temperature was recorded at night.
words.ex_cn: 最低温度是在夜间记录的。
words.en: Lowest means the smallest in size, amount, degree, or intensity. It is the superlative form of 'low'.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.ex: He dislikes eating broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢吃西兰花。
words.en: If you dislike someone or something, you consider them to be unpleasant and do not like them.

words.tr: adj. 不兼容的；不相配的；
words.ex: The software is incompatible with old systems.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件与旧系统不兼容。
words.en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they are very different in important ways, and do not suit each other or agree with each other.

words.tr: n. 乐观；乐观主义；乐观精神；
words.ex: His optimism helps him stay happy even when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他的乐观让他即使在困难时也能保持快乐。
words.en: Optimism is a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something.

words.ex: He is intolerant of people who are late.
words.ex_cn: 他不能容忍迟到的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as intolerant, you mean that they do not accept behavior and opinions that are different from their own.

words.ex: He is pessimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持悲观态度。
words.en: If someone is pessimistic, they expect that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result.

words.ex: The evidence justifies his decision.
words.ex_cn: 证据证明了他的决定是有道理的。
words.en: To justify means to show or prove to be right or reasonable.

words.ex: The bridge has a strong structural design.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构设计。
words.en: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr: n. 崩溃；故障；细目分类；
words.ex: The stress led to a breakdown.
words.ex_cn: 压力导致了崩溃。
words.en: A breakdown is a failure of a system, machine, or relationship, or a sudden collapse in someone's mental health.

words.ex: The executives meet every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 高管们每周一开会。
words.en: Executives are people who have the power to make decisions and control a company or organization.

words.tr: v. 发现； adj. 无盖的，未保险的 v. 揭开…的盖子( uncover的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The detective uncovered the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探发现了真相。
words.en: If something is uncovered, it has no covering or protection.

words.tr: adj. 对立的； v. 反对；“oppose”的现在分词；
words.ex: The two teams have opposing views on the rule change.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍对规则修改持有对立的观点。
words.en: If you are opposing someone or something, you are competing against them or trying to prevent them from doing something.

words.ex: He has big visions for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来有远大的愿景。
words.en: The ability to see or the experience of seeing. Also, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc., could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way.

words.ex: He made a strategic decision to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了一个有战略性的决定来省钱。
words.en: Relating to the identification of long-term or overall aims and interests and the means of achieving them.

words.ex: The autocratic leader made all decisions without asking others.
words.ex_cn: 这位独裁的领导人独自做出所有决定，从不询问他人。
words.en: If you describe someone as autocratic, you are criticizing them because they have complete power and make decisions without asking anyone else's advice.

words.ex: There is uncertainty about the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天的天气还不确定。
words.en: Uncertainty is a situation in which something is not known, or something that is not known or certain.

words.ex: His politeness made everyone feel welcome.
words.ex_cn: 他的礼貌让每个人都感到受欢迎。
words.en: Politeness is the practical application of good manners or etiquette so as not to offend others.

words.tr: n. 同等的人；相等物；“equal”的复数； v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: He thinks he has no equals in chess.
words.ex_cn: 他认为在国际象棋上没有人能和他匹敌。
words.en: If one thing equals another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: The journalist was seen as the mouthpiece of the government.
words.ex_cn: 这位记者被视为政府的喉舌。
words.en: A mouthpiece is a part of a musical instrument, telephone, or other device that you put in or near your mouth. It can also refer to a person, newspaper, etc., that expresses the opinions and policies of a government or organization.

words.ex: The mediator helped the two sides reach an agreement.
words.ex_cn: 调解人帮助双方达成了协议。
words.en: A mediator is a person who tries to end a disagreement by helping the two sides to talk about and agree on a solution.

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.ex: He is wanting a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一辆新自行车。
words.en: If something is wanting, it is lacking or not good enough in a particular way.

words.ex: He eats eggs but watches his cholesterol.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋，但注意自己的胆固醇。
words.en: Cholesterol is a substance that exists in the cells of the body and in blood, which can cause heart disease if there is too much of it.

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.ex: He said greetings to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们问好。
words.en: A greeting is something friendly that you say or do when you meet someone.

words.ex: He collects old stamps from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的旧邮票。
words.en: Stamps are small pieces of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it. They show that you have paid to send the letter or package.

words.tr: adj. 很少；（与复数名词和复数动词连用）有些；
words.ex: He has the fewest apples among his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他朋友中他的苹果最少。
words.en: The superlative form of 'few', meaning the smallest number or amount.

words.tr:
adj. 稳定的；
v. 使稳住；
words.ex: The boat moved in a steady way on the calm sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在平静的海面上平稳地移动。
words.en: If something is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about. If you steady something, you stop it from shaking or moving about.

words.ex: She was noticing the changes in her garden every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都在注意花园里的变化。
words.en: To become aware of something or someone by seeing, hearing, or feeling them.

words.tr: n. 漂流； v. “raft”的现在分词；
words.ex: We went rafting down the river last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去河上漂流了。
words.en: Rafting is the sport or activity of travelling down a river on a raft.

words.ex: The roller coaster gave her a thrill.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让她感到兴奋。
words.en: A thrill is a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

words.tr: n. 习俗；习惯；关税；海关；“custom”的复数；
words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日里点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: The place at a port, airport, or border where officials check the goods or luggage of people entering or leaving a country, and where they collect taxes on goods being imported.

words.tr: adj. 个人化的； v. “personalize”的过去式；
words.ex: He bought a personalised mug with his name on it.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个印有他名字的个性化杯子。
words.en: Something that is personalised is designed or made for a particular person, often with their name or initials on it.

words.tr: adj. 订做的； v. 调整使适应；“tailor”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He wore a tailored suit to the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件订做的西装去面试。
words.en: Made or adapted for a particular purpose or individual.

words.tr: v. 访问；面试( interview的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is interviewing people about their daily habits.
words.ex_cn: 他正在访问人们关于他们的日常习惯。
words.en: The act of conducting an interview, especially as part of a job application process or for journalistic purposes.

words.tr: v. 监管；监督；看到，无意中看到（oversee 的现在分词）；
words.ex: The manager is overseeing the project.
words.ex_cn: 经理正在监管这个项目。
words.en: To supervise or watch over a task, project, or group of people to ensure that it is done correctly.

words.ex: The test has only numerical answers.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试只有数字答案。
words.en: Numerical means relating to numbers or consisting of numbers.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.ex: The children noticed regularities in the number patterns.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们注意到了数字模式中的规律。
words.en: Regularities refer to the state or quality of being regular, consistent, or uniform in pattern or arrangement.

words.ex: He draws graphs to show the data.
words.ex_cn: 他画图表来展示数据。
words.en: A diagram that represents the variation of a variable in comparison with that of one or more other variables.

words.tr: v. 处理；称呼；称呼（address的现在分词）；
words.ex: The government is addressing the problem of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在处理污染问题。
words.en: To deal with a problem or issue; to speak to an audience; to write the name and address on an envelope or package.

words.tr:
v. 附着；粘贴；
adj. 粘或有粘性的；
words.ex: The sticker is sticking to the table.
words.ex_cn: 贴纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: The present participle of the verb 'stick', which means to attach something to something else using a sticky substance, to continue doing something despite difficulties, or to extend out from a surface.

words.tr: v. 执行；强制；“enforce”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 强制性的；
words.ex: The police enforced the new traffic law.
words.ex_cn: 警察执行了新的交通法规。
words.en: If someone in authority enforces a law or a rule, they make sure that it is obeyed, usually by punishing people who do not obey it.

words.ex: The silvery moon lit up the lake.
words.ex_cn: 银色的月光照亮了湖面。
words.en: Something that is silvery looks like silver or is the color of silver.

words.ex: People use thermometers to check body temperature.
words.ex_cn: 人们用体温计来检查体温。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature, typically one consisting of a narrow, hermetically sealed glass tube marked with graduations and having at one end a bulb containing mercury or alcohol which extends along the tube as it expands.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；烧伤；“burn”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The wood burned in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 木头在壁炉里燃烧了。
words.en: If there is a fire or a flame somewhere, you say that it is burning. If something is burning, it is on fire.

words.tr: v. 排泄； adj. 分泌（excrete 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The body excreted waste through the kidneys.
words.ex_cn: 身体通过肾脏排泄废物。
words.en: To excrete means to separate and eliminate or discharge (waste) from the body or an organism.

words.ex: He enters the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To come or go into a place or to become a member of a group or organization.

words.tr: n. 中毒； v. “poison”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child suffered from poisoning after eating the berries.
words.ex_cn: 孩子吃了这些浆果后中毒了。
words.en: The act or process of administering poison or becoming poisoned.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.ex: He has good chances to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他有很大的机会赢得比赛。
words.en: The likelihood of something happening; an opportunity to do or achieve something.

words.ex: The experimenter recorded the results carefully.
words.ex_cn: 实验者仔细记录了结果。
words.en: A person who conducts experiments, especially in a scientific context.

words.ex: Birds are migratory in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天是迁徙的。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by migration; tending to migrate.

words.ex: The evidence warrants a new investigation.
words.ex_cn: 证据使新的调查成为必要。
words.en: If something warrants a particular action, it makes the action seem necessary or appropriate for the circumstances.

words.ex: This program supports developmental milestones in children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目支持儿童的发展阶段。
words.en: Developmental is an adjective that describes something related to the growth or development of someone or something.

words.ex: The delays caused the train to arrive late.
words.ex_cn: 这些延迟导致火车晚点了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.tr: n. 获得；得到的东西；收购；
words.ex: The acquisition of new skills takes time.
words.ex_cn: 获得新技能需要时间。
words.en: An acquisition is something that someone buys, often to add to a collection of things.

words.ex: Genes determine eye color and height.
words.ex_cn: 基因决定眼睛颜色和身高。
words.en: Genes are the parts of cells in living things that control what they look like, how they grow, and how they develop. They are passed from parents to their children.

words.tr: adj. 未出世的；未诞生的；未来的；
words.ex: The unborn baby moved gently in the womb.
words.ex_cn: 未出世的婴儿在子宫里轻轻蠕动。
words.en: Not yet born; still to be born.

words.ex: There are billions of stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有数十亿颗星星。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of a thousand and a million; 1,000,000,000 or 10^9.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.ex: Papa is cooking breakfast for us.
words.ex_cn: 爸爸正在为我们做早餐。
words.en: A term of endearment for one's father.

words.tr: v. 重新开发；重建，重新开发( redevelop的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The old factory was redeveloped into a park.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧工厂被重新开发成了一个公园。
words.en: To develop again or differently; to improve an area by building new houses, shops, etc.

words.tr: n. 嗡嗡响； adj. 嗡嗡响的； v. “buzz”的现在分词；
words.ex: The bees were buzzing around the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花周围嗡嗡响。
words.en: If a place is buzzing, it is full of activity and excitement.

words.ex: He enjoys the nightlife in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢城市里的夜生活。
words.en: Nightlife refers to the entertainment and social activities available in a city or town at night, such as bars, clubs, and restaurants.

words.tr: v. 从事；乘船( embark的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is embarking on a new business.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从事一项新的生意。
words.en: To start a journey, especially on a ship or aircraft; to start doing something new or different.

words.ex: He dreams of other worlds.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想着其他世界。
words.en: The term 'worlds' refers to the earth and all life on it, including human civilization, or a particular group of living things and the environment they live in. It can also denote a particular domain or sphere of activity.

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

words.ex: The bread has many fibres.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包含有许多纤维。
words.en: Fibres are thin, thread-like structures that are found in plants and animals, used in the manufacture of textiles and other materials.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.ex: He made three entries in the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了三项比赛。
words.en: Entries refer to the act of entering or the right to enter a place, or an item written or printed in a diary, list, account book, etc.

words.ex: The village held a gala to celebrate the harvest.
words.ex_cn: 村庄举办了一个节日来庆祝丰收。
words.en: A gala is a special public celebration, entertainment, performance, or festival.

words.ex: Children play near the roadsides after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在路边玩耍。
words.en: The area adjacent to the edge of a road.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.tr: v. 购买；采购；“purchase”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is purchasing a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他正在购买一部新手机。
words.en: the activity of buying goods or services

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.tr: adj. 忠实的；虔诚的；可靠的；
words.ex: He is a faithful friend who always helps me.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是帮助我的忠实朋友。
words.en: Someone who is faithful remains loyal to a person, belief, or cause, and continues to support them.

words.tr: n. 爱国主义；爱国精神；
words.ex: He showed patriotism by serving his country in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在军队中为国家服务表现出爱国主义。
words.en: Patriotism is the love and devotion to one's country.

words.tr: adj. 未固定牢的；宽松的；
words.ex: The loose screw fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 那个松动的螺丝从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.

words.ex: He has two sons.
words.ex_cn: 他有两个儿子。
words.en: The male offspring of a person or animal.

words.ex: The king sat on the throne.
words.ex_cn: 国王坐在王位上。
words.en: The throne is the special chair used by a king, queen, or emperor during ceremonies, or the position of being a ruler.

words.tr: vi. 长期不和（feud的现在分词形式）
words.ex: The two families are feuding over land.
words.ex_cn: 这两个家族因土地而争吵。
words.en: Feuding refers to a prolonged mutual hostility, typically between two families, groups, or individuals, characterized by a series of retaliatory acts or disputes.

words.ex: Ancient empires grew large and powerful.
words.ex_cn: 古代帝国变得庞大而强大。
words.en: An empire is a group of countries or regions that are controlled by one ruler or government. It can also refer to a large and powerful organization or group of organizations.

words.tr: v. （使）统一；（使）联合；（使）成一体；“unify”的现在分词；
words.ex: The teacher tried unifying the class with one rule.
words.ex_cn: 老师试图用一条规则统一全班。
words.en: Making or becoming united, uniform, or whole.

words.ex: The stylistic choice of words made the poem more beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 词语的文体选择使这首诗更加优美。
words.en: Relating to the style or manner of something, especially in literature or art.

words.ex: She blends flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To mix substances together so that they combine into a single substance.

words.ex: The loud music was 90 decibels.
words.ex_cn: 那首音乐很响，有90分贝。
words.en: A decibel is a unit used to measure the intensity of a sound or the power level of an electrical signal by comparing it with a given level on a logarithmic scale.

words.tr: n. 米；公尺；仪表；计量仪；
words.ex: The table is two meters long.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子两米长。
words.en: A meter is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to 100 centimeters. It can also refer to a device that measures and records the quantity, degree, or rate of something, such as electricity or gas.

words.ex: His perceptions of success are different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对成功的观念与我的不同。
words.en: The way in which something is regarded, understood, or interpreted.

words.ex: He lived in a crude hut with no electricity.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个没有电的简陋小屋里。
words.en: A crude substance or product is in its natural state and has not been processed or refined.

words.tr: v. 提升；饲养；筹募；增加；“raise”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is raising his voice to be heard.
words.ex_cn: 他提高声音以便被人听到。
words.en: The act of increasing something in amount or size, or the process of bringing up and educating children.

words.ex: Schoolchildren walk to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 学童每天早上走路去学校。
words.en: Schoolchildren are children who attend school.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.tr: adj. 各学科间的；跨学科的；
words.ex: The project is interdisciplinary, combining biology and chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是跨学科的，结合了生物学和化学。
words.en: Involving two or more academic, scientific, or artistic disciplines.

words.ex: His words were contradictory.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: If two or more facts, ideas, or statements are contradictory, they state or imply that opposite things are true.

words.ex: The clack of the typewriter filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 打字机的哒哒声充满了房间。
words.en: If things clack, they make a short loud noise, especially when they hit each other.

words.ex: The snake made a loud hiss.
words.ex_cn: 蛇发出了响亮的嘶嘶声。
words.en: To make a sharp sound like that of the letter s prolonged, as a snake does, or as steam does when forced under pressure through a small opening.

words.ex: His intrusive questions made her uncomfortable.
words.ex_cn: 他打搅的问题让她感到不舒服。
words.en: Something that is intrusive disturbs your privacy or peace in an unwanted way.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: The law governs how people drive.
words.ex_cn: 法律控制人们开车的方式。
words.en: To govern means to control and direct the public business of a country, city, group of people, etc.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；
words.ex: The two magnets interact when they are close.
words.ex_cn: 当两个磁铁靠近时，它们会互相作用。
words.en: to communicate with or react to each other

words.ex: The children were silent during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在看电影时很安静。
words.en: Someone or something that is silent makes no noise at all.

words.ex: They explored the forest to find the hidden cave.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索了森林，寻找那个隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To travel through or examine a place or an area in order to learn about it.

words.ex: He cut the bread with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切面包。
words.en: A knife is a tool for cutting or a weapon, consisting of a flat piece of metal with a sharp edge on the end of a handle.

words.tr: n. 磨快；磨尖 v. （使）提高( sharpen的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The sharpening of the knife took only a few minutes.
words.ex_cn: 把刀磨快只花了几分钟。
words.en: The act of making something sharp or sharper, or the process of becoming sharp or sharper.

words.tr: v. 概括；总结； vt. 概括，总结（summarise 的现在分词）；
words.ex: He is summarising the main points of the story.
words.ex_cn: 他正在概括这个故事的主要内容。
words.en: Presenting the main points of a text or situation in a concise form.

words.ex: He was dropping his keys on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把钥匙掉在地板上。
words.en: The act of falling or being allowed to fall vertically; the act of delivering something by parachute.

words.ex: He made three proposals for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个项目提出了三个建议。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for consideration by others.

words.ex: The child obeys his mother.
words.ex_cn: 孩子听从妈妈的话。
words.en: If you obey a person, a command, or an instruction, you do what you are told to do.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.tr: v. 禁止；不准；“forbid”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign forbids parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志禁止在这里停车。
words.en: If you describe something as forbidding, you mean it has a severe, unfriendly, or threatening appearance.

words.ex: They widened the road to fit more cars.
words.ex_cn: 他们加宽了这条路，以便容纳更多汽车。
words.en: To make or become wider.

words.ex: The loading of the cargo took three hours.
words.ex_cn: 货物的装载花了三个小时。
words.en: The process of loading something, especially data or cargo, onto a vehicle, ship, or computer system.

words.tr: n. 卸载；卸载 v. 从…卸下货物( unload的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The unloading of the cargo took three hours.
words.ex_cn: 货物的卸载花了三个小时。
words.en: The act of removing goods from a vehicle or vessel.

words.tr: adv. 遗传上地；基因上地；
words.ex: The dogs are genetically similar to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗在遗传上彼此相似。
words.en: In a way that relates to genes or heredity.

words.tr: adj. 改良的；改进的；修正的； v. 更改；修饰；“modify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The modified version works better than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 改良后的版本比旧版本更好用。
words.en: Changed in form or character.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫躺在沙发上。
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.ex: He draws diagrams to explain the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他画图来解释这个问题。
words.en: A diagram is a simplified drawing showing the appearance, structure, or workings of something; a schematic representation.

words.ex: The scale weighs the apple.
words.ex_cn: 秤称苹果的重量。
words.en: To determine the weight of something by using a scale or balance; to consider carefully in order to make a decision.

words.ex: The bug is 5 millimetres long.
words.ex_cn: 这只虫子有5毫米长。
words.en: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter.

words.ex: The war caused great upheavals in the country.
words.ex_cn: 战争给这个国家带来了巨大的动荡。
words.en: Upheavals are sudden, violent changes or disturbances that cause a lot of trouble, confusion, and worry.

words.ex: Children are often adaptable to new environments.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通常能适应新环境。
words.en: If someone or something is adaptable, they are able to change their ideas or behaviour in order to deal with new situations.

words.ex: A crow sat on the tree branch.
words.ex_cn: 一只乌鸦坐在树枝上。
words.en: A crow is a large black bird which makes a loud, harsh noise. If someone crows, they talk in a very proud way about something they have done or achieved.

words.tr:
n. 栖枝；鲈鱼；
v. 栖息；处于（高处）；
words.ex: The bird sat on a perch near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在树旁的一根栖枝上。
words.en: A perch is a branch or rod where a bird rests or a high position where someone or something is located. As a verb, it means to rest or be located in a high position.

words.ex: The birds sit on the ledges of the building.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿停在建筑物的边缘上。
words.en: A ledge is a narrow horizontal surface projecting from a wall, cliff, or other surface.

words.ex: The bird perched on the branch.
words.ex_cn: 鸟栖息在树枝上。
words.en: To perch means to sit or rest on a high or narrow place.

words.ex: Many immigrants work hard to build a new life.
words.ex_cn: 许多移民努力工作以建立新的生活。
words.en: Immigrants are people who come to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.tr: adj. 逐渐的；逐步的；渐进的；
words.ex: The change was gradual.
words.ex_cn: 这种变化是逐渐的。
words.en: A gradual change or process happens in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.tr: adj. 城市化的；都市化的；
words.ex: The village became urbanised after the new road was built.
words.ex_cn: 这条新路建成后，这个村庄变得城市化了。
words.en: Made urban in character; developed with buildings and infrastructure.

words.ex: The children laughed while playing gophers at the carnival.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐园玩打地鼠时笑了。
words.en: Gophers are small burrowing rodents native to North and Central America, known for their extensive tunneling activities.

words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.ex: He gave a bold speech in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前发表了大胆的演讲。
words.en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

words.tr: adj. 内分泌腺的；内分泌的；
words.ex: The endocrine glands release hormones into the blood.
words.ex_cn: 内分泌腺将激素释放到血液中。
words.en: Relating to or denoting glands which secrete hormones or other products directly into the blood.

words.ex: The mouse has high corticosterone when it is stressed.
words.ex_cn: 当老鼠感到压力时，它的皮质酮水平很高。
words.en: Corticosterone is a steroid hormone produced in the adrenal cortex that is involved in the regulation of metabolism, immune response, and stress.

words.tr: adj. 表面上的； v. “seem”的现在分词；
words.ex: His seeming kindness hid his true intentions.
words.ex_cn: 他表面上的善良掩盖了真实的意图。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.ex: The cat chased the rat under the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫追着老鼠跑到了桌子底下。
words.en: A rat is a small animal with a long tail that looks like a large mouse and is considered a pest.

words.tr: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的； v. “scare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was scared of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.tr: v. 挥手；挥舞；招手；起伏；“wave”的现在分词；
words.ex: He was waving at the car to stop.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向那辆车挥手示意停下。
words.en: The act of moving one's hand or an object back and forth as a signal or greeting.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.tr: adj. 习惯的；惯常的； v. “accustom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you know it so well or have experienced it so often that it seems natural, unsurprising, or easy to deal with.

words.tr:
adj. 季度的；
adv. 每季一次；
words.ex: The company releases its quarterly report every three months.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每三个月发布一次季度报告。
words.en: Something that happens quarterly happens four times a year, at intervals of three months.

words.tr: n. 新手；新手( novice的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The novices learned to swim in the shallow pool.
words.ex_cn: 新手们在浅水池里学习游泳。
words.en: People who are new to and inexperienced in a skill or activity.

words.ex: He goes to the mall to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他去商场买衣服。
words.en: A mall is a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded.

words.ex: We woke up early to see the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 我们早起看日出。
words.en: The time in the morning when the sun appears or full daylight arrives.

words.ex: The vote was overwhelmingly in favor of the new law.
words.ex_cn: 投票压倒性地支持这项新法律。
words.en: In a way that is very great or very strong; so powerful that you cannot resist it or decide how to react.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.tr: v. （使…）成对；（使…）成双； adj. 配对的 v. （使…）成对， （使…）成双( pair的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The teacher paired the students for the activity.
words.ex_cn: 老师把学生们两两配对进行活动。
words.en: Being part of a pair or set; matched.

words.ex: He moved to the countryside when he was in his seventies.
words.ex_cn: 他在七十多岁时搬到了乡下。
words.en: The seventies refers to the decade from 1970 to 1979 or the age between 70 and 79 years old.

words.ex: He is in his nineties and still walks every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他九十多岁了，但仍然每天早上散步。
words.en: The nineties refers to the decade from 1990 to 1999 or the age between 90 and 99.

words.ex: He gave a dismissive shrug when she explained her idea.
words.ex_cn: 当她解释自己的想法时，他轻蔑地耸了耸肩。
words.en: If you are dismissive of someone or something, you show that you do not consider them to be important or worth considering.

words.ex: He is updating his phone software.
words.ex_cn: 他正在更新他的手机软件。
words.en: To make something more modern or up to date by adding new information or changing its design.

words.tr: n. 孙子；孙女；外孙；外孙女；“grandchild”的复数
words.ex: My grandma loves playing with her grandchildren.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶喜欢和她的孙子们一起玩。
words.en: Someone's grandchildren are the children of their son or daughter.

words.tr: v. 打电话；“phone”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is phoning his mother now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在给妈妈打电话。
words.en: The act of making a telephone call.

words.tr: adj. 印象深刻的； v. 使印象深刻；“impress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was impressed by her kindness.
words.ex_cn: 她的善良给我留下了深刻的印象。
words.en: If you are impressed by something or someone, you feel great admiration for them.

words.ex: He buys groceries every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周六买杂货。
words.en: Groceries are foods you buy at a grocer's or a supermarket.

words.ex: The magic show had a strange fascination for children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演对孩子们有一种奇特的迷惑力。
words.en: A fascination is a very strong interest or attraction for someone or something.

words.ex: We use a repellent to keep mosquitoes away.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用驱虫剂来驱赶蚊子。
words.en: A repellent is a substance that is used to keep insects or animals away from something. It can also refer to something that is extremely unpleasant or disgusting.

words.ex: He rides a motorcycle to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑摩托车去上班。
words.en: A motorcycle is a vehicle with two wheels and an engine.

words.tr: v. 迎合； n. 迎合（tailor 的现在分词）；
words.ex: The company tailoring its ads to young people.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司迎合年轻人的需求来调整广告。
words.en: The craft or business of making, altering, or repairing garments.

words.ex: Initially, he didn't like the job.
words.ex_cn: 最初，他不喜欢这份工作。
words.en: At the beginning; at first.

words.ex: He fastened the ties around his neck.
words.ex_cn: 他把领结系在脖子上。
words.en: Ties refer to the connections or relationships between people, groups, or things, as well as the narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck, typically by men, under the collar of a shirt.

words.ex: He will modify the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会更改计划。
words.en: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 凑整；凑整（round 的现在分词）； v. 使变圆；
words.ex: The calculator uses rounding to show two decimal places.
words.ex_cn: 计算器使用凑整来显示两位小数。
words.en: Rounding refers to the process of adjusting a number to a nearby value that is easier to work with or understand, often to a specific degree of accuracy.

words.tr: v. 一瞥； adj. 一瞥( glance的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was glancing at his watch.
words.ex_cn: 他瞥了一眼手表。
words.en: If something is glancing, it is done quickly and not directly, or it hits something at an angle rather than directly.

words.tr: n. 抓搔； v. 抓搔；刮；“scratch”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cat's scratching made a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 猫的抓搔发出了很大的声音。
words.en: The act of scraping or rubbing something with a sharp or rough object, or the sound made by this action.

words.ex: He explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地解释了这道数学题。
words.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.tr: v. 订购；命令；点餐；“order”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I ordered a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我订购了一份披萨当晚餐。
words.en: Arranged or disposed in a neat, tidy way or in a regular sequence.

words.ex: I remember remembering my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得记得我上小学的第一天。
words.en: The act of recalling or keeping in mind something from the past.

words.tr: n. 处理；加工； v. 处理；加工；“process”的现在分词；
words.ex: The processing of data takes a long time.
words.ex_cn: 数据的处理需要很长时间。
words.en: The act of treating or preparing something by a special method.

words.tr: adj. 注意力分散的； v. “distract”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was distracted by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被巨大的噪音分散了注意力。
words.en: If you are distracted, you are not able to concentrate because you are worried or thinking about something else.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.tr: v. 使稳定；使坚固；使坚固（stabilize的过去分词）；
words.ex: The doctor stabilised the patient's heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 医生稳定了病人的脉搏。
words.en: Made steady, firm, or constant; brought to a state of stability.

words.tr: v. 促进；使便利；使容易；
words.ex: The teacher facilitates learning by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来促进学习。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

words.tr: adv. 无限期地；不确定地；
words.ex: The meeting was postponed indefinitely.
words.ex_cn: 会议被无限期推迟了。
words.en: If something will happen indefinitely, it will happen for an unlimited or unknown period of time.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fade in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色在阳光下逐渐消失。
words.en: To gradually grow faint and disappear.

words.ex: The olfactory nerve helps us smell food.
words.ex_cn: 嗅神经帮助我们闻到食物的味道。
words.en: Relating to the sense of smell.

words.ex: The auditory system helps us hear sounds.
words.ex_cn: 听觉系统帮助我们听到声音。
words.en: Relating to the sense of hearing.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.tr: adj. 神经（病）学的；神经系统的；
words.ex: The doctor checked for neurological damage after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，医生检查是否有神经学方面的损伤。
words.en: Relating to the anatomy, functions, and organic disorders of nerves and the nervous system.

words.ex: The accident caused an impairment in his vision.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故导致了他的视力受损。
words.en: An impairment is a condition in which a part of a person's mind or body is damaged or does not work well.

words.tr: v. 帮助；援助；协助；“assist”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He assisted his friend with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助朋友做作业。
words.en: If you assist someone, you help them to do a job or task by doing part of the work for them.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.ex: Many people go to gyms to get stronger.
words.ex_cn: 许多人去健身房锻炼身体。
words.en: Gyms are places equipped for physical exercise and training, often featuring a variety of equipment for cardiovascular and strength training.

words.tr: v. 投资；投入；“invest”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is investing money in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他正在投资一笔钱到一家小企业。
words.en: The act of committing money or capital to an endeavor with the expectation of obtaining an additional income or profit.

words.tr: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤寂的；
words.ex: He lives in a solitary house far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离城镇很远的独自一人的房子里。
words.en: A solitary person or thing is the only one in a place.

words.ex: The fanatics cheered loudly for their team.
words.ex_cn: 狂热者们为他们的球队大声欢呼。
words.en: Fanatics are people who are extremely enthusiastic about a particular activity, subject, or cause, often to an excessive degree.

words.tr: v. 使受伤；弄痛( hurt的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The fall was hurting his leg.
words.ex_cn: 摔倒使他的腿受伤了。
words.en: If you are hurting, you are feeling pain, either physically or emotionally.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: His intentions are good.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是好的。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.tr: v. 相信；认为； adj. 相信( believe的现在分词 )；
words.ex: I am believing what you said.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你所说的话。
words.en: To accept as true or real; to have faith in the truth, existence, or reliability of something, although without absolute proof.

words.tr: adj. 可管理的；可应付的；可处理的；
words.ex: The project is manageable if we work together.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们一起合作，这个项目是可以管理的。
words.en: If you describe something as manageable, you mean that it is easy to control or deal with.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: The botanic garden has many rare plants.
words.ex_cn: 植物园里有许多稀有植物。
words.en: relating to plants or the study of plants

words.ex: Add a teaspoon of sugar to the tea.
words.ex_cn: 给茶里加一茶匙糖。
words.en: A teaspoon is a small spoon that you use to put sugar into tea or coffee.

words.ex: The children are using colourings in their art class.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在美术课上使用彩色图案。
words.en: Colourings refer to the substances used to give color to something, or the variety of colors in something.

words.tr: v. 遗弃；抛弃；“abandon”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被遗弃了的；
words.ex: They abandoned the old car by the road.
words.ex_cn: 他们把那辆旧车遗弃在路边。
words.en: Left behind or deserted; given up.

words.ex: The children's reactions were funny and loud.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的反应又有趣又大声。
words.en: A reaction is a response to something that has happened or been said, or is the process of reacting to something.

words.tr: n. 姜黄；姜黄根；姜黄根粉末；
words.ex: She adds turmeric to her soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加姜黄来调味。
words.en: A bright yellow aromatic powder obtained from the rhizome of a plant of the ginger family, used for flavoring and coloring in Asian cooking and formerly as a fabric dye.

words.ex: She washes her hands before eating.
words.ex_cn: 她吃饭前洗手。
words.en: To clean something with water and, typically, soap or detergent.

words.ex: The soup was too watery and tasted bland.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太稀了，味道淡。
words.en: Something that is watery contains, resembles, or consists of water.

words.ex: The red dye comes from cochineal insects.
words.ex_cn: 这种红色染料来自胭脂虫。
words.en: A red dye derived from the dried bodies of cochineal insects, used for coloring food and textiles.

words.tr: v. 挤压；压碎；“crush”的现在分词；
words.ex: The machine is crushing the cans.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器正在挤压罐子。
words.en: If you describe something as crushing, you mean that it is very severe or intense.

words.ex: Rust is an oxide of iron.
words.ex_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
words.en: An oxide is a chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and one other element in its chemical formula.

words.ex: The old bike has rust on its chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆旧自行车的链条上有锈。
words.en: Rust is a reddish-brown substance that forms on the surface of iron or steel when they are exposed to air and moisture, causing them to corrode.

words.ex: Reptiles live on land and lay eggs.
words.ex_cn: 爬行动物生活在陆地上并产卵。
words.en: Reptiles are a class of cold-blooded vertebrates that are covered with scales and lay eggs on land.

words.ex: Crocodiles live in rivers and swamps.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼生活在河流和沼泽中。
words.en: Crocodiles are large aquatic reptiles that live throughout the tropics in Africa, Asia, the Americas and Australia.

words.tr: n. （无对应中文释义，可能为拼写错误或非标准词汇）
words.ex: Tiliquarugosa is not a real word.
words.ex_cn: Tiliquarugosa 不是一个真实存在的词。
words.en: A scientific name for the blue-tongued skink, a type of large, slow-moving lizard.

words.tr: v. 打盹儿；打瞌睡；打盹儿，打瞌睡( doze的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was dozing on the sofa after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他在午饭后躺在沙发上打盹儿。
words.en: In a light, drowsy sleep; not fully asleep.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.ex: The shark opened its jaws wide.
words.ex_cn: 鲨鱼张开了它的颚。
words.en: The jaws are the two bones in your head between which your teeth are fixed, or the parts at the sides of your mouth that you can move when you eat or speak.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.ex: Beetles crawl under the leaves.
words.ex_cn: 甲虫在树叶下爬行。
words.en: Beetles are a group of insects that form the order Coleoptera, in the superorder Endopterygota. Their front pair of wings is hardened into wing-cases, elytra, distinguishing them from most other insects.

words.ex: The snail moves slowly across the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过花园。
words.en: A snail is a small creature with a soft, wet body and a spiral shell. It moves very slowly.

words.ex: Cassowaries live in the rainforests of Australia.
words.ex_cn: 食火鸡生活在澳大利亚的雨林中。
words.en: Cassowaries are large, flightless birds native to the tropical forests of New Guinea, nearby islands, and northeastern Australia. They are known for their striking appearance, including a casque on their head, and can be dangerous if provoked.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: The ship uses GPS for navigation.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用GPS进行导航。
words.en: The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.ex: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 埃菲尔铁塔是巴黎著名的地标。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a place that is easily recognized and can be used to judge your position or the position of other buildings or features.

words.tr: n. 交配； v. “mate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The birds engage in mating during spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: The process by which animals come together for the purpose of reproduction.

words.tr: v. 孵化；孵出；孵化( hatch的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The eggs hatched after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这些蛋在三周后孵化了。
words.en: If an egg hatches or if it is hatched, it breaks open and a baby bird, fish, insect, or other animal comes out. If you hatch a plot or a scheme, you plan it secretly.

words.tr: n. 接受训练的人；新兵( trainee的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The trainees are learning how to use the new machines.
words.ex_cn: 这些接受训练的人正在学习如何使用新机器。
words.en: A trainee is someone who is being taught how to do a particular job.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.ex: The game became massively popular after the update.
words.ex_cn: 更新后，这个游戏变得大幅度流行。
words.en: To a very great degree or extent; extremely.

words.ex: She wore a red skirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色短裙去参加派对。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and covers part or all of the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to the act of moving along the edge of something.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.tr: adj. 恐惧的；受惊吓的； v. “terrify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was terrified of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: If you are terrified, you are extremely frightened.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: He is the premier player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最优秀的球员。
words.en: The premier is the leader of the government in some countries, equivalent to a prime minister.

words.ex: The children are hiking on the mountainsides.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在山坡上徒步。
words.en: The sides of a mountain.

words.ex: The bird glide smoothly over the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在湖面上滑行。
words.en: To move smoothly and continuously along, as if without effort or resistance.

words.tr: adv. 温柔地；温和地；轻轻地；
words.ex: She gently woke the baby.
words.ex_cn: 她温柔地叫醒了宝宝。
words.en: In a mild, kind, or tender manner; not harshly or severely.

words.tr: n. 赛车；竞赛； v. 比赛；疾走；“race”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves watching racing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末观看赛车。
words.en: Racing is the sport of competing in races, especially horse races or car races.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.ex: The movie is featuring a famous singer.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影 featuring 一位著名歌手。
words.en: If something features a particular person or thing, they are an important part of it.

words.ex: She made an embroidery of a flower on the pillow.
words.ex_cn: 她在枕头上绣了一朵花。
words.en: Embroidery is the craft of decorating fabric or other materials using a needle to apply thread or yarn. It may also incorporate other materials such as pearls, beads, quills, and sequins.

words.tr: v. 悬挂；“hang”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He hung the picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把画挂在墙上。
words.en: to suspend or be suspended from above with the lower part dangling free

words.ex: The cat is beneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: In or to a lower position than someone or something, under someone or something.

words.ex: She wore a dress with two petticoats under it.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条裙子，下面穿了两条衬裙。
words.en: A petticoat is a piece of clothing like a thin skirt, which is worn under a skirt or dress.

words.ex: The company's profits grew ten folds in one year.
words.ex_cn: 公司利润一年内增长了十倍。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies on the other part, or to be able to be bent in this way.

words.ex: He bent his knees to pick up the book.
words.ex_cn: 他弯下膝盖捡起书。
words.en: The knees are the joints in the middle of the legs that allow them to bend.

words.tr: v. 变更；改动；“alter”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He altered the plan to fit the new schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他修改了计划以适应新的时间表。
words.en: Changed in form or character without becoming something else.

words.tr: n. 连衣裙；衣服( dress的名词复数 )；
words.ex: She buys three new dresses for the summer.
words.ex_cn: 她为夏天买了三条新连衣裙。
words.en: Clothes for women or girls, typically consisting of a skirt, bodice, and sometimes sleeves.

words.ex: This shirt is tighter than my old one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比我旧的那件更紧。
words.en: Comparative form of 'tight,' meaning more firmly fixed, more restrictive, or more intense.

words.tr: adj. 庞大的；肥大的；体积大的；
words.ex: The box is too bulky to fit in the car.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子太大了，放不进车里。
words.en: Something that is bulky is large and heavy, and therefore difficult to move or carry.

words.tr: v. 减损；毁损，贬低，减损( detract的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The bad weather detracted from our fun trip.
words.ex_cn: 糟糕的天气减损了我们旅行的乐趣。
words.en: If something detracts from an achievement, success, or quality, or if someone detracts from it, they make it seem less good or less impressive.

words.tr: n. （放在衣袋里或连在腰带上的）小袋；（放在衣袋里或连在腰带上的）小袋( pouch的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He put his keys in the pouches on his belt.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙放在腰带上的小袋里。
words.en: A pouch is a small flexible bag, often used for carrying small items or as a container.

words.ex: The com is growing fast in this city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的商业正在快速增长。
words.en: A term used to refer to a company or business, often in the context of commerce or trade.

words.ex: The photographers took pictures at the park.
words.ex_cn: 摄影师们在公园里拍照。
words.en: A photographer is a person who takes photographs, especially as a job.

words.ex: He will vote for the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 他将投票支持新领袖。
words.en: If you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

words.tr: v. 命名；“entitle”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有资格的；
words.ex: They entitled the book 'The Silent Wind'.
words.ex_cn: 他们给这本书命名为《寂静的风》。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

words.tr:
n. 法官；裁判员；
v. 判断；
words.ex: The judges made a fair decision.
words.ex_cn: 法官们做出了公正的裁决。
words.en: A judge is a person who is in charge of a court of law and who makes decisions about legal cases.

words.ex: He was criticised for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而受到批评。
words.en: If you criticise someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.ex: She wore a dress in pinks to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件粉色的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Pinks are flowers of the genus Dianthus, which includes carnations and sweet williams. They are known for their fragrant, colorful blooms.

words.ex: The purples in the sunset were beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 日落中的紫色很美。
words.en: Purples refer to the colors that are between red and blue in hue. It can also refer to clothing or robes of this color, or the dye used to produce this color.

words.ex: He took several shots of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了几张日落的照片。
words.en: Shots can refer to photographs, injections, attempts, or the act of shooting.

words.ex: The fox ran quickly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狐狸快速地跑过森林。
words.en: A fox is a wild animal which looks like a dog and has reddish-brown fur, a pointed face and ears, and a thick tail. Foxes are often described as cunning and sly.

words.tr: v. 猜想；怀疑；“suspect”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被怀疑的；
words.ex: I suspected he was lying.
words.ex_cn: 我猜他撒谎了。
words.en: Believed to be guilty of a crime or wrongdoing, but not yet proven.

words.ex: He outlined the plan in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他用一句话概述了这个计划。
words.en: To outline means to describe something in a general way, without giving all the details, or to draw the outer edge of something.

words.tr: n. 节奏；拍子；（音乐的）节拍；（警察的）巡逻区域
words.ex: The music has a steady beat.
words.ex_cn: 这首音乐有稳定的节奏。
words.en: Beats can refer to the rhythmic units in music or the act of defeating someone in a competition.

words.ex: She ate the freshly baked bread.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了刚烤好的面包。
words.en: Recently; just now.

words.ex: The sky turned pale blue at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时，天空变成了淡蓝色。
words.en: Something that is pale is not strong or bright in color.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.tr: adj. 煮[烹]熟的；煮[烹]熟的 v. 烹调( cook的过去式和过去分词 )； v. 密谋；
words.ex: The cooked rice smells delicious.
words.ex_cn: 煮熟的米饭闻起来很香。
words.en: Cooked food has been prepared by heating it.

words.ex: The uncooked vegetables taste fresh and crisp.
words.ex_cn: 未烹饪过的蔬菜尝起来新鲜爽脆。
words.en: Not cooked; raw.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.ex: The snake has a deadly bite.
words.ex_cn: 这种蛇的咬伤是致命的。
words.en: If something is deadly, it is likely or able to cause someone's death, or has already caused someone's death.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.tr: v. 依赖；依靠；信赖；信任；信任( rely的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is relying on his friends for help.
words.ex_cn: 他正依赖朋友的帮助。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.ex: The cows trample the grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 牛在田野里践踏草地。
