words.en: If someone tramples something or tramples on it, they step heavily and carelessly on it and damage it.

words.ex: The city builds reservoirs to store rainwater.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建造蓄水库来储存雨水。
words.en: A reservoir is a large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.ex: He ate fries with ketchup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了配番茄酱的炸薯条。
words.en: Fries are thin strips of potato that are fried until they are crisp and golden brown.

words.tr: 意大利调味饭（肉汤加干酪等制成）（risotto 的名词复数）
words.ex: He cooks risottos every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都做意大利烩饭。
words.en: An Italian dish made from rice cooked in broth to a creamy consistency, typically with added ingredients such as cheese, vegetables, or meat.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.ex: He reacted quickly when the ball came at him.
words.ex_cn: 当球朝他飞来时，他迅速做出了反应。
words.en: To act in response to something; to respond to a stimulus.

words.tr: v. 声明；坚决地表示；声明( protest的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was protesting his innocence to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他向警察声明自己无罪。
words.en: Expressing strong objection or disapproval, typically in a public or organized manner, often to oppose a policy, action, or situation.

words.ex: The country's industrialisation began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 该国的工业化始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: Industrialisation is the process by which an economy is transformed from primarily agricultural to one based on the manufacturing of goods. Individual manual labor is often replaced by mechanized mass production, and craftsmen are replaced by assembly lines.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: Many people face unemployment during the economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 在经济危机期间，许多人面临失业。
words.en: Unemployment refers to the state of being without a job, especially when one is actively seeking employment.

words.ex: The outcome is foreseeable.
words.ex_cn: 结果是可以预见的。
words.en: If a future event is foreseeable, you know that it will happen or that it can happen, because it is a natural or obvious result of something else that you know.

words.ex: He works in hairdressing at a local salon.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家本地美发沙龙从事美发工作。
words.en: The activity or occupation of cutting and styling hair.

words.ex: The secretaries type letters and answer phones.
words.ex_cn: 秘书们打字并接电话。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.ex: The teacher gave a dictation of five sentences.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了一次五句话的听写。
words.en: Dictation is the speaking or reading aloud of words for someone else to write down.

words.tr: v. 打字；定型；“type”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is typing a letter on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他正在电脑上打一封信。
words.en: The act of writing something using a typewriter or computer keyboard.

words.ex: He barely slept last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚几乎没睡觉。
words.en: You use barely to say that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.tr: n. 寿命；使用寿命；生命期；
words.ex: The lifespan of a housefly is only a few weeks.
words.ex_cn: 家蝇的寿命只有几周。
words.en: The length of time for which a person or animal lives or a thing functions.

words.tr: adj. 无望的；凄凉的；荒凉的；
words.ex: The future looks bleak without a job.
words.ex_cn: 没有工作，未来看起来毫无希望。
words.en: If you describe a situation as bleak, you mean that it seems unlikely to improve or get better.

words.tr: n. （议会、法院等的）书记员；<美>店员；<英>办事员；<美>店员( clerk的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The clerks wrote down all the court proceedings.
words.ex_cn: 书记员记录了所有的法庭程序。
words.en: Clerks are people who work in offices or shops, performing tasks such as keeping records or serving customers.

words.ex: He listened to music from the eighties.
words.ex_cn: 他听八十年代的音乐。
words.en: The decade from 1980 to 1989; the age between 80 and 89.

words.ex: The extra chair is redundant because we have enough seats.
words.ex_cn: 这把额外的椅子是多余的，因为我们已经有足够的座位了。
words.en: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because there is no more work for you.

words.ex: The cars had many collisions on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在结冰的道路上发生了多次碰撞。
words.en: A collision occurs when two or more objects hit each other, or when two or more ideas or opinions are in opposition.

words.tr: n. 一系列（相关的想法、事物）；星座( constellation的名词复数 )；
words.ex: His ideas form a constellation of creative solutions.
words.ex_cn: 他的想法构成了一系列创新的解决方案。
words.en: A constellation is a group of stars which form a pattern and have a name.

words.ex: The team is consisting of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: to be made up or composed of something

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.ex: She is ensuring that everyone has enough food.
words.ex_cn: 她正在确保每个人都有足够的食物。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.tr: v. 碰撞；相撞( collide的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The two cars were colliding at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 两辆车在十字路口相撞了。
words.en: If two or more moving people or objects collide, they crash into one another. If a moving person or object collides with a person or object that is not moving, they crash into them.

words.ex: The storm left debris on the road.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在道路上留下了碎片。
words.en: The remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up.

words.ex: The weather prediction says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: A prediction is a statement about what you think will happen in the future.

words.ex: She coordinates the team's schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她协调团队的安排。
words.en: If you coordinate an activity, you organize the various people and things involved in it. If you coordinate the different parts of your body, you make them work together efficiently.

words.ex: The spacecraft landed safely on Mars.
words.ex_cn: 航天器在火星上安全着陆。
words.en: A spacecraft is a vehicle or machine designed to fly in outer space. Spacecraft are used for a variety of purposes, including communications, Earth observation, meteorology, navigation, space colonization, planetary exploration, and transportation of humans and cargo.

words.ex: The treaty establishes peace between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 该条约建立了两国之间的和平。
words.en: To establish means to set up or found something, such as a business, institution, or system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: The program is nationally recognized.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目在全国范围内被认可。
words.en: In a way that relates to the whole of a nation.

words.tr: v. 重订时间表( reschedule的现在分词 )
words.ex: He is rescheduling the meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把会议改到明天。
words.en: The act of arranging or planning something again for a different time.

words.ex: He ate a biscuit with tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喝茶时吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A biscuit is a small, flat cake that is crisp and usually sweet.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.tr: adj. 建筑学的；建筑方面的；
words.ex: The book shows architectural drawings of old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这本书展示了古老建筑的建筑图纸。
words.en: Relating to the art and science of designing and constructing buildings.

words.tr: n. 帆布背包( rucksack的名词复数 )
words.ex: The children carry their books in rucksacks.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们用帆布背包背着书。
words.en: A rucksack is a bag that you carry on your back, especially when you are walking or climbing.

words.ex: He took a photographic memory of the scene.
words.ex_cn: 他把场景记在了像照片一样的记忆里。
words.en: Relating to or used in photography; resembling a photograph in accuracy or detail.

words.ex: He won a prize-winning essay contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了一个获奖作文比赛。
words.en: Having won a prize or prizes.

words.tr: n. 牧羊人；羊倌；牧羊人，羊倌( shepherd的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The shepherds walk with their sheep in the hills.
words.ex_cn: 牧羊人带着他们的羊在山上行走。
words.en: Shepherds are people who take care of sheep. They guide and protect the sheep, often leading them to places where they can graze. In a broader sense, the term can also refer to someone who guides or directs others, such as a spiritual leader or mentor.

words.ex: The teacher gave an explanatory note to help students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个解释性的笔记来帮助学生。
words.en: Serving or intended to explain or make clear.

words.ex: The cheesemaker works early every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶酪制造商每天早上很早就工作。
words.en: A person who makes cheese, especially as a profession.

words.tr: n. 着陆；降落；楼梯平台； v. “land”的现在分词；
words.ex: The plane made a smooth landing at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场平稳着陆。
words.en: The act of coming to or bringing something to land, especially an aircraft.

words.ex: He nailed the wood boards to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把木板钉在墙上。
words.en: Planks of wood; a group of people who manage or direct a company or organization; the stage in a theater.

words.ex: The city is redeveloping the old factory area.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在重新开发旧工厂区域。
words.en: To redevelop means to develop again or differently, especially to improve an area by replacing old buildings with new ones or changing the use of land.

words.ex: The children count the squares on the grid.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们数网格上的正方形。
words.en: Open, public areas in towns or cities, often surrounded by buildings, used for gatherings, markets, or as a focal point of a district.

words.tr: n. 马达；发动机；机动车；
words.ex: The car has a strong motor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强大的马达。
words.en: A motor is a device that changes energy into mechanical motion, especially such a device that provides power for a vehicle or for another device with moving parts.

words.tr: adj. 破坏性的；引起混乱的；
words.ex: The new technology caused disruptive changes in the market.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术给市场带来了破坏性的变化。
words.en: Causing or tending to cause disruption.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.ex: He likes maths because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: the science of numbers, quantities, and shapes and the relationships between them

words.tr: v. 从事于；（使）参与；“engage”的现在分词； adj. 有趣的；
words.ex: He is engaging in community service.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从事社区服务。
words.en: An engaging person or thing is pleasant, interesting, and entertaining.

words.tr: v. 强化；加强；“reinforce”的现在分词；
words.ex: The teacher is reinforcing the rules to help students behave.
words.ex_cn: 老师正在强化规则以帮助学生守规矩。
words.en: To strengthen or support, especially with additional personnel or material.

words.ex: He drew a geometric shape on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个几何图形。
words.en: Relating to geometry, or according to its methods and principles.

words.tr: n. 分数；小部分；<数>分数( fraction的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He added two fractions together.
words.ex_cn: 他把两个分数加在一起。
words.en: A fraction is a part of a whole number, such as 1⁄2 or 3⁄4.

words.ex: The butterfly has perfect symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶有完美的对称性。
words.en: Symmetry is the quality of being made up of exactly similar parts facing each other or around an axis.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.tr: adj. 直言无讳的；坦率的；
words.ex: He is an outspoken teacher who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位直言不讳的老师，总是说真话。
words.en: Someone who is outspoken expresses their opinions frankly and honestly, even if they are likely to shock or offend people.

words.ex: He received criticism for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而受到批评。
words.en: Criticism is the act of expressing disapproval of someone or something and of the faults they have or the mistakes they have made.

words.ex: The rulers made laws for their people.
words.ex_cn: 统治者为他们的人民制定法律。
words.en: Rulers are people who rule or govern a country or community. It can also refer to a straight strip or cylinder of plastic, wood, metal, or other rigid material, typically marked at regular intervals and used to draw straight lines or measure distances.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.ex: They reside in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: If someone resides somewhere, they live there or are staying there.

words.tr: v. 降落；着陆；“land”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 拥有大量土地的；
words.ex: The plane landed safely at night.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在夜间安全降落。
words.en: Having a large amount of land, especially as a result of inheritance.

words.tr: v. 倒塌；昏倒；暴跌；“collapse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The old building collapsed during the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 那座老建筑在地震中倒塌了。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: The museum displays old portraits of kings and queens.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了国王和王后的旧肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.ex: The walls have old tapestries with colorful flowers.
words.ex_cn: 墙上挂着有彩色花朵的旧挂毯。
words.en: A tapestry is a piece of heavy woven cloth, often with a picture or pattern, used as a wall hanging or soft furnishing.

words.ex: The walls have wooden panelling.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁上有木制镶板。
words.en: Panelling refers to the wooden panels that are used to cover the walls of a room, often for decorative purposes.

words.ex: The shadowy figure disappeared into the night.
words.ex_cn: 那个模糊的身影消失在夜晚中。
words.en: A shadowy place or area is dark and full of shadows.

words.ex: The ceremony was solemn and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 仪式庄严而安静。
words.en: Solemn means very serious and not cheerful, often because something important or sad is happening or being remembered.

words.tr: n. （私宅中的）起居室；休息厅( lounge的名词复数 )；
words.ex: They relaxed in the lounges after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们在晚饭后在起居室里放松。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house, hotel, or other building where people can sit and relax.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.tr: n. 家具陈设；室内陈设品；
words.ex: The room has simple furnishings.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有简单的家具陈设。
words.en: The articles of furniture and other items that are used to make a room or building suitable for living or working in.

words.ex: They bought new wallpaper for the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他们为卧室买了新壁纸。
words.en: Wallpaper is a material used to cover and decorate the interior walls of homes, offices, and other buildings; it is usually sold in rolls and is applied onto the wall using wallpaper paste.

words.ex: The children ran down the hallway.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在走廊里奔跑。
words.en: A hallway is a long passage inside a building with doors leading off to rooms on either side.

words.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 她具有非凡的音乐天赋。
words.en: Something that is extraordinary is very unusual or remarkable.

words.ex: He made a gesture of welcome with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手做了一个欢迎的姿态。
words.en: A gesture is a movement that you make with a part of your body, especially your hands, to express emotion or information.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.tr: n. 气球；热气球；玩具气球；球状物；
words.ex: The child held a red balloon at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在派对上拿着一个红色的气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.tr: n. 编码；译成电码； v. “code”的现在分词；
words.ex: He learned coding to build websites.
words.ex_cn: 他学习编码来搭建网站。
words.en: Coding refers to the process of creating instructions that computers can execute. It involves writing, testing, and maintaining the source code of computer programs.

words.ex: The robot cleans the floor every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人每天打扫地板。
words.en: A robot is a machine that is programmed to move and perform certain tasks automatically.

words.tr: n. 手臂；武器；兵器；“arm”的复数；
words.ex: He raised his arms to wave at the plane.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂向飞机挥手。
words.en: Weapons, especially as used by the military.

words.tr: v. 决心；决定；“determine”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 坚决的；坚定的；有决心的；
words.ex: He is determined to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他决心完成比赛。
words.en: If you are determined to do something, you have made a firm decision to do it and will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: He works in the automotive industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在汽车工业工作。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with motor vehicles.

words.ex: The government wants to improve healthcare for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望为所有人改善医疗保健。
words.en: Healthcare refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.ex: He used the map to orientate himself.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来确定自己的位置。
words.en: To orientate means to align or position something relative to the points of a compass or other specified positions. It can also mean to familiarize someone with a new situation or environment.

words.tr: v. （计算机）存取（access 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: He accessed the file yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天访问了这个文件。
words.en: To access something means to obtain or retrieve it, especially from a computer or other electronic device.

words.ex: Losing the game was a big letdown.
words.ex_cn: 输掉比赛是一次很大的失望。
words.en: A letdown is a disappointment or something that is not as good as you expected it to be.

words.tr: n. 头脑风暴；集思广益； v. “brainstorm”的现在分词；
words.ex: We had a brainstorming session to find new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次头脑风暴来寻找新点子。
words.en: Brainstorming is a group creativity technique by which efforts are made to find a conclusion for a specific problem by gathering a list of ideas spontaneously contributed by its members.

words.tr: v. 设计；拉开（draft 的过去分词）；
words.ex: He drafted a simple house plan.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一个简单的房屋平面图。
words.en: To draft means to write a document, plan, or law that will be discussed and possibly changed before it becomes official. It can also mean to choose someone for a particular job or position, especially in the military.

words.ex: He amended the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送信件之前修正了它。
words.en: To amend something means to make changes to it in order to improve it or make it more accurate.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: The falcon flew high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 猎鹰在群山上空飞翔。
words.en: A falcon is a bird of prey, known for its speed and keen eyesight, used in falconry.

words.ex: A hawk flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹰飞过田野。
words.en: A hawk is a bird of prey with a strong beak and sharp claws, known for its keen vision and swift flight. As a verb, to hawk means to sell goods aggressively, often in public places.

words.tr: v. 俯冲；猛冲；俯冲，猛冲( swoop的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The hawk was swooping down to catch a mouse.
words.ex_cn: 老鹰正在俯冲下来抓一只老鼠。
words.en: Moving rapidly downward through the air, especially in order to attack or catch something.

words.ex: The eagle caught the fish with its talons.
words.ex_cn: 鹰用爪子抓住了鱼。
words.en: The sharp claws of a bird of prey.

words.tr: v. （鸟）飞落；坐落于（某物顶部或边缘）（perch的现在分词）；
words.ex: The bird is perching on the branch.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟停在树枝上。
words.en: To sit or rest on something high or narrow, especially for birds.

words.ex: The cats sleep in the shades under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 猫在树下的阴凉处睡觉。
words.en: Shades refer to the darkness or coolness caused by the blocking of direct sunlight, or the different degrees of lightness or darkness of a color.

words.tr: int. 嗯（表示犹豫、思考或不确定的声音）
words.ex: He said hm when he didn't know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 当他不知道答案时，他嗯了一声。
words.en: An interjection used to express hesitation, thoughtfulness, or uncertainty.

words.ex: His expression showed he was happy.
words.ex_cn: 他的表情显示他很快乐。
words.en: The act of making your thoughts, feelings, etc., known by speech, writing, or some other method.

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；
words.ex: His answer was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.ex: He is lecturing about history at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里讲演历史。
words.en: The act of giving a lecture or lectures.

words.ex: He wins many triumphs in sports.
words.ex_cn: 他在体育中赢得许多胜利。
words.en: A triumph is a great success or achievement, often one that has been gained with a lot of skill or effort.

words.ex: He learns different philosophies from ancient books.
words.ex_cn: 他从古书中学习不同的哲学思想。
words.en: Philosophies are the theories or sets of beliefs about the nature of the universe and human life.

words.tr: adj. 不可动摇的；坚定不移的；
words.ex: His belief in justice is unshakable.
words.ex_cn: 他对正义的信念是不可动摇的。
words.en: If you describe someone's beliefs as unshakable, you are emphasizing that they are so strong that they cannot be destroyed or changed.

words.ex: Children find happiness in simple games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在简单的游戏中找到幸福。
words.en: Happiness is a state of well-being and contentment.

words.ex: The storm was destructive and broke many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴具有破坏性，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.

words.ex: His anger grew when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他的愤怒增加了。
words.en: A strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.

words.ex: He felt jealousy when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到妒忌。
words.en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.ex: The dictionary defines the word clearly.
words.ex_cn: 词典精确地解释了这个词。
words.en: Specifies or describes the essential qualities or characteristics of something.

words.ex: He is wholly responsible for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他完全对这个错误负责。
words.en: Completely or entirely.

words.ex: The signal transforms into a different frequency.
words.ex_cn: 信号被变换为不同的频率。
words.en: To change something completely, usually to improve it.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.tr: n. 开始；创始；入会仪式；
words.ex: The initiation of the project took place last Monday.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的开始是在上星期一。
words.en: The act of starting something, or the process of being started.

words.tr:
n. 欲望；渴望；
v. 渴望；期望；
words.ex: He felt a strong desire to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强烈的环游世界的欲望。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen.

words.tr: n. 保证；事业； v. 承担；从事；“undertake”的现在分词；
words.ex: He gave an undertaking to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他保证按时完成项目。
words.en: An undertaking is a task or project, especially one that is important or difficult.

words.tr: n. 君主；国王；（纸牌中的）老 K；君主，国王( king的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The kings ruled the land long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这些君主很久以前统治着这片土地。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the Head of State of that country.

words.ex: The presidents met to discuss the economy.
words.ex_cn: 总统们会面讨论经济。
words.en: The heads of state or leaders of organizations, especially in political contexts.

words.tr: adj. 创办的； v. 建立；“found”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is a founding member of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他是这所学校的创办成员。
words.en: The act of establishing or setting up something, such as an institution or organization.

words.ex: The fathers took their children to the park.
words.ex_cn: 父亲们带他们的孩子去公园了。
words.en: Fathers refers to male parents or ancestors. It can also denote founders or originators of a movement or idea.

words.ex: He has seventeen apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有十七个苹果。
words.en: The number seventeen is the natural number following sixteen and preceding eighteen.

words.ex: The stoics remain calm in difficult times.
words.ex_cn: 斯多葛学派的人在困难时期保持冷静。
words.en: The Stoics were a school of Hellenistic philosophy founded in Athens by Zeno of Citium in the early 3rd century BC. The Stoics taught that becoming a clear and unbiased thinker allows one to understand the universal reason (logos).

words.ex: He is an ardent supporter of environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 他是环境保护的热心支持者。
words.en: An ardent person has strong feelings or enthusiasm for something.

words.tr: adj. 安慰的；慰问（console 的现在分词）；
words.ex: Her consoling words made me feel better.
words.ex_cn: 她安慰的话让我感觉好些了。
words.en: Providing comfort in a time of need or distress.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.ex: The economist predicts higher prices next year.
words.ex_cn: 这位经济学家预测明年价格会上涨。
words.en: An economist is a person who studies, teaches, or writes about economics.

words.ex: He believes in capitalism and owns a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他相信资本主义，并拥有一家小企业。
words.en: Capitalism is an economic system in which the means of production are privately owned and operated for profit in a competitive market.

words.ex: The schoolboy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 那个小学生很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: A schoolboy is a boy who attends school.

words.ex: He rereads his favorite book every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年重读他最喜欢的小说。
words.en: To read something again.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；主要的；基本的；最好的；
words.ex: This is the prime reason for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 这是延误的首要原因。
words.en: Prime is used to describe something that is of the best possible quality, or the most important or basic part of something.

words.ex: The minister signed the new law.
words.ex_cn: 部长签署了新法律。
words.en: A minister is a person who is in charge of a particular government department or a member of the clergy in some Christian churches.

words.ex: His refusal to listen is irrational.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝倾听是不合理的。
words.en: If you describe someone's feelings and behavior as irrational, you mean they are not based on logical reasons or clear thinking.

words.ex: He overcame many obstacles to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了许多障碍，完成了比赛。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.tr: adj. 遵守纪律的； v. “discipline”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a disciplined student who always arrives on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个遵守纪律的学生，总是准时到达。
words.en: Someone who is disciplined behaves in a controlled way, obeying rules or standards.

words.ex: He is a principled man who never lies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个坚持操守的人，从不撒谎。
words.en: Having or showing strong beliefs about what is right and wrong; based on moral principles.

words.ex: The music resonates with her emotions.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与她的情感产生共鸣。
words.en: If something resonates, it vibrates and produces a deep, strong sound. If a place or situation resonates, it seems full of a particular quality or feeling.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.ex: The prince is the heir to the throne.
words.ex_cn: 王子是王位的继承人。
words.en: A person legally entitled to inherit property or a title.

words.ex: The nucleus of the team is the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的核心是队长。
words.en: The central and most important part of an object, movement, or group, forming the basis for its activity and growth.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生的；临近的；
words.ex: An imminent storm is coming soon.
words.ex_cn: 一场即将发生的风暴很快就要来了。
words.en: If you say that something is imminent, especially something unpleasant, you mean it is almost certain to happen very soon.

words.tr: adj. 不够好的；不能令人满意的；
words.ex: The food was unsatisfactory.
words.ex_cn: 食物不够好。
words.en: If you describe something as unsatisfactory, you mean that it is not as good as it should be, and cannot be considered acceptable.

words.ex: They eat sandwiches for lunches at school.
words.ex_cn: 他们在学校吃三明治当午餐。
words.en: Lunches refer to the meal eaten in the middle of the day, or the act of eating this meal.

words.ex: He topped his last record by running faster.
words.ex_cn: 他通过跑得更快超过了上次的记录。
words.en: A topping is a layer of food that is spread or placed on top of a dish to add flavor or decoration.

words.ex: We ate ice cream and cake for desserts.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃冰淇淋和蛋糕作为甜点。
words.en: Desserts are sweet foods eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.tr: n. 功能选择单；菜单( menu的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Click the menus to choose the settings.
words.ex_cn: 点击功能选择单来选择设置。
words.en: Lists of food and drink options available at a restaurant or event.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.ex: It's a coincidence that we both wore blue today.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天都穿了蓝色，真是巧合。
words.en: A coincidence is when two or more similar or related events occur at the same time by chance and without any planning.

words.ex: The worm has a segmented body.
words.ex_cn: 这条蠕虫的身体是分割的。
words.en: Divided into or composed of segments or sections.

words.ex: The baby takes naps twice a day.
words.ex_cn: 这个婴儿每天睡两次午觉。
words.en: A nap is a short sleep, usually during the day.

words.tr: n. 报告； v. 报告；报道；“report”的现在分词；
words.ex: The reporting of the accident was very clear.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故的报告非常清晰。
words.en: The act of giving a spoken or written account of something that one has observed, heard, done, or investigated.

words.ex: There is a correlation between exercise and good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间存在相关性。
words.en: A correlation between things is a connection or link between them.

words.ex: The shopkeeper will evaluate the old watch.
words.ex_cn: 店主将估价这块旧手表。
words.en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

words.ex: Dopamine makes us feel happy when we succeed.
words.ex_cn: 当我们成功时，多巴胺让我们感到快乐。
words.en: A neurotransmitter in the brain that is involved in the regulation of movement, emotion, motivation, and pleasure.

words.ex: He walked quietly into the room.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地走进了房间。
words.en: In a manner that does not attract attention; silently or calmly.

words.ex: He is solving a math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解决一个数学问题。
words.en: To find an answer to a problem or to deal with a difficult situation.

words.tr: v. 认为；以为；相信； n. 相信( belief的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He believes the weather will be sunny tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他认为明天天气会晴朗。
words.en: If you believe something, you think it is true, correct, or real.

words.tr: v. 规定；开药方；“prescribe”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 规定的；法定的；
words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for the cough.
words.ex_cn: 医生规定了治疗咳嗽的药物。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.tr:
n. 青少年；
adj. 青少年的；
words.ex: The adolescent walked to school with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年和朋友们一起走路去上学。
words.en: An adolescent is a young person who is developing into an adult.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his hip.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤到了臀部。
words.en: The hip is the area on each side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

words.tr: n. 园艺（学）； v. 从事园艺；“garden”的现在分词；
words.ex: He enjoys gardening in his backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在后院做园艺。
words.en: The activity of tending and cultivating a garden, especially as a pastime.

words.ex: He felt isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤立。
words.en: The state of being in a place or situation that is separate from others

words.ex: The cafe knows its regulars by name.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆认识它的常客的名字。
words.en: Regulars refers to people who frequently visit a particular place or who are members of a regular army.

words.tr: v. （使）燃烧； n. 烧伤；烧伤，烧痕( burn的名词复数 ) v. （使）燃烧( burn的；
words.ex: The match burns the paper.
words.ex_cn: 火柴点燃了纸。
words.en: If you burn something, you destroy or damage it with fire. A burn is an injury caused by fire or by something very hot.

words.tr: adv. 适度地；不过分地；有节制地；
words.ex: He eats moderately to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他适度饮食以保持健康。
words.en: In a manner that is neither too much nor too little; to a moderate extent.

words.tr:
n. 东南；
adj. 位于东南的；向东南的；
words.ex: The storm came from the southeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东南方向。
words.en: The southeast is the direction which is halfway between south and east.

words.ex: He is a strong comer in the talent show.
words.ex_cn: 他在才艺比赛中是个有成功希望的人。
words.en: A comer is someone who arrives somewhere or someone who is likely to be successful in the future.

words.ex: The fans sat in the pavilion to watch the game.
words.ex_cn: 观众坐在看台上观看比赛。
words.en: A pavilion is a building or tent used for a specific purpose, such as entertainment or exhibitions, often found in parks or at fairs.

words.ex: The cricketers played a match last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 板球运动员上星期天打了一场比赛。
words.en: Cricketers are people who play cricket, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The baseball player made three fast pitches.
words.ex_cn: 这位棒球运动员投了三个快速投球。
words.en: 1. To throw something with a quick movement of the arm. 2. To try to persuade someone to buy something, accept an idea, etc. 3. To set up a tent or a similar structure.

words.tr: adj. 功能的；起作用的；实用的；
words.ex: This chair is functional and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子功能性强且舒适。
words.en: Relating to the way in which something works or operates.

words.ex: He makes monthly payments for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付汽车费用。
words.en: Payments refer to the act of paying money or something that is paid.

words.ex: His persuasion helped me change my mind.
words.ex_cn: 他的说服让我改变了主意。
words.en: Persuasion is the act of persuading someone to do something or to believe that something is true.

words.ex: The trams run every ten minutes in the city.
words.ex_cn: 城市里的电车每十分钟一班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that runs on tracks along public streets and is used to carry passengers, especially in cities.

words.ex: The organisers gave out tickets at the door.
words.ex_cn: 组织者在门口分发门票。
words.en: People who plan and arrange an event or activity.

words.ex: He lacked the money to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他缺乏买食物的钱。
words.en: If someone or something lacks a particular quality or thing, they do not have it or do not have enough of it.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.ex: This paper is thinner than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸比那张薄。
words.en: Comparative of thin; having less thickness, width, or density than something else.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.tr: adj. 干的；干燥的； v. 变干；“dry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She ate dried fruit for a snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃干果当零食。
words.en: If something is dried, it has had all the moisture removed from it, often to preserve it.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.ex: My joints hurt when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，我的关节会疼。
words.en: Joints are the places where two parts of something are joined together, especially where two bones are connected in a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: The sailor fixed the rope on the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手修理了船上的绳子。
words.en: A sailor is a person who works on a ship as a member of its crew.

words.ex: The burden was borne by the old man.
words.ex_cn: 这个负担由老人承担了。
words.en: Carried or transported by the specified means; caused or supported by.

words.tr: v. 找出位置；定位；“locate”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is locating the lost keys on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他正在桌上找出丢失的钥匙。
words.en: To locate means to find the exact position of something or someone.

words.tr: v. 打猎 (hunt的过去式和过去分词)；猎取；搜寻；寻找；打猎( hunt的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The men hunted deer in the forest last winter.
words.ex_cn: 这些人去年冬天在森林里打猎鹿。
words.en: Hunted is the past tense and past participle of hunt, which means to chase and kill wild animals for food or sport, or to search for something or someone.

words.ex: Rats ran across the kitchen floor.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠跑过了厨房地板。
words.en: Rats are small rodents that are often considered pests.

words.tr: v. （尤指坏事或不欲之事）泛滥；超过（范围）；超过（范围）( overrun的过去式 )；
words.ex: The flood overran the small village.
words.ex_cn: 洪水泛滥了这个小村庄。
words.en: If an army or a group of people overruns a place, they take control of it by force. If an event overruns, it continues for longer than it was intended to.

words.ex: The cows graze on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Grassland is a large open area of country covered with grass, especially one used for grazing.

words.ex: The farmer worked on the plantation every day.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天在耕地上劳作。
words.en: A plantation is a large piece of land, especially in a tropical country, where crops such as coffee, sugar, rubber, or tobacco are grown.

words.ex: The drummer changed the tempo of the song.
words.ex_cn: 鼓手改变了这首歌的拍子。
words.en: The speed at which a piece of music is played or the rate or speed of motion or activity.

words.ex: He attends school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天上学。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 发票；发货单；
v. 开发票；记清单；
words.ex: He paid the bill after receiving the invoice.
words.ex_cn: 他收到发票后付了款。
words.en: An invoice is a document that lists goods or services that have been provided and says how much money you owe for them.

words.ex: He stayed home because of sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: A particular illness or disease.

words.ex: The twinning of the two babies was a miracle.
words.ex_cn: 这对双胞胎的出生是一个奇迹。
words.en: The process or state of being paired or matched closely, often used to describe the relationship between twin cities or the symmetrical growth of crystals.

words.tr: n. 主办人；主办地方；主办机构；[计算机]主机( host的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The hosts welcomed all guests with smiles.
words.ex_cn: 主办人们微笑着欢迎所有客人。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains other people as guests, or a computer that provides data or services to other computers.

words.ex: The municipal library is open every day.
words.ex_cn: 这座市政图书馆每天都开放。
words.en: Relating to a city or town or its governing body.

words.ex: The poplar trees grow tall by the river.
words.ex_cn: 白杨树在河边长得很高。
words.en: A poplar is a type of tree that grows quickly and is often planted for its wood or to provide shade.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块煎饼。
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.tr: n. 叉状物；叉（挖掘用的园艺工具）( fork的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The garden has forks for holding plants.
words.ex_cn: 花园里有用于固定植物的叉状物。
words.en: A fork is a tool used for eating or serving food, consisting of a handle with several narrow prongs on one end. It can also refer to a point where something, such as a road or river, divides into two parts.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.tr:
adj. 严格的素食主义的；
n. 严格的素食主义者；
words.ex: He is a vegan and eats only plant-based food.
words.ex_cn: 他是个严格的素食主义者，只吃植物性食物。
words.en: A vegan is someone who does not eat or use any animal products, such as meat, fish, eggs, cheese, or leather.

words.ex: He is reusing old bottles to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他正在重新使用旧瓶子来省钱。
words.en: The act of using something again, especially to reduce waste or save resources.

words.ex: The bread is stale because it was left out too long.
words.ex_cn: 面包不新鲜了，因为它放得太久。
words.en: If food or air is stale, it is no longer fresh and therefore unpleasant.

words.tr: v. 改革；改造；“reform”的现在分词；
words.ex: The government is reforming the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在改革教育体系。
words.en: The process of making changes in something in order to improve it.

words.tr: n. 印刷；印刷术； v. “print”的现在分词；
words.ex: The printing of books started long ago.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的印刷很久以前就开始了。
words.en: Printing is the process of producing texts and images, typically with ink on paper using a printing press.

words.tr: adj. 敏感的；感情脆弱的；体贴的；善解人意的；
words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: If you are sensitive to other people's needs, problems, or feelings, you understand and are aware of them.

words.tr: n. 隆起物；肿块；碰撞( bump的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The road has many bumps that make the car bounce.
words.ex_cn: 这条路有很多隆起物，让车颠簸。
words.en: Small raised areas or lumps on a surface, or the act of hitting something with force.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a drug for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了一种治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.tr: n. 药店；药房；（医院的）药房；制药( pharmacy的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The pharmacies on Main Street are open late.
words.ex_cn: 主街上的药店营业到很晚。
words.en: Pharmacies are places where medicines are prepared and sold.

words.ex: The freshness of the fruit made it delicious.
words.ex_cn: 水果的新鲜让它很好吃。
words.en: The quality of being fresh; newness or recentness; the state of being free from staleness, mustiness, or decay.

words.ex: He was predicting rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他当时预言明天会下雨。
words.en: To say that an event or action will happen in the future, especially as a result of knowledge or experience.

words.ex: He avoids gluten because it makes him sick.
words.ex_cn: 他避免食用麸质，因为它让他生病。
words.en: A protein found in wheat and some other grains; it gives dough its elasticity and helps it rise and keep its shape.

words.ex: He cannot drink milk because he is lactose intolerant.
words.ex_cn: 他不能喝牛奶，因为他乳糖不耐受。
words.en: Lactose is a sugar that is found in milk and milk products.

words.ex: He has food intolerances and avoids dairy and gluten.
words.ex_cn: 他有食物不耐受，避免食用乳制品和麸质。
words.en: The unwillingness to accept views, beliefs, or behavior that differ from one's own.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with flu last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被诊断出患了流感。
words.en: If someone or something is diagnosed as having a particular illness or problem, their illness or problem is identified. If an illness or problem is diagnosed, it is identified.

words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.ex: This smoothie is a tasty mix of fruits and yogurt.
words.ex_cn: 这种奶昔是水果和酸奶的美味混合。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance; a combination of different qualities, things, or emotions.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.ex: The cave paintings predate written history.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画早于文字历史。
words.en: To exist or occur at a date earlier than something else.

words.ex: He left the party, and subsequently went home.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，随后回家了。
words.en: If something happens subsequently, it happens after something else.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.tr: v. 嵌入；插入； adj. 插入的；嵌入的；附着的；插入( insert的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He inserted a coin into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他把一枚硬币嵌入机器中。
words.en: If you insert an object into something, you put the object inside it.

words.tr: n. 探测仪；探针；探针( probe的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The scientists used probes to collect data from deep space.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们使用探测仪从深空收集数据。
words.en: A probe is a device or tool used to explore, investigate, or measure something, especially in scientific research. It can also refer to an investigation into something.

words.tr: v. 追溯到；“date”的现在分词； n. 约会；
words.ex: This artifact is dating back to 500 BC.
words.ex_cn: 这件文物可追溯到公元前500年。
words.en: The act of going out regularly with somebody as a romantic or sexual partner.

words.tr: adj. 饱和的； v. “saturate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sponge was saturated with water.
words.ex_cn: 海绵被水浸透了。
words.en: If something is saturated, it is completely soaked with liquid or has absorbed as much of a substance as it can.

words.tr: n. 石南属植物；石南属植物（heather 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The hills are covered with heathers in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 秋天时，山丘上覆盖着石南属植物。
words.en: Low-growing shrubs with small leaves and colorful flowers.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.ex: He accumulates coins from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的硬币。
words.en: To accumulate means to gradually gather or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something.

words.ex: The acidity of lemon juice is very high.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁的酸性很强。
words.en: Acidity is the level of acid in substances such as water, soil, or wine.

words.ex: Farmers use peat to improve soil quality.
words.ex_cn: 农民用泥炭来改善土壤质量。
words.en: Peat is a brown, soil-like material consisting of partly decomposed vegetable matter forming in wet conditions in bogs and fens, and used for fuel and as a mulch.

words.ex: His deficiency in math made him struggle in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的缺乏让他在课堂上很吃力。
words.en: A deficiency is a lack or shortage of something that is needed.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.tr: n. 前辈；前身；前任；前任( predecessor的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Our predecessors built the first roads here.
words.ex_cn: 我们的前辈修建了这里的第一条道路。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.tr:
v. 落下；
adj. 点亮的；
words.ex: The bird alighted on the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟落在了树上。
words.en: If someone alights from a vehicle or if they alight, they get out of it after a journey.

words.ex: The horses graze in the small paddocks near the farm.
words.ex_cn: 马儿在农场附近的小牧场吃草。
words.en: A paddock is a small field or enclosure where horses are kept or exercised.

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.ex: The students have a rotational schedule for cleaning the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们轮流负责打扫教室。
words.en: Relating to or involving rotation; occurring in turn or sequence.

words.tr: n. 过度放牧；v. 过度放牧（overgraze 的现在分词）；
words.ex: Overgrazing damages the grassland and makes soil poor.
words.ex_cn: 过度放牧会破坏草地，使土壤贫瘠。
words.en: The excessive grazing of livestock that leads to the degradation of land.

words.tr: v. 停；息；停止；“cease”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The rain ceased after an hour.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一个小时后停了。
words.en: If something ceases, it stops happening or existing.

words.ex: He felt sadness after the abandonment of his old dream.
words.ex_cn: 在放弃旧梦想后，他感到悲伤。
words.en: The act of giving up or leaving something or someone permanently.

words.ex: The rotation of teachers helps the school run smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 教师的轮换有助于学校顺利运行。
words.en: Rotation refers to the action of rotating around an axis or center.

words.ex: The climatic changes affect the crops.
words.ex_cn: 气候的变化影响农作物。
words.en: Relating to the climate or weather conditions of a particular area.

words.ex: He feels pressures from school and family.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自学校和家庭的压力。
words.en: Pressures refer to the force or influence that is applied to someone or something, often causing stress or forcing them to act in a certain way. It can also denote the physical force exerted on an object by something in contact with it.

words.ex: The weather today is wetter than yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气比昨天更湿润多雨。
words.en: Comparative of wet: more wet.

words.ex: He felt hopeless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到毫无希望。
words.en: If you feel hopeless, you feel very unhappy because there seems to be no possibility of a better situation or success.

words.tr: adj. 令人安心的； v. “reassure”的现在分词；
words.ex: Her smile was reassuring.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑令人安心。
words.en: If you find someone's words or actions reassuring, they make you feel less worried about something.

words.ex: The car turned at the roundabout near the park.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在公园附近的环形交叉路口转弯。
words.en: A roundabout is a circular area at a place where several roads meet. You drive round it until you come to the road that you want.

words.ex: The children are playing violins in the school orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校管弦乐队中演奏小提琴。
words.en: Violins are bowed string instruments with four strings tuned in perfect fifths. They are the smallest and highest-pitched instruments in the violin family, which also includes the viola, cello, and double bass.

words.tr: v. （漫不经心地）弹（弦乐器）；（漫不经心地）弹拨；（漫不经心地）弹（弦乐器）( strum的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was strumming his guitar while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时漫不经心地弹着吉他。
words.en: to play a guitar or similar instrument by sweeping the thumb or a plectrum up or down across the strings

words.tr: n. 拇指( thumb的名词复数 ); （手套的）拇指部份
words.ex: He gave a thumbs up to show he liked it.
words.ex_cn: 他竖起大拇指表示他喜欢。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is in the opposite direction to the other fingers and is used for grasping and holding.

words.tr: n. 拍手；掌声；拍手声；<医> 拍打法（按摩的一种手法） v. 拍手( clap的现在分词；
words.ex: The audience started clapping after the performance.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众开始拍手。
words.en: The act of striking the palms of the hands together to make a loud sound, often as a form of appreciation or encouragement.

words.tr: n. （十三到十九岁的）青少年
words.ex: The teenager walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年每天步行上学。
words.en: A teenager is someone who is between thirteen and nineteen years old.

words.ex: He wants to pursue his dream of becoming a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他想追求成为作家的梦想。
words.en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

words.ex: The hospital is a public institution.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家公共机构。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: The doctor used a laser to fix her eye.
words.ex_cn: 医生用激光修复了她的眼睛。
words.en: A laser is a device that emits light through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: His blindness made him rely on his hearing.
words.ex_cn: 他的失明让他依赖听觉。
words.en: Blindness is the condition of being unable to see because of injury, disease, or a congenital condition.

words.tr:
adj. 警觉的；警惕的；
n. 警报；
v. （使）警惕；（使）戒备；
words.ex: The alert guard noticed the strange movement.
words.ex_cn: 这位警觉的警卫注意到了奇怪的动静。
words.en: If you are alert, you are paying full attention to things around you and are able to deal with anything that might happen.

words.tr: adj. 仓促而就的，草率的；忙碌的; v. 迅速移动；匆忙行事；突袭（rush 的过去式和过去分词...
words.ex: The rushed report had many mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 这份仓促写成的报告有很多错误。
words.en: Done or completed too quickly and without enough thought or preparation.

words.ex: The helmsman steered the boat through the waves.
words.ex_cn: 舵手驾船穿过波浪。
words.en: A helmsman is a person who steers a ship or boat.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.tr: v. 感到恐慌；惊慌失措；
words.ex: He started panicking when he lost his wallet.
words.ex_cn: 当他丢失钱包时，他开始感到恐慌。
words.en: Experiencing sudden uncontrollable fear or anxiety, often causing wildly unthinking behavior.

words.ex: The accident caused many casualties.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了许多伤亡人员。
words.en: A casualty is a person who is killed or injured in a war or in an accident.

words.ex: The climbers grabbed the ropes to climb the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者抓住绳索来爬山。
words.en: Ropes are thick, strong strings made by twisting together several thinner strings. They are used for tying, pulling, or climbing.

words.tr: n. 结；结( knot的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by looping a piece of string, rope, or something similar on itself and tightening it.

words.ex: He filled the tank with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把罐子装满了水。
words.en: A tank is a large container for holding liquid or gas, or a heavily armored fighting vehicle carrying guns and moving on a continuous articulated metal track.

words.ex: The weather is colder today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气更冷了。
words.en: Comparative form of cold; having a lower temperature.

words.tr: v. 发电子邮件；“e-mail”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He e-mailed me the homework last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚给我发邮件发送了作业。
words.en: To send an electronic message from one computer user to one or more recipients via a network.

words.ex: The scruffy dog wandered around the alley.
words.ex_cn: 那只邋遢的狗在小巷里游荡。
words.en: If someone or something is scruffy, they are untidy and look a little dirty.

words.ex: She wore heeled shoes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了带跟的鞋子去参加派对。
words.en: adj. Having a heel or heels; armed.

words.ex: He bought a pair of suede shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一双绒面革鞋。
words.en: Suede is a type of leather with a napped finish, commonly used for jackets, shoes, and furniture.

words.ex: The walls are beige.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁是米黄色的。
words.en: A pale sandy yellowish-brown color.

words.tr: adj. 玷污的； v. “stain”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The white shirt was stained with coffee.
words.ex_cn: 这件白衬衫被咖啡弄脏了。
words.en: Something that is stained has been marked or discolored, often in a way that is considered unattractive or undesirable.

words.ex: He twisted his ankle while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时扭伤了脚踝。
words.en: The joint between the foot and the leg, in which movement occurs in two planes.

words.ex: He threw the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A bin is a container that you put rubbish in.

words.tr: n. 鞋底；鞋底( sole的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The soles of my shoes are worn out.
words.ex_cn: 我的鞋底已经磨破了。
words.en: The undersurface of a person's foot or of a shoe.

words.ex: He refused to eat the broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

words.ex: He loves zoology and studies animals in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱动物学，研究野外的动物。
words.en: Zoology is the scientific study of animals.

words.ex: Invertebrates live in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 无脊椎动物生活在海洋中。
words.en: Invertebrates are animals that do not have a backbone or spinal column. This group includes animals such as insects, spiders, worms, jellyfish, and mollusks.

words.ex: The dog belongs to a phylum called chordata.
words.ex_cn: 狗属于一个叫做脊索动物门的门。
words.en: A major taxonomic group of organisms, ranking above a class and below a kingdom, and comprising organisms that share a common set of characteristics.

words.tr: n. 缓步动物门（一类微小的水生动物，俗称水熊虫）；
words.ex: Tardigrada can survive in extreme environments like space.
words.ex_cn: 缓步动物门能在太空等极端环境中生存。
words.en: Tardigrada, commonly known as water bears or moss piglets, are a phylum of water-dwelling, eight-legged, segmented micro-animals.

words.tr: v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；
words.ex: Plants thrive in sunny places.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。
words.en: To thrive means to grow or develop well or vigorously.

words.tr: vt. 看（view的过去式与过去分词形式）
words.ex: He viewed the painting quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地观看了那幅画。
words.en: To look at or consider something in a particular way.

words.tr: v. 创造；制造硬币( coin的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He coined a new word for the invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项发明创造了一个新词。
words.en: To coin a word or phrase means to invent it.

words.ex: He poured water into a wooden barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进一个木桶里。
words.en: A barrel is a large, round container for liquids or food, typically made of wood or metal.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and two coaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和两名教练。
words.en: Consists of or is made up of specific parts or elements.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.tr: n. 唱片；磁盘；圆盘；背脊骨间的软骨层；圆盘( disc的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He collected old discs from the 1980s.
words.ex_cn: 他收藏了20世纪80年代的老唱片。
words.en: A disc is a flat, circular shape or object. In the context of music or computers, it refers to a record or a disk used for storing data.

words.ex: The vacuum cleaner uses suction to pick up dust.
words.ex_cn: 吸尘器利用吸力来吸走灰尘。
words.en: Suction is the process by which liquids, gases, or small particles are drawn into a space or device because the pressure inside is lower than the pressure outside.

words.ex: The child clings to his mother's leg.
words.ex_cn: 孩子紧贴着妈妈的腿。
words.en: If you cling to someone or something, you hold onto them tightly.

words.tr:
n. 紧握；掌握；控制；
v. 紧握；掌握；
words.ex: He has a strong grip on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住把手。
words.en: To grip something means to hold it tightly. It can also mean to hold someone's attention completely.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put into as much as can be held.

words.ex: The dentist found a cavity in his tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医在他的牙齿上发现了一个腔。
words.en: A cavity is a hole or space inside something.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗很可爱。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.ex: The children ran outwards from the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从房子里向外跑。
words.en: Moving or facing away from the center or a particular point; towards the outside.

words.tr: n. 细探针；细长针；细长针（stylet的复数形式）；
words.ex: The doctor used stylets to examine the tissue.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用细探针检查组织。
words.en: A stylet is a slender, pointed instrument, typically used by surgeons to guide catheters or by insects to pierce plant tissues.

words.ex: The needle will pierce the skin.
words.ex_cn: 针会刺穿皮肤。
words.en: If a sharp object pierces something, or if you pierce something with a sharp object, the object goes into it and makes a hole in it.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

words.ex: The highs of his career came when he won the championship.
words.ex_cn: 他职业生涯的高水平出现在他赢得冠军的时候。
words.en: Highs refer to the highest points or levels achieved in a particular context, such as in prices, temperatures, or emotions.

words.tr: n. 人；生物；生物（ being的名词复数 ）；
words.ex: All human beings want to be happy.
words.ex_cn: 所有人类都希望快乐。
words.en: Plural of being: a living creature; existence or reality.

words.ex: The asteroid flew past Earth safely.
words.ex_cn: 这颗小行星安全地从地球旁飞过。
words.en: An asteroid is a small rocky body orbiting the sun. Large numbers of these, ranging enormously in size, are found between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, though some have more eccentric orbits.

words.ex: She curls her hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上卷头发。
words.en: To form into a spiral or curved shape; a piece of hair that grows in a curved shape.

words.ex: The beer was stored in a large tun.
words.ex_cn: 啤酒被储存在一个大酒桶里。
words.en: A large cask, especially one for holding liquids such as beer or wine.

words.ex: The cat is retracting its claws.
words.ex_cn: 猫正在缩回它的爪子。
words.en: To retract means to take back or withdraw something that has been said or done.

words.ex: His metabolism is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的新陈代谢非常快。
words.en: Metabolism is the set of life-sustaining chemical transformations within the cells of living organisms.

words.tr:
v. 降低；落下；
n. 落下；
words.ex: The temperature drops at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度降低。
words.en: 1. a small round or pear-shaped portion of liquid that hangs or falls, or adheres to a surface. 2. to let or make something fall vertically. 3. a small quantity of liquid.

words.ex: The helmet protects his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: Water and oil are liquids.
words.ex_cn: 水和油是液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr: v. 咀嚼；“chew” 现在分词；
words.ex: He is chewing gum quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在安静地咀嚼口香糖。
words.en: The act of biting and grinding food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

words.ex: The baby suck milk from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿从奶瓶里吮吸牛奶。
words.en: To draw something into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 果汁；汁；汁( juice的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He drinks orange juices every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝橙汁。
words.en: Liquids extracted from fruits or vegetables, often consumed as drinks.

words.ex: The stone is covered with green moss.
words.ex_cn: 石头上覆盖着绿色的苔藓。
words.en: Moss is a small, green plant that grows in damp, shady places, often forming a soft, thick layer on the ground, trees, or rocks.

words.tr: v. 由...组成；包含；由...组成（过去式和过去分词形式，通常用于被动语态，如 be comprised of）；
words.ex: The team is comprised of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: Formed or constituted by the combination of parts or elements; made up of.

words.ex: The apple is coated with sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果裹了一层糖。
words.en: Covered with a layer of a particular substance.

words.ex: She applied hair gel to style her hair.
words.ex_cn: 她用了发胶来造型头发。
words.en: A gel is a thick, jelly-like substance, especially one used to style hair.

words.ex: Many animal extinctions are caused by human activities.
words.ex_cn: 许多动物的灭绝是由人类活动引起的。
words.en: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being or becoming extinct.

words.tr: n. 沉淀物；沉淀物 v. 安排( settle的现在分词 )； v. 安家；安排；（使）安定；
words.ex: The settling at the bottom of the jar is normal.
words.ex_cn: 瓶底的沉淀物是正常的。
words.en: The process by which particles suspended in a fluid descend under the influence of gravity to form a sediment, or the act of resolving a dispute or reaching an agreement.

words.ex: We ate grilled prawns for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们晚餐吃了烤大虾。
words.en: Prawns are large shrimp that are often used in cooking.

words.ex: She picked samphire from the rocky coast.
words.ex_cn: 她从岩石海岸采摘了海蓬子。
words.en: A fleshy-leaved plant that grows near the sea, often used in cooking for its salty flavor.

words.ex: A handful of students stayed after class to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 少数学生课后留下来提问。
words.en: A handful of something is a small amount of it, especially when it is not enough or when it is difficult to manage.

words.ex: He fries fish in a pan every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日用平底锅油炸鱼。
words.en: To cook something in hot fat or oil, or to be cooked in this way.

words.ex: The cake tastes delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕味道很美味。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as delicious, you mean that it has a very pleasant taste.

words.tr: n. 豆；豆( bean的名词复数 )；[亦用复数][口语][通常用于否定结构]丝毫；[复数][美国；
words.ex: He eats beans for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃豆子。
words.en: Beans are the seeds of certain types of plants which are eaten as food. They are a good source of protein and fiber.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: He eats a ripe mango every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个熟透的芒果。
words.en: A mango is a large sweet yellowish fruit which grows on a tree in hot countries.

words.ex: He ate a sweet melon for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块甜瓜当甜点。
words.en: A melon is a large, juicy fruit with a hard rind, belonging to the gourd family, typically eaten fresh.

words.ex: He ate a coconut for snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一个椰子当零食。
words.en: A coconut is the large brown seed of a tropical tree, which has a hard shell containing white flesh that you can eat and a clear liquid that you can drink.

words.ex: She baked apple tarts for the family picnic.
words.ex_cn: 她为家庭野餐烤了苹果果馅饼。
words.en: A tart is a baked dish consisting of a filling over a pastry base with an open top not covered with pastry. The pastry is usually shortcrust pastry; the filling may be sweet or savory, though modern tarts are usually fruit-based, sometimes with custard.

words.ex: He eats a strawberry every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗草莓。
words.en: A strawberry is a small red fruit which is soft and juicy and has tiny yellow seeds on its surface.

words.ex: He is deaf and uses sign language to communicate.
words.ex_cn: 他是聋的，使用手语交流。
words.en: If someone is deaf, they cannot hear anything, or they cannot hear very well.

words.ex: He is an illustrator who draws pictures for children's books.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位为儿童书籍画画的插画师。
words.en: An illustrator is an artist who draws pictures, especially for books.

words.ex: The faraway village is hard to reach.
words.ex_cn: 那个遥远的村庄很难到达。
words.en: A faraway place is a long distance away from where you are.

words.tr: adj. 有抱负的；有志向的； v. “aspire”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is an aspiring writer who dreams of publishing a novel.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有抱负的作家，梦想出版一部小说。
words.en: If you use aspiring to describe someone who is starting a particular career, you mean that they are trying to become successful in it.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的；使人愉快的； v. 款待；“entertain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an entertaining show.
words.ex_cn: 小丑表演了一场有趣的节目。
words.en: Providing amusement or enjoyment.

words.tr: n. 表示友谊的事例；友谊（friendship 的复数）；
words.ex: Childhood friendships often last a lifetime.
words.ex_cn: 童年的友谊常常持续一生。
words.en: Friendships are relationships between people who are friends, characterized by mutual affection, trust, and support.

words.ex: He asks questions in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上提问。
words.en: Requests information or expresses a question.

words.ex: He felt loneliness after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤独。
words.en: Loneliness is the unhappiness that is felt by someone because they do not have any friends or do not have anyone to talk to.

words.tr: adj. 激发同情心的，暖人心房的
words.ex: The letter was heart-warming.
words.ex_cn: 这封信很暖心。
words.en: Something that is heart-warming causes you to feel happy, usually because it involves kindness or love.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: The children screamed with joy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们因喜悦而尖叫。
words.en: Joy is a feeling of great happiness.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: She danced beautifully at the party.
words.ex_cn: 她在派对上漂亮地跳舞。
words.en: In a way that is pleasing to the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.ex: He kept mentioning his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他一直提到他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: The act of referring to something briefly or casually.

words.ex: He made good deals at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上做了几笔不错的交易。
words.en: Deals can refer to agreements or arrangements between parties, especially in business, or the act of distributing or handling something.

words.ex: Immigration to this country has increased recently.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的移民数量最近增加了。
words.en: Immigration is the act of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own.

words.ex: The fence is a barrier to animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏是动物的障碍。
words.en: A barrier is something such as a rule, law, or policy that makes it difficult or impossible for something to happen or be achieved.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；喊叫；
v. 哭；哭泣；
words.ex: His cry woke up the whole house.
words.ex_cn: 他的哭泣惊醒了整个房子。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain; to shout or scream, typically to express fear, pain, or grief.

words.ex: The children's laughter filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的笑声充满了房间。
words.en: The sound of people laughing, especially when it is loud and continuous.

words.ex: The movie was hilarious and made us laugh a lot.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影非常搞笑，让我们笑得很开心。
words.en: If you describe something as hilarious, you mean that it is extremely funny and it makes you laugh a lot.

words.ex: He learns English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习英语。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.ex: Phone notifications are common distractions while studying.
words.ex_cn: 手机通知是学习时常见的分心因素。
words.en: Something that prevents someone from concentrating on something else.

words.ex: He listens to audiobooks while driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车时听有声书。
words.en: Audiobooks are recordings of books or other works being read aloud, which can be listened to rather than read.

words.tr: n. <法>（文学、艺术等的）类型，体裁，风格( genre的名词复数 )
words.ex: He likes different genres of music.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢不同类型的音乐。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.tr: adj. 令人抑郁的；令人沮丧的；令人消沉的； v. “depress”的现在分词；
words.ex: The rainy weather made the day feel depressing.
words.ex_cn: 阴雨的天气让这一天感觉令人抑郁。
words.en: Making someone feel very unhappy and without hope.

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.ex: The bridge is linking the two cities.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接着两座城市。
words.en: The act of making a connection between two or more things, or the connection itself.

words.tr: adj. 令人不快（或忧虑、苦恼）的； v. “upset”的现在分词；
words.ex: The news was upsetting to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让每个人都感到不快。
words.en: If something is upsetting, it makes you feel unhappy, disappointed, or worried.

words.ex: The chemical harmed the fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 这种化学物质伤害了河里的鱼。
words.en: If someone or something is harmed, they are hurt in some way, or damage is caused to them.

words.tr: v. “breed”的过去式和过去分词；培育；繁殖；
words.ex: The dogs were bred to be friendly and smart.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗被培育得友好而聪明。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.tr: v. 研究；调查；调查( investigate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The police are investigating the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察正在调查这起事故。
words.en: Examining or inquiring into something systematically.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.tr:
n. 标签；标记；
v. 加标签于；
words.ex: The tag on the shirt says 'wash cold'.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫上的标签写着‘冷水洗涤’。
words.en: A tag is a small piece of card, cloth, or plastic which is attached to an object or person and has information about that object or person on it. A tag can also be a word or phrase that is used to describe or identify something, especially in a computer file or on a website.

words.ex: The bird lives in a small cage.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟住在一个小笼子里。
words.en: A cage is a structure of wire or metal bars in which birds or animals are kept.

words.ex: The doctor will weigh the baby at the clinic.
words.ex_cn: 医生将在诊所称量婴儿的体重。
words.en: To weigh something means to measure how heavy it is, usually by using scales. It can also mean to consider something carefully before making a decision.

words.ex: The deviation from the plan caused delays.
words.ex_cn: 偏离计划导致了延误。
words.en: A deviation is a noticeable difference from what is expected or from a standard.

words.tr:
n. 淡水；
adj. 淡水的；
words.ex: Fish live in freshwater lakes.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在淡水湖中。
words.en: Freshwater refers to water that is not salty, especially water in rivers and lakes.

words.tr: n.微纤维（microfibre 的名词复数）
words.ex: The cloth traps microfibres from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这块布能捕捉织物中的微纤维。
words.en: Very fine synthetic fibres used in clothing and cleaning cloths.

words.ex: He tried to detach himself from the group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图脱离这个群体。
words.en: If you detach one thing from another that it is fixed to, you remove it. If one thing detaches from another, it becomes separated from it.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: The car needs new tyres because they are worn out.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车需要新轮胎，因为它们已经磨坏了。
words.en: Tyres are the rubber coverings that are placed around the wheels of vehicles in order to provide traction and reduce road shocks.

words.tr: n. 影响；影响（impact 的复数）； v. 对……产生不良影响；
words.ex: The impacts of pollution are clear on the river.
words.ex_cn: 污染对河流的影响是显而易见的。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: v. 牵涉；使参与；表明（某人参与了罪行等）( involve的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The accident is involving two cars.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故牵涉到两辆车。
words.en: If a situation or activity is described as involving, it requires a lot of effort and attention.

words.ex: He washed his mouth after eating.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完饭后洗了嘴。
words.en: The opening in the lower part of the human face, surrounded by the lips, through which food is taken in and sound is uttered.

words.ex: Too much alcohol is impairing his judgment.
words.ex_cn: 过多的酒精正在削弱他的判断力。
words.en: If something impairs something such as an ability or the way something works, it damages it or makes it worse.

words.tr: v. 埋入；存放( lodge的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The bullet was lodged in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 子弹嵌入了墙里。
words.en: Having submitted a formal complaint or report.

words.tr: v. 发现； vt. [无]对…检波 v. 发现，发觉，查明( detect的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The sensor detected a small movement.
words.ex_cn: 传感器发现了一个轻微的移动。
words.en: If something is detected, it is noticed or discovered, often as a result of an investigation or because of special equipment.

words.ex: The teacher underlined the key point.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了这个关键点。
words.en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, especially in order to emphasize it.

words.ex: The math teacher asked for a proof of the theorem.
words.ex_cn: 数学老师要求给出这个定理的证明。
words.en: Proof is a fact, argument, or piece of evidence which shows that something is definitely true or definitely exists.

words.ex: The helmet prevents head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 头盔能防止头部受伤。
words.en: To stop something from happening or someone from doing something.

words.tr: n. 塑料微球（由聚乙烯或聚丙烯制成，常用于个人护理产品中）；
words.ex: Many cosmetics contain microbeads that pollute rivers.
words.ex_cn: 许多化妆品含有会污染河流的塑料微球。
words.en: Microbeads are tiny pieces of plastic that are used in some personal care products for exfoliation.

words.tr: n. 凝胶；冻胶；凝胶，冻胶( gel的名词复数 ) v. 形成胶体( gel的第三人称单数 )；
words.ex: She applied hair gels to style her hair.
words.ex_cn: 她用了发胶来造型头发。
words.en: Gels are semi-solid systems consisting of a network of solid particles or molecules dispersed in a liquid. They can also refer to the process of becoming a gel.
